rgyas gyur/ /srid mtha'i bar gyi nyam thag bcings pa rnams/ /zhi ba rgya chen 'jigs med sgrol bar shog /ces pa lta bu bsngo ba la sems skyed du btags pa lta bu skabs du mar yod la/ sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i blo la yang bdag 'jig rten 'dren pa med pa rnams kyi 'dren par gyur cig /ces sogs rgyal po rang nyid rgyal sar phyung nas 'bangs la khrims bca' bar 'dod pa lta bu rgyal po lta bu'i sems skyed dang / dge ba 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas 'thob par gyur cig ces bsngos pa mnyan pa bdag gzhan lhan cig tu pha rol tu phyin 'dod pa lta bu'i sems dang / bdag ni byang chub rings tshul du/ /'tshang rgyar mos shing spro ba med/ /sems can gcig gi don du yang / /phyi mtha'i bar du gnas par bgyi/ /zhes pa lta bu bdag don la mi rtog pa rdzi bo lta bu'i sems skyed pa ste du mar yod la/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams ni byang chub 'dod par mi byed de byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ khye'u rin chen byin skyes nas lo gsum lon pa ston pa thugs dang po bskyed pa'i tshe des bzod pa thob nas bskal ba sum 'bum lon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des ston pa srang du gshegs pa na ma ma'i phang pa nas mchongs te rtse ba'i yo byad kyi gser gyi pad+ma de bzhin gshegs pa la phul nas/ de phyir me tog phul ba 'dis/ /bdag la rnam smin 'bras ma gyur/ /dngos po thams cad gcod slad du/ /pad+ma 'di ni bdag gis phul/ /zhes rnam smin med par bsngos pa dang / tshangs pa khyad par sems kyi mdo las/ li tsā wi dra ba can gyi 'od ston pas byang chub tu lung bstan pa'i tshe/ des bdag ni 311

byang chub mi 'dod byang chub tu mi rtog 'tshang rgya bar mi 'dod na ci'i slad du lung bstan/ bka' bstsal pa/ dper na mi zhig gis me chen po sbar te rtswa dang shing dang sbar sbur dag 'dzud par byed cing 'tshig par ma gyur cig ces zer na de 'tshig par mi 'gyur ram/ gsol ba de ni ma lags te 'tshig par 'gyur ro/ /bka' bstsal ba/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dang bla med dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher bsags te byang chub mi dmigs mi 'dod na yang byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes sogs rgya cher bshad pas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' lta bu rnams kyi sems skyed kyi rgya mtsho mtha' yas pas 'jug pa ni rang cag byis pa rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin no/ /'o na sangs rgyas 'thob par mi 'dod na smon sems btang bar 'gyur ro zhe na sngar sangs rgyas de dngos por 'dzin pa las log ste nam mkha' la thob ma thob mi dmigs pa ltar shes pas gang 'thob pa dang gang gis 'thob pa sogs kyi dngos 'dzin log pas don dam sems skyed kyi ming du 'phos pa yin gyi smon pa btang ba ni dngos 'dzin gyi bye brag kho na'o/ /gzhan yang skyes bu dam pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams mthong ba na de lta bur bdag nyid smon par byed pa yang rjes su mthun pa'i byang chub kyi sems tsam du 'gyur te mi skye ba'i bzod par bsngos pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni ring du 'khor ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /phra rags kyis dbye na rags pa brda las byung ba dang phra ba chos nyid kyis thob pa ste deng sang ni cho gas skye ba dang sgom stobs kyis skye ba la grags so/ /cho ga las skyes pa byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob par 312

khas blangs pa'i stobs kyis thob pa ni skabs 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa zhes bya ste/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni skyed bgyi zhing / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du slob par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i/ byang chub thugs ni skyed bgyi zhing / /zhes pas sems skyed dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du slob par bgyi/ /zhes pas byang sdom ste gnyis ka lhan cig tu len pa'o/ /yang na dang por/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni skyed par bgyi/ /zhes khas blangs pa ni sems skyed yin la byang sdom ma yin pa'i mu ste 'di la byang chub 'thob pa'i ched du sbyin sogs la brtson na 'jug sems dang / sems tsam bskyed la brtson pa mi byed na smon rkyang ste 'di dag la rang stobs kyis skyes pa dang gzhan rkyen gyis skyes pa dang khas blangs kyis skyes pa ste sna tshogs pa yod do/ /yang dang por sems skyed thob pa zhig phyis byang sdom kho na len par 'dod nas/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du slob par bgyi/ /zhes khas blangs pa ni byang sdom kho na len pa'i mu'o/ /mdor na gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i phyir spang bya spong sems dang bsgrub bya sgrub sems kyi blo brtan por skyes pa 313

mtshan gzhi/ byang sdom yin par mtshon/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i ched du byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob par dam bcas pa'i sems khyad par can mtshan nyid do/ /dbye na tshul khrims rnam pa gsum ste mi mthun phyogs spong ba sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang rang rgyud la dge ba sgrub pa dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang gzhan la phan bde sgrub pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims te lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yin la/des sems ting nge 'dzin thob pa lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de las chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab thob pa lhag pa'i shes rab ste rgyu dang 'bras bu'i go rim med na mi 'byung du gnas so/ /'dir legs bshad bsdus par/ gzhan don du byang sdom gyi cho gas blangs pa'i sems pa dge ba rgyun chags byang sdom gyi mtshan nyid/ de yang gzhan don du byang sdom gyi zhes pas dman pa'i sdom pa gsal/ sems pa dge ba zhes pas sdom min bsal/ rgyun chags zhes pas bar ma'i dge ba bsal bar 'dod kyang / ma nges te/ sa brgyad pa'i byang sems 'gog pa la mnyam par bzhag pa'i gnas skabs kyi de rgyud kyi byang sdom chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal te byang sdom yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sems pa dge ba rgyun chags can yin par thal/ gzhan don du byang sdom gyi cho gas blangs pa'i sems pa dge ba rgyun chags canaḥyin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na de de ma yin par thal sems sems byung gi rgyu ba dang bral ba'i phyir te/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug la snyoms par zhugs pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang byang sdom gyi bya ba'i gtso bo gzhan don yin pas byang sdom gyi cho gas blangs pa zhes pas 314

gzhan don don gnyer du 'grub pa'i phyir de zur du smos pa'ang zlos pa'i skyon no/ /yang sa bzang pas/ sems skyed ni sngar bshad pa ltar smon 'jug gnyis ku'i bdag nyid can yin la/ sdom pa ni lus dang longs spyod la ltos pa med par sgo gsum gyis rnam pa thams cad du gzhan la phan par zhugs pa 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can te theg pa chen po pa'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i tshul khrims so zhes zer ba yang dpyad pa'i gzhi ste lus dang longs spyod la ltos pa med par sgo gsum gyis rnam pa thams cad du gzhan la phan par zhugs pa de brten pa sdom pa'i chos yin nam rten gang zag gi chos yin/ dang po ltar na sdom pa rang gi lus dang longs spyod la ltos pa med par sgo gsum gyis gzhan phan byed pa de byang chub sems dpa' las kyang ngo mtshar che'o/ /gnyis pa ltar na byang sdom rgyud ldan thams cad lus dang longs spyod la ltos pa med par sgo gsum gyis rnam pa thams cad du gzhan la phan par zhugs pa yin na ra dang ri dwags kyi shing rtas 'gro ba lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' mi srid pa dang byang chub sems dpa' phyir ldog pa mi srid pa dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dbang po yongs su smin pa sha stag tu thal bas 'di 'grub na smon pa'i gnas su bzang yang mi 'grub ste lha chen po dang sgra chen po dang snying stobs chen po mched gsum gyis stag mo bkres pa bu bcas mthong ba na yang su rang gi shas 'di'i bkres pa sel ba su yod ces gleng ba na gcen gnyis kyis de lta bu sus kyang mi nus so zhes smras shing gcung gis rang cag rnams lta bu la dka' ba yin mod kyi skyes bu chen po tshe rabs mang 315

por goms pa rnams la de lta bu ga la dka' zhes smras shing mthar gcen gnyis brid de rang gi lus byin pa'i 'og tu gcen gnyis kyis kyang / 'di yis bdag gi nyes pa bsgrags pa snyam/ /zhes brjod par bshad pa'i phyir dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyid kyi nang tshan gyi dbang po rno brtul dang brtson pa che chung dang thabs la mkhas mi mkhas kyi khyad par mtha' yas pa de lta bu ni sems can gyi khams gzhan la ma mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /ci tshul khrims gsum po 'di dag gcis gam tha dad ce na/ spyir byed las kyi cha nas tha dad par bshad la chos kyi sbyin pa lta bu dngos sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims su 'gyur zhing rgyu des rang rgyud la dge ba'i chos sdud du 'gyur ba dang / shugs kyis de nas bstan pa ltar spang bya spong bas bdag gzhan gnyis ka la nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims skyed pa sogs re re yang brgyud nas tshul khrims gsum gar du 'gyur ba shin tu mang la dper na chu gcig gis dri ma bkru ba dang brlan pa dang ngoms pa ste byed las gsum byed pa ltar don gyis tshul khrims gsum gar du 'gyur ba shin tu mang ngo / /tshul khrims gsum du nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ byang sa las/nyon mongs pa med par rang gi sems gnas par byed pa dang bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su sgrub par byed pa dang sems can yongs su smin par byed pa ste byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba thams cad gsum po de dag tu zad pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /go rim yang gtso bor snga ma las phyi ma 'byung ba rgyu 'bras kyi go rim du bzhag go /bzhi pa cho ga la theg pa chen po ni nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas pas spyir bsam gyis mi khyab kyang da lta rgya 316

bod na theg chen gyi shing rta'i srol chen po rnam pa gnyis te 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis slob dpon klu sgrub rjes su bzung ste de las brgyud pa zab mo lta ba'i gzhung dang / 'phags pa byams pas slob dpon thogs med rjes su bzung ste de las brgyud pa rgya chen spyod pa'i gzhung ste gnyis yin la des na byang chub tu sems skyed pa'i cho ga'ang shing rta'i srol gnyis so/ /chos rje sa skya pas/ byang chub sems skyed cho ga yang / /dbu ma sems tsam lugs gnyis yod/ /dper na nas kyi sa bon ni/ /grang dro kun du skye ba ltar/ /de bzhin dbu ma pa yi yang / /sems skyed mchog dman kun la skye/ /dper na 'bras kyi sa bon ni/ /dro ba'i yul du skye ba ltar/ /de bzhin sems tsam pa yi yang / /sems skyed sdig can la mi skye/ /zhes sogs bshad pa ni thogs med sku mched sems tsam pa yin pas de las brgyud pa'i phyir sems tsam pa'i lugs so zhes bsams par zad mod kyang / byams pa thogs med kyis gsungs shing / /klu sgrub kyang ni bzhed pa yi/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ byams pa ni sa bcu pa la gnas pa'o thogs med ni sa gsum pa la gnas pa'o klu sgrub ni sa dang po la gnas pa'o zhes bshad pas klu sgrub sa dang po ba las thogs med sa gsum pa ba rtogs pa dma' bar yang mi rigs la/ dbyig gnyen gdul ba'i don du sems tsam gsungs par bshad pas kyang sems tsam pa dngos ma yin par grub cing dbyig gnyen gyis yum don sems tsam du bkral ba yang rang gis yum don rtogs pa sems tsam gyi lta ba'i drin las byung ba'i drin du gzo ba'i ched yin par bshad pas kyang 'grel pa rtsom dus na dbyig gnyen yang dbu 317

ma'i lta ba thugs la 'khrungs par don gyis 'phangs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang dbu sems ni lta ba'i ming yin la de yang rang rig bden par 'dod pa sems tsam pa dang de yang mi bden par 'dod pa dbu ma pa yin la sems skyed kyi cho ga 'di gnyis la rang rig khas len mi len gyi khyad par bshad pa med pa'i phyir/ dbyig gnyen sems tsam pa yin du bcug kyang de las brgyud pas sems tsam pa'i lugs su 'gyur na 'o na rgya chen spyod gzhung gi sems skyed cho ga 'di chos can dbu ma'i lugs yin par thal te dbu ma pa las brgyud pa'i phyir te 'phags grol btsun grol gnyis dbu ma pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na rgya chen spyod gzhung ni sems tsam gyi lta ba min te sems tsam gyi lta ba la nges par dbu ma'i rigs pas gnod de rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod pa'i phyir/ rgya chen spyod gzhung gis chos thams cad mtshan nyid gsum gyis gtan la phab ste dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid gtso bor 'chad pa dang /zab mo lta ba'i gzhung chos thams cad bden gnyis kyis gtan la phab ste ji ltar blos btags pa ltar mi gnas pa rang bzhin rnam dag gi stong nyid gtso bor ston pa 'di gnyis ni gcig gi nges don la gcig gi rigs pas gnod pa ma yin te gdul bya'i dbang gis 'chad tshul tha dad kyang gnyis ka las mthong ba'i lam du chos nyid mthong ba na tha dad pa ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ dpe de dag kyang byis pa mgu byed du zad de/ nas kyi sa bon chos can grang dro kun tu mi skye bar thal te ha cang grang bar mi skye ste gangs ri'i rtser mi skye ba'i phyir/ ha cang dro bar mi skye ste me'i nang du mi skye ba'i 318

phyir/ 'dod na grang dro kun du skye ba nyams so/ /sems tsam lugs kyi sems skyed sdig can la mi skye na ni so skye la mi skye bar 'gyur te sdig pa gtan med kyi so skye yang dka' ba'i phyir dang yang mtshams med byas pa lta bu'i sdig pa can 'gyod 'jigs drag pos byang chub kyi sems la 'jug na khyad par du skye rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang zab mo lta rgyud kyi cho gas sems bskyed nas slar rgya chen spyod gzhung gi sems skyed len mi rigs par thal/ de gnyis la dbu sems kyi khyad par yod la sngar dbu ma'i lta ba skyes nas phyis sems tsam par 'gyur ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang skyabs 'gro dang yan lag bdun pa dang lam gyi chos mtha' dag la dbu sems gnyis su dbye rigs par thal/ sems skyed la de ltar dbye rigs pa'i phyir/ gal te de 'dod de dbu ma'i lta bas zin pas de dag byas na dbu ma'i lugs dang sems tsam gyi lta bas zin pas byas nas sems tsam lugs su 'gyur ro snyam na 'o na dbu ma'i lta ba la gnas pas cho ga gnyis gang las sems bskyed kyang dbu ma'i lugs dang / sems tsam gyi lta ba la gnas pas lugs de gnyis gang las sems bskyed kyang sems tsam lugs su khas len dgos pas rtsa ba'i dam bca' nyams so/ /des na sems skyed kyi cho ga la dbu sems kyi gzhung tha dad du btags pa 'dis ni sems skyed gnyis po la lta ba tha dad yod par go ba dang mchog dman yod par 'khrul ba skye zhing rgya chen spyod gzhung gi skyes chen rnams la sems tsam pa'o zhes brnyas pa skye ba'i dgag bya yod pas de ltar mi 'dod par shing rta'i srol so so'i lugs zhes 'dod par bya'o/ /thun mong du gang las blang ba'i 319

yul ni/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas/ /nus dang ldan las blang bar bya/ /med na rten nam dkon mchog las/ /zhes bya ste/ 'di la gnyis te slob dpon yod pa dang med pa'o/ /de yang slob dpon gyi spyan sngar 'gro ba la srog gam tshangs spyod kyi bar chad du 'gyur ba yod na thag nye bar bzhugs kyang slob dpon med pa zhes bya ste dal 'byor gyi rten dang dge ba'i blo rnyed dka' bas na der mi 'gro bar sku gzugs sam dkon mchog las blang bar bya la/ de med na thag ring po na bzhugs kyang slob dpon yod pa zhes bya ste ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyi rten du 'gyur/ spang blang gi lung ston/ rang gi 'dod pa drir yod pa'i phyir nges par slob dpon las blang bar bya'o/ /slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni byang sdom 'bogs chog la mkhas pa/ thob la ma nyams pa/ brda sprod par nus pa/ brtse bas slob ma skyong ba ste chos bzhi ldan gyi skyes bu chen po ste/ lam sgron las/ yang dag mtshan nyid ldan pa yi/ /bla ma bzang las sdom pa blang / /sdom pa'i cho ga la mkhas dang / /bdag nyid gang zhig sdom la gnas/ /sdom pa 'bogs bzod snying rjer ldan/ /bla ma bzang por shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /yang na theg pa chen po'i tshig don la mkhas shing byang sdom brtan pa'i skyes chen te/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /sogs so/ /bla ma med na sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar smon 'jug gang len pa'i tshig rnams snying thag pa nas lan gsum du brjod pas 'thob ste/ byang sa las/ gal te yon tan dag dang ldan pa'i gang zag med par gyur na byang chub sems dpas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar bdag nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 320

khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang bar bya ste zhes so/ /sku gzugs kyang ma rnyed na mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon sum du bsgoms nas smon 'jug gang len pa'i tshig lan gsum brjod pas 'thob ste/ bslab btus las/ yang de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen med na phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon sum du bsgoms la sdom pa bdag nyid kyi stobs dang sbyar la blang bar bya ste zhes so/ /gang gis len pa'i rten ni/rigs sad skyabs song smon pa'i brten/ /so thar smon ldan 'jug pa'i rten/ /zhes bya ste/ theg pa chen po'i rigs yod cing sad pa dkon mchog la skyabs su song ba ni smon sems skye ba'i rten yin te theg chen gyi rigs med pa'am yod kyang ma sad na theg chen gyi bsam pa khyad par can mi skye ba'i phyir dang / sdom pa kun la yod mod kyi/ /skyabs su ma song ba la med / /ces grags pa'i phyir/ de'i steng du so thar ris gang rung dang ldan zhing smon pa'i sems skyes pa ni byang sdom gyi rten yin te/ sdom pa rgya chen de yi rten/ /zhes dang / lam sgron las/ so sor thar ba ris bdun gyi/ /rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi/ /skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min/ /zhes dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po khang bzang gtsang bar bzhugs su gsol rigs pa ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyal po yang sdom pas bsdams pa gtsang ba'i rgyud la bzhugs su gsol bar rigs pa'i phyir dang so thar ni gzhan gnod spong ba yin la byang sdom ni gzhan la phan 'dogs pa yin pas gnod pa las ma log par phan 321

gdags pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /thar rgyan las/ gal te gzhan dag na re so thar de byang sdom skye ba'i rten du mi 'thad de za ma dang ma ning dang lha la sogs la so thar mi skye la byang sdom skye bar bshad pa'i phyir/ gnas pa'i rten du mi 'thad de so thar ni shi 'phos pas gtong la byang sdom des mi gtong ba'i phyir ro zhe na/ lan ni so thar la bsam pa'i khyad par gyis rigs gsum yod de ris bdun po de khams gsum gyi bde ba 'dod pa'i bsam pas blangs pa legs smon gyi tshul khrims dang rang gi sdug bsngal gtan du spang bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas blangs pa nyan thos kyi nges 'byung gi tshul khrims dang byang chub chen po 'thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pas blangs pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i tshul khrims so/ /de ltar gsum las snga ma gnyis ni za ma sogs la mi skye zhing shi 'phos pas gtong la nyams na slar gso mi rung ba'i phyir byang sdom gyi rten min la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni za ma sogs la'ang skye ba dang shi 'phos kyang mi gtong ba dang nyams kyang gsor rung ba'i phyir byang sdom skye ba'i rten yang yin la gnas pa'i rten yang yin te mdo rgyan 'grel par/sems de'i rten gang zhe na byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa ni rten no zhes gsungs so/ /yang na skye ba'i rten du dgos la gnas pa'i rten du ma nges te zag med kyi sdom pa'i rten du bsam gtan gyi sdom pa bzhin no zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i so thar de yang len pa'i cho ga logs su mi dgos te sngar nyan thos kyi bslab pa blangs pa nyid bsam pa khyad par can gyis zin pa na gnas 'gyur nas byang chub sems dpa'i 322

sdom par 'gyur ba yin te dman pa'i sems btang yang spong ba'i sems pa ma btang ba'i phyir ro zhes bshad de so so thar ris bdun las gang rung len pa nyid kyi tshe sems skyed kyis zin na de byang chub sems dpa'i so thar yin pas de byang sdom gyi rten dngos yin la/ sngar legs smon nam nges 'byung gis blangs pa yin kyang sems skyed pa na 'khor ba'i bde ba 'thob 'dod dang rang don du zhi ba 'thob 'dod dang bral zhing gzhan don du byang chub 'thob 'dod du gnas 'gyur la spong sems 'dor ba'i phyir de nyid byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i tshul khrims su gyur pas byang sdom gyi rten du rung ba'o/ /snga ma gnyis byang sdom gyi rten ma yin zhes pa yang dman pa'i bsam pa de ma spangs kyi bar du ste dman pa'i bsam pa dang sems skyed gzhi gcig la mnyam du mi 'du ba'i phyir/ gnas pa'i rten du ma nges te dge slong byang chub sems dpas bslab pa phul ba'i tshul gyis gzhan don spyod pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /theg chen so thar shi 'phos pas mi gtong na lha dang byis pa'i dge slong srid par thal lo zer mod/ lha'i dge slong byams pa mgon po dang mngon par dga' bar skyes so cog rang bzhin gyi dge slong du bshad pas der skyes ma thag rnams byis pa'i dge slong du kho bos khas blang ngo / /de gnyis 'dul ba'i sde snod rnams las bkag ces pa'ang theg dman dang theg chen gyi 'dul ba gang las bkagadang po ltar na bkag par zad do/ /gnyis pa ltar na sgrub byed bkod la khungs ston cig /de yang cho ga dngos ni/ bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag gis/ /cho ga'i gtso bo rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes bya ste/ de yang shing rta'i srol 323

gnyis te thar rgyan las/ byang chub kyi sems de blang ba'i cho ga ni bla ma mkhas pa dag gi brgyud pa'i man ngag las tshul lugs tha dad pa du ma snang ngo / /de ltar snang yang ni 'dir 'phags pa 'jam dpal nas slob dpon klu sgrub na mar la brgyud pa slob dpon zhi ba lha'i lugs dang /'phags pa byams pa nas slob dpon thogs med na mar brgyud pa jo bo gser gling pa'i lugs dang gnyis su shes par bya'o zhes so/ /cho ga dngos ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis legs bstan pa/ /klu sgrub zhi lha'i gdams ngag ni/ /mchod pa skyabs 'gro sdig bshags dang / /yi rang bskul gsol bsngo ba ste/ /sbyor ba'i cho ga rnam pa bdun/ /dngos gzhi sems skyed sdom bzung gnyis/ /rjes ni dbugs dbyung gzhan gzengs bstod/ /ces pa ste gzhan rnams rim pas gzhung du rgyas par 'chad la dngos gzhi ni mdor bsdu na spyod 'jug gi gzhung bzhin sems skyed dang sdom pa cig char len pa'am tha dad du len pa gang mos pa tshar gsum gyis blang la/ rgyas par ni bslab btus su gsungs pa ltar/ rje btsun 'jam dpal sngon rgyal po nam mkha' zhes bya bar gyur pa na sangs rgyas 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar sems skyed dang sdom pa stabs gcig tu nod pa ltar bdag cag gis kyang stabs gcig tu nod par bya ste/ 'khor ba tha ma med pa yi/ /sngun gyi tha ma ji srid pa/ /de srid sems can phan don du/ /spyod pa dpag yas spyad par bgyi/ /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan snga 'dir/ /byang chub mchog tu sems skyed do/ /'gro ba thams cad mgron gnyer te/ /dbul zhing 'phongs las sgrol bar bya/ /de ring phan chad gal te yang / /bdag gis 324

'dod chags sems skyed na/ /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bslus par 'gyur/ /byang chub nam zhig 'thob bar du/ /tha ba'i sems dang gnod sems dang / /phra dog dang ni ser sna yang / /de ring phan chad mi bya'o/ /tshangs pa'i spyod pa bdag gis spyad/ /sdig pa'i 'dod pa yongs su btang / /tshul khrims sdom dang des pa la/ /sangs rgyas rjes su bslab par bya/ /bdag ni byang chub rings tshul du/ /'tshang rgyar mos shing spro ba med/ /phyi mtha'i thug gi bar du yang / /sems can gcig phyir sbyang bar bgyi/ /tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni sbyang bar bya/ /phyogs rnams bcu po thams cad du/ /bdag gi ming ni grags par bgyi/ /lus dang ngag gi las rnams kyang / /rnam pa kun tu bdag gis sbyang / /yid kyi las kyang sbyang bar bya/ /mi dge'i las ni spyad mi bya/ /zhes lan gsum du brjod pas blang ngo / /'jug pa'i sdom pa skye ba gtan du bzung na tshe rabs gzhan la mi dran pas nyams par 'gyur ro zhe na de ltar mi 'gyur te tshe rabs thams cad du rab tu 'byung bar smon lam 'debs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i smon lam la bslab par mdo 'di nyid las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rjes dkon mchog la gtang rag gi mchod pa rgya chen po dbul zhing don chen po brnyed pa'i dga' spro bsgoms nas bdag dbugs dbyung gzhan gzengs bstod/ byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ /gnyis pa rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi lugs la smon pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / 'jug pa'i sdom pa bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal ba byams pas nyer bstan pa'i/ /man ngag las byung cho ga ni/ /325

gsol gdab tshogs bsag skyabs 'gro'i mchog /smon pa'i sbyor ba rnam pa gsum/ /dngos gzhi byang chub mchog sems skyed/ /dga' skyed bslab bya brjod pa'i rjes/ /'di ni smon pa'i cho ga'o/ /zhes bya ste/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po la yang gsum/ gsol ba gdab pa/ tshogs bsag pa/skyabs 'gro khyad par can bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob mas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mdun du song nas phyag bya/ bla mas de 'khor ba la skyo ba bskyed/sems can la snying rje bskyed/ sangs rgyas la 'dod pa bskyed/ bla ma la gus pa bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang slob dpon gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por sems skyed par mdzad du gsol zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang por dkon mchog la phyag bya mchod pa 'byor tshad du bshams pa dang yid kyis sprul ba dbul/ de yang dge slong gi sdom pa dge 'dun las 'thob pa ltar byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa las 'thob pa yin no/ /de yang rang la 'byor ba che bar yod na che bar btang dgos te/ bde gshegs grags byin 'dzam gling rgyal po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i tog de la/ /gtsug lag khang pa bye ba phul nas kyang / /dang por byang 326

chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes so/ /'byor ba chung na chung ngu re phul bas kyang skye ste/ bde gshegs 'od 'phro grong khyer bsten pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas 'od de la/ /rtswa yi sgron me dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes so/ /ci yang ma 'byor bas thal mo sbyar ba dang phyag tsam gyis kyang chog ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan phreng ldan gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'gying ldan bzhud de la/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal thal mo lan gsum sbyar/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro gong du bshad pa 'dir bya'o/ /dngos gzhi ni sems can thams cad la byams pa sgom/ de'i sdug bsngal la snying rje skyed/ de las skyob nus pa sangs rgyas las med pas bdag gis de thob par byas te sdug bsngal las bskyab bo zhes sems thag pa nas bsams te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu sbyin pa las byung ba dang tshul khrims las byung ba dang sgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa bgyid du bstsal ba dang bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba des ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag 327

ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du sems can ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang ma grol ba rnams 'grol ba dang dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzlo ba'i slad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis blang ngo / /de yang ma brgal ba ni ngan song gsum ste ngan song gi sdug bsngal rgya mtsho lta bu las ma brgal ba'i phyir/ bsgral ba ni de dag mngon mtho lha mi la dgod par bya ba'o/ /ma grol ba ni lha mi rnams te nyon mongs kyi 'ching ba lcags sgrog lta bus bsdams pa'i phyir/ 'grol ba ni de bkrol nas thar ba la 'god pa'o/ /dbugs ma phyin pa ni nyan rang ste theg pa chen por dbugs ma phyin pa'i phyir/ dbugs dbyung ba ni de dag bsam pa sems skyed dang sbyor ba phar phyin drug gis dbugs phyung ste sa bcu la 'god pa'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams te mi gnas pa'i myang 'das ma thob pa'i phyir ro/ /yongs su mya ngan las bzlo ba ni de dag sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la dgod pa'o/ /slad du ni dgos ched de rnams bya ba'i ched du 'tshang rgya bar dam bca' ba'o/ /rjes dga' spro skyed/ bslab bya yang go bar bya'o/ /de ltar smon pa'i sems skyes pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ste byang chub dang sems can la dmigs pa dang dpa' zhing snying stobs dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa'i sdom pa bzung ba la yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum ste/ 'jug pa'i sdom pa bzung 328

ba'i phyir/ /gsol gdab thun mong bar chad dri/ /mchod dbul myur du sbyin par gsol/ /thun mong min pa'i bar chad dri/ /bslab pa khas blang dga' ba sgom/ /de ni sbyor ba'i chos bdun no/ /dngos gzhi byang sems sdom pa blang / /mjug chog mkhyen par gsol ba dang / /phan yon bstan dang gsang bar gdams/ /bslab bya gtang rag dang rnam lngas/ /'jug pa'i sdom pa byin pa'o/ /de yang / slob dpon las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa len par 'tshal gyis de la gnod pa ma mchis na bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du cung zad gsan zhing stsal ba'i rigs so zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ thun mong gi bar chad dri ba la gsum las/ dang po snying stobs la brtag pa ni/sems can thams cad smin par byed pa'i bslab pa rnams la slob nus sam/ zhing khams grangs med pa sbyong ba dang sangs rgyas grangs med pa mnyes par byed pa la slob nus sam/ nyams na nyes dmigs che bas nyes dmigs des mi 'jigs sam/ phan yon tshad med pa'i bslab pa de la slob par spro'am zhes dri/ slob mas nus/ mi 'jigs/ spro lags zhes lan gdab/ gnyis pa shes rab la brtag pa ni/ khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi ma mo thos sam/ shes sam/ dad dam/ srung bar nus sam dri/ slob mas cung zad thos/ cung zad shes/ shin tu dad/ srung bar nus zhes lan gdab/ gsum pa 'dun pa la brtag pa ni/ rigs kyi bu khyod nyon cig /khyod 'di ltar sems can ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang sogs —rdog nas 'byung ba'i mthar sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad 329

par 'dod dam/ de la khyod kyis bsam pa brtan pa dang yi dam brtan par bya'o/ /gzhan dang 'gran pa'i ched du ma yin nam/ gzhan gyis nan gyis len du bcug pa ma yin nam/ zhes dri zhing 'dod lags/ ma lags zhes lan gdab bo/ /slob dpon med pa'i tshe bar chad dri lan mi dgos la/bdag sems can ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang ma grol ba rnams 'grol ba dang dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzlo ba dang sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod cing de dag la bdag sems skyed pa brtan pa dang yi dam brtan par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gcig brjod/tshogs gsog pa ni/ dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul/ /bdag pos yongs su ma bzung dang / /bla na med pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus blo yis blangs te 'bul/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po kun/ /ma lus dkon mchog spyan sngar 'bul/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gyur 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa tsam mam cho ga gzhan gyis kyang mchod pa dang lus phul la bdag la byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang ba myur du stsal du gsol zhes gsu/ma gyis myur du sbyin par gsol ba gdab/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bar chad dri ba'i phyir/khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam zhes dri zhing yin no/ /btab bo zhes lan gdab/ bslab pa'i gnas go bar byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam/sa kyi bslab pa'i gzhi rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshul khrims de dag bdag las 330

len par 'dod dam zhes dri lan bya'o/ /slob dpon med na de gnyis bsdams nas/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba byang chub sems dpa' lags shing byang chub tu smon lam btab pa lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshul khrims de dag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad las blang bar 'tshal lo zhes lan gcig brjod do/ /de nas da lta byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye bar 'gyur ro zhes dga' ba sgom pa ste sbyor ba'i chos bdun no/ /thar rgyan du sbyor ba la chos bcur gsungs kyang deng sang lag tu blang ba ltar byas so/ /dngos gzhi ni gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i ched du blangs nas srung sems skyed/ slob dpon gyis rigs kyi bu ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba la byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims gang la 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslab pa dang ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad slob par 'gyur ba dang phyogs bcu dag na da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad da ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims de thams cad yang dag par nod dam zhes dri zhing / nod lags zhes lan 331

gdab pa tshar gsum gyis 'bogs so/ /slob dpon med na bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang sa chen po la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la gsol bar 'tshal te de dag gi spyan sngar byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang sogs brjod nas mthar de thams cad bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo zhes lan gsum mo/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o/ /mjug mkhyen par gsol ba ni slob dpon kho nas phyogs bcur phyag dang mchod pa byas la pus btsugs thal sbyar gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi bas bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba las byang chub sems pa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dpang du gyur par phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag tu bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa'i mchog lkog tu gyur kyang chos thams cad la lkog tu ma gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo zhes lan gsum brjod de phyag bya/ slob dpon med na rang gis de ltar byas te/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi bas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sogs brjod/ phan yon bstan pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod nyon cig 'di ni chos nyid yin te gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par len pa'i las brjod pa rdzogs pa de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di lta bu'i ltas 'byung bar 'gyur te sa g.yo 332

bar 'gyur/ lha'i rnga bo che grag par 'gyur/ me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing ga ge mo zhig na byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi bas byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba las byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par mnos so zhes yang dag par mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ /de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis chos kyi brtse bas bu dang spun zlar dgongs pa mdzad/ de ltar dgongs pa mdzad pas byang chub sems dpa' de'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes brjod cing slob dpon med na rang gis de ltar 'gyur bar yid ches pas kyang 'grub/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba khyod nyon cig byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa 'di dad pa med pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste gang gi phyir dad pa med pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rab tu bstan na dad pa med pa'i sems can de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la ma dad pas spong bar byed de des na ji snyed byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur pa de snyed kyi bsod nams ma yin pa'i phung po ma dad pa de la ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpas sems can sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su srung bar bya ba yin pas sdig pa las ldog par bya ste de'i phyir mchog tu dge ba'i byang chub kyi sems gsang bar bya ba yin no 333

zhes gdam zhing slob dpon med na rang gis de ltar yid la nges par bya'o/ /de nas bslab bya ji ltar 'tsham pa bstan zhing mjug tu gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya'o/ /rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi cho ga lag tu blang ba bshad zin to/ /'dir shing rta'i srol gnyis kyi cho ga las skyes pa'i sems skyed de gcig gam tha dad ce na/ 'di la chos rje sa skya pa sogs shin tu tha dad cing mchog dman yod par bzhed la/ legs bshad bsdus par yang gzhung 'di gnyis dang po len pa'i cho ga mi 'dra bar du bsrung bya ltung ba'i grangs mi 'dra tha mar phyir bcos mi 'dra/ dang po len chog mi 'dra ste byang sa las sdig bshags ma gsungs te sdig bshags ni 'gyod cing yid gdung ba dang bcas pa yin la byang chub kyi sems ni shes rgyud dga' ba rgyas pa la skye bar dgongs so/ /gzhung 'dir sdig bshags rgyas par gsungs te ras dri ma med pa la tshon 'dzin pa ltar rgyud dag pa la byang sdom skye bar dgongs so/ /byang sa las phyag mchod tsam ma gtogs yan lag bdun pa tshang bar ma gsungs la gzhung 'dir tshang bar gsungs so/ /byang sa las byang sdom gyi sngon du bslab pa brjod pa dang bar chad dri ba gsungs la 'dir de dag ma gsungs so/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga la yang sems skyed dang sdom pa gnyis ku'i brjod tshul mi 'dra ba yod do/ /mjug chog la yang bslab pa brjod pa yod med sogs kyi khyad yod do/ /bar du bsrung bya la khyad yod de byang sar rtsa ltung bzhir bshad la 'dir rgyal po'i lnga blon po'i lnga las dang po ba'i ltung ba brgyad thun mong du byang sems mi gtang ba dang bcu dgur gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /phyir bcos mi 'dra ste 3 34

byang sa las/ sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya/ /zag pa 'bring ni gsum la bshags/ /gcig gi mdun du lhag ma rnams/ /zhes 'chad la/ bslab btus su byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la 'chags pa'i thabs zhu dgos pa'i phyir zhes snang la gzhan mang zhig kyang tha dad par 'dod do/ /spyir de gnyis kyi byang chub kyi sems de gcig gam tha dad ces dris pa la cho ga tha dad do zhes sogs ni mkhas pa'i lan min la/ tha dad tshul de dag kyang bslab btus kyi rgya dpe 'di gnyis shin tu mi gcig ste gcig lañtsa dang gcig warnyu lar bris pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rigs pa kho nar snang ngo / /khyed rang ltar na'ang byang sa'i lugs kyi 'bogs chog las chos can/ byang sdom mi skye bar thal te ras dag pa la tshon 'dzin pa ltar rgyud dag pa la skye dgos pa las bshags pas rgyud dag par ma byas pa'i phyir/yang spyod 'jug gi sems skyed kyi cho ga 'di las chos can/ byang sdom mi skye bar thal/ byang sdom ni shes rgyud dga' ba rgyas pa las skye la 'dir ni sdig pa la 'gyod cing bshags pas yid gdung bar byas pa'i phyir/ so so'i rtags khyab rang gis khas blangs zin to/ /spyir sdig pas 'gyod cing bshags pa las sems dang bar byas shing sdig pa'i gnyen po yang byang chub kyi sems las lhag pa med par bstan zin pas gnyen po la nan tan gyis 'jug par 'dod pa 'di nyid shes rgyud dga' ba rgyas pa yin gyi sdig pa la 'gyod par ma mthong ba'i sems nga rgyal dang bcas pa tsam po ba de 'dra byang chub kyi sems skye ba'i dga' ba rgyas pa ga la yin/ spyir ha cang spro ba dang zhum pa'i dus su gnyen po mi skye'i bar ma'i sems las skye bar 335

gsungs/ pas sems dga' ba rgyas pa la byang sdom skye zhes pa'ang 'brel chung ngo / /byang sar phyag mchod tsam las ma gsungs pa'ang yan lag lhag ma lnga mi dgos pa'i rnam bcad kyang ga la yin/ bar chad dri ba yang bsdu na khyod byang chub kyi sems zhe nas len 'dod cing spang blang la slob nus sam zhes 'dri bar 'du la/ de ni sems skyed don gnyer gyis 'ongs par go na ma dris rung de ltar go ba'i phyir/ gom pa 'dor ba mthong bzhin du khyod kyis gom pa 'dor nus sam zhes dri mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /dngos gzhi yang khyad par med de sems skyed gnyis tshig don mtshungs shing sdom pa len chorge gnyis tshig don mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de yang byang sa las ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ zhes bya ba 'di dang / ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa ltar/ /zhes pa 'di gnyis la don mi 'dra ba ci zhig yod/ ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir zhes sogs kyi dgos pa byang sa'i cho gar yod la spyod 'jug gi cho gar dngos su ma smos mod kyi don gyis tshang ba yin te ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs bskyed pa ltar bdag gis skyed do zhes khas blangs pas sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sems skyed la cig char du zhugs shing khas blangs pa yin na ma brgal ba bsgral ba sogs de'i lhag mar ci zhig lus/ byang sdom gyi tshig don gnyis ka khyad med de/ ji 336

ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag ji ltar gnas pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas par bgyi/ /zhes khas blangs pa 'di dang / byang sar/ khyod dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang sogs kyis de thams cad bdag las blang bar 'dod dam zhes dris pa la 'tshal lags par khas blangs pa 'di gnyis la rgya che chung cung zad kyang mi mngon te sngon gyi bde gshegs kyi sgras da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'ang mtshon pa'i phyir dang / mdor na gnyis ka yang bdag byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa la slob bo zhes pas byang sdom 'dzin zhing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ji ltar thugs bskyed pa ltar sems skyed do zhes pas sems skyed 'dzin pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/ mjug chog la'ang bslab pa brjod pa la cho gar ming btags rung ma btags rung gnas skabs de nyid dam de las gzhan du'ang rung ste spang blang gi gnas rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba re gnyis ka la ston par mtshungs shing 'dul ba las rang gis mkhan po byas te rab tu phyung nas bshad pa la bkod pa ni sla'i spang blang gi lung mi 'bogs pa ni de lta ma yin no zhes gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na cho ga'i don la khyad par med na yang gnas skabs spyod 'jug gi lugs ni gdul bya bsdus pa la dga' ba'i ngor don gtso bor bsdus te bya ba nyung ngus bstan la/ byang sar ni spros pa la dga' ba'i 337

ngor de nyid rnam pa du mar phye nas rgyas par bstan pa ste cho ga'i ngo bo ni gcig kho na'o/ /bstan bya byang chub kyi sems la yang khyad par med de snying rjes gzhan don dang 'bras bu byang chub la dmigs pa'i blo skyed par mtshungs shing gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod kyi blo sems skyed yin pa dang de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob par dam bca' ba'i blo byang sdom yin par gnyis ka la mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na spyod 'jug dang byang sa gnyis byang chub dang sems can sogs kyang tha dad du ngos 'dzin dgos par thal bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te spyod 'jug las sems sdom lhan cig tu 'dzin par yang bshad la/ byang sar byang sdom gyi sngon du sems bskyed dgos pas khyad yod do snyam na/ byang sar spros pa la dga' ba'i ngor dang byang chub sems dpa' rim can du 'jug pa shas che ba'i dbang du mdzad nas sngon du sems bskyed cing byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la ci rigs par sbyangs te slar sdom pa len pa'i dbang du mdzad nas de ltar du gsungs la/ spyod 'jug tu dbang po rno ba bsdus pa la mos pa dang cig char 'jug pa'i dbang du byas nas sems sdom lhan cig tu nod par bstan mod kyang / sems sdom lhan cig tu nod pa'i tshe yang sngon du sems bskyed de nas sdom pa nod pas rten dang brten par yod la tshigs bcad gcig gis gnyis ka len pa dang 'jug pa nye ba skad cig ma mang pos bar ma chod par len pas lhan cig tu len pa'i sgrar brjod kyi zhib mor dpyad na lhan cig ma yin te snga phyir yod pa'i phyir/ des na sems skyed rten dang sdom pa brten pa yin pa'ang gnyi ga la 338

khyad med do/ /srung tshul dang phyir bcos kyang gnyi ga don mi 'gal bar 'og tu 'chad do/ /lnga pa bslab bya la smon pa'i bslab bya dang 'jug pa'i bslab bya'o/ /dang po ni/ sems can gcig kyang blos mi spang / /rtag tu sems de'i phan yon bsam/ /tshogs gnyis bsag la brtson par bya/ /yang yang byang chub sems gnyis sbyang / /nag po'i chos bzhi spangs nas ni/ /dkar po'i chos bzhi bsten par bya/ /zhes lnga ste sems can gang yang rung bas bdag gi sems sun phyung ste nga ni nam yang khyod la phan mi 'dogs so snyam pa'am phrad par ma gyur cig snyam pa ni sems can de blos spangs pa'i blo ste thun tshod 'das na byang sems 'chor ro/ /'di la sems can gzhan thams cad blos spangs ni nyan rang gi yid byed skyes na ma gtogs mi 'byung bas gcig kho na mtshan gzhi'i dper byas so/ /des na/ phan btags lan du gnod byas na/ /yang lan snying rje chen pos bslan/ /dzasbu gling gi skyes mchog ni/ /nyes pa'i lan yang legs pas ldon/ /zhes pa dang /ma dros pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' chos gcig dang ldan na rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su 'dzin to chos gcig pu gang zhe na sems can blos yongs su mi gtang ba'o zhes gsungs pa ltar bslab pa ni mi 'chor ba'i thabs so/ /rtag tu byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon bsam pa ni byang sems mi nyams pa'i thabs te jo bo chen po yang / ngan 'gro las ni ldog bgyid cing / /mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /rga shi med par 'dren byed pa/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / gang la sems kyi dam pa 339

rin chen de/ /skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing / /sogs shar shar gsung bar grags pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ tshogs kyi gtam las/ de ring bdag gis bsod nams dang / /ye shes tshogs ni gang bya dang / /sems can phan pa gang bya zhes/ /byang chub sems dpas rtag tu bsam/ /zhes pa ltar dge ba'i 'dun pa sngon du btang ste bsod nams kyi tshogs chos spyod bcu dang bsdu dngos bzhi dang tshul khrims gsum la sogs pa thabs kyi spyod pa rnams rtag par bya la de rnams kyang ye shes kyi tshogs 'khor gsum yongs dag tu shes pas bya ste de ltar sngags thung gcig bzlas pa yan yang tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu rtag par gsog pa ni sems de'i stobs skyed pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyu yi byams dang snying rje sgom/ /nyin mtshan thun drug sems skyed blang / /bdag gzhan rje ba'i gtong len sbyang / /'di ni byang chub sems sbyangs pa'o/ /zhes pa/ ste byams pa dang snying rje sgom pa ni rgyu la sbyangs pa'o/ /byang chub kyi sems yang yang blang ba ni sems dngos sbyangs pa'o/ /bdag gi dge bde sems can la byin zhing gzhan gyi sdig sdug bdag la len pa'i gtong len spyad pa ni bsam sbyor gnyis kya'i sgo nas byang chub sems kyi spyod pa sbyangs pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ bla ma dang ni mchod 'os slu/ /'gyod gnas min la gzhan 'gyod skyed/ /rgyal sras gzhan la khro bas skur/ /sems can la ni g.yo sgyus spyod/ /'di rnams nag po'i chos bzhi ste/ /byang sems nyams dang brjed pa'i rgyu/ /bzlog pa dkar po'i chos bzhi ste/ /rtag par mi brjed rgyu yin no/ /de yis smon pa'i bslab bya bshad/ /ces pa ste/ bla ma dang mchod 'os mkhan slob dang sbyin gnas 340

sogs la slu sems kyis rdzun la sogs pas mgo bskor na de dag gis tshor rung ma tshor rung dgyes rung ma dgyes rung kham che rung chung rung mgo 'khor rung ma 'khor rung thun tshod las 'das na byang sems 'chor ro/ /de bzhin du gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas min pa dge ba byas pa la shes bzhin du 'gyod pa bskyed na skyes rung gnyis pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa'i gang zag la zhe sdang gis mi snyan pa brjod na ci lta bus brjod kyang thos ma thos dga' ma dga' ci yin yang gsum pa'o/ /sems can gang yang rung ba zhig la g.yo zol zhig byas na tshor ma tshor dga' ma dga' phan gnod cir gyur kyang nag pa'i chos bzhi pa ste 'di bzhi ga la thun tshod kyi nang khongs su bshags bsdam gyis ma sleb na 'chor ba'o/ /de dag gi gnyen por dkar po'i chos kyang bzhi ste shes bzhin du srog gi phyir yang rdzun mi smra ba dang / sems can thams cad dge ba la 'god cing khyad par theg chen la 'god pa dang / sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bzhag cing yon tan phyogs bcur bsgrag pa dang /sems can la lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas pa'o/ /'di dag ni 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa'i bslab bya la dgag pa'i bslab bya dang / sgrub pa'i bslab bya gnyis/ dang po la/ byang sa'i lugs ni/ rnyed dang bkur stir chags pa yis/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang / /sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la/ /ser snas chos nor mi ster dang / /gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par/ /khros nas gzhan la 'tshog pa dang / /theg pa chen po spong byed cing / /dam chos 'drar snang 341

ston pa'o/ /zhes rtsa ltung bzhi'am brgyad de kun dkris chen pos spyad na byang sdom 'chor te dge slong gi pham pa bzhin no/ /kun dkris 'bring dang chung ngus byas pa ni lhag ma dang ltung byed bzhin no/ /dkon mchog gsum la gsum mi mchod/ /'dod pa'i sems kyi rjes su 'jug /rgan pa rnams la gus mi byed/ /dris pa la ni lan mi 'debs/ /mgron pos bdag gir mi byed cing / /gser la sogs pa len mi byed/ /chos 'dod pa la sbyin mi byed/ /tshul khrims 'chal rnams yal bar 'dor/ /pha rol dad phyir slob mi byed/ /sems can don la bya ba chung / /snying brtser bcas na mi dge med/ /'tsho ba log pa dang du len/ /'phyar nas rab tu rgod la sogs/ /'khor ba gcig pur bgrod par sems/ /grags pa ma yin mi spong ba/ /nyon mongs bcas kyang 'chos mi byed/ /gshe la lan du gshe la sogs/ /khros pa rnams ni yal bar 'dor/ /pha rol shed kyis 'chags pa spong / /khros pa'i sems kyi rjes su 'jug /rnyed bkur 'dod phyir 'khor rnams sdud/ /le lo la sogs sel mi byed/ /chags pas bre mo'i gtam la bsten/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi don mi tshol/ /bsam gtan sgrib pa spong mi byed/ /bsam gtan ro la yon tan blta/ /nyan thos theg pa spong bar byed/ /rang tshul yod bzhin de la brtson/ /brtson min phyi rol bstan bcos brtson/ /brtson par byas kyang de la dga'/ /theg pa chen po spong bar byed/ /bdag la bstod cing gzhan la smod/ /chos kyi don du 'gro mi byed/ /de la smod dang yi ger bsten/ /dgos pa'i grogs su 'gro mi byed/ /nad pa'i rim gro bya ba spong / /sdug bsngal sel bar mi byed dang / /bag med pa la rigs mi 342

ston/ /byas la lan du phan mi 'dogs/ /gzhan gyi mya ngan sel mi byed/ /nor 'dod pa la sbyin mi byed/ /'khor rnams kyi ni don mi byed/ /gzhan gyi blo dang mthun mi 'jug /yon tan bsngags pa smra mi byed/ /rkyen du 'tsham par tshar mi gcod/ /rdzu 'phrul bsdigs la sogs mi byed/ /snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang / /sems dge ba la nyes pa med ces pa'i nyes byas bzhi bcu rtsa drug ni 'dul ba'i nyes byas dang mtshungs so/ /bslab btus su ni nam mkha' snying po'i mdo las gsungs pa ltar/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog dang / /dam pa'i chos ni spong ba dang / /rtags can chad pas gcod pa dang / /mtshams med lnga yi las byed dang / /chad par lta ba 'dzin pa ste/ /byang sems rgyal po'i rtsa ltung lnga/ /grong dang ljongs dang grong khyer dang / /grong brdal yul 'khor 'joms pa ste/ /byang sems blon po'i rtsa ltung lnga/ /bde gshegs sku 'joms khrag 'byin dang / /rtsa ba'i pham pa rnam bzhi ste/ /rab tu byung ba'i rtsa ltung lnga/ /ma sbyangs pa la stong nyid ston/ /theg chen la zhugs phyir zlog dang / /so thar spangs te theg chen sbyor/ /slob pa'i theg pa la smod dang / /rnyed phyir bdag bstod gzhan smod dang / /zab mo bzod par rdzun smra dang / /rngan par dkon mchog dkor sbyin len/ /spong rdzas kha ton par sbyin te/ /las dang po yi ltung ba brgyad/ /ces bya ste 'di la mdo ltar na blon po la dkon mchog gi rdzas 'phrog yul 'joms chos spong rtags can la 'tshe mtshams med byed pa ste ltung ba lnga dang grong grong khyer sogs kyi dbye bas phye ba lnga ste ltung ba bcur gsungs kyang snga ma lnga rgyal po dang thun mong du bsdus nas thun mong ma yin pa'i 343

grong sogs lnga bye brag tu phye ba bstan bcos kyi lugs ltar bshad pa yin la 'grel chen las blon po'i ltung ba gcig ces kyang bshad do/ /mdor nyan thos kyi rtsa ltung lnga ni pham pa bzhi dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'joms shing khrag 'byin pa'o zhes gsungs pas bshad kyi deng sang 'dren pa nyung bar snang ngo / /'dir gzhan rnams go sla la rtags can chad pas gcod pa ni/ tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong la'ang / /ngur smrig 'phrog dang rdeg pa dang / /btson rar gzhug par byed pa dang / /rab tu byung las 'bebs pa dang / /zhes rtags kyi cha tsam 'dzin pa'i gang zag yang sdud pa yin la de la gnod pa ci byas kyang rtsa ltung ngo / /gang gi khu ba las bdag nyid kyi lus kyi rgyur gyur pa ni pha dang / gang gi zla mtshan las bdag gi lus bskyed pa ni ma dang / khams gsum gyi nyon mongs spangs pa ni dgra bcom pa yin la de rnams bsad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sus kyang bsad par mi nus mod kyi ngan sems kyis sku las mtshal phyung zhing byung ba dang / bstan pa 'di la 'khor lo'i dbyen lhas byin gyis byas pa las gzhan mi 'byung mod kyang bsam pa ma dag pas las kyi dbyen dang zang zing gi ched du dge 'dun phye ba'i dbyen te 'di lnga ni las shin tu mi bzad pa yin zhing shi ma thag bar do med par mnar med du skye bas na mtshams med pa'i las lnga'o/ /chad par lta ba ni las dkar nag gi 'bras bu med par lta ba dang tshe phyi ma med par lta ba'o/ /gang na mi rigs bzhi yod pa grong dang / bzo rigs bco brgyad yod pa grong khyer dang grong khyer du ma yod pa grong gi brdal dang brdal du ma yod pa yul ljongs dang yul 344

ljongs du ma yod pa yul 'khor du brgyad stong pa'i 'grel par bshad do/ /ma sbyangs pa la stong nyid ston pa ni de ma dad cing skrag par 'gyur ba la ste dad na nyes pa med do/ /theg chen la zhugs pa phyir ldog pa la yang theg dman du rigs nges par mthong na nyes pa med dam snyam mo/ /theg dman du zhugs pa theg chen du sbyor ba la theg chen gyi snod ldan du mthong na nyes pa med do/ /slob pa nyan thos kyi theg pa la smod pa yang gzhan theg chen la gzud pa'i dgos pa mthong nas theg dman la smod pa ltar ston na nyes pa med do/ /rnyed bkur gyi phyir bdag bstod gzhan smod dang bdag ni chos zab mo la bzod pa thob pa'o zhes mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ba dang / rgyal rigs dang dge sbyong phye nas dge sbyong sogs dkon mchog gi rdzas rgyal rigs la gsang du ster ba dang ster 'jug pa'am byin pa len pa dang /spong ba bsam gtan pa deng sang bod na sgom chen par grags pa'i longs spyod phrogs te klog pa kha ton pa deng sang mtshan nyid par grags pa la ster du 'jug pa dang ster ba ste byed pa po dang byed du 'jug pa po'am ster ba po dang len pa po gnyis ka la rtsa ba'i ltung ba ste pham pa dang mtshungs la phyi ma 'di bzhi la ltung med mi srid do/ /'dir nyes byas ni mi zad pa brgyad cu ste/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal yid mi bde/ /nus bzhin zhi bar mi byed dang / /bde dang yid bde mi skyed pa/ /ltung ba'i gzhi ste lus sems kyi/ /rten gyis phye na rnam pa bzhi/ /da lta dang ni ma 'ongs pa'i/ /dus kyis phye bas rnam pa brgyad/ /de ched sgo gsum mi brtson dang / /phan pa'i rgyu rkyen mi tshol dang / /gnyen po'i phyogs la mi 'bad pa/ /de ltar rjes su 345

sgrub pa'i sgo/ /gsum gyis phye bas nyi shu bzhi/ /bde sdug yal 'dor ltung ba'o/ /sdug bsngal yid mi bde chen po'i/ /gnyen por chung ngu mi skyed pa/ /ltung ba'i gzhi ste 'di phyi yi/ /skye bas phye ba rnam pa bzhi/ /rang gzhan rgyud kyis phye bas bzhi/ /bde dang yid bde chen po'i phyir/ /chung ngu nyams par mi byed pa/ /ltung ba'i gzhi ste skye ba dang / /rgyud kyis phye bas rnam pa brgyad/ /sgrub pa yal bar 'dor ba yi/ /ltung ba rnam pa bcu drug go /de ltar bzhi bcu re re la'ang / /re zhig yal bar 'dor ba dang / /gtan du 'dor bas rnam pa gnyis/ /phan yon nyes dmigs mi zad pa'i/ /yan lag ltung ba brgyad cu'o/ /zhes byung ste nyes byas ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de yang byang sa las byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba gtso che ba'i dbang du mdzad nas de la 'byung nye ba rnams spang bar bcas pa yin la/ nam snying gi mdor khyim pa'i rten can gyi byang sems la gtso bor dgongs nas de la 'byung nye ba rnams spong bar bcas pa ste/ rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' dang blon po byang chub sems dpa' dang las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gsum gar gyis kyang rtsa ltung de gsum gar spang dgos par mtshungs shing / byang sa'i lugs kyi sdom ldan gyis kyang de rnams ma spangs na rang gi bslab bya rnams kyang srung bar mi nus med kyang gtso bor rgyal po sogs so so'i ming gis bstan pas 'jigs pa skye zhing 'di ni bdag la nan tan gyis gdams so zhes srung bar 'gyur bas na so so'i ming gis bstan pa yin la zhib mor dpyad na lugs phan tshun gyi ltung ba gcig gi khongs su gcig shos 'du bas na gnas skabs kyi tha snyad tha dad pa tsam 346

mo/ /phyogs mthun gyi ltung ba gzhan spang ba theg chen gyi mdo sde sna tshogs las thor bur gsungs pa ni/ gzhan yang ltung ba'i phyogs mthun ni/ /lus ngag yid kyi mi dge ba/ /rnam pa bcu po rnam par spang / /rnyed dang ma rnyed grags ma grags/ /bde sdug bstod smad 'jig rten gyi/ /chos brgyad po la chags sdang spang / /yul mi nye du dgra gnod sems/ /rnam 'tshe khyad gsod kha zas sogs/ /mi 'chi ba yi rtog pa ste/ /log pa'i rtog pa brgyad po spang / /tshul 'chos kha gsag 'thob kyis 'jal/ /gzhogs slong rnyed pas rnyed tshol te/ /log pa'i 'tsho ba rnam lnga spang / /rgyal po'i pho brang gdol pa'i gnas/ /shan pa gzugs tshong chang tshong gnas/ /spyod yul min pa rnam lnga spang / /sdig pa'i grogs dang 'grogs pa spang / /sdig lta 'dzin dang nyan rang gi /yid la byed pa skyed pa dang / /dmigs par lta dang rlom sems dang / /lung bstan mngon par zhen pa dang / /dben par dga' bas gzhan smod dang / /phan tshun mi mthun rtsod pa dang / /rgyal sras gzhan la khong khro sogs/ /bdud kyi las rnams rab tu spang / /lta bas gzings pa rnam par spang / /mu stegs gsang tshig tshol ba dang / khyim la lta zhing 'khren pa dang / /rgyal sras gzhan la phrag dog dang / /ma thos mdo sde spong ba ste/ /dge ba 'dzad pa'i rgyu bzhi spang / /rdo rje rdo rjes 'joms pa ltar/ /rgyal sras phan tshun zhe sdang ba/ /kho nas 'joms phyir khro ba spang / /'dzam gling skye bo'i srog bcad cing / /bdog pa thams cad phrogs pa bas/ /sems dpa' gzhan gyi zas kham gcig /dud 'gro gcig la ster ba yi/ /dge ba'i bar chad byed pa ni/ /ches cher lci ste char mi phod/ /de bas dge ba'i 347

bar chad spang / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis khengs pa/ /de la yon tan chu mi 'jug /de bas khengs pa rab spangs te/ /nga rgyal med pa nyid du bya/ /'di rnams mdo sde sna tshogs par/ /rgyal bas rab tu bkag pa nyid/ /thams cad yod smra'i gzhung las kyang / /tshangs par mtshungs spyod grogs brnyas pa'i/ /ltung ba lta bu'i sdig gzhan med/ /bsags pa'i dge kun de yis 'dzad/ /de bas mgal dum tsam la yang / /gnod sems skyed par mi bya na/ /sems bcas lus la lta ci smos/ /de phyir brgya lam tsam na yang / /khengs pa spang bar bya zhes bshad/ /mdor na blang dor ci yang rung / /ma brtags ma dpyad tsham tshom gyis/ /'jug gam ldog na rmongs pa ste/ /'di las ltung ba kun skyed byed/ /chos bzhin dpyad nas dgag dgos kyi/ /lci yang phan yon nyes dmigs bcas/ /legs par shes nas 'dor ba'am/ /len pa ltung ba med pa'o/ /de ltar spang bya shes nas ni/ /spong ba'i yi dam brtan bskyed nas/ /nam yang ltung bas ma gos bya/ /gos na 'phral du bshags cing bsdam/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal mkhyen par gsol nas ni/ /'gyod cing gnod pas mthol zhing bshags/ /phyin chad sdom sems brtan par bya/ /mdo 'don gzungs bzla mchod rten gdab/ /de sogs dge ba phal cher ni/ /ltung ba'i gnyen por mi 'gyur med/ /chos kun gzod nas ma dmigs pa'i/ /stong nyid la mos gnyen po'i mchog /kun nas nyon mongs chos rnams nyid/ /gzod nas rnam byang nyid du shes/ /'khor ba'i khams nyid myang 'das kyi/ /dbyings su gang gis mthong ba de/ /sgrib pa'i g.yul las rgyal zhes gsungs/ /zhes theg pa 348

chen po'i mdo sde sna tshogs las gsungs pa rnams skyes chen du ma sa bshad pa ltar bsdus te brjod pa'o/ /rtsa ltung las gzhan pa sdom pa'i gtong rgyu yod dam zhe na/ skyabs 'gro btang dang smon sems log /bslab pa phul dang log lta skyes/ /nyan rang yid byed skyes pa dang / /sems can blo yis spangs pa rnams/ /byang sdom rtsad nas gtong ba'i rgyu/ /rtsa ba'i ltung bas nyams shing 'jig /nyes byas sogs kyis na smad do/ /zhes bya ste skyabs 'gro dang smon sems btang na byang sdom rtsa ba nas gtong ste rtsig pa zhig nas ri mo mi gnas pa bzhin te rten log pa'i phyir ro/ /byang sdom gyi bslab pa phul na gtong ste sdom pa las phyin ci log tu khas blangs pa'i phyir/ log lta skyes na gtong ste thar pa dang las 'bras med par 'dzin pas dge ba'i rten chad pa'i phyir/ nyan rang gi yid byed skyes pa ste bdag byang chub chen pos ci zhig bya rang nyid zhi ba 'thob par bya'o snyam na gtong ste smon sems kyi mi mthun phyogs skyes pa'i phyir/ sems can blos spangs na gtong ste des smon sems gtong la rten log na brten pa mi gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ltung kha cig gis gtong la kha cig gis rtsa ba mi gtong yang nyams shing nus med du byed do/ /de ltar dgag pa'i bslab bya bshad nas/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa'i bslab bya phar phyin drug /bsdu na tshul khrims rnam gsum spyad/ /ces bya ste/ sgrub pa'i bslab bya ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam bslab pa gsum mam tshul khrims rnam pa gsum ste byang chub sems dpas spyad par bya ba mtha' dag ste gzhung gis rgyas par 'chad do/ /drug pa phan yon ni/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi nang du chud/ /bslab pa kun gyi 349

rten du 'gyur/ /sdig pa'i phung po rtsad nas gcod/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rtsa ba tshugs/ /bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'thob/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur/ /sems can kun la phan pa mchog /myur du rdzogs 'tshang rgya ba ste/ /smon sems phan yon rnam pa brgyad/ /rang don bsod nams rgyun mi 'chad/ /gzhan don mtha' yas 'byung ba ste/ /khyad par 'jug pa'i phan yon gnyis/ /grangs su chad par bstan pa'o/ /mdor na gnas skabs mthar thug gi/ /phan bde thams cad 'byung ba ni/ /grangs su ma chad phan yon no/ /zhes bya ste/ dang po ni/ byang chub kyi sems med na spyod pa phun tshogs ci yod kyang theg chen par mi chud sangs rgyas mi 'thob la byang chub kyi sems skyes ma thag theg chen par chud rgyal sras kyi ming thob pa ste/ byang sa las/ sems de skyes ma thag tu bla na med pa'i byang chub theg pa chen po la zhugs pa yin te zhes dang / byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang sa las/ ser/sa bskyed pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa rnams kyi rten yin te zhes so/ /gsum/ pa ni/gnyen ngo/ dge ba'i nang na byang chub kyi sems mchog yin pas sdig pa 'joms pa'i phyir te/ des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed/ /ces 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ sems can gyi rgyud sa gzhi lta bu la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ljon shing bskrun pa'i rtsa ba tshugs pa yin te byang sa las sems 350

bskyed pa de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs ba'i byang chub kyi rtsa ba yin no zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ dpas byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang / /gal te de la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang nas/ de ni de las lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rin chen phreng bar/ skyes bu gang zhig byang chub sems/ /skad cig tsam zhig sgom byed na/ /de yi bsod nams phung po 'di/ /rgyal ba yis kyang bgrang mi spyod/ /ces so/ /drug pa ni/ dpas byin gyi mdo las/ gaṅgā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams mi gang gis/ /rin chen dag gis yongs bkang ste/ /bde gshegs rnams la phul ba bas/ /gang gis thal mo sbyar bgyis te/ /byang chub tu ni sems btud na/ /mchod pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/lus can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed na/ /mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas dag la mchod par 'gyur/ /mi gang gis ni sangs rgyas zhing / /gaṅgā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed dag /me tog rnams kyis bkang byas te/ /'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas/ /gang gis 'dir ni thal sbyar te/ /byang chub tu ni sems 'jug na/ /'di ni bsod nams ches mang ste/ /de la tshad ni yod ma yin/ /byang chub sems ni ci 'dra ba/ /de ltar blo mchog gis bstan pa/ /de 'dra'i mchod pa gang yang med/ /de 'dra pa yi dpal yang med/ /ces so/ /bdun pa ni/ sdong po bkod pa las/ 'jig rten pa thams cad la phan pas rten lta bu'o zhes dang / byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yod med na/ /'bras 351

bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung / /zhes so/ /brgyad pa ni/ byang sa las/ sems de skyes na mtha' gnyis la mi gnas te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes so/ /'jug sems la ni de'i steng du khyad par ba gnyis te/ sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa/ /de nas bzung ste gnyid log gam/ /zhes sogs dang / gang zhig bde bas 'phongs pa dang / /sdug bsngal mang ldan de dag la/ /bde ba kun gyis tshim pa dang / /zhes sogs 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /mdor na 'khor ba'i bde ba thams cad ni byang chub kyi sems la brten pa'am des bskyabs pa ste ljon shing gis bskyabs par rtswa 'phel ba lta bu/ nyan rang gi yon tan thams cad ni byang chub kyi sems kyi phyogs gcig gi 'bras bu/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan thams cad ni byang chub kyi sems kyi gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad ni byang chub kyi sems kyi mthar thug gi 'bras bu ste 'khor 'das kyi yon tan thams cad byang chub kyi sems las byung ba yin no/ /bdun pa nyams pa'i nyes dmigs ni/sems mchog de las nyams gyur na/ /rgyal kun mi mnyes 'gro kun bslus/ /rang gzhan don nyams ngan 'gror 'gro/ /de bas 'bad de sems 'di srung / /zhes bya ste/ ngan 'gro mu mtha' med par 'khor/ gzhan don las nyams/ sa 'thob pa la ring du 'gor ba ste/ sems can de dag kun bslus pas/ /bdag gi 'gro ba ci 'drar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'di ltar de ni byung gyur na/ /sems can kun gyi don la dman/ /zhes dang / sa 'thob pa la yun ring thogs/ /zhes sogs re re zhing 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /352

brgyad pa phyir bcos ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba chen po rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la bshags/ /sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya/ /zag pa 'bring ni gsum la bshags/ /gcig gi mdun du lhag ma rnams/ /gzhan yang rgyal sras nam snying gi /mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal ni/ /rmi lam skal 'tsham lus bstan te/ /de yis ltung ba las slong byed/ /ma grub na ni skya rengs la/ /gsol ba btab na de yis sbon/ /gzhan yang nyin mtshan thun drug tu/ /phung po gsum pa la sogs pas/ /'chags la nyes pa'i chus mi gos/ /chos kun gzod nas zhi ba ste/ /mkha' dang sgyu ma ltar shes nas/ /'gro la snying rje mi 'dor ba/ /de la nyes pa'i gnas mi dmigs/ /zhes bya ste/ sdom pa nyi shu par/ sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya/ /zhes slar blang ba las bshags pa dngos su ma byung bas de ltar 'chad pa mang mod kyang snga ma rtsa ltung chen po byung ba la 'gyod pas bshags shing bsdams nas slar len pa kho nar rigs te theg pa thams cad kyi 'dul bar gang las ltung ba byung ba nyes pa'i gzhi de btang zhing ma bsdams par phyir bcos mi 'chags par mtshungs pa'i phyir dang / zag pa 'bring ni gsum la bshags/ /zhes pa'i shugs kyis kyang / zag pa chen po tshogs la bshags/ /zhes 'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /slar yang sngar gyi cho gas dge ba'i bshes gnyen yod pa'am med pa las blang bar bya ste des sor chud par 'gyur ro/ /'dir gtsang nag pas byang sdom nyams pa lan bdun gyi bar du bskyar du rung zhing de nas mi rung bar bshad pa la mtsho sna pa chen pos de ni 'dul ba las skyes pa la lan bdun du bsnyen rdzogs bskyar rung bar bshad pa'i 353

rigs bsgres par zad de byang sdom la bdun gyi nges par bzung ba med do zhes 'chad do/ /kun dkris 'bring gis byas pa'i pha ma 'dra rnams ni zag pa 'bring po ste byang chub sems dpa' la bshags shing slar bsdams pas sor chud do/ /kun dkris chung ngus bskyed pa ni byang chub sems dpa' gcig la bshags shing phyis bsdam pa'o/ /de las gzhan pa'i nyes byas rnams ni phung po gsum pa brjod pas 'dag pa'o/ gsum/ spyir bshags tshad dus las 'das na ji tsam 'das pa ltar chad pa che ba 'dul bar spo mgu spyod pa sogs la bcabs pa'i grangs kyis spyod pa ltar don gyis sdom pa thams cad la mtshungs pas rtsa ltung byung nas lo'am zla ba la sogs pa lon na bshags bsdam dang gnyen po la nan tan cher bya dgos par grub bo/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa la ltung ba byung ba rnams byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la gsol na des smon lam gyi dbang gis sel bar byed de de'i spyi bo la brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bu 'od 'bar ba 'dzin pa las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rtsa ltung las slong nus pa'i rtags su 'chang bar gsungs so/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' ltung ba can des khrus dang gtsang sbra bya spos btul te byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod de phyag 'tshal na nam mkha'i snying pos dngos sam rmi lam du mi nas bya'i bar skal ba 'tsham pa'i gzugs kyis ltung ba las 'byin pa'i thabs ston par 'gyur la/ gal te ma byung na tho rangs langs te lha'i bu skya rengs la skya rengs skya rengs thugs rje chen po can skal ba chen po can khyod dzaspu'i gling 354

du shar ma thag tu bdag la thugs rjes khyab par mdzod cig byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po thugs rje can la bdag gi tshig gis spron te bdag gi rmi lam du yang de ston par 'gyur zhing gang gis thabs des ltung ba bshags par 'gyur ba dang 'chags pa'i theg pa chen po la thabs dang ye shes 'thob par mdzod cig ces smras nas gnyid log na skya rengs shar tshe nam snying rmi lam du skal ba bzhin ston pas ltung ba 'chags pa ston no zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang gang gis dben par byang chub sems dpa' nam snying la phyag byas te/ a ga ru'am rgya spos sam dus kyi rjes su 'brang bas bdugs te thal mo sbyar nas phyogs mtshams kun du yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal nas/ tabyāshā/ su mṛ sha su mṛ sha su mṛ sha kā ru ṇi ga tsa ra tsa ra bi tsa ra sa tsa ra/ kā ru ṇi ka mu ra mu ra/ be ga dha ri ma tsa me/bhu dza pā da kā ru ṇi ga tsirnya ma ṇi pū ra ya kā ru ṇi ma sarba sha me s+thā pā ya adzñā dha ri/ sku gung spu gung / ru ti bi be ka gung dṛṣ+ṭi bi be ka gung pū ra ya kā ru ṇi ka pū ra yan+tu ma ma a sha sarba pazitsa a sho ka ga ti swā hā/ 'di lan du mar bzlas te nyal na des rmi lam du mi nas bya'i bar skal ba 'tsham pa'i gzugs bstan te tshul gcig pa'i chos ston par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas bshags pa'i tshe'ang gzungs 'di brjod na legs so snyam mo/ /de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin ster ba'i gzugs kyang 'dir bshad do/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' tshogs pa nas gcig gi bar du bshags yul ma rnyed na yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du byas te phung po gsum pa la sogs pas bshags shing 355

sdom par dam bcas nas slar blangs pas kyang thams cad sor chud par byed de theg pa chen po 'di ni sems kyi las kho na gtso ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems ji ltar nyams su blang pa bshad nas/don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems ji ltar sgom pa yang cung zad bshad par bya ste/ de yang don dam byang sems kyi ngo bo ni gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs shing 'di klu'i zhabs kyis 'grel par mdzad pa byang chub sems 'grel yin la/ spang bkong phyag rgya'i mdo dang klu'i zhabs nyid kyi don dam sems skyed kyi cho gar yang / dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyis rang gi/ sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bgyi'o zhes tshigs su bcad pa lhug par bgrol te gsungs la 'phags klu'i cho ga de nyid la brten nas 'bogs pa dang len pa'i rgyun byung ba la/chos rje sa skya pas/ don dam sems skyed ces bya ba/ /bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skye mod kyi/ /cho ga'i sgo nas 'di mi skye/ /gal te cho gas skye ba na/ /brda las byung ba'i sems skyed 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs mod kyang re zhig brtag par bya ste/ ci sngags lugs kyi don dam sems skyed yod dam med/ gal te yod na/ khyed rang ltar na de chos can/ cho ga las skye 356

bar thal/ sngags kyi lugs yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ mdo dang sngags kyi khyad par ni/ /cho ga'i bya ba yod med yin/ /zer ba dang 'gal/ 'dod na de chos can/ brda las byung ba'i sems skyed du thal/ cho ga las skyes pa'i sems skyed yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ don dam sems skyed yin pa'i phyir te 'khor gsum ga la lan gyis dben no/ /yang dbu sems kyi sems skyed gnyis chos can/ sngags lugs su thal/ cho ga las skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na de gnyis la chos can/ dbang bskur yod par thal/ gsang sngags yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ dbang bskur med pas gsang sngags min/ /zer ba dang 'gal lo/ /spyir yang cho ga zhes bya ba ni de 'grub pa'i thabs kyi bya ba'i ming ste dper na so nam gyi bya ba la so nam gyi cho ga zhes grags pa dang / rgya mtsho las nor bu len pa'i thabs la de'i cho ga grags pa lta bu'i phyir/ des na kun rdzob sems skyed kyang don dam sems skyed skye ba'i cho ga yin te de skye ba'i thabs yin pa'i phyir/ des na cho ga'i ming tsam la de tsam du zhen pa ni mkhas pa'i rnam 'gyur ga la yin/ don dam sems skyed sgom stobs kyis skye zhes pa'ang da lta ma blangs par bsgugs nas bsdad pas nam zhig na chu las lbu ba ltar skyer re ba zhig ma gtogs da lta nas bsgoms pas gong nas gong du je gsal du 'gyur te ji lta ba mngon du byed pa zhig tu khyed cag gis ma go ba 'dra ste de lta na khyed rnams kyis yun ring por bsgugs shig dang de'i 'bras bu ci 'dra ba zhig blta'o/ /des na don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni da lta nas gtso bor mnyam par bzhag pa sgom pa'i stobs kyis skyed pa ste/ byang 357

chub sems 'grel las/ byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis de ltar kun rdzob kyi rnam pas byang chub kyi sems smon pa'i rang bzhin can bskyed nas don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni gtso bor sgom pa'i stobs kyis bskyed par bya ba yin la de'i phyir de'i rang bzhin bshad par bya'o zhes rgyud la bsgom byar bstan no/ /gal te 'di'i khungs gsang ba 'dus pa yin zhing sngags kyi byang sems kyis bsgrub byar bstan pa'i phyir phar phyin theg par 'di bshad na gsang sgrogs su 'gyur ro zhe na/ ston pa nyid kyis rgyud du tshigs bcad kyis bka' bstsal zhing spang bkong phyag rgya'i mdor tshigs lhug pas bka' bstsal bas mdo sngags gnyi gar du tshig bcad lhug las khyad par gzhan med par gsungs pa de ci'i phyir gsang sgrogs su 'gyur/ don 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mthong ba nyid snying por dril te gsungs par snang bas sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa sogs sngags bla med kyi gsang sgrogs su mi 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /de yang stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi mthong ba ni don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis byang chub sems/ /khams dang phung sogs rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs shing / /rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed/ /snying rjes brlan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'bad pas bsgom par bya ba yin/ /zhes so/ /stong nyid ji lta bu zhig zhe na/ stong pa nyid ni bstan du che/da la gang gi yang ngo bor mi gnas mod kyang las dang po ba la sgro btags kyi rnam par rtog pa rim gyis bsal bas nges par byed de/ de yang / dngos po thams cad dang bral ba 358

ni mdor bstan pa ste chos 'di thams cad ni ji ltar sgro btags pa de ltar yang mi gnas la/ sgro ma btags pa'i dus kyi rang bzhin 'di'o zhes bya bar yang med de gzod ma nas dngos po thams cad kyis stong pa'o/ /de yang mu stegs pa rnams kyis bdag tu btags pa gzhom pa'i ched du ston pas bdag gcig tu 'dzin pa gzhig pa'i phyir phung po lnga dang bdag kun la khyab pa gzhig pa'i phyir khams bco brgyad dang za ba po'i bdag rang dbang can gzhig pa'i phyir skye mched bcu gnyis bstan no/ /de la nyan thos grub mtha' pa rnams kyis der mngon par zhen pas phra ba rang mtshan gyi dngos po don dam par 'dzin pa na de gzhom pa'i phyir gzung 'dzin du snang ba'i chos thams cad ni sems las gzhan ma yin par bstan no/ /de la yang rnal 'byor spyod pa ba rnams kyis so so rang rig gi sems don dam du zhen pa'i 'khrul ba skyes pa na sems nyid kyang dmigs su med par bstan pa ste/ bdag tu 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /phung po khams sogs bstan pa yin/ /sems tsam po la gnas nas ni/ /skal chen rnams kyis de yang spang / /rnam par shes par smra ba la/ /sna tshogs 'di ni sems su grub/ /rnam shes rang bzhin gang zhe na/ /da ni de nyid bshad bya ste/ /'di dag thams cad sems tsam zhes/ /thub pas bstan par gang mdzad de/ /byis pa rnams kyi skrag pa ni/ /spang ba'i phyir yin de nyid min/ /kun btags dang ni gzhan dbang dang / /yongs su grub pa nyid 'di ni/ /stong nyid bdag nyid gcig pu yi/ /ngo bo sems la btags pa yin/ /theg chen dga' ba'i bdag nyid la/ /chos la bdag med mnyam pa nyid/ /sems ni 359

gdod nas ma skyes te/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni mdor bsdus gsungs/ /zhes dang / sems 'di ming tsam yin pa ste/ /ming las gzhan du 'ga' yang med/ /ming tsam du ni rnam rig lta/ /ming yang rang bzhin med pa yin/ /nang ngam de bzhin phyi rol lam/ /yang na gnyi ga'i bar dag tu/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis sems ma rnyed/ /de phyir sgyu ma'i rang bzhin sems/ /kha dog dbyibs kyi dbye ba'am/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa'am/ /skyes pa bud med ma ning sogs/ /ngo bor sems ni gnas pa min/ /mdor na sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /gzigs par ma gyur gzigs mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /ji lta bur na gzigs par 'gyur/ /zhes te ji ltar sems kyi rang bzhin ci yang ma yin gang du'ang mi 'du ci yang byar med sus kyang mthong du'ang med ma mthong du'ang med gnyis ka dang gnyis min du mi gnas pa de bzhin du chos thams cad de kho na ste gang la'ang gcig pa dang tha dad par ma mthong ba 'di ni chos kyi bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de ltar rang gi sems gdod ma nas ngo bo med cing gnas med la skye ba dang 'gag pa ma yin par mthong ba 'di ni stong pa nyid ces kun rdzob tu tha snyad du bya ba ste/ brtser ldan kun gyis dus gsum du/ /stong pa mkha' dang mtshungs par mkhyen/ /de phyir chos rnams kun gyi gzhi/ /zhi zhing sgyu ma dang mtshungs par/ /gzhi med srid pa 'jig byed pa'i/ /stong nyid 'di ni rtag tu sgom/ /zhes so/ /ji ltar sgom zhe na/ gang yang ma dmigs shing 'dzin pa las log pa tsam la sgom par tha snyad du byas pa ste/ sems la dmigs pa med pa yi/ /gnas pa nam mkha'i 360

mtshan nyid yin/ /de dag stong nyid sgom pa ni/ /nam mkha' sgom par bzhed pa yin/ /zhes so/ /stong nyid de chad par lta ba ma yin nam zhe na rtag chad ni dngos 'dzin can rnams la yod kyi rang bzhin shes pa rnams la med de/ stong nyid rang bzhin du brjod pas/ /'ga' zhig chad par smras pa min/ /des ni rtag pa nyid du yang / /'ga' zhig smras pa ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /des na chos thams cad ni rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma tsam zhig ste de la kun rdzob tu brjod la de'i tshe'ang de nyid rang gi ngo bo gzod nas dag pa la don dam par 'dogs par zad kyi kun rdzob las gzhan du don dam pa rtag brtan kyang med de chos gcig la bsam pa'i dbang gis ming tha dad du byas pa sgyu ma'i na chung la sgyu mar ma shes pa'i cha nas bzang mo zhes brjod pa dang sgyu mar shes nas sgyu ma'i bud med ces smras kyang de gnyis la gzhi tha dad mi dmigs pa bzhin te/kun rdzob las ni tha dad par/ /de nyid dmigs pa ma yin te/ /kun rdzob stong pa nyid du bshad/ /stong nyid kho na kun rdzob yin/ /med na mi 'byung nges pa'i phyir/ /byas dang mi rtag ji bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /de ltar chos rnams kyi dngos po'i gnas tshul stong pa nyid du shes nas de la rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni stong nyid sgom pa yin la de'i tshe de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can sgyu ma lta bu la snying rje 'bad med du 'byung zhing chos thams cad su'i yang ma yin par —rig pas gang la'ang chags pa med par thams cad gtong / chu nang du lha dang srin po'i gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu shar ba ltar 'khor 'das gnyis ku'ang de tsam du mthong bas srid pas mi skrag 361

zhi ba la mi re bar nam mkha' ma stongs kyi bar du gzhan don la brtson par 'gyur ba ni stong nyid bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu yin te/ de ltar stong pa nyid 'di ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis sgom byas na/ /gzhan gyi don la chags pa'i blo/ /'byung bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /ces dang / gang zhig bsgoms pas brtan pa yang / /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal gyis bred nas/ /bsam gtan bde ba dor nas kyang / /mnar med par yang 'jug par byed/ /'di ni ngo mtshar 'di bsngags 'os/ /'di ni dam pa'i tshul lugs mchog /de dag rnams kyis rang lus dang / /nor rnams byin pa ngo mtshar min/ /chos rnams stong pa 'di shes nas/ /las dang 'bras bu bsten pa gang / /de ni ngo mtshar bas ngo mtshar/ /rmad byung bas kyang rmad du byung / /sems can skyabs pa'i bsam pa can/ /de dag srid pa'i 'dam skyes kyang / /de byung nyes pas ma gos pa/ /chu yis pad ma'i 'dab ma bzhin/ /zhes dang rgyan las/ de yis chos kun sgyu ma lta bu dang / /skye ba skyed mos tshal 'gro ltar rtogs pas/ /'byor ba'i dus dang rgud pa'i dus na'ang 'di/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal dag gis 'jigs pa med/ /rang gi yon tan sems can phan 'dogs dga'/ /bsam bzhin skye ba rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul/ /rgyan dang ston mo sa mchog brtse dga' ba/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid min pa rnams la med/ /gzhan don brtson ldan snying rje'i bdag nyid 'di/ /gang tshe mnar med la yang dgar 'dzin pa/ /de 'dra ba dag snying na gzhan bsten can/ /sdug bsngal 'byung ba rnams kyis ga la 'jigs/ /zhes so/ /de ltar don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems shes rab dri ma med pas 362

srid pa la mi gnas shing snying rje chen pos zhi ba nyan rang gi mtha' la mi gnas pa de nyid la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ste byang chub sems 'grel de nyid las/ 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa la/ /bdag nyid che de mi gnas pas/ /de phyir sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das par bshad/ /ces so/ /des na don dam byang sems chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin khong du chud pa 'di med na kun rdzob byang sems nyid kyang srung bar mi nus te myur du 'jig par 'gyur la don dam pa'i rang bzhin gyi phyogs 'di shes pa na cho ga'i ming can gyis blangs kyang rung ma blangs kyang rung ste kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bzod par dka' ba bcos ma ma yin pa snying rje zlog tu med pa'i shugs kyis drangs pa smon lam gyi rnam pa mtha' yas pa la 'jug pa de lta bu ni nyin re la yang lan ches mang por bzlog mi nus par de nas skye ba yin no/ /gal te don dam byang sems da lta bsgom bya min te de 'phags lam na yod pa'i phyir snyam na 'o na sbyin sogs drug kyang da lta bsgrub bya min te sa dang po nas drug pa'i bar la re re yod pa'i phyir/ rjes su yi rang yang da lta bsgom bya min te de zag bcas sgom lam na yod pa'i phyir/ smon lam yang da lta gdab bya min te de sa dgu pa na yod pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba yang blta byar mi rung ste de bsngo ba sgom lam na yod pa'i phyir/ des na mi mdzangs pa dag bu ram gyi zhing dang 'bras sā lu'i zhing rmod cing bskrun pa'i zhing las kyi mtha' la gcig tu brtson pa'i 'gram du byis pa rtse ba dag 'dus te 'di ni 'di 'dra'o 'di ni rings so 'di ni gdab nyes so zhes sna tshogs par smra ba 363
