bzhin du 'chi bas skrag cing mi lus don ldan du 'dod pa'i skyes bu rnams rtse gcig tu dam pa'i lam sgrub pa na mkhas pa'i ming can tshe 'di'i zang zing gi 'dun ma grub pas chog pa du mas khyed cag gi de ni nor ro 'di ni thungs so sa bon la mi 'thad do cho gas skye'o mi skye'o zhes gzhan gyi dge ba la phrag dog pa'i snyad 'dogs sna tshogs pa bgyid pa rnams kyi tshig gis sems mi g.yo bar rtse gcig tu rang gi yang dag pa'i lam sgrub par byos shig des na/ kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /de nyid gzod nas stong pa nyid/ /chos rnams nam mkha' ji 'dra bar/ /shes pa'i mnyam bzhag goms par bya/ /de ltar ma rtogs sems can la/ /snying rjes rtag tu phan pa spyad/ /'di ni don dam sems mchog yin/ /de ltar kun rdzob don dam gyi/ /byang chub sems gnyis lhur byed pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phrin las gcig tu gnas pa yin/ /zhes bya'o/ /byang chub kyi sems spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don go rim du bshad pa la gsum/ byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon bshad pa/ byang chub kyi sems ji ltar blang tshul/ thob pa mi nyams par srung tshul lo/ /dang po la ma mthong ba'i phan yon/ mthong chos kyi phan yon/ dpe drug gis bsngags pa ste thun mong gi phan yon gsum/ 'jug sems kyi phan yon khyad par du bshad pa'o/ /dang po la yang / sdig pa sel ba/ rang la phan pa/ gzhan skyob pa/skyes bu gsum ga'i lam gyi rten du 'gyur ba ste bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems min pa/ /dge gzhan gang gis zil gyis non par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/364

'grel pa phal mo cher de ltas zhes pa'i rkang pa'ang 'di la sbyar ro/ /'di la sdig pa drungs 'byin pa ni don dam byang sems kyi phan yon yin yang kun rdzob kyi smon pas kyang mngon gyur ba mgo gnon nus te sems skyed pa las kyi sgrib pa chen po dang ldan yang ngan song du ma song ba mang du bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ bskal ba du mar rab dgongs mdzad pa yi/ /thub dbang rnams kyis 'di nyid phan par gzigs/ /zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dis ni tshad med skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bde mchog bde blag nyid du 'thob par byed/ /ces gsungs te/ skra 'bal ba sogs kyi gdung ba med par 'jug pas bde mchog dang bde blag ste/ bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ /sems shes su zhig sgyid lug 'gyur/ /zhes 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /'o na byams pa'i stobs kyi skyes rabs sogs ji lta zhe na/ pha rol gyi sdug bsngal gyis rang sdug bsngal bar gyur pa'i blo can rnams ni de 'dra ba la bde ba nyid du mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes dka' 'grel chen mor ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag gzhom 'dod cing / /sems can mi bde bsal bar 'dod pa dang / /bde mang brgya phrag spyod par 'dod pas kyang / /byang chub sems nyid rtag tu gtang mi bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'khor ba'i bde ba 'dod pas kyang sems bskyed par bya ste 'khor ba'i bde 'bras thams cad bskal pa bye bar myong yang des rgyu la bri gang du mi mngon pa'i phyir/ rang nyid zhi ba 'dod pas kyang byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya ste myur du 'khor ba las thar bar 'dod pas kyang byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o zhes dang mchog zung myur du thar bar 365

'dod pas theg dman du sems bskyed pa yin yang nga byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'di gnyis thar bar ma nus so zhes so/ /sems can skyabs par 'dod pas kyang sems bskyed par bya ste de'i rgyu ni de kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ smon pa'i byang chub kyi sems skyes ma thag de nyid du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gnag rjes tsam du byas te rgyal ba'i sras kyi ming 'thob/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lhas phyag byed/ byang chub sems dpa'o zhes bkur snyi'i gnas su 'gyur ba'i phyir te 'dul ba'i lung las rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis ston pa la rab byung gi phan yon zhus pas khyod nyid la dri bar bya ste khyod kyi bran go re long mngag gzhug pa ci dgos byed pa zhig da lta nga'i thad du rab tu byung ste bsnyen par rdzogs na phyin chad des khyod kyi rkang pa bkru ba dang go re long byed dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de mi bgyid de gzhan du na de'i zhabs la bdag gis phyag bya ba dang bdag gis de'i rkang pa bkru bar bya bar 'gyur ro/ /bka' bstsal pa rgyal po chen po de lta bas na don 'dis kyang ngas rab tu byung ba'i phan yon bshad pa ma yin nam/ zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa dpe drug gis bsngags pa ni/ dman pa mchog tu bsgyur ba gser 'gyur gyi rtsi'i dpe/ rin dang mthu che ba nor bu'i dpe/ 'bras bu zad mi shes pa dpag bsam gyi shing gi dpe/ myong bar nges pa'i sdig pa 'joms pa dpa' bo'i 366

dpe/ myong bar ma nges pa 'joms pa me'i dpe/ phan yon rgyas par mdo las bstan tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bur/ /mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan zung / /zhes gsungs te/ gser gyi rigs chen po dngul chur snang bas lcags thams cad gser du byed kyang de lcags kyis nyams mi nus pa lta bu'o/ /'dir sdong po bkod pa na gser du snang ba'i dngul chu zhes yod kyang 'gyur ram bar du ma dag pa zhig ste ro bcud chen po de ni rnam pa dngul chur yod la ngo bo gser gyi mchog yin pas des phrad ma thag lcags khams kyi ro thams cad phug nas gser gyi khams 'ba' zhig par byed par mdo myang 'das sogs dang rgyud dus 'khor sogs las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'gro ba'i ded dpon gcig pu tshad med blos/ /legs par yongs su brtags na rin che bas/ /'gro ba'i gnas dang bral bar 'dod pa rnams/ /rin chen byang chub sems legs brtan par zung / /zhes gsungs te/ dka' 'grel chen mor/ 'gro ba tshong brdal pa rnams la kye byang chub kyi sems kyi nor bu kho na nyos shig ces gtan tshigs dang bcas nas 'doms pa ste nyi zla'i 'od kyis khyab pa tshun chad kyi dngos po kun gyis rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i rin du mi chog pa ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi rin du nyan rang man gyi dge ba thams cad kyis mi chog par gsungs pa drangs so/ /gsum pa ni/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni/ /'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi 367

ljon shing rtag par yang / /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ dge ba gzhan rnams ni sba dang smyug ma dang chu shing ltar 'bras bu lan gcig phyung nas rtsa ba skam la byang chub kyi sems ni n+ya gro dha la sogs pa ltar 'bras bu zad mi shes pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang / /dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa che las ltar/ /gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba/ /de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra lta bu'ang byang chub kyi sems kyi mthus tshe de la sgra byung gi bzod pa thob par 'gyod bsal gyi mdo las bshad pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa ni/ des ni dus mtha'i mes bzhin sdig chen rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed/ /ces gsungs te/ dus mtha'i mes dngos po thams cad kyang sreg pa ltar myong bar nges ma nges sogs kyi mi dge ba'i las lam thams cad nus med du byed pa'o/ /'o na las chud mi 'dza' bar gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te bsod nams kyi tshogs nam mkha'i khongs lta bur chud pas rgya mtshor lan tshwa srang gcig ltar mi mngon pa dang / gnyen po stobs ldan gyis zil gyis mnan pas nus med du byas pas bsregs pa nyid yin pa'i phyir dang / ma spyad par las mi zad pa yang gnyen pos ma zin pa la dgongs la 'di ni sdig pa thams cad rtsa ba nas med par byed pa'i thabs chen po yin pa'i phyir dang / sems can thams cad sdug bsngal kun las bton te bde ba thams cad la sbyar bar sems shing sngar byas kyi sdig pa rnams rnam par sun 'byin pas zad par byed pa'i phyir ro zhes 'grel 368

chen las so/ /'di ni 'grel pa mkhan po dang rngog lo'i lugs ltar ma dpyad par bshad pa ste gtsang nag pa na re myong nges kyi sdig pa med de myong nges ni rgyu nus pa thogs med la 'jog na de ni skad cig gnyis par 'bras bu 'byin pa yin la sdig pa ni nus pa thogs bcas yin la thogs bcas la myong bar ma nges pas khyab bo/ /des na 'bras bu sdug bsngal las skyob pa dang rgyu sdig pa las skyob pa la skyel ma dang me'i dpe'o zhes 'chad do/ /drug pa ni/ de yi phan yon dpag tu med pa dag /byams mgon blo dang ldan pas nor bzang bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ phan yon mtha' yas mod kyi rags pa zhig sdong pos brgyan par byams pas gsungs pa la ltos shig ces pa ste dpe nyis brgya lhag pa zhig rang don gyi yon tan gzhan don gyi yon tan mi mthun pa'i phyogs gcod pa'i yon tan mthu phun tshogs 'grub pa'i yon tan te don bzhir bsdus te bstan la de tshigs bcad du bsdus pa ni/ ji ltar sa bon zhing dang sa chu rlung / /me dang zla ba nyi ma sgron ma mig /lam dang mu stegs gzhon pa sgo khang bzang / /skyed tshal gnas rten gzhi dang pha ma dang / /ma ma rgyal po lha dbang rgya mtsho ri/ /khor yug gangs ri spos ngad ldang ba'i rogs/ /nam mkha' pad+ma glang chen cang shes rta/ /kha lo bsgyur ba sman dang sa 'og nyid/ /rdo rje spos snod me tog mchog dang ni/ /kha ba'i tsan+dan dkar min a ga ru/ /lta na sdug pa'i sman rgyal 'bral byed sman/ /dbang po ngal sos po dang dpal lhab lhub/ /bskal me sman mchog rtsa ba ma grub pa/ /klu yi rin chen chu dwangs yid bzhin 'byung / /bum bzang 'dod sbyin shing dang ngang ris gos/ /shing 369

bal gshol dang mde'u thung mda' dang mdung / /go cha ral gri spu gri'i so dang ni/ /ste'u kha dpa' bo'i ru mtshon sta re dang / /mtshon cha lag pa rkang pa mig mkhan nyid/ /skam pa tsher zung mdza' bo nor gtsug lag /gter dang chu mig me long pad ma dkar/ /chu klung klu rgyal 'tsho ba'i dbang po dang / /bdud rtsi snyi dang mchil pa spos kyi snod / /dug sman sngags dang rlung dkyil rin chen gling / /rigs dang 'byung gnas tshong 'dus chu yi khams/ /sbrang rtsi lam snod char pa gnas khab len/ /bai ḍūr+ya dang dbang sngon tho rengs rnga/ /chu dwangs dzaspu'i gser rgyan ri rab dang / /skyabs don dbyig dang mchod sbyin gyi yo byad/ /rgan pa gleng gzhi mdo dang rdzi bo dang / /srung ma dbang po'i mig 'phrul chu'i zhags pa/ /dbang po'i ma dang mchod rten lta bu yi/ /byang chub sems kyi yon tan brjod mi langs/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras yon tan ci yod pa/ /de kun byang chub sems kyi mthur ltos shig /gang gis byang chub sems mchog de bskyed pa/ /de yi yon tan tshad med phun su/ma tshogs/ /ji ltar 'jigs med ces bya'i rtsi yod de/ /de 'chang de la 'jigs pa lnga mi 'byung / /de bzhin kun mkhyen sems kyi rtsi 'chang de/ /yul gyi dug dang 'dod chags mes mi tshugs/ /kun rtog du bas mi 'chi nyon mongs kyi/ /mtshon gyis mi chod srid pa'i chus mi 'khyer/ /ji ltar mchu yi rtsi 'chang na/ /dri yis sbrul kun 'byer ba ltar/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsi yi dris/ /nyon mongs sbrul tshogs 'byer bar byed/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rtsi bcangs pas/ /dgra las kun tu rgyal ba ltar/ /kun mkhyen thub dka'i sems 'chang ba/ /bdud dang phas rgol kun las rgyal/ /sdug 370

bsngal zug rngu kun 'byin rnam sel rtsi dang mtshungs/ /lta na sdug pa'i rtsi ltar nyon mongs nad kun sel/ /rtsi yi shing chen sbyor ba'i shun pas rma 'tsho zhing / /shun pa slar skye de bzhin byang sems kyis bskru na pa/ /kun mkhyen sems kyis las nyon rma 'tsho nyams mi nus/ /rtsa ba ma grub shing gis 'dzam gling rnam 'phel ltar/ /byang chub sems kyis 'gro kun dge ba yongs su 'phel/ /dga' ba 'thob pa'i rtsi bzhin du/ /bcangs pas lus sems nad med byed/ /rtsi mchog dran pa 'thob pa ltar/ /bcangs pas dran pa rnam dag 'thob/ /ji ltar pad ma chen po'i rtsi/ /zos pas bskal pa'i tshe thub ltar/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsi zos pa/ /grangs med bskal pa'i tshe la dbang / /mi snang ba yi rtsi bcangs pa/ /'gro ba kun gyis mi mthong ltar/ /byang chub sems ldan 'dres spyod kyang / /bdud kyi yul kun gyis mi mthong / /rin chen yongs su sdud pa yi/ /nor bu rgya mtshor gnas de srid/ /bskal me 'bar yang ta la yi/ /srid tsam skem par nus min ltar/ /byang chub sems kyi nor bu'i mchog /gang gi yid mtshor gnas rnams kyi/ /dge ba'i chu gter rkyen rnams kyis/ /mi 'phrog chud zar 'gyur ba med/ /'od 'dus nor bu ji bzhin dman pa'i sems/ /rin chen rgyan mang kun nas zil gyis gnon/ /chu dwangs bzhin du nyon mongs 'dam rnyog sel/ /chu 'grogs bcangs ltar 'khor ba'i chur mi 'bying / /klu nor go cha'i rin chen sus thogs pa/ /sbrul gyi gnod las rnam par rgyal ba ltar/ /sems skyed rin chen thogs pa'i rgyal ba'i sras/ /khams gsum kun tu 'gro yang nyams pa med/ /yid bzhin rgyal po lta bur dgos rgu 'byung / /me shel 371

bzhin du shes rab nyi zer gyis/ /phog pa'i mod la ye shes me chen 'byin/ /zla bas mdzes ltar sngo ba'i zla zer gyis/ /phog na dge ba'i smon lam chu rgyun 'byin/ /snying rje chen po'i rin chen sems/ /gtsug gi nor bur mngon thogs pa'i/ /rgyal sras klu yi dbang po ni/ /mi khom gnod pa'i 'jigs pa med/ /byang chub sems kyi nor bu gang / /rin chen 'gro ba'i rgyan dam pa/ /'gro kun bsam pa skong ba las/ /nam yang byang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nor bu rin chen lta bur mun pa sel/ /dbang sngon lta bur kha dog gcig tu byed/ /baiḍūr+ya bzhin dri med 'od kyang gsal/ /rnam dag 'od bzhin rin chen kun las 'phags/ /me 'byung lta bur mun pa rab tu sel/ /theg dman 'ching bu zil gnon nor bu nyid/ /dbang rgyal nyi zla'i gzugs brnyan rgyan ston ltar/ /'khor bar gnas kyang rgyal yul gzugs brnyan ston/ /de la longs spyod thams cad kyis/ /rin du mi chog ji lta bar/ /lha mi nyan rang dge kun gyis/ /rgyal sras sems kyi rin mi chog /rgya mtsho'i rgyan bzhin kun mkhyen gyi/ /chu gter rgyan kun snang bar byed/ /bla med yid bzhin rgyal po las gzhan gyis/ /zil gyis mi non lha rdzas dzasbu'i gser/ /rin chen sems kyi klu dbang grub pa ni/ /nyon mongs sbrul gyi tshogs la rang dbang byed/ /rgyal sras mi zhum sems kyi mtshon thogs pa/ /nyon mongs dgra yis mi tshugs rab tu dpa'/ /bla med sems kyi lha rdzas sbrul snying ni/ /lhag bsam gcig gi yon tan dri yis kyang / /chos dbyings rab 'gengs nyan rang bcas pa yi/ /'jig rten kun gyi dge ba zil gyis gnon/ /ji ltar kha ba'i tsan+dan ni/ /gdung sel bsil ba de bzhin du/ /372

nyon mongs gdung sel ye shes kyi/ /lus kyang rab tu sim par byed/ /rgyal sras ri dbang drung 'ongs kun/ /kun mkhyen gser mdog gcig tu bsgyur/ /ljon shing sus kyang mi tshugs dang / /kun nas 'du ba'i shun phrags kyi/ /dri zhim 'byung ba de 'dra ba/ /'dzam gling me tog gzhan la med/ /de bzhin sems skyed kyis bskrun pa'i/ /smon lam dang ni ye shes kyi/ /dri zhim de lta nyan thos dang / /rang sangs rgyas pa kun la'ang med/ /shing mchog de dag kha 'bus na/ /me tog mang po'i 'byung gnas nyid/ /de ltar rin chen sems kyi shing / /dge bas kun nas kha 'bus pa/ /zag bcas zag pa med pa yi/ /byang chub me tog 'byung gnas nyid/ /yongs 'du'i me tog gis bsgos pa'i/ /gos sam til mar dri de lta/ /gzhan la yod pa min de ltar/ /rgyal sras tshe gcig sems bskyed pa'i/ /yon tan dri zhim ngad ldang bas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i drung 'gengs pa/ /de lta bskal pa 'bum phrag tu/ /goms pa'i slob ma rnams la'ang med/ /rgya mtsho gnod bral nas skye ba/ /na li ki ri zhes bya'i shing / /rtsa ba nas ni 'bras bu'i bar/ /'gro ba'i sman du mi 'gyur med/ /brtse dang smon lam gyis bskrun pa'i/ /rgyal sras sems kyang de 'dra ste/ /thog ma'i sems nas rgyal ba'i bar/ /kun kyang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho nyid/ /gser du snang ba'i dngul chu yis/ /lcags kun gser du sgyur byed kyang / /lcags kyis ngan par bsgyur mi nus/ /byang chub bsngos pa'i dge ba'i ros/ /las nyon lcags kun drungs 'byin yang / /de ni las dang nyon mongs kyis/ /nam yang nyams par byar mi nus/ /me ni chung yang ji tsam rkyen dang phrad pa de snyed 373

'bar ba ltar/ /tshogs gnyis bud shing spel ba de srid ye shes 'od kyi snang ba 'byin/ /rin chen sems kyi mar me gcig las dus gsum rgyal ba'i mar me'i tshogs/ /mngon par spel yang sems kyi sgron me de ni mi zad thug pa med/ /byang chub sems kyi sgron me chung ngus kyang / /thog med bsags pa'i las nyon mun pa sel/ /smon lam sdong bu snying rje'i mar ldan pa/ /de srid bla med sems kyi sgron me 'bar/ /sems mchog lha yi dzam+bu'i gser gyi rgyan/ /mi ldog rgyal sras dbang bsgyur rgyal po yi/ /mgo bor thogs de byis pa nyan rang bcas/ /'jig rten yon tan rgyan gyis 'phrog pa med/ /thams cad mkhyen sems seng ge'i nga ro yis/ /dmigs par gnas pa'i ri dwags kun 'byer yang / /dang po'i sems ldan rgyal sras seng ge'i bu/ /btsas ma thag pa rnams kyang dga' bar byed/ /stong nyid seng ge'i rgyus pas rgyud byas pa/ /rin chen byang chub sems kyi pi wang sgras/ /srid par dga' ba'i pi wang rgyud 'chad de/ /nyan rang gtam gyi sgra dag 'gag par 'gyur/ /nyon mongs ra dang ma he'i 'o ma'i mtshor/ /kun mkhyen sems kyi seng ge'i 'o ma ni/ /thigs gcig blugs pas de kun zad 'gyur te/ /nyan rang dman pa'i rnam thar 'du mi nus/ /rgyal sras ka la piṅka'i phru gu ni/ /srid pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs na gnas pa yi/ /lhag bsam nga ros nyan rang gangs ri'i bya/ /stobs yongs rdzogs pa'i dbyangs kun zil gyis gnon/ /rgyal ba mkha' lding dbang po'i rigs byung ba/ /dang po'i sems ldan btsas ma thag pa yi/ /snying rje'i gshog rlung lhag bsam mig dag pa/ /de ni nyan thos rnams dang rang rgyal gyi/ /bya gzhan 'dab ma yongs su rdzogs 374

la'ang med/ /stobs chen gyis sbyang mde'u thung lta/ /nyes pa'i go cha ma lus 'bigs/ /mthu chen rngams shing khros pa ltar/ /snying rjes rngams pa'i lhag bsam gdong / /sems skyed thor bu ldan de bsring / /bdud kyi 'gro bas thub pa med/ /'phong la mkhas pa'i mchan bu ltar/ /ma byang na yang gzhan dag gi /stobs kyi shes pa zil gyis gnon/ /'phong gi rgyus la dang po nyid/ /rkang stabs goms par byed pa ltar/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang 'dod pa rnams/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa goms par byed/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan pos sngags bsgrubs te/ /sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul ston pa ltar/ /sems skyed smon lam bsgrubs nas ni/ /rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul yongs su ston/ /sgyu ma'i rig sngags gzugs med kyang / /mos pa tsam gyis sprul ba ltar/ /kun mkhyen sems ni gzugs med kyang / /goms pas chos dbyings mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /byi las bltas pas byi ba'i tshogs/ /skrag cing 'byer ba de bzhin du/ /lhag bsam sbyor ba chung ngus kyang / /las dang nyon mongs rab tu 'byer/ /dzasbu'i gser gyi rgyan gyis ni/ /rgyan gzhan zil gyis gnon pa ltar/ /byang chub sems kyi rgyan bzang pos/ /nyan rang yon tan zil gyis gnon/ /khab long gis ni sra ba yi/ /lcags sgrog kun nas 'jig pa ltar/ /rin chen sems kyis lta ba dang / /ma rig sred pa'i sgrog kun 'jig /khab long khams ni gar gnas par/ /phal pa'i lcags kun mi gnas ltar/ /las nyon rngams dang nyan rang gi /rnam thar kun kyang yongs su 'byer/ /gang gis chu srin tshil zos pa/ /chur gnas kun gyis mi gnod ltar/ /byang sems cha gcig zos pa yang / //las dang nyon mongs kyis mi 'jigs/ /375

theg pa dman pa'i rnam grol kyi/ /chu srin gyis kyang gnod mi nus/ /rin chen sems kyi bdud rtsi sus 'thungs pa/ /de ni dman pa'i 'jigs pa kun las rgyal/ /rku ba grub ltar bdud kun gyis mi mthong / /chos kyi rgyal por bsten de 'jigs kun bral/ /lhag bsam chus brlan dman pa'i mes mi 'jigs/ /sems skyed thub dka'i dpa' bo la brten pa/ /de ni spyod pa ngan pa'i dgras mi 'jigs/ /brgya byin rdo rje thogs pa ji bzhin du/ /bdud dang pas kyi rgol ba'i lha min 'joms/ /ro bcud tshim par 'thungs pa'i skyes bu bzhin/ /dman par mi 'chi skyo ba'i rga nad med/ /sman sbyong kun la chu sngon 'gro ba ltar/ /rgyal sras spyod kun sngon du sems skyed 'gro/ /mi yi bgyi kun srog dbang sngon 'gro nyid/ /rgyal ba'i chos kun byang chub sems kyis sgrub/ /srog dbang 'gags pa 'tsho bar mi nus ltar/ /rin chen sems dang bral na 'tshang mi rgya/ /rgya mtsho dug gis gdug par mi nus ltar/ /srid zhi'i blo yis rin chen sems mi gos/ /sems kyi dam pa nyin mor byed pa'i dpal/ /zag med dman pa'i sar 'od kun las rgyal/ /rgyal bu gzhon nus rig dang dbang gis ni/ /blon po'i mchog kun zil gyis gnon pa ltar/ /dang po'i las can rgyal ba'i sras kyis kyang / /nyan rang snying rje'i mthu yis zil gyis gnon/ /blon po ches cher gtso bos kyang / /rgyal bu gzhon nur phyag byed cing / /des kyang rim gro'i tshul byed ltar/ /nyan rang rnams dang rgyal sras ltos/ /kun mkhyen sems kyi mtshan ldan phyir/ /rgyal sras 'ching ba kun ldan yang / /nyan rang mchog dang mnyam pa min/ /sems skyed rin chen yongs dag yang / /'gro mig 376

rab rib kyis khebs la/ /shun par ldan pa nyid du snang / /rtsi sman kun bsdus sbyar ba'i gzugs/ /mthong ngam 'grogs pas nad 'jil ltar/ /thabs shes dge kun las bsgrubs pa'i/ /rgyal sras 'gro ba'i sman mchog yin/ /byang chub sems kyi gos bzang ngang ris can/ /de ni nyon mongs 'dam gyis gos mi 'gyur/ /smon pa'i 'khrul 'khor spyi bor byang chub kyi/ /sems kyi gzer ldan de ni rgyal sras kyi/ /spyad pa kun la mthu ldan smon lam dang / /ye shes yongs su grub phyir 'gyes mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems kyi gzer dang mi ldan pa'i/ /byang chub yan lag sbyar ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /dgos pa yongs su sgrub par nus ma yin/ /glang po'i snying zhes dkar min a ga rus/ /bdugs na rgyal po'i dpung tshogs mkha' la 'gro/ /de bzhin byang chub sems kyis bdugs pa yi/ /dge ba thams cad rgyal ba'i mthar thug 'gro/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rje rin chen ni/ /dman pa'i rin chen khungs nas mi 'byung ste/ /snying rje chen po rdo rje'i 'byung khungs sam/ /rgyal bar dmigs pa'i gser gyi khu/ ngas nas 'byung / /shing rgyal rtsa ba mi dmigs kyang / /shing kun la ni rgyas par snang / /kun mkhyen sems kyi dge ba'i mtha'/ /mi dmigs na yang rgyal sras kyi/ /yon tan 'jig rten kun khyab mthong / /ji ltar rdo rje rin po che/ /ngan pa'i snod kyis bzung mi nus/ /thams cad 'bigs byed brag kun 'jig /chag kyang gser rgyan zil gyis gnon/ /dum bur gyur kyang phongs pa sel/ /chung yang rin chen gzhan kun gcog /bsod nams dman pa'i lag mi phyin/ /brtag mi mkhas pas shes mi nus/ /'ju bar mi nus de'i mtshon cha/ /377

stobs chen phal gyis 'degs mi nus/ /mi tshugs pa med kha mi 'bab/ /rdo rje nyid kyi gzhi las gzhan/ /sa phyogs phal bas brten mi nus/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi sra ba yis/ /chu 'dzag mi 'gyur sa mi 'jig /chu yis mi 'drul mes mi 'tshig /rgyal ba bltams dang byang chub gnas/ /rdo rje'i gzhi las gzhan dag gis/ /brten par nus pa srid ma yin/ /dpe de rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rje yang / /mos zhan tshul 'chal ser sna can/ /sems can ngan pas bzung mi nus/ /lhag bsam brtan gang de yi snod/ /chos kun phug ste rtogs par byed/ /lta ba'i brag ri kun kyang 'jig /nyams kyang nyan rang zil gyis gnon/ /nan tan med kyang srid pa na/ /phongs pa rnam par sel ba 'thob/ /dmigs pa shin tu chung ngus kyang / /mi shes pa kun rnam par gcog /dge ba ngan ngon ldan pa yi/ /lha mis 'thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /shes rab 'chal bas yon tan gyi/ /khyad par shes par nus ma yin/ /rkyen gzhan gyis ni zhu mi nus/ /rgyal sras stobs chen shugs drag las/ /nyan rang gis kyang theg ma yin/ /ye shes gzhan gyis brdugs/ pa der/ /mi thogs yongs su bzod par 'gyur/ /rgyal sras smon lam rdo rje gang / /sems skyed gzhi yis bzung bar nus/ /yongs su bsngos pa'i rdo rje'i gzhir/ /dge ba kun nas 'dzag pa med/ /lhag bsam rdo rje'i gzhis brten pa'i/ /smon lam sa chen dma' mi 'gyur/ /las nyon chu yis mi 'phrul zhing / /sdug bsngal me yis 'tshig ma yin/ /bla med byang chub spyod pa kun/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems skyed ni/ /smon lam ye shes ldan pa yi/ /rdo rje sra ba'i lte ba las/ /sems gzhan gyis ni 378

bzung mi nus/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mngon par sems bskyed pa/ /yon tan de dang gzhan kun gyis kyang brgyan pa ste/ /gang gis bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sems mchog bskyed pa rnams/ /yon tan rgya chen de lta thob cing 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bdag gis nor bzang gi rtogs brjod du bsdus pa yin no/ /bzhi pa 'jug pa'i phan yon khyad par du bshad pa la/dbye ba/ mtshan nyid/ smon pa'i phan yon/ 'jug pa'i phan yon rgyas bshad/ des na byang chub sems dpa' sdig pa dang bsod nams kyi zhing khyad par can du bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdus na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs te byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na smon 'jug rnam pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ji lta bu zhe na/ yul gzhan du 'gro bar 'dod la 'gro ba'i bya ba dang bral ba ltar byang chub 'thob par smon la sgrub pa'i brtson pa dang bral ba de ni smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang nam sbyor bas sgrub par 'dod pas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs pa phyin chad ni 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems so/ /'grel chen las/ sems gang smon pa las skyes pa sbyin sogs la 'jug pa dang bral ba de ni smon pa byang chub kyi sems te 'di ltar/'gro ba thams cad bskyab pa'i phyir sangs rgyas su gyur cig ces dang po kho nar smon pa'i sems lta bu'o/ /'jug pa nyid la sems pa'am 'jug pa 379

nyid kyi sems te sems de'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sems snga ma sngon du song ba nyid gang nas bzung ste sdom pa len pa sngon du 'gro bas tshogs rnams la rab tu 'jug pa de ni 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems so/ /bstan pa'i rim pas rnam pa gnyis yin te dbye ba ni de dag kho na'o zhes bya bar nyid kyi sgras bstan to/ /kyang gi sgras phan tshun sdud pa yin te gnyi ga'ang byang chub kyi sems yin par bstan to/ /des ni snga ma byang chub kyi sems ma yin no snyam pa'i dogs pa bsal ba yin te dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo las btsan thabs su sems bskyed pa sangs rgyas kyi rgyur bshad pa dang / sdong brgyan las byang chub tu sems skyed pa dkon no de bas kyang byang chub tu 'jug pa dkon no zhes so/ /de yang skyes bu gang zhig mngon par 'dod pa'i yul du phyin par bya ba'i ched du 'gro bar 'dod pa ni 'gro bar bsams pa ste 'gro ba nyid ni ma yin no/ /yang gzhan ni der phyin par bya ba'i ched du 'jug pa ste 'gro ba nyid do/ /ci ltar ni ji bzhin du'o/ /de sgrub pa dang bral ba yin du chug mod kyi de lta na'ang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu nyid du re zhig bzhag ste/ dge ba gzhan las chen po yin par/ rtag par yang / 'bras bu che 'byin/ sogs kyis khyad par du byas pa'i phyir te/rdo rje pha lam chag kyang gser gyi rgyan zil gyis gnon pa'i dpe dang sbyar ba'i phyir dang / rgyal po la gdams pa las/ khyod spyod lam ci byed kyang byang chub la 'dun pa ma brjed pa dang dge ba thams cad la yi rang zhing de dag dkon mchog thams cad la phul nas dge ba sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas byang chub tu sngos shig /de lta na khyod rgyal 380

po'i bya ba yang mi nyams la byang chub kyi lam yang rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam smin las khyod lha mi'i rgyal po mtha' yas pa myong yang bsod nams de'i cha tsam yang mi rdzogs so zhes gsungs so/ /des na spyod pa dang bral ba'i byang chub kyi sems la yang brnyas par mi bya ste des kyang 'khor ba'i bde ba mtha' yas pa skyed pa'i phyir ro zhes rgya cher bshad do/ /'on kyang rgyal po la gdams pa de ni spyod pa dang bral ba ma yin par mthong ste spyod pa'i gtso bo sems yin la de lus ngag ci spyod kyang sems byang chub kyi sems dang yi rang dang dge ba gtong ba dang de gzhan don du bsngo ba bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de lta mod kyi rgyal po khyod ni bya ba mang byed pa mang bas khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa mtha' dag la slob mi nus kyis 'di tsam zhig la slob par gyis shig ces bslab pa bsdus te gsungs pa bṛ dzi'i bu la khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum sgo gsum gyi kha na ma tho ba spong bar bsdus te bstan pa lta bu yin la/dgra bcom rang rgyal sems bral byang chub sems dga' na/ /dpa' bo rtag tu mnyam bzhag yin par shes par bya/ /zhes byang chub yid byed dang ma bral na yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dag pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sangs rgyas 'thob pa la res 'ga' smon pa drag tu skyes shing 'thob par dga' ba yod kyang de'i spyod pa sgo gsum gyis mi sgrub par gnyug mar gnas pas 'tsho ba ni spyod pa dang bral bar 'jog dgos so/ /dka' 'grel chung ngu las ni/ 'gro ba'i bya ba la dmigs pa'i blo gnyis po 'gro ba'i bya ba nyams su myong ma myong gnyis kur du yod kyang ngo bo tha dad pa 381

ltar blo 'di gnyis kyang skye 'phags gnyi ga la yod kyang ngo bo tha dad par bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ byang chub smon pa'i sems las ni/ /'khor tshe 'bras bu che 'byung yang / /ji ltar 'jug pa'i sems bzhin du/ /bsod nams rgyun chags 'byung ba min/ /zhes gsungs te/ smon 'jug gi phan yon gyi khyad par ngos bzung ba'o/ /bzhi pa la phan yon dngos bshad pa/de lung gis sgrub pa/ smon pa phan yon dang ldan pa'i 'thad pa gsum/'jug nga/ phan yon che ba'i 'thad pa lnga bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang nas bzung ste sems can khams/ /mtha' yas rab tu sgrol ba'i phyir/ /mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su/ /sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa/ /de nas bzung ste gnyid log gam/ /bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs/ /rgyun mi 'chad par du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung / /zhes gsungs te/'di la dka' 'grel chung ngur/ gang nas bzung ste zhes bya ba ste chos kyi dbyings mthong nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa mtshan nyid pa thob pa'i 'og tu ni chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du gnas skabs thams cad du bsod nams rgyun mi 'chad pa yin no zhes dang / yang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ma blangs pa'i smon lam ni smon pa yin la blangs pa'i ni 'jug pa yin no zhes byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u'i 'grel pa mkhan rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis bshad pa ni btags pa la dgongs pa'am yang na 'khrul bar nges so zhes so skye la 'jug sems med pa ltar bshad kyang byang sems rgyal blon gyi rtsa ltung dang pham pa dang 'dra ba'i chos sogs 'jug sems kyi spang bya 'di rnams ni nges par so so skye bo la 'byung nye ba kho na yin pa'i phyir dang /382

gzhan du na 'jug pa sems skyed dang don dam pa'i sems skyed gcig par 'gyur ro/ /des na so so skye bo'i skabs kho na la smon 'jug gtso bor bzhag pa yin la dus gang nas bzung ste sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i ched du dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang mtshungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya la slob par khas blangs shing sgrub 'dod kyi blo brtan por skyes pa ni 'jug sems skyes pa yin la de phyin chad gnyid dang brgyal ba dang ra ro ba sogs bag med pa'i dbang du gyur te gsal por mi dran pa'i gnas skabs na yang bsod nams nam mkha' dang mnyam pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung na de las gzhan pa dge ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas pa'i dus na lta ci smos pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di ni 'thad pa dang bcas par/ /lag bzang gis ni zhus pa las/ /dman mos sems can don gyi phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i 'dus pa nyer drug pa lag bzang ngam dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i mdo las mdza' bo'i bu mo'i gtam gyi sgo nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i don 'di dag dman pa la mos pa'i gnyen por bka' bstsal ba'o/ /legs bshad bsdus par ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /gang gsungs na/ lag bzang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang byang chub kyi sems rjes su dran pa dang byang chub kyi sems sgom pa dang byang chub tu smon pa de ni gtong ba chen po grangs med cing dpag tu med pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na sems can thams cad la chos kyi char sbyin par 'dod 383

pa de ni de gtong ba thams cad kyi nang na mchog yin pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pa 'di khungs yin no zhes nyang bran dang gtsang nag pa sogs 'chad par bshad do/ /gsum pa la dmigs pa rgya che ba dang / dkon pa dang phan 'dogs che ba'i rtags kyis phan yon che bar sgrub pa las/ dang po ni/ sems can rnams kyi klad nad tsam/ /bsal lo snyam du bsams na yang / /phan 'dogs bsam pa dang ldan te/ /bsod nams dpag med ldan 'gyur na/ /sems can re re'i mi bde ba/ /dpag tu med pa bsal 'dod cing / /re re'ang yon tan dpag med du/ /sgrub par 'dod pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs te/ mdza' bo'i bu mos ma'i mgo la 'gongs pa'i sems can su yang 'dir ma 'ong zhig de thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bdag gis nod do zhes sdug bsngal nyi tshe ba zhig sel bar bsams pa la bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob na sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad gtan du bsal nas bde ba thams cad sbyin par 'dod pa la lta ci smos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ pha 'am yang na ma yang rung / /su la 'di 'dra'i phan sems yod/ /lha dang drang srong rnams kyang rung / /tshangs pa la yang 'di yod dam/ /sems can de dag nyid la sngon/ /rang gi don du'ang 'di 'dra'i sems/ /rmi lam du yang ma rmis na/ /gzhan gyi don du ga la skye/ /gzhan dag rang gi don du yang / /mi 'byung sems can don sems gang / /sems can rin chen khyad par 'di/ /snga na med pa'i rmad cig 'khrungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'gro ba kun gyi dga' ba'i rgyu/ /sems can sdug bsngal rtsir gyur pa/ /rin chen sems kyi bsod nams 384

gang / /de la ji ltar gzhal gyis lang / /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /gsum pa la sbyor bas zin pa/ byed pa mang ba/ lan la mi ltos pa/ sgrub pa rgya che ba'i rtasas kyis re re zhing phan yon che ba dang / de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rmad du byung bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phan par bsams pa tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas mchod las khyad 'phags na/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /bde don brtson pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsu/ngas te/tshad med pa sgom pa tsam yang bsod nams che na sems can gyi don sbyor bas sgrub pa smos ci dgos te dpas byin gyi mdor/ sangs rgyas zhing ni mi gang gis/ /rin chen bdun gyis bkang byas te/ /'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas/ /gang gis thal mo sbyar byas te/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed na/ /gang la mtha' ni ma mchis pa'i/ /mchod pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod sems yod kyang / /sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyug /bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ /rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ /gang zhig bde bas phongs pa dang / /sdug bsngal mang ldan de dag la/ /bde ba kun gyis tshim pa dang / /sdug bsngal thams cad gcod byed cing / /gti mug kyang ni sel byed pa/ /de dang dge mtshungs ga la yod/ /de 'dra'i bshes kyang ga la yod/ /bsod nams de 'dra'ang ga la yod/ /ces gsungs te/ phan pa dang mi phan pa 'thob spong la sems can rang rang mkhas mod gzhan gyis byar ci yod ce na/ sems can de rnams kyis bde ba dang sdug bsngal ngos ma zin zhing sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la bde bar 'khrul ba dbul ba spong ba'i phyir nor rku ba 385

sogs phyin ci log tu spyod pas sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig 'grub pa de rnams la bde ba ster ba dang sdug bsngal 'joms pa dang gti mug gi blo sel bar nus na de bas lhag pa'i don dang dge ba gzhan ga la yod de phan 'dogs pa'i bshes de 'dra ba ni gzhan yod pa min no/ /gsum pa ni/phan btags lan ldon gang yin pa/ /de yang re zhig bsngags 'os na/ /ma bcol legs par byed pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'gro ba nyung zad nar ma'i zas sbyor dang / /skad cig zas tsam sbyin par byed pa dang / /brnyas bcas nyin phyed 'grangs par byed pa yang / /dge ba byed pa yin zhes skye bos bkur/ /zhes gsungs te/ mi rnams zhing dman pa 'gro ba nyung zad la dang dus dman pa lan gcig gam 'ga' zung tsam dang dngos po dman pa zas skom tsam dang sbyor ba dman pa brnyas pa dang bcas shing ma gus la nga rgyal ba dang phan 'dogs dman pa nyin phyed tsam 'grangs pa ste de tsam byin pa la yang dge ba byed par bkur na byang chub sems dpa' ni de lta bu ma yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ sems can grangs mtha' yas la yun ring du/ /bde bar gshegs kyi bde ba bla na med/ /yid la bsams pa mtha' dag rdzogs byed pa/ /rtag tu sbyin pa lta zhig smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs te/ de dag lnga las zlog pa'i dge ba byed pa de ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste sred med kyi bus zhus pa las yod de yod na lag pa 'dod pa la lag pa sbyin par byed do zhes sogs gsungs so/ /lnga pa ni/ gang zhig de 'dra'i rgyal sras sbyin bdag la/ /gal te ngan sems skyed par byed pa de/ /ngan sems bskyed 386

pa'i grangs bzhin bskal bar ni/ /dmyal bar gnas par 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs/ /'on te gang zhig yid rab dang byed na/ /de yi 'bras bu de bas lhag par 'phel/ /rgyal sras rnams la do gal chen pos kyang / /sdig pa mi 'byung dge ba ngang gis 'phel/ /gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de/ /skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing / /gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes gsungs te/dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa phyag rgya'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi mchod rten bshig pa'am bsregs la rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la gnod sems dang tha ba dang khong khro ba'i sems nga/ sbyang zhing spyos te brgyad na 'di ni de bas ches grangs med pa'i sdig pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs pa ni sangs rgyas so/ /sangs rgyas las byung ba ni mchod rten dang bde ba'i yo byad thams cad dang lha'i ris thams cad do byang chub sems dpa' la dam pa ma yin par byas na sangs rgyas thams cad la dam pa ma yin par byas par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' la dam par byas na sangs rgyas thams cad la dam par byas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / rab zhi rnam nges kyi mdor/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa' la khong khro ba'i sems bskyed cing brnyas pa'i sems bskyed pa de srid du des bdag bskal par dmyal bar gnas par bya dgos so zhes go 387

cha bgo bar bya'o zhes so/ /gal te de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung bas kyang de ltar smin par ma bshad la 'jig rten gsum na de bzhin gshegs pa las lhag pa med na 'di ji ltar rigs she na/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sus kyang ngan sems skyed par mi nus te bskal pa grangs med par sems can thams cad la byams pa'i thugs bsgoms pa'i phyir 'di'i sku la mtshon gyis mi tshugs so zhes bstan pa'i phyir dang / 'dir las kyi rnam smin kyang dngos po la ma bstan te sangs rgyas rnams ni las kyi rnam smin dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /des na gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir skabs phye ste drang don du bstan gyi nges pa'i don ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' la gnod pa byas pas ni sangs rgyas nyid rtsa ba dang bcas pa bcom zhing nye bar bcom pa yin te lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi don nye bar bcom par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' la dad na bsod nams de bas kyang ches lhag par skye ste 'jam dpal gal te yongs su brtag pa nye bar bzung ste phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can thams cad kyi mig bton pa/ra gyur la yang yongs su brtag pa nye bar bzung ste gal te rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu cho/ byams pa'i sems la gnas pa 'ga' zhig gis de dag thams cad kyi mig skyed par byed pa de bas 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gzhan zhig gis theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la sems dang bas lta na 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams lhag par skye'o zhes so/ /do gal chen pos zhes sogs/ 'chad lugs gnyis te/ 'grel chen dang bi bhu 388

nyis ni byang chub sems dpa'i sgo gsum gyi spyod pa mtha' dag dang bas bskyed pa'i phyir dang byang chub kyi sems kyi mthu las yin pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'ga' zhig gis gnod pa byed pa'i sems skye bar mi 'gyur te 'jam dpal gyi rnam thar las rin po che'i rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu cod pan la thogs pa'i klu'i rgyal po rnams la pha rol gyi 'jigs pa dang gnod pa mi 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub kyi sems dang snying rje chen po'i rgyal po'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu cod pan la bcings pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la ngan song dang ngan 'gro pha rol gyi 'jigs pa dang gnod pa mi 'byung ngo zhes gsungs pa yin na de'i phyir de rnams la don ma yin pa 'phel ba'i 'bras bu rtsub pa ci'i phyir 'bad cing rtsol bar byed/ de'i phyir de rnams la dga' ba dang dang ba dang mchog tu dga' ba ngang gis skye'o zhes 'chad kyang lung de 'byor bar mthong ste ngan song dang ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung zhes mi khom par mi skye ba'i don can du snang la 'dir ni byang chub sems dpa' la gzhan gyis gnod pa byed mi nus pa'i lung 'dren rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i rang bzhin can nyid kyis mthong bas kyang zhe sdang zhi zhing dga' ba skye ba shas che bas byang chub sems dpa' la gnod pa'i blo skye ba nyung bar bshad na rung ngo / /'o na ston pa byang chub sems dpa'i dus lhas byin gyis rtag tu gnod pa byed pa sogs ci zhig ce na de ni sngon bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi tshe 'tsho ba pa zhig gis spyod pa'i grogs bgyid par smon lam btab ste khyod sbyin pa la spyod pa na bdag gis mgo 389

dang rgyal srid sogs gzhan gyis slong mi nus pa slong zhing ster la des khyod kyi bsam pa rdzogs par gyur cig sogs nas khyod bzod pa la spyod pa na bdag gis gzhi med par khyod kyi yan lag dang nying lag dang srog gi bar du gcod cing des khyod 'khrugs pa med par bzod pa yongs su dag ste pha rol tu phyin pa myur du rdzogs par gyur cig /ces dang 'khor gzhan mang pos kyang de dang mthun par smon lam btab pa'i dbang gis yin gyi/gzhan du na byang chub sems dpa' la sdang bas bltas pa'i rnam smin mtha' yas pas tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'brang bar ga la 'gyur/gzhan yang glang po che'i phra ba ni glang po che nyid kyis bzod kyi bong bus mi bzod do de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' la byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyis gnod par byed kyi gzhan gyis gnod pa byed mi nus so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' nyams par yang 'dis byed de dper na rdo rje pha lam ni rdo rje pha lam ma yin pas gcog par mi nus so de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang byang chub sems dpa' gzhan la gnod pa byas pa ma yin pas nyams par mi nus so zhes sogs bshad do/ /dge ba'i lhas ni gzhan gyis gnod pa byas kyang de byang chub sems dpa' la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i don du 'chad la/ 'di ni phan gnod ni kun tu btags pa tsam las rang gi ngo bos ci yang ma yin la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid gang las mi 'da' ba 'di dag gzigs pa'i phyir dang / phan gnod kyi yul bdag tu 'dzin pa mi mnga' ba'i phyir dang / chos thams cad ni rgyu rkyen gyi rten cing 390

'brel bar 'byung ba 'khrul 'khor gyi skyes bu'i bya ba ltar gzigs pa'i phyir dang / thams cad kyang yang dag pa'i mtha' dang ngo bo nyid kyis mtshungs shing mnyam par gzigs pa'i phyir na phan gnod du btags pa 'di dag ni bye ma'i khang bu la zhen pa'i byis pa'i spyod yul na bye ma'i khang bu zhig pa dang ma zhig pa lta bu yin gyi de dpyod ldan rgan po'i ngor ma yin pa ltar ro/ /de lta mod kyi su zhig khros 'khrugs te gnod pa'i rnam pa thams cad byang chub sems dpa' la byed pa na byang chub sems dpa' de gnod par rtog pa dang khon du 'dzin pa mi mnga' mod kyang de nyid kho nas dge ba'i chos mtha' yas pa 'phel bar byed de 'di ltar bdag gzhan ma gzigs pa'i shes rab dang / chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis mnyam pa dang / de ltar ma shes pa la lhag par brtse ba dang / sems can gyi ngo bor ma zhugs pa'i 'khrul ba glo bur ba 'di dag bdag gis sbyang bar nus so zhes snying stobs dang / de'i phyir sems can thams cad kyi nyes pa 'di dag bdag gis bsal bar bya'o zhes byang chub kyi sems te gnyen po'i phyogs thams cad me la bud shing bsnan pa ltar skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir 'di ni shin tu 'chad par rigs so/ /des na snga mas ni/rgyal sras rnams la do gal chen pos kyang gzhan gyis gnod pa'i blo skye bar dka' bas sdig pa byed pa 'byung ring la yul khyad par can du mthong nas bkur sti byas pa la sogs pa'i dge ba lhag par 'phel lo zhes 'bru bsnan zhing / phyi mas ni rgyal sras rnams la ni gzhan gyis do gal chen po'i sgo nas gnod par rlom pas lus srog 'jig pa sogs byas kyang byang chub 391

sems dpa' de'i rgyud dkrug par mi nus shing slar dge ba'i blo mtha' yas pa skyed pa'i grogs byed do zhes 'bru gnyer ba'o/ /mdor na byang chub kyi sems kho na phan yon mtha' yas par gzigs pas byang chub kyi sems la khong du chud mi nus pa'i ngo mtshar ba skyes nas de gang gi rgyud la skyes pas byang chub sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas su 'jog pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal lo zhes glo bur du'ang ched du brjod par mdzad la/ byang chub sems dpa' la gnod pa byas kyang gnod pa'i rkyen de nyid kho na des rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur te mthar thug byang chub kyi bde bar 'brel bar mdzad pa mdor na phan gnod cis 'brel na'ang don chen po dang ldan pas bde ba'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa de la ha cang ngo mtshar bas skabs ma yin par yang bstod pa'i tshig brjod pa'o/ /'di ni 'grel chen las/de la gnod pa byed par brgya lam na nus kyang de nyid rgyu mtshan du byas nas rgyu 'ga' las de la dad pa skye bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba dang 'brel ba gnod sbyin lngas byams pa'i stobs la bzhin no/ /yang na/gang dag bdag la kha zer ram/ /sogs smon lam gyi dbang gis mthar bde bar 'brel ba dang / yang bu sdug pas rtsed mo byas pa ltar gzigs nas thugs rje chen pos bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba bzod le las 'chad pa ltar ro zhes 'chad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' la ngan sems skyes pas kyang dmyal bar 'phen pa dang gnod pa byas pas bde bar 'brel ba 'gal lo zhe na/ dge ba'i lhas ni gnas skabs tha dad de dang por ngan sems las rnam smin sdug bsngal myong yang phyis 'brel ba'i rgya las thar 392

bar 'gyur ba'o zhes bshad la/ legs bshad bsdus par ni rnam smin gyi 'bras bu tshe phyi ma sdug bsngal myong yang skyes bu byed 'bras tshe 'dir bde ba dang 'brel ba ste byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni da lta nas gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang na gnod pa byas pas gnas skabs rnam smin sdug bsngal myong yang nam zhig na de'i thugs rje dang smon lam gyis 'dren pa ste bzod smra'i skyes rabs bzhin no/ /yang na ngan sems yod pa'i gnod pa byas na sdug bsngal myong yang ngan sems med pa'i gnod pas bde bar 'brel te byams pa'i stobs kyi skyes rabs bzhin no zhes bshad kyang 'di 'dra ba dag rigs par mi che su/ gnod sbyin lngas sha khrag slongs pa'ang ngan sems med pa min te yul de'i sems can su'i yang mdangs 'phrog par ma nus pa'i rgyu rgyal po'i byams pa yin par go nas rgyal po la mi bzod pa skyes shing de sbyin pa la dga' bas bdag gis gnod par nus so yang snyam nas zas slong zhing des gzhan gyi sha khrag byin na nyin re zhing yang ster bar 'gyur bas bdag cag gi don de nyid do snyam pa dang / de nyid kyis byin na rgyu des rgyal po bsad par nus so snyam nas phrag dog dang brkam pa dang glags lta ba'i blos bslangs par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang ngan sems med pa'i gnod pa'ang 'grub par dka' ste ngan sems ni gnod par 'dod pa yin la gnod par 'dod pa med na gnod pa mi byed pa'i phyir/ des na phan gnod ni byed las kyis mi 'jog gi bsam pas 'jog pa ste rgyu 'dis 'di bsad par bya'o snyam nas zas ster gos bskon na'ang gnod par 'jog la/ 'di'i nad bsal bar bya'o 393

snyam nas me btsa' dang thur ma 'debs kyang phan par 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang yul de la phan gnod du bsams nas byas kyang der ma gyur pa ni yod do/ /bzod smra'i skyes rabs bzhin zhes pa la'ang theg chen thun mong ma yin pa ltar na de dag sngon gyi smon lam gyis spyod pa'i grogs yin la gnas skabs gdul bya kha cig la ngan song du song bar ston yang de gnas tshul min te pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi grogs bya bar 'dod pa kho nas grogs byas te dge ba 'phel bar byas pas grogs byed po ngan song du 'gro ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ tshe phyi mar sdug bsngal myong yang da lta bde ba myong bas bde bar 'brel bar bzhag na ha cang thal ches te tshong pa bcom pa dang yo byad 'phrogs pa'ang bde bar 'brel bar thal ba'i phyir ro/ /bshad pa dang po yang ha cang rgyu mtshan mi bzang la/ des na de 'dra'i rgyal sras sogs ni nges pa'i don te byang chub sems dpa' ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi rten gnas gcig pu yin pas de las gnyan pa'i zhing gzhan med pa'i phyir nyes pa ches lci bar grub bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' la nyes pa byas pa de byang chub sems dpa' des ma skyabs na ngan song las thar ba med pa'i tshod yin yang gang zhig sa la 'gyel ba sa la bsten te ldang ba ltar byang chub sems dpa' de nyid kyis skyob par byed de gang bdag gis sems can thams cad skyabs par zhugs pa yin na bdag la bsten nas gzhan ngan song du ltung bar ci'i phyir byed/ thog mar 'di tsam skyabs par ma nus na gzhan su zhig skyob par nus snyam ste de kho na skyob pa'i ched du dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang sbyor ba thams cad kyis 394

skyabs par brtson par byed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i mthus myur du thar bar 'gyur bas bde bar 'brel ba zhes bshad na legs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon gyi le'u ste dang po'o// //le'u gnyis pa/ sdig pa bshags pa/le'u gnyis pa la mtshams sbyar ba ni dka' 'grel chung ngur/ de ltar phan yon brjod pas spro ba thob pa de la gzung ba'i cho ga ston to zhes so/ /legs bshad bsdus par ras snum dang dri mas dag pa la tshon 'dzin pa ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi tshon 'dzin pa la shes rgyud sdig ltung dag pa dgos pas dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir yan lag bdun pa skyabs 'gro dang bcas pa bstan to/ /de yang thog ma med pa nas sgrib pa gsum ste bya 'os ma byas pa dang mi bya ba byas pa dang bya ba byas pa chud zos pa'o/ /dang po la yul khyad par can la dad gus ma byas pa dang / nor la chags pas mchod sbyin ma byas pa dang / log par zhen pas yang dag pa'i skyabs ma bzung ba'o/ /de gsum gyi gnyen por phyag dang mchod pa dang skyabs su 'gro ba go rim ltar bzhag go /mi bya ba byas pa la gnyis te rang gis mi dge ba byas pa dang / gzhan gyi dge ba la bar chod byas pa'o/ /dang po'i gnyen por sdig bshags so/ /gnyis pa'i gnyen por rjes su yi rang ba sogs gsum mo/ /dge ba byas kyang chud zos pa'i gnyen por byang chub tu bsngo ba rnam par bzhag go zhes bshad do/ /dka' 'grel chung ngur ni thog med kyi las kyi 395

sgrib pa bzhi ste rang gis mi dge ba spyad pa dang / gzhan gyi dge ba'i bar chad byas pa dang / chos spangs pa dang / log par smon pa'o/ /dang po'i gnyen por bshags pa/ gnyis pa'i gnyen por yi rang / gsum pa'i gnyen por bskul gsol gnyis/ bzhi pa'i gnyen por bsngo ba'o zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon kṛṇi pas ni/ mchod dang bdag dbul sdig 'chags dang / /khrus gsol sku dbyi gos rgyan byugs/ /me tog chal 'gram phreng ba dbul/ /spos dang lha bshos sgron maṇ+ḍal/ /gzhal yas khang dang gdugs rol mo/ /smon lam mthu yis mchod tshogs dbul/ /bla med mchod dang bstod par smon/ /phyag dang skyabs 'gro sdig 'chags dang / /yi rang bskul gsol smon lam gdab/ /ces nyi shu rtsa bdun po dag gis sems sbyang par bshad do/ /mdor na sems bzung ba'i cho ga la gsum/ sbyor ba/dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la bdun/ mchod pa/ skyabs 'gro/ sdig bshags/ rjes su yi rang bskul ba/ gsol ba/ bsngo ba ste bdun no/ /dang po la bdag dbang ba'i dngos pos mchod pa/ bdag gir ma bzung ba'i dngos pos mchod pa/ lus dbul ba/ blos sprul pa'i mchod pa bcu gcigabla na med pa'i mchod pa ste mnyes pa'i mchod pa lnga dang / bkur sti'i mchod pa bstod phyag gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos/ /dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod/ /ces gsungs te/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir gyis ched du bya ba'o/ /zhes gzhan rnams su bstan la dka' 396

'grel chen mor/ rin chen sems de bdag gis bzung bya'i phyir/ /zhes bdag nyid len por bstan no/ /legs par mchod ni dngos po'o/ /gzhan rnams ni zhing ngam yul te yon tan gyi rgya mtsho dkon mchog gsum la bdag gis dngos su bshams pa 'dis mchod pa'i don no/ /dkon mchog thams cad 'dir mchod yul du mngon du gyur tam zhe na de ma gyur kyang mngon sum du gyur ma gyur la mchod pa'i phan yon khyad med de/ rgyan las/sangs rgyas rnams la gos la sogs/ /mngon sum mngon sum min par mchod/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang / /sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang / /'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang / /chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang / /rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du/ /nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang / /ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang / /shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang / /lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni/ /spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing / /mtsho dang rdzing bu pad mas brgyan pa dag /ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang / /gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ /yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun/ /blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na/ /yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes/ /bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te/ /mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma 397

mchis/ /des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis 'di/ /bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /ces gsungs te/ 'dir nam mkha' rab 'byams kyi sh+lau ka ni/ me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang / /zhes sogs re re'i mthar yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes dka' 'grel chen mor ro/ /spud pa ni rgyan gyis shin tu spras pa'i don no/ /yal ga dud pa ni gug pa ste sa la reg pa lta bu dang / ma rmos pa ni thong gshol gyis ma slog par ro zhes so/ /ci'i phyir bdag pos ma bzung ba 'di rnams kyis mchod ce na/bdag ni sogs kyis de'i rgyu mtshan bstan no/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi/ /sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su bzung bas na/ /srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyi/ /sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing / /sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do/ /zhes gsungs te/ bdag la bdog pa ni lus kho nar zad la 'di phul nas khyed kyi bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i don no/ /de rnams ni dngos po rdzas su yod pas mchod pa yin la/ bzhi pa blos sprul pa ni/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri 398

rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa dbul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis/ /'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang / /'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi/ /stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi/ /dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ /thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i/ /me tog man dha ra dang pad ma dang / /ut+pal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang / /phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod/ /spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi/ /bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul/ /zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi/ /lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi/ /gser gyi pad+ma tshar du dngar ba yi/ /rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byugs pa der/ /me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bgyi/ /gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba/ /dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang / /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi/ /rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/ /khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong brgyan/ /dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa bsgreng ba sogs/ /rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ba/ /sems can sdug bsngal sim byed 399

pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang / /mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la/ /rin chen me tog la sogs char/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab par shog /ces gsungs te/ de yang tshigs bcad phyed dang gsum gyis khrus gsol ba/ de nas phyed dang gnyis kyis gos rgyan dbul ba/ gcig gis byugs pa/ gcig gis me togarkang pa gnyis kyis spos/ rkang pa gnyis kyis lha bshos/ sh+lau ka phyed kyis sgron me/ phyed dang gnyis kyis bzhugs khang / gcig gis gdugs kyis mtshon te chen po la 'os pa'i yo byad rnams/ gcig gis glu dang rol mo/de nas gcig gis dkon mchog gi rten thams cad la mchod pa rtag tu byin gyis rlob pa'i smon lam ste bcu gcig go /de yang shel gyi sa gzhi bstar ba ni brkyang nul gyi zhal ba legs par bdar zhing phyis pas 'od 'tsher ba ste lta bu'i don du 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /tshigs bcad phyed kyis na bza' rkyang pa smos la/ de nas tshigs bcad gcig gis gos dang rgyan lhan cig tu smos pa ni dang po mchog gi sprul sku rgyan spangs pa tshangs spyod kyi cha byad can rnams la dbul ba dang / phyi ma byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa'i rtags 'chang ba rnams la dbul ba'i don te mchog gi sprul sku la rgyan dbul ba ni mi rigs pa'i sbyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba'i spos ni 'og min gyi sbrul gyi snying po sogs yin la stong gsum ni mngon pa las bshad pa ltar gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya pa nyid bzung ngo / /gser btso ma ni kha sbyar du bskol ba la sogs pas nang gi dri ma sbyangs pa ste/ byi dor byas pa ni ro tsa na la sogs pa'i nor bus phyis pa 400

dang sbyangs pa ni bul tog dang lan tshwa dang skyu ru ra la sogs pas phyi'i dri ma sbyangs pa ste de lta bu yang yin la gser yang yin pa ste 'jig rten la grags pas brjod kyi ston pa'i sku'i mdzes pa la ni dpe cung zad kyang med do zhes 'grel chen las so/ /'grel chen du mā li ka ni parnyiṣa'o zhes/ me tog man dha ra dang parniṣa/ /zhes 'don no/ /bdug pa'i sprin ni sprin 'khrigs pa'am yang na sprin gyen du 'gro ba lta bur 'phyur ba'o zhes so/ /gser gyi pad ma ni gser gyi kong bu pad ma'i dbyibs can yin la tshar du dngar ba ni de mang du sbrengs pa'i gral byas pa ste der tsam pa ku'i mar dang li shi'i mar dang dza ti'i mar dang 'bru mar bsung can sbyar ba'i mar me dang / la lar ni nor bu rin po che bzhag pas snang ba byed pa ste nor bu mchog gis dpag tshad brgya la sogs par mun pa sel ba'i phyir dang /sgron me phal ba ni sbrul la sogs pa'i srog chags 'du du ba bku mig la gnod la/ rin po che'i sgron me ni de las ldog ste yi dwags dang dud 'gro 'byer mig la phan pas mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /sa gzhi bstar ba zhes pa'i tshigs bcad phyed kyis gang du gzhal med khang bya ba'i gzhi'i khyad par yang ston la kun tu grags pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa yang bsdu'o/ /gzhal yas khang ni rin po che thams cad pa las byas pa/ dpag tshad brgya stong gi khyon dang ldan zhing mang du brtsegs pas nam mkha' gang ste sprin la reg pa lta bur snang ba/ lha'i bu dang bu mo'am mi'i gzhon nu dang gzhon nu ma glu gar dang bstod dbyangs sgrog pas gang ba'o/ /gdugs kyis mtshon pa ni rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang seng ge'i khri rkang rten can dang gzims 401

cha la sogs pa'o/ /des na/ dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa sgreng ba sogs/ /zhes 'bru gnyer te/ dka' 'grel chung ngu'i lugs so/ /rol mo ni sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi las rol mor gtogs pa bco brgyad de/ bro dang rnga chen rnga phran dang / /rdza rnga kha gcig rdza rnga che/ /pi waṃ rgyud gcig rgyud gsum pa/ /rgyud mang lcags kyi sil khrol dang / /'khar ba'i sil khrol pheg rdob pa/ /rnga mu kuṇ+ḍa pa ṭa ha/ /sil snyan glu dbyangs ldan pa dang / /rol chen pi waṃ gling bu bsgyur/ /'khor ba'i rnga dang bco brgyad do/ /zhes bsdus pa'o/ /dbyangs ni glu dbyangs su gtogs pa bdun te/ bar ma drang srong sa 'dzin pa/ /drug ldan lnga ldan blo gsal ba/ /'khor bstan pa ste rnam pa bdun/ /zhes pa yin la dka' 'grel chen mor/ dbyangs ni sa 'dzin la sogs bdun dang de'i dbye bas ka mo da la sogs pa shin tu mang bas rgya mtsho'o zhes so/ /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad ni chos 'dzin pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi thad dang glegs bam dang tha na de las shog bu re re'am gcig gi dum bu tsam rlung gis bdas pa'i sa phyogs yan chad yin la/ mchod rten ni ring bsrel gyi gnas te/ skur bcas skur ni med pa yi/ /zhes zhal phyag dang bcas pa'i rnam par gtod pa ni skur bcas dang bang rim la sogs nga/ can ni skur med pa'i mchod rten zhes tshigs bcad bzhi par gsungs la/ 'dir ni skur bcas la sku gzugs zhes zur du smos te mdor na rgyu dang gzo bo dang tshad ci 'dra na'ang rung tha na de dag gi dum bur gyur pa yang bsdu ste de thams cad du mchod pa'i char 'bab par gyur cig pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod /02

mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ /ces gsungs te/ mdor na bdag cag gis ni ji ltar mchod par bya ba dang ji ltar mnyes par 'gyur ba mi shes la de ni 'phags chen rnams nyid kyis mkhyen pa/ra 'thad pas na sangs rgyas rnams sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur pa na ji lta bus mchod par mdzad pa de lta bus bdag gis kyang mos pas mchod par bgyi'o zhes bsam pa ste 'di dbang bcu rdzogs pa rnams kyi blo shin tu rnam par dag pas byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir na ma dag pa'i blo can gyi mchod pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pas bla na med pa'i mchod pa'o/ /'dir gzhan yang dmigs pa dang bcas pas bla na med pa'i mchod par 'gyur ba ni byang chub kyi sems sgom pa ste/ mkhas pas byang chub sems bsgoms na/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la/ /mchod pa 'di ni dam pa ste/ /zhes so/ /dmigs pa med pa bdag med pa la bzod pa ni bla na med pa'i mchod pa mchog yin te lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyi mdo las/ byang chub 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /me tog spos dang de bzhin zas skom dag /phul nas mi mchog sangs rgyas mchod pa bas/ /gang gis gang las bdag dang srog dang ni/ /gang zag ma ma/chis de 'dra'i chos 'di dag /thos nas de la 'od gsal bzod thob pa/ /de yis mi mchog dam pa mchod pa lags/ /zhes dang seng ge'i sgra chen gyi mdo las/ gang 'du shes dang mtshan ma skyed par mi byed pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa yin no blang dor med pa dang gnyis su med par 'jug pa de ni de bzhin 403

gshegs pa mchod pa yin no grogs po dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ni dngos po med pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas de ni dngos po'i 'du shes la gnas pas mchod par sla ba ma yin no zhes gsungs so/ /mchod pa 'di rnams ni dam tshig gsum bkod las thabs mkhas skyes pa'i rin po che'i ri bo dang sogs nas yongs su bzung ba med pa rnams dbul bar bya'o zhes sogs dang / dkon mchog sprin dang phal po che'i mdo las bstan pa'o/ /de ltar mnyes pa'i mchod pa bstan nas bkur sti'i mchod pa la gnyis kyi dang po bstod pa ni/ yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la/ /nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /ces gsungs te/ yon tan gyi rgya mtsho dkon mchog gsum po de la'o/ /bdag ni byed pa po ste lus gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed la sogs par byin gyis brlabs shing lus re la yang mgo mtha' yas pa dang de re re yang lce mtha' yas shing lce re res kyang yon tan gyi khyad par brgya stong brjod cing de yang skad kyi gtang rag dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho dang ldan pas bstod par byed de phal chen las gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams mang po la dbang ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rin chen mang gi bu mo rnams kyi tshul lta bu yin la/ spyir yon tan khyad par can la shes nas yi rang bas kyang bsod nams dpag tu med de bskal bzang las de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus mtha' yas chos thams cad kyi tshul la nges par rton pa'i ting nge 'dzin ston pa na rgyal po bsod nams me tog bu stong dang btsun mo stong 404

du bcas pa des bdag cag gis 'di mi shes mod kyi 'on kyang rjes su yi rang bar bya'o zhes 'khor dang bcas pas rjes su yi rang bar byas pa las bsod nams cher thob par gsungs shing sngon sangs rgyas skar rgyal ri'i phug na zad par me'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa la 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di byang chub sems dpar gyur pas rkang pa gcig gis 'greng bas bskor zhing zhag bdun du tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod pas bskal pa dgu'i tshogs bzlums par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /bstod pa'i sgra de yang dkon mchog thams cad kyi spyan sngar rgyun mi 'chad par grags par gyur cig ces mos shing bsngo ba ste/ nor bzang gis byams pa la phyag byas pa'i tshe khyod kyi phyag 'di sangs rgyas thams cad dang 'jam dpal la sogs pa thams cad dang mchod rten thams cad kyi spyan sngar cig char du 'byung ngo zhes dang de lta na yang khyod 'jam dpal gyi rkang pa'i drung las g.yo ba med do zhes gsungs pa lta bu ste tshul 'di dag ni bsam gyis khyab pa ma yin no/ /gnyis pa phyag ni/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ / chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud nas ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /byang chub sems kyi gzhi rnams dang / /mchod rten kun la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mkhan po de bzhin slob dpon dang / /brtul zhugs mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs te/zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi lus ni bdag gi lus de tsam du mos pa ste zhing zhes bya ba ni stong gsum mi mjed dam gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa la sogs pa'o/ /rdul ni phra rab ste chos mngon pa las/ phra rab 405

rdul dang rdul phran dang / /lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang / /nyi zer rdul dang sro ma dang / /de las byung dang de bzhin nas/ /sor tshigs zhes bya gong bdun 'gyur/ /zhes snga ma bdun la phyi ma rer bshad pa'i rtsa ba'i rdul de'o/ /zhing de la rdul ji tsam mchis pa'i grangs dang mnyam par bdag gi lus kyang de snyed mos pas 'dud pa'o/ /gang la na dus gsum gyi phyogs bcu'i dkon mchog thams cad la ste phyag gcig kyang de thams cad la cig char 'dud pa'i blo'o/ /'di ji ltar nus she na bsam pa'i dbang gis te sems kun nas dad pas 'dud pa ni phyag yang dag pa yin la sems la ni rgyab mdun dang shar nub mi dmigs pas thams cad la cig char du dad par byar nus pa'i phyir ro/ /ci 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams da ltar med pa ma yin nam zhe na ma yin ste gdul bya'i dbang ma gtogs sangs rgyas su yang mya ngan las 'das pa ma mthong bar khyim bdag nan khugs kyi rnam thar las gsungs pa'i phyir dang / spyir yang chos thams cad la dmigs pa'i blo gzhan skye ba dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems kyi gzhi ni sngon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gang du gtong ba dang gtong ba chen po sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa spyad pa'i sa phyogs choms te ston pa nyid kyis kyang snying stobs chen po'i rus bu sa gzhi las phyung ba la phyag mdzad de 'di dag gis nga rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bo zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mchod rten ni bisba dang khang bu dang rgyal mtshan ltar grags pa brgyad dang bcu gnyis dang bye ba la sogs pa ste mdor na 'phags pa rnams kyi ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi las gang yang rung 406

ba'am thams cad bzhugs pa'o/ /brtul zhugs mchog ni brtul zhugs nyid dang de dang ldan pa'i gang zag ste skyes bu zung bzhi gang zag ya brgyad dang chos bzhin du tshangs par spyod pa thams cad la'o/ /gnyis pa skyabs 'gro la spyi'i tshul gyis gtan la dbab pa dang / gzhung ji lta bar bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro gnyis/dang po la/ rgyu dang yul dang ngo bo dbye/ /dus dang nges tshig cho ga dang / /bslab bya dang ni phan yon dang/ /nyams pa'i nyes dmigs slar gso ba'o/ /zhes bcu gcig las rgyu ni las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa'i dad pa dang dkon mchog la dang ba'i dad pa dang de'i yon tan la 'dod pa'i dad pa ste gsum ga'am gang rung dang ldan pa dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i blo skye ba'i rgyu'o/ /yul ni/ sangs rgyas sku gnyis chos mya ngan las 'das pa dge 'dun gang zag brgyad de/ skyabs 'gro bdun bcu par/ thub pa'i dbang po'i sku gnyis dang / /mya ngan 'das dang gang zag brgyad/ /de la gus pas skyabs 'gro gang / /gsum la skyabs su song ba yin/ /zhes so/ /ngo bo ni 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las thar ba'i ched du dkon mchog la skyabs gnas su 'dzin pa'i blo ste de yang sangs rgyas la ston pa dang chos la lam dang dge 'dun la grogs kyi ched du skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /dbye na ngan song gis 'jigs te mtho ris kyi ched du skyabs su 'gro ba legs smon gyi skyabs 'gro dang / 'khor bas 'jigs te myang 'das 'thob pa'i ched du skyabs su 'gro ba nges 'byung gi skyabs 'gro gnyis te thun mong gi skyabs 'gro mtshan nyid pa ni phyi ma 'di kho 407

na'o/ /dus ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du khas len pa'o/ /nges tshig ni/ 'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyob pa dang / /bla med gnas su 'gro ba'i phyir/ /skyabs 'gro zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /cho ga ni slob dpon du 'os pa la phyag byas te tsog pu thal mo sbyar nas btsun pa'am bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs dge slong kho nas 'bogs dgos kyang mdo sde pa yan gyi lugs la dge bsnyen gyis phog kyang skye bas gal te bla ma khyim pa yin na rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la/ zhes lan gsum gyis blang ngo / /slob dpon gyis thabs yin no dang slob mas legs so brjod cing bslab bya bshad par bya'o/ /bslab bya ni spyir thos pa'i sa'i bsdu bar/ sbyor bas dge ba'i rten sgrub pa dang / dbang po mi rgod par bya ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi blang ba dang / sems can la snying rje bar bya ba dang / dus dus su dkon mchog mchod par bya ba la bslab par gsungs la/ khyad par du jo bo'i lugs kyis khyad par gyi bslab bya gsum cha mthun gyi gsum thun mong gi lnga ste bcu gcig la bslab par gsungs te/ tshangs pa la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i lha la phyag mi 'tshal/ sems can la 'tshe ba spang / mu stegs can la mi bsten pa ni khyad par gyi bslab bya gsum ste myang 'das kyi mdor/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs song ba/ /de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te/ /nam du yang ni lha gzhan la/ /'dud par byed pa ma 408

yin no/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs song ba/ /'tshe zhing gnod pa'i sems dang bral/ /dge 'dun la ni skyabs song nas/ /mu stegs can la phyogs mi bya/ /zhes so/ /cha mthun gsum ni sangs rgyas kyi rten ci 'dra na yang rung ste sā tsha'i chag dum gyi bar la gus par bya/ chos mi spang zhing yig 'bru re la'ang gus pa skyed/ rab tu byung ba lta ci smos te ngur smrig gi tshal bu 'dzin pa la'ang ston pa ltar blta bar bya'o/ /thun mong gi lnga ni/ rnyed dka' bas na srog dang gtsigs dang bya dga'i ched du'ang dkon mchog mi spang / na tsha skyid sdug ci byung yang mo bon mi bya bar dkon mchog la blo 'gel/ longs spyod thams cad kyi phud dbul/ dus dang dus su mchod pa la bslab cing phyogs gar 'gro yang de'i sangs rgyas la phyag bya/ phan yon rjes su dran pas nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du skyabs 'gro la 'bad par bya'o/ /phan yon ni/ bsdu bar/ srung ba chen po dang ldan pa dang log par mos pa'i sgrib pa 'dzad pa dang skyes bu dam par chud pa dang dkar po'i lha rnams kyi yid du 'ong ba ste bzhi dang / bsod nams chen po dang dga' ba dang ting nge 'dzin dang rnam dag ste bzhi 'thob par gsungs la/ jo bos brgyad du gsungs te/ nang par gtogs dang sdom pa'i rten/ /mi sogs gnod pas mi tshugs dang / /sdig pa 'dzad dang bsod nams 'phel/ /ngan song mi ltung khyad par lam/ /bla med byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes nang pa sangs rgyas par gtogs pa dang sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba dang gzhan gyi gnod pas mi tshugs pa dang sdig pa thams cad 'dag pa dang bsod nams cher 'thob pa dang shi 409

'phos nas mi khom nga/ra mi ltung ba dang lam khyad par can rgyud la skye ba dang mthar mya ngan las 'das pa 'thob par 'gyur ba ste brgyad do/ /nyams pa'i nyes dmigs ni phan yon las ldog pa ste skyabs med pas 'jigs shing yang byin rlabs med pas bya ba la mthu chung rten med pas sdom pa thams cad kyang 'gyel ba'i ri bo ltar 'jig pa'o/ /nyams na slar gso ba ni dkon ra/chog gi rten nam slob dpon la phyag dang mchod pa byas te snga ma ltar blangs pas sor chud pa ste grangs tshad kyi rnam par bzhag pa med do/ /gnyis pa theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro ni sdom tshig snga ma bzhin las/rgyu'i khyad par ni theg chen gyi rigs sad cing gtso bor snying rje'i dbang gis len pa ste/ rgyan las/ 'di ni de dngos 'dod pas khas len de yang snying rje las rig bya/ zhes so/ /yul ni sangs rgyas chos kyi sku chos theg chen gyi 'gog lam dge 'dun phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste dkon mchog gsum re re yang yon tan drug ldan du rgyud blar bshad pa de la gnas skabs su skyabs su 'gro zhing / mthar thug gi skyabs yul ni chos kyi sku kho na ste/ skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/ /zhes so/ /de dag ni gzhan rgyud kyis bsdus pa la skyabs su 'gro bas rgyu'i skyabs 'gro zhes bya la bdag nyid skyabs yul der sgrub par mos pa ni 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro ste drag shul can gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar na sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba yin zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa bsgru ba par bya'o snyam du mngon par 'du byed de de ltar na sangs rgyas la skyabs su/ song ba yin no/ /ji ltar na chos la skyabs 410

su song ba yin zhe na/ bdag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten la chos kyi bgo bsha' bya'o snyam du dran pa 'thob ste da ltar na chos la skyabs su song ba yin no/ /ji ltar na dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba yin zhe na/ dge 'dun gyi yon tan sgrub pa'i phyir chos ston no snyam du dran pa 'thob ste de ltar na dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba yin no zhes so/ /'di ltar na byang chub kyi sems dang 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro ni ming tha dad kyi ra/tshan gzhi tha mi dad par nges so/ /bod mang dag rang rgyud la 'byung 'gyur la skyabs su 'gro ba 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro zhes zer mod de nyid slar dri bar bya ste 'byung 'gyur la ji ltar skyabs su/ 'gro/ bdag rgyud la ma 'ongs pa na dkon mchog gsum 'byung bas de la bdag skyabs su mchi'o zhes rtog pa 'di ma yin grang / de lta na ni zhing 'dir phyis lo tog skye bar 'gyur bas de bza' bar bya'o zhes zhing 'gram du bkres par sgug pa dang khyad ci zhig /des na bdag rgyud kyi khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po de nyid dri ma dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas yin la de nyid 'gog lam 'byung rung gi rgyur gnas shing dri mas cung zad dag pa na rten gyi gang zag de dge 'dun du bgrang ba'i phyir dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor gzod ma nas gnas par shes pas de'i dri ma sbyong ba la 'bad par byed kyi dbul pos khang 'og gi gter rnyed pa na bu lon mi len pa ltar gzhan nas mi tshol ba'i nges pa skyes pa 'di la 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gror gdags so/ /ngo bo ni kun 'gro'i don dang khas len gyi don dang rtogs pa dang zil gnon ste don bzhi ldan 411

gyi skyabs 'gro ste/ rgyan las/ kun tu 'gro dang khas len rtogs dang zil gnon par/ /dbye ba'i rang bzhin don rnam bzhi yi khyad par gyis/ /theg pa mchog phyir dkon mchog skyabs rab song ba gang / /de nyid skyabs su song ba rnams kyi mchog ces bya/ /zhes dang de'i phan yon yang / gang phyir dang por nges par bya ba 'di dka' ste/ /de ni bskal pa stong phrag du mar sgrub par dka'/ /gang phyir grub na sems can phan byed don chen te/ /de phyir theg chen 'di la skyabs don mchog yin no/ /zhes so/ /de yang sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang theg pa dang lam thams cad kyi mthar 'byin pa dang 'khor 'das rang bzhin gcig par shes pa ni kun 'gro'i don te/ gang zhig sems can thams cad bsgral bar zhugs pa dang / theg pa ye shes kun tu 'gro ba mkhas par ldan/ /gang zhig mya ngan 'das la 'khor zhi ro gcig pa/ /de 'dra'i blo ldan de 'dir kun 'gror shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /spro bas byang chub chen po don du gnyer ba dang dka' ba spyod pa la ji mi snyam pa dang sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid sgrub par mos pa ni khas len gyi don te/ gang zhig dga' ba mang pos byang chub mchog don gnyer/ /gang zhig skyo ba med par dka' ba yang dag spyod/ /gang zhig rnam sangs rgyas nas sangs rgyas kun mnyam 'gyur/ /blo ldan de ni khas len mchog tu shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /yang byang chub kyi sems kyi sa bon dang shes rab kyi ma dang snying rje'i ma mas zin pas sangs rgyas kyi sras su skyes pa yang khas len gyi don cig shos te/ sangs rgyas sras kyi mchog tu legs par gang skyes pa/ /sems dang shes rab dag 412

ni tshogs ldan snying rje 'di'i/ /sa bon ma dang mngal gnas ma ma mtshungs pa med/ /blo ldan de ni khas len mchog tu shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang stobs dang zhi ba thob pa dang sems can gdul ba'i thabs shes pa dang 'od zer chen pos dbang bskur bas chos la dbang thob pa dang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ston pa dang bslab pa bca' ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa kun grub pa dang byang chub chen po 'ba' zhig par gyur pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum 'dzin pa dang gzhan don nam mkha' lta bu rgyun mi 'chad pa dang bde ba dang rtag pa'i sku thob cing srid zhi las rnam par grol ba rtogs pa'i don dang / nyan rang du bcas pa'i dge ba zil gyis mnan nas bsngo ba zil gnon gyi don te/ sna tshogs mtshan rnams kun gyis de lus brgyan/ /sems can thams cad smin par byed stobs thob/ /sangs rgyas bde chen mtha' yas zhi ba rnyed/ /sems can kun skyabs thabs chen bshams pa shes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis 'od zer chen pos dbang bskur byin/ /de ni chos la dbang ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ston pa'i rnam pa shes/ /bslab pa bca' bas tshar gcod phan 'dogs byed la brtson/ /blon po chen po lta bur pha rol phyin la 'jug pa'i phyir/ /byang chub chen po'i phyogs mthun brdal la rtag tu spyan 'byed phyir/ /gsang ba'i gnas ni rnam gsum rtag tu yang dag 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /sems can mang don rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par rab byed phyir/ /bsod nams phung tshan srid gsum bla ma srid pa'i bde ba dang / /sdug bsngal phung po chen po rab zhi blo mchog 413

bde ba dang / /chos mang phung po mchog dang rtag pa'i sku ste dge ba'i tshogs/ /bag chags zlog cing srid dang zhi las rnam par grol ba 'thob/ /blo ldan nyan thos tshogs bcas dge ba rgya chen don chen dang / /mtha' yas rtag rgyun mi 'chad zad mi shes pas zil gyis gnon/ /zhes so/ /yang na sangs rgyas 'thob par 'dod pa ngo bo'i don snying rje chen po rgyu'i don kun mkhyen la dmigs pa 'bras bu'i don phan bde sgrub pa la skyo ba med pa las kyi don theg pa thams cad kyi yon tan ma lus par sgrub pa ldan pa'i don brda dang chos nyid kyis thob pa sogs dbye ba mtha' yas pa 'jug pa'i don te don drug ldan gyi skyabs 'gro zhes kyang bya ste/ 'di ni de dngos 'dod pas khas len de yang snying rje las rig bya/ /de las rnam pa kun mkhyen phan dang bde byed dka' la skyo ba med/ /nges par 'byung la theg pa kun gyis brton pa'i yon tan rtag tu ldan/ /brda dang chos nyid thob pa blo ldan rnams kyi skyabs 'gro 'di mchog yin/ /zhes so/ /dbye na rgyu dang 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro gnyis te bshad zin la/ yang na rags pa brda las byung ba dang phra ba chos nyid kyis thob pa gnyis te dang po ni cho gas phog pa'am lus ngag gi rnam rig las skyes pa yin la phyi ma ni rigs sad stobs kyis sam dkon mchog gi byin rlabs sam sgom stobs kyis thob pa'o/ /de nyid la kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro zhes kyang bya ste brda las byung ba ni slu ba'i chos can yin la chos nyid kyis thob pa ni don dam pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir/ chos nyid kyis ji ltar 'thob ce na chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ji lta ba bzhin sgro skur med par mthong ba ste ma 414

dros pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpas chos thams cad bdag med pa dang sems can med pa dang srog dang gang zag med par shes nas gzugs su ma yin mchan mar ma yin chos su/ ma yin par de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par rjes su mthong ba de lta bu ni zang zing med pa'i sems kyis sangs rgyas la skyabs su so nga ba yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de ni chos kyi dbyings so chos kyi dbyings gang yin pa de ni thams cad kyi rjes su song ba zhes bya ste de ltar chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi rjes su song bar mthong ba de lta bu ni zang zing med pa'i ser/sa kyis chos la skyabs su song ba yin no/ /gang chos kyi dbyings 'dus ma byas par rab tu sgom pa dang nyan thos kyi theg pa ba la 'dus ma byas pa ston pa dang 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis su med pa 'di lta bu ni zang zing med pa'i sems kyis dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba yi na no zhis so/ /dus ni bla na med pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi bar te sems can thams cad ji srid gnas pa dang nam mkha' ji srid gnas pa'i bar te 'dor ba'i dus rme/da do/ /des tshig ni rgyan las/ 'tshe ba dag ni thams cad dang / /ngan song dang ni thabs yin dang / /'jig tshogs theg pa dman dag las/ /skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam pa yin/ /zhes lnga las skyob par bshad pa'i dang po bzhi las thun mong gi skyabs 'gros kyang skyob la 'dir ni gtso bor theg dman las skyob pa yin no/ /cho ga la ni theg chen gyi slob dpon nam med na sku gzugs sam sangs rgyas rnams yid kyis bsams pas kyang rung ste de'i —/15

spyan sngar phyag mchod byas nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon yod na slob dpon nam btsun pa'am rigs kyi bu bdag la dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba sems can thams cad bskyab pa'i ched dang sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad par bya ba'i slad du dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi ste thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba skyes bu chen po skyes bu khyu mchog bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sku bla na med pa'i sku chos kyi sku mnga' ba la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mchog la skyabs su mchi ste bla na med pa de bzhin gshegs pa la mnga' ba zhi ba chos kyi sku so so rang gis rig pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun dul ba tshogs kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi ste phyogs bzhi'i 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum dang thabs legs bya/ rjes su bslab bya bshad do/ /bslab bya ni snga ma'i steng du dge ba thams cad gzhan don du byang chub tu bsngo/ nyan rang gi zhi bde don du gnyer ba'i blo spang /sems can la phan bde ci thogs la 'bad par bya'o/ /phan yon ni theg chen par chud pas nyan rang las kyang bsam pas khyad par du 'phags shing ye shes khyad par can dang bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ba ste/ rgyan las/ skyabs su 'gro ba 'dir song don chen te/ /de ni tshad 416
