med yon tan tshogs 'phel 'gyur/ /'gro ba 'di la snying rje'i bsam pas khyab/ /mtshungs med 'phags chen chos kyang rgyas par byed/ /ces so/ /nyams pa'i nyes dmigs ni gzhan don gyi blo nyams na nyan rang du ltung zhing skyabs 'gro btang na srid par ltung ba'o/ /nyams na slar gso ba ni slob dpon nam rten nam dkon mchog yid kyi yul du dmigs te blangs pas sor chud la spyir theg chen gyi gnyen po ni mi mthun pa'i blo skyes pa'i de ma thag slar ldog cing gnyen po la bsten pa kho na gtso che'o/ /gnyis pa gzhung don ni/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /zhes gsungs te/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar te dus kyi nges bzung ngo / /theg chen gyi dkon mchog gsum ni yul nges bzung du bya ba ste bdag nyid dang dgos pa shugs la 'phangs so/ /'grel chen las/ snying po'i sgra 'di ni snying po'i tshig gi ste 'o ma'i snying por mar gyi snying po zhes bya ba bzhin no/ /de ltar na ji srid du byang chub kyi snying po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi bar du zhes pa'i don no/ /skyabs kyi don ni skyob pa'i don yin la mchi ba ni de'i bka' yongs su skyong ba yin te gang zhig gang la skyabs su 'gro ba de ni de'i bka' las 'da' ba ma yin pa'i don no zhes so/ /gsum pa sdig bshags la spyi gzhung gnyis las dang po ni/ gang sbyang ba'i sdig pa ni dug gsum gyis kun nas bslang ste bcas rang gi kha na ma tho ba bgyis pa'am bgyid du bstsal ba'am bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba las byung ba mngon mtho dang nges legs la 417

sgrib par byed pa'i las ni 'dir gang bshag par bya ba mi dge ba'i las kyi mtshan nyid do/ /de yang dug gsum ni kun slong ste/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba/ /zhes pas dug gsu/ma gyis kun nas bslangs na rnam pa dge bar snang yang ngo bo mi dge ba nyid do/ /bcas pa ni sdom nga/ gang blangs pa dang 'gal ba'i cha rnams yin la rang bzhin ni sdom pa ra/ blangs par spyad pa'i mi dge ba bcu'o/ /kha na ma tho ba ni bya bar mi rigs pa'i cha nas de skad brjod do/ /bgyis pa dang bgyid du bstsal ba dang bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba ni 'bras bu mtshungs pa ste/ dmag la sogs par don gcig phyir/ /thams cad byed pa po bzhin ldan/ /zhes so/ /byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa yang bdag nyid kyis bsdus nas bshag par bya ste/ rgyal po ma skyes dgas bdag sems can thams cad kyi nongs pa yang 'chags par bgyi'o zhes gsol pa na ston pas rgyal po chen po khyod rang nyid kyi nyes pa 'chags par ma zad sems can thams cad kyi nongs pa 'chags par byed pa ni rgyal po chen po khyod yang legs so zhes bka' bstsal ba'i phyir ro/ /sbyong byed ni stobs bzhi ste chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo las/ byams pa byang chub ser/sa dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sdig pa byas shing bsags pa zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang sor chud par byed pa'i stobs dang rten gyi stobs so/ /de la dang po ni mi dge ba'i las byas nas de la 'gyod pa mang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni mi dge ba'i las byas kyang 118

dge ba'i las la shin tu brtson pa'o/ /gsum pa ni sdom pa yang dag par blangs nas sdig pa mi byed pa'i sdom pa thob pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su/ 'gro ba dang byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba ste zhes dang / shar nas nub kyi rgya mtsho la thug par chu bo chen po pha mtha' mi mngon pa zhig drag por 'bab la de bzhin du phyogs gsu/ma ga las 'bab na bye ma'i phung po de chu bo gcig gis kyang rmeg med par byed na bzhis lta ci smos pa'i dpes bstan to/ /bathag tshul ni skye bo mang po 'dus pa dang yul khyad par can gyi spyan sngar bdag gis mi bya ba byas so zhes 'gyod pa'i smre sngags dang bcas te sgrog pa mthol ba dang / sngar byas pa la khong du dug 'thungs pa lta bu'i 'gyod pa bskyed nas da ni srog la bab kyang mi bya bar khas len pa ni stobs gnyis kyi sgo nas bshags pa dngos yin la skyabs 'gro dang byang sems 'dzin pa rten gyi stobs dang /sdig pa'i gnyen por dge ba sgrub pa gnyen po'i stobs lag tu blang ngo / /gnyen po ji lta bu zhe na sdig pa'i gnyen por dge ba spyod pa ste mngon pa kun btus las/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi las las ni gnyen po'i las stobs dang ldan par lta ste mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi 'bras bus 'phangs su zin yang gnyen po'i stobs kyis gzhan du sgyur bar byed pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzod las ni stong pa nyid bsgo mas pas sdig pa 'byang bar gsungs so/ /rdo rje gcod pa las mdo sde zab mo bton pas dang / dam tshig gsum bkod dang dpung bzang gi rgyud las bzlas pas dang / me tog brtsegs pa'i gzungs las de bzhin gshegs 419

pa'i mchod rten mchod pas dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi le'u las sku gzugs bzhengs pas sdig pa 'dag par gsungs so/ /gnyen po de yang sdig pa ji snyed byas pa de snyed bya dgos sam zhe na ma yin te mya ngan 'das chen gyi mdo las/ dge ba gcig gis kyang sdig pa mang po 'joms te zhes dang / rdo rje chung ngus ri rab bam me chung ngus rtswa shing ngam dug chung ngus sems can 'joms pa ltar dge ba chung ngus kyang sdig pa chen po 'joms pas na don du gnyer ba chen po nyid do zhes so/ /phan yon ni byams pa seng ge sgra'i mdo las/ mi shes pas ni gang byas pa'i/ /sdig pa'i las ni bshag par bgyi/ /mkhas pas nyes pa bshags na ni/ /las dang lhan cig mi gnas so/ /zhes dang gser 'od las/ gang gis bskal pa stong rnams su/ /sdig pa shin tu mi bzad bgyis/ /lan gcig rab tu bshags pa yis/ /de dag thams cad byang bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / de yang sun 'byin pa'i stobs kyis sdig pa 'dag pa ni kha drag gi bu lon ma khor ba la zhu ba byas pa lta bu/ gnyen po'i stobs kyis 'dag pa mi gtsang ba'i 'dam du chud pa phyung nas bkrus pa lta bu/ nyes pa las zlog pa'i stobs kyis 'dag pa chu rgyun gnod pa can gyi 'ol kha bsgyur ba lta bu/ rten skyabs sems kyis 'dag pa kha nyen gyis kha btsan la 'jus pa'am dug gi gnyen por sman bsten pa lta bu ste/ gcung dga' bo bud med la chags pa dang / sor phreng can mi stong du gcig gis ma tshang ba bsad pa dang mthong ldan dang bde byed pha ma bsad pa'ang stobs re re nyams su blangs pas dgra bcom pa thob pa ste/ gang zhig sngon chad bag 420

med gyur pa las/ /phyis nas bag dang ldan par gyur de yang / /zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te/ /dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ /zhes dang lung rnam 'byed las/ gang gis sdig pa'i las byas pa/ /dge ba yis ni 'gog byed de/ /nyi zla sprin las byung ba bzhin/ /'jig rten 'dir ni de snang 'gyur/ /zhes dang las rnam 'byed las/ shin tu mi bzad las rnams byas pa ni/ /bdag la rnam par smod pas srab par 'gyur/ /rab tu bshags dang sdom par byed pa yis/ /de dag shin tu rtsad nas bton pa bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bshags pas sdig pa dag pa'i rtags rmi lam du 'byung ste skul byed kyi gzungs las/ rmi lam na zas ngan skyugs pa dang zho dang 'o ma la sogs pa 'thungs pa dang nyi ma dang zla ba mthong ba dang nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang me 'bar ba dang ma he dang mi nag po thub pa dang dge slong dang dge slong ma'i dge 'dun mthong ba dang 'o ma 'byung ba'i shing dang glang po che dang khyu mchog dang ri dang seng ge'i khri dang khang bzang gi steng du 'dzegs pa dang chos nyan pa la sogs pa rmis na sdig pa dang 'bral bar 'gyur te zhes so/ /'on kyang de la rlom sems su mi bya'o/ /sgrib pa nyid gzod ma nas rang bzhin gyis dag par mthong zhing sgrib pa'i rang bzhin nyid chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin du mnyam par mthong na sgrib pa sbyang du med de las kyi sgrib pa rnam dag gi mdo las/ dge slong dri med 'od pham pa byung ba la ston pas chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu dang skad cig mar bstan zhing chos thams cad ni btags pa ste phyin ci log las byung ba'o chos thams cad ni nam mkha' ltar yongs 421

su/ dag pa ste dri ma med pa'o zhes sogs bstan pas byang chub tu sems skyes shing bskal pa bzang po'i 'og tu 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan pa dang / /yu la 'di dag ni dug med stong pa ste/ /dngos por dmigs pa thams cad bzung du med/ /ces sogs gsu/ngas so/ /gnyis pa gzhung don la bzhi/rnam/ nga/ra su/na dbyung ba dang / rten bzung ba dang / gnyen po la 'bad pa dang / sor chud par bya ba'o/ /dang po la yang bzhi/ byas pa'i rnam grangs la brtags nas 'gyod pa skyed pa/ myur du 'chi bar dogs pas sun 'byin pa/ don med par brtags pas sun 'byin pa/ rnam smin la 'jigs pas sun dbyung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la/ /thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas/ /tshe rabs 'di'am gzhan dag tu/ /bdag gis ma 'tshal sdig bgyis pa'am/ /bgyid du bstsal ba nyid dang ni/ /gti mug 'khrul bas bdag non te/ /rjes su yi rang gang bgyis pa/ /nongs pa de ni 'gyod bgyis nas/ /bsam pa thag pas mgon la 'chags/ /bdag gis dkon mchog gsu/ma dang ni/ /pha ma'am bla ma gzhan dag la/ /nyon mongs sgo nas lus ngag dang / /yid kyis gnod bgyis gang lags dang / /nyes pa du ma'i skyon chags pa'i/ /sdig can bdag gis sdig pa gang / /shin tu mi bzad bgyis pa de/ /thams cad 'dren pa rnams la 'chags/ /zhes gsungs te/ bdag gis ma 'tshal zhes pa ni bdag nyid gti mug chen por bstan no/ /bgyis pa ni rang gis sgo gsu/ma gyis so/ /bgyid du bstsal ba ni ngag dang yid 422

kyis gzhan byed du bcug pa'o/ /yi rang ba ni gzhan gyis sdig pa byas pa la yid kyis dga' bar byed pa'o/ /'gyod bgyis nas zhes pa ni dmyal ba la sogs par mi dge ba'i rnam smin thos pas 'jigs pa'o/ /de la dkon mchog gsu/ma ni bla na ma mchis pa'i zhing dang pha la sogs pa ni phan btags pa'i zhing yin te de la gnod pas ni sdug bsngal gyi rnam par smin pa rgya che zhing drag pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /khyad par dge 'dun gyi rdzas gang zag gis ma byin par len pa ni ches lci ste gal te zhal du 'du ba'i sgo zhig yin na 'di ni rnam smin ma myong bar mi 'dag par dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs so/ /mi bzad pa ni me stag las me chen mched pa lta bu ste rgyu'i dus na chung yang rnam smin gyi dus na 'jigs su rung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag ni sdig pa ma byang ba'i/ /sngon du 'gum par 'gyur du mchi/ /ji ltar 'di las nges thar bar/ /myur ba'i chul gyis skyab tu gsol/ /yid brtan mi rung 'chi bdag 'di/ /byas dang ma byas mi sdod pas/ /na dang mi na kun gyi yang / /glo bur tshe la yid mi brtan/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'chi ba'i dus ma nges pas sdig pa ma byang bar shi dogs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ thams cad bor te cha dgos pa/ /bdag gis de ltar ma shes nas/ /mdza' dang mi mdza'i don gyi phyir/ /sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas/ /mi mdza' rnams kyang med 'gyur zhing / /mdza' ba rnams kyang med par 'gyur/ /bdag kyang med par 'gyur ba ste/ /de bzhin thams cad med par 'gyur/ /rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin/ /dngos po gang dang gang spyad pa/ /de de dran pa'i yul du 'gyur/ /'das pa thams cad mthong 42 3

mi 'gyur/ /re zhig gson tshe 'di nyid la'ang / /mdza' dang mi mdza' du ma 'das/ /de dag don du byas pa'i sdig /mi bzad gang yin mdun na gnas/ /de ltar bdag ni glo bur zhes/ /bdag gis rtogs par ma gyur pas/ /gti mug chags dang zhe sdang gis/ /sdig pa rnam pa du ma byas/ /zhes gsungs te/ ci'i ched du byas na thams cad bor nas rang gcig pur 'gro dgos pa ma shes par mdza' ba skyong ba dang mi mdza' ba gzhom pa'i don du byas so/ /su'i ched du byas pa des myong ngo zhe na/ de dag thams cad med par gyur kyang rnam smin ni rang gi mdun lta bu phyi ma'i sems kho na la gnas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ nyin mtshan sdod pa yong med par/ /tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing / /snon pa gud nas yong med na/ /bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur/ /bdag ni mal na 'dug bzhin du/ /gnyen bshes kun gyis mtha' bskor yang / /srog 'chad pa yi tshor ba dag /bdag nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la/ /gnyen gyis ci phan bshes ci phan/ /de tshe bsod nams gcig skyob na/ /de yang bdag gis ma bsten to/ /mgon po bag med bdag gis ni/ /'jigs pa 'di 'dra ma 'tshal nas/ /mi rtag tshe 'di'i ched dag tu/ /sdig pa mang po nye bar bsgrubs/ /skye bo yan lag gcod pa'i sar/ /de ring khrid pa'ang bred gyur te/ /kha skam mig rtsa ngan la sogs/ /snga las gzhan du 'gyur snang na/ /gshin rje'i pho nya 'jigs 'jigs lta'i/ /sha tshugs can gyis bzung gyur cing / /'jigs chen nad kyis thebs gyur pa/ rab tu nyam thag smos ci dgos/ /su zhig 'jigs chen 'di las bdag /legs par skyob par byed 424

'gyur zhes/ /bred sha 'thon pa'i mig bgrad nas/ /phyogs bzhir skyabs dag tshol bar byed/ /phyogs bzhir skyabs med mthong nas ni/ /de nas kun tu yi mug 'gyur/ /gnas der skyabs yod ma yin na/ /de tshe bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang myur du 'chi nges pa/ /'chi ma'i gnad gcod/ de'i tshe dge ba ma bsgrub pas 'gyod par 'gyur ba/ sdig pa spyad pas 'gyod par 'gyur ba/ 'chi ba la skrag par rigs pa/ kun tu skyabs tshol ba/ skyabs ma rnyed nas sdug bsngal ba rnams rim pa ltar tshigs bcad res bstan zhing lnga pa tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan no/ /gnyis pa rten gyi stobs ni/ de bas rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa/ /stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la/ /de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi/ /de yis thugs su chud pa'i chos/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /bdag ni 'jigs pas rnam skrag nas/ /kun tu bzang la bdag nyid 'bul/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la'ang bdag nyid kyis/ /bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rjes spyod pa ma 'khrul ba/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang / /nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ /sdig ldan bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang / /sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ /thugs rje che mgon thams cad la/ /skyabs tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod/ /gang zhig mthong nas gshin rje yi/ /pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams/ /skrag nas phyogs bzhir 'byer byed pa/ /rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das/ /da ni 425

'jigs pa cher mthong nas/ /khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ /'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ /zhes gsungs te/ de lta bu 'byung bar nges pa skyes pas 'jigs shing skrag pa dang skyabs gzhan rnyed pas sdug bsngal ba dang skyabs la yid ches pa'i blo bcos min gyis da lta nas sangs rgyas dang chos dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la ci bya mchang brlag gi tshul gyis skya bas su 'gro zhing / khyad par du sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa'i bsod nams ba spu'i khung bu la gnas kyang smon lam gyi dbang gis byang chub sems dpar ston pa kun tu bzang po dang / da ltar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas phal mo che zhig 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas sngon byang chub tu btsud pa yi na pas sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa'i bla mar gyur kyang byang chub sem/sa dpa'i tshul las mi g.yo ba 'jam dpal dang / mtshan thos pa tsar/ gyis sdug bsngal thams cad skyob par smon lam btab ste mtshan byin gyis brlabs pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ltung ba sel ba'i smon lam can nam mkha'i snying po dang /bdud kyis mi 'khrugs pa sa'i snying po dang / gang mthong ba tsam gyis bdud dang gshin rje'i dpung mthar byed pa phyag na rdo rje dang / la sogs pas byams pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la sogs byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje can de rnams la skyabs su mchi zhing lus phul te gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /bdag nyid 'bul zhes dang / bdag nyid kyis 'es/ pa ni gzhan gyis byed du bcug pa sogs ma yin par rang nyid kho nas sems thag pa nas skyabs su/ gsol te/ sngon chad sdig pa ci yang mi bya —126

ste/ /zhes sogs kyis khyed kyi bka' las 'das mod kyang da ni nam du yang bka' las mi 'da' bas bdag rjes su zungs shig pa'o/ /gong du byang chub snying por sogs kyis skyabs su song ba ni lam/ thams cad kyi gzhi'i skyabs 'gro dngos bzung ba yin la/ 'di ni rten gyi stobs su glo bur gyi 'jigs pas dkon mchog ra sadar sbran pa yin pas zlos pa'i skyon med do/ /gsum pa ni/ tha mal nad kyis 'jigs na yang / /sman pa'i ngag bzhin bya dgos na/ /'dod chags la sogs nyes brgya yi/ /nad kyis rtag btab smos ci dgos/ /de gcig gis kyang 'dzam gling na/ /gnas pa'i mi kun rlag byed la/ /de dag gso ba'i sman gzhan ni/ /phyogs rnams kun nas mi rnyed na/ /de la sman pa thams cad mkhyen/ /zug rngu thar/sa cad 'byin pa yi/ /bka' ltar mi byed sems pa ni/ /shin tu gti mug smad pa'i gnas/ /g.yang sa tha mal chung ngu la'ang / /bag yod gnas par bya dgos na/ /dpag tshad stong du lhung ba yi/ /yun ring g.yang sa smos ci dgos/ /de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ /bdag ni med par 'gyur ba'i dus/ /de ni gdon mi za bar 'byung / /bdag la mi 'jigs su/ yis byin/ /'di las ji ltar nges thar 'gyur/ /gdon mi za bar med 'gyur na/ /ci phyir bdag yid bde bar 'dug /ces gsu/ngas te/ci'i phyir bka' las mi 'da' zhe na tshigs bcad dang po'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i nad ni shin tu 'jigs par ston pa la gnyis pa'o/ /sman pa sangs rgyas gcig pur ston pa ni gsum pa'o/ /g.yang sa'i dpes bzlos te bstan pa ni bzhi pa'o/ /sdig pa sbyong ba las rings pa'i bya ba gzhan med /27

par ston pa ni sh+lau ka gnyis so/ /bzhi pa ni/ sngon chad myong ste zhig pa las/ /bdag la lhag pa ci yod na/ /bdag ni de la mngon zhen nas/ /bla ma'i bka' dang 'gal bar byas/ /gson tshe 'di dang de bzhin du/ /gnyen dang bshes pa rnam spangs nas/ /gcig pur ga shed 'gro dgos na/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' kun ci rung / /mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung / /de las ji ltar nges thar zhes/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bdag gis ni/ /'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam par rigs/ /bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho'am/ /bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin las/ /gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams/ /mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du/ /thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis/ /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te/ /de dag thams cad 'chags par bgyi/ /'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par bzung du gsol/ /'di ni bzang po ma lags pas/ /slan chad bdag ni yong mi bgyid/ /ces gsungs te/ tshigs bcad dang po gsum gyis 'gyod pa'i rgyu mtshan bsams/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa dang tshigs bcad phyed kyis mthol zhing bshags/ de nas phyed kyis slan chad sdom par dam bcas pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyod pa la 'jug pa las sdig pa bshag pa gtso bor ston pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa rnam par phye ba'o// //le'u gsum pa/ byang chub kyi sems yongs su bzung ba/le'u gsum pa la 'brel ni bshags pa'i 'og tu yi rang sogs 'byung 428

bar 'brel lo/ /des na bzhi pa rjes su yi rang la spyi gzhung gnyis/ dang po la ngo bo ni rang gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba la rab tu dga' zhing yi rang ba'i blo'o/ /dbye na rgyu dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang 'bras bu bde ba la rjes su yi rang ba ste gnyis sam yi rang bya'i dge bas phye na rnam pa du mar 'gyur ro/ /sgom tshul la ni 'grel chen las rjes su yi rang ba ni gsu/ma/ ste lus ngag yid kyis so/ /lus kyis ni ba spu ldang ba mchi ma 'khrugs pa lus 'dar ba la sogs pas so/ /ngag gis ni legs par byas so rab tu byas so bzang po zhig byas so zhes brjod cing yi rang bar byed pa'o/ /sems kyis ni sems rab tu dang bas yang dag par dga' bar byed pa'o zhes so/ /phan yon ni/ pha rol gyi dge ba las ches lhag pa 'thob pa ste rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis nyin bdun du ston pa 'khor bcas la bsnyen bkur ba la mu to ba zhig gis rjes su yi rang bar byas pas ston pas rgyal po khyod kyi dge ba bsngo'am khyod kyi 'di la bsten nas 'di las ches lhag pa'i bsod nams thob pa de'i dge ba bsngo zhes gsungs pa na bdag gi 'di las ches lhag pa su zhig snyam nas de bsngo bar zhus pas mu to bas rjes su yi rang bsgoms pa'i dge ba bsngo bar mdzad la/ nyin bdun pa la blon po rnams kyis mu to ba sems 'khrug tu bcug pas rgyal po'i dge ba bsngo bar mdzad par gsungs pa dang / mi ldog byang chub mchog la rab tu zhugs pa yi/ /sems bskyed pa la bsam pa thag pas yi rang ba/ /stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal yang tshad bzung rung / /rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de lta min/ /dge ba don gnyer phan 'dod sems can ji snyed pa/ /kun gyi bsod 429

nams phung po la yang yi rang 'gyur/ /zhes dang / srid pa gsum na sems can ma lus ji snyed pa/ /yongs su brtag pa bzung ste de dag thams cad kyis/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa sangs rgyas dgra bcom rang rgyal la/ /bskal pa ra/tha' yas sbyin byin nyan thos legs tshol na/ /byang chub sems dpa' ma/khas pa thabs mkhas gang zhig gis/ /de dag bsod nam/sa bya ba'i dngos la yi rang nas/ /sems can don du byang chub mchog rab yongs bsngo na/ /yongs su bsngos pas dge ba de kun zil gyis gnon/ /nor bu mching bu'i phung po chen por gyur pa yang / /rin chen baiḍūr+ya gcig de kun zil gyis gnon/ /de bzhin 'gro kun sbyin pa'i phung po rgya chen kun/ /rjes su/ yi rang byang chub sems dpas zil gyis gnon/ /zhis khams gsu/ma gyi ser/sa can thams cad nyan thos kyi lam du zhugs nas sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas dang dgra bcom pa rnams la mchod pa byed cing nyan thos kyi byang chub tu bsngo ba re re zhing byed la byang chub sems dpas de thams cad la yi rang ba gcig bsgoms nas de'i dge ba sangs rgyas su bsngos pas snga ma de thams cad zil gyis gnon nus par dpe dang bcas nas bshad nga/'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems can kun gyi ngan song gi /sdug bsngal ngal bso/'i dge ba dang / /sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la/ /dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa/ /de la rjes su yi rang ngo / /lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /nges par thar la yi rang ngo / /skyob pa rnams kyi byang chub dang / /rgyal sras sa la'ang yi rang ngo / /sem/sa can thams cad bde mdzad pa'i/ /thugs skyed dge ba / rte0

rgya mtsho dang / /sems can phan par mdzad pa la/ /dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /zhes gsungs te/ rgyu bsod nams cha mthun dang / de'i 'bras bu mngon mtho'i bde ba/ thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba/ nyan rang gi byang chub/ theg chen gyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang sa bcu/ rgyu theg chen gyi lam sgrub pa rnams la snga ma rnams tshig rkang gnyis re dang tha ma sh+lau ka gcig gis bstan pa yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la/ /thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thoms la/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol/ /zhes gsungs te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gang da ltar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu gzhan gyis rtogs dka' bar mkhyen pa dang / dam pa'i chos ni sangs rgyas nyid las dkon par ston pa dang / dge ba skyed pa'i phyir gzhan gyis gsol ba 'debs su gzhug pa'i dus la bzhes te 'o skol gyi ston pas sangs rgyas nas zhag zhe dgur thun mong gi gdul bya la chos ma bstan pa dang / de nas/ gzhan gyis gsol ba btab la nga mi ltos/ /skye bo 'di kun tshangs la dad pa ste/ /de yis gsol ba btab nas chos 'khor bskor/ /zhes bstan pa ltar sangs rgyas kha cig de bas yun thung ba dang kha cig lo mang po dang sku tshe ring ba la la bskal pa'i bar dang de bzhin gshegs pa la la lo dpag tu med par bzhugs kyang chos ma bstan par mthar nyin gcig kho na chos bstan ste mya ngan las 'da' bar mdzad pa yang gsungs pas de lta bu rnams la dad pas dmigs te chos ston par gsol ba 'debs pa sh+lau ka gcig go /'dir rang tshangs 431

par bsgoms te gser gyi 'khor lo phul nas bskul bar mos zhes zer ba ni gsang sngags dang bsres pa ste 'on kyang mos pa'i stobs tsam gyis yin na 'gal ba med do/ /drug pa ni/ rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/ /thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /'gro 'di ldongs par mi 'god cing / /bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos kyi sku mya ngan las 'da' ba med kyang mchog gi sprul sku ni gdul bya la dkon par ston pa dang rtag 'dzin zlog pa dang sku gdung gyes pa'am ril pos gdul bya rnams kyi ched dang bka' bsdu ba dang bstan pa'i gnas tshad sogs kyi phrin las lhag ma mang po ston dgos pa'i phyir mya ngan las 'da' ba nges par ston la/ de yang ston pas kun dga' bo mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs su gzhug pa'i phyir/ kun dga' bo gang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la bsten bsgom mang du byas pa de ni 'dod na bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag gi bar du yang 'dug go /de bzhin gshegs pas kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang bzhi la bsten te bsgom mang du mdzad pas bzhed na bskal pa 'am bskal pa las lhag gi bar du yang bzhugs so/ /zhes lan gsum gsungs kyang kun dga' bo bdud kyis thebs pas ci yang ma gsol ba na nyin mor spyod du song zhig ces gsungs pa'i 'og tu sdig can gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar gsol ba btab/ mgar ba'i bu tsun+das mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pas gnyis ka dga' ba'i phyir sku tshe'i tshad zla ba gsum byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu ste/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de lta bu mtha' yas pa rnams la dmigs te mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 432

gsol ba gdab pa sh+lau ka gcig go /bdun pa bsngo ba la gsum/ bsngo ba dngos/ lus sogs sems can la btang ba/ smon lam rgya cher gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de ltar 'di dag kun byas te/ /dge ba bdag gis gang bsags pa/ /des ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /'gro ba nad pa ji srid du/ /nad sos 'gyur gyi bar du ni/ /sman dang sman pa nyid dag dang / /de yi nad g.yog byed par shog /zas dang skom gyi char phab ste/ /bkres dang skom pa'i gnod pa bsal/ /mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma'i tshe/ /bdag ni zas dang skom du gyur/ /sems can phongs shing dbul ba la/ /bdag ni mi zad gter gyur te/ /yo byad mkho rgu sna tshogs su/ /mdun na nye bar gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs te/ gzhan don du spyir bsngo ba dang nad dang bkres pa dang phongs pa sel ba ste bzhi la tshigs bcad re res bsngo ba gsungs la/ nad dang mu ge ni ma 'ongs pa de'i bskal pa'i dus te/ mdzod las/ de nas las kyi lam lhag pas/ /tshe thung lo ni bcu par 'gyur/ /bskal pa mtshon dang nad dang ni/ /mu ge rnams kyis mthar phyin to/ /zhag rnams dang ni zla ba dang / /lo bdun dag ste go rim bzhin/ /zhes mi rnams tshe lo bcu pa'i dus der thog mar mtshon gyi bskal pa zhag bdun gyis dmyal thag par byed do/ /de'i lhag ma rnams nad kyi bskal pa zhag bdun dang zla ba bdun gyis dmyal thag gcod do/ /de'i lhag mar lus pa rnams mu ge'i bskal pa zhag bdun zla ba bdun lo bdun gyis lhag ma tsam du byed la de nas rdzogs ldan gyi mgo rtsom par 'gyur ba'o/ /des na spyir sems can gyi nad sogs sdug bsngal 433

thams cad dang khyad par nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma ba de rnams kho na shin tu sdug bsngal zhing skyabs gzhan med par gzigs pas de rnams kyi don du bsngo ba ste/ mtshon gyi bskal pa bar ma'i tshe/ /bdag ni mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / /zhe sdang gdug rtsub kun zhi nas/ /byams pa che la gnas gyur cig /ces pa'ang don gyis 'thob bam snyam mo/ /'gro ba nad pa sogs ni nad kyi bskal pa las skyabs pa'i don du bsngo ba'o/ /zas dang sogs ni mu ge'i bskal pa las skyabs par bsngo ba'o/ /sems can phongs shing sogs ni mis phongs pa las sdig pa la 'jug par gzigs nas de'i ched du lhag par bsngo ba'o/ /'grel chen las 'di ni rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba las dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag sdug bsngal gyi phung po thams cad zlog pa'i phyir sems can thams cad kyi gnas su gyur cig /yongs su sgrol ba'i phyir skyob pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad las srung ba'i phyir skyabs/ sa thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i phyir rten/ shin tu grub bde 'thob pa'i phyir dpung gnyen/ rab rib med pa'i ye shes kun tu bstan pa'i phyir snang ba/ ma rig pa'i mun pa zlog pa'i phyir sgron mer gyur cig ces sogs kyis yongs su bsngo la de yang lhag pa'i bsam pas yongs su bsngo'i tshig tsam gyis ni ma yin no/ /dga' ba mgu ba rab tu dang ba rab tu dga' ba mnyen pa byams pa mdza' ba phan gdags pa'i sems kyis yongs su bsngo'o zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /phangs pa med par btang bar bya/ /thams cad btang bas mya 434

ngan 'da'/ /bdag blo mya ngan 'das pa sgrub/ /thams cad gtong bar chabs cig la/ /sems can rnams la btang ba mchog /bdag gis lus can thams cad la/ /lus 'di ci bder byin zin gyis/ /rtag tu gsod dang smod pa 'am/ /brdeg sogs ci dgar byed la rag /bdag gi lus la rtse byed dam/ /co 'dri ga zha'i rgyu byed kyang / /bdag gi lus 'di byin zin gyis/ /'di yi kha tas ci zhig bya/ /de la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /las gang yin pa'ang byed du chug /ces gsungs te/ dang pos ni lus longs spyod dge bar bcas pa sems can la byang chub kyi rgyur gtong bar dam bca' ba'o/ /gnyis pas de'i 'thad pa ston te de rnams ma btang na byang chub mi 'thob la bdag ni byang chub sgrub pa'i phyir dang / lus longs spyod blos ma btang na yang 'chi ba'i dus 'jog dgos kyang don cir yang mi 'gyur la des na da lta nas sems can la btang na don chen por 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas gnyis kyis byin pa go bar byas te da ni lus longs spyod la bdag gir bzung ba'i gze reg mi bya'o zhes dam 'cha' ba dang /de nas phyed kyis las 'chol ba po rang la mi gnod pa'i las de la bkol zhig ces 'doms par byed pa'o/ /'grel chen las ni dus gsum gyi dge ba gtong na ma 'ongs pa'i dge ba da lta ji ltar gtong zhe na/ bden mod de'i dus kyi zhen pa ldog pa dang da ltar yang bsam pa dag pa 'phel ba'i ched do/ /ltos pa med pa ni bdag don la ste ci'i phyir gtong na sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir ro/ /'di ni blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/ dge ba'i sems dang sems las byung ba rnams dran la rjes su dran nas kyang 435

byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni 'das pa la mkhas pa'o/ /gang ma 'ongs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba nges par sems shing byang chub la mngon du phyogs pa'i las sems te bdag la dge ba'i sems skye ba 'gyur ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni ma 'ongs pa la mkhas pa'o/ /sogs dang / thams cad gtong ba la mos pa yongs su rdzogs te gtong ba'i sems kyi shugs kyis lus kyi sbyor ba des yongs su 'dzin pa thams cad gtong ste yongs su 'dzin pa 'di ni srid pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba ste de las grol ba la grol ba zhes bya'o zhes so/ /rang don du cung zad mi srung ngam zhe na/thams cad gtong bar sogs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa las/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ni chos thams cad la gzhan gyir 'du shes skyed par byed de dngos po 'ga' yang mi len no sogs dang / sred med kyi bu'i mdor/ gtong ba'i blo mi 'jug pa'i dngos po srel bar mi bya'o sogs dang / blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo'i 'byung bzhis sems can la sgo sna tshogs nas phan 'dogs tshul rnams drangs so/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang / /'ga' yang don med ma gyur cig /bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gis/ /khro'am dad pa'i sems byung na/ /de nyid rtag tu de dag gi /don chen 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gang dag bdag la kha zer ram/ /gzhan dag gnod pa byed pa'am/ /de bzhin phyar ka gtong yang rung / /thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur/ /bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ /lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon 436

dang / /brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni/ /gzings dang zam pa nyid du gyur/ /gling don gnyer la gling dang ni/ /gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang / /bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa/ /kun gyi bran du 'gyur bar shog /yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang / /rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang / /dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang / /lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor gyur/ /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang / /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang / /sems can dpag tu med pa yi/ /rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i/ /sems can kun la rnam kun tu/ /thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du/ /bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /ces gsungs te/ dang po'i tshig rkang drug gis bdag nyid la sus ji ltar dmigs pa'i blo skyes kyang blo de nyid gang zag de la don chen po'i rgyur 'gyur bar smon pa dang / de nas tshigs bcad gcig gis gnod lan phan bder 'brel bar smon pa'o/ /de nas gnyis kyis sems can la ji ltar mkho ba de dang der 'gyur bar smon pa ste/ rta'i rgyal po bā la har gyur pas srin mo'i gling nas 'byin pa la sogs pa'o/ /gling don gnyer la gling dang ni/ /zhes pa la gzhan dag rgya dper dī paṃ zhes mar me'i skad dod yod pa rgya dpe bklag nyes pa'am ma dag pas dī pa zhes bklags nas gling du bsgyur bar zad do zer yang / mar me 'dod la mar me dang / /zhes par 'grel chen dang bi bhu ti'i 'bru snang zhing / 'on kyang rngog 'gyur phal cher na/ gling don gnyer la zhes kho na snang bas rgya dpe tha dad pa snyam mo/ — /de nas yid bzhin nor la sogs pa'i tshigs 437

bcad gnyis kyis 'bad rtsol dang rtog pa med par lhun gyis grub pa sangs rgyas kyi sa'i phrin las 'grub par smon pa dang / de nas gcig gis de ltar sems can gcig la ji ltar ba bzhin du sems can thams cad la rtag par 'grub pa'i smon lam mo/ /de la gnas mal ni zhag mal gyi bsti gnas te mtshan mo'i lha mo rnams kyi rnam thar las mun par snang ba bskyed pa dang gnas mal stob pa sogs de dag gi phrin las su gsungs so/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu ni dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'o/ /bum pa bzang po ni sngags kyis bsgrubs nas grub pa na de nas gang 'dod pa 'byung ba ste dge slong dgra bcom ni bum pa nas theg pa chen po'i sde snod mtha' yas pa phyung ste lta bar bshad pa ltar ro/ /rig sngags ma grub pa rnams la myur du 'grub pa'i mthu stsol ba'am/ /yang na ral gri dang mig sman dang lham sogs grub pa'i rdzas su gyur pas don ster ba'o/ /sman chen po ni lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa'i bcud len gyi bdud rtsi tshe bskal par 'tsho ba dang rig 'dzin gyi lus su byed pa'o/ /dpag bsam gyi shing ni 'dod rgu ster ba'i shing ste de las gang 'dod blang du 'byung ba'o/ /'dod 'jor gyur ba ni 'dod rgu 'jo ba'i ba lta bu'i don te ji ltar 'dod pa'i don gyi 'byung gnas su gyur cig pa'o/ /sa sogs ni 'bad rtsol dang rnam rtog med par don byed pa'i dpe'o/ /'di rnams ni rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba rnam pa bcu la sogs pa rgyal sras chen po rnams kyi bsngo ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa 'dus pa'o/ /'dir dogs pa 'di 'byung ba'i gnas yod de/ ci gcig gi dge ba gcig shos la byin pas gcig shos la mi phan na 438

don med la/ phan na las ma byas pa dang phrad pa'i nyes par thal bas rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'jig go /yang gzhan gyis bdag la gnod pa byas pa 'dis 'di bde ba 'thob par gyur cig snyam pa 'di 'grub bam mi 'grub na bsngos pa don med par 'gyur la/ 'grub na rgyu mi dge ba byas pas 'bras bu bde ba 'byung bar thal lo/ /yang mar me 'dod la mar mer 'gyur ba sogs 'di gnas dang gnas min gyi bsngo ba gang yin/ gnas kyi bsngo ba yin na mar me dang gnas mal dang nor bu sogs ni bem po yin pas byang chub sems dpa' bem por 'gyur ba yod par thal lo/ /gnas min gyi bsngo ba yin na bsngos pa don med de mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro zhes dogs par 'gyur ro/ /de la skyon dang po med de las byas pa dang phrad kyi ma byas pa dang mi phrad pa dang gzhan byas kyi las la gzhan mi dbang ba ni theg pa thun mong gi las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag phyogs gcig pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin la/ 'dir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mchog rnams ni las la dbang thob pas las sems kyi sgyur kha tsam du mayo zhing ci yang byar med pa dang ji ltar yang gtub pa dbyer med par mkhyen pas las byin gyis rlob par mdzad pa'i phyir te 'di ni theg dman na yang mi rnams sen mo'i steng du zhing rmo bas 'tsho bar byed pa byung rung nga'i nyan thos rnams bsod snyoms kyis phongs par mi 'gyur te gal te de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub ma thob na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba'i dge ba kho na bgrang las 'das par yod la de thams cad ston pa nyid kyi longs spyod du smin par 'gyur ba rnams bdag gir ma 439

mdzad par ma 'ongs pa'i nyan thos rnams larjes su gnang ba'i phyir ro zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten gyi nor lha rnams kyis kyang skye ba phyi mar smin rgyu'i longs spyod tshe 'dir bsgyur bar nus shing de lta bu bu lon snga nud du blangs pas 'bras bu chung ngur byas pa yin yang de la 'jig rten pa rnams nor lhas dngos grub byin par grags pa'i phyir/ 'o na sems can thams cad kyi mi dge ba'i las gtan med du yang sangs rgyas kyis ci'i phyir byin gyis mi rlob ce na/ 'di ni sangs rgyas rang ngos nas de ltar brlabs pa yin te chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du sangs rgyas pa kho nar gzigs pas ma dag pa'i khams gzhan ma gzigs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang gzhan snang la der snang bar ma nges te mig ldan gyis gzugs gsal bar mthong ba'i mdun na long ba la de ltar ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang mig ldan gyis gzugs mthong ba la brten nas sman pa bos te long ba'i rab rib bsal te phye bas des kyang gzugs mthong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir mig ldan gyis gzugs mthong ba de long ba'i rab rib dag byed kyi rgyur 'gyur ba ltar sangs rgyas kyis ma dag pa ma gzigs pa kho nas sems can rnams kyis ma dag par mthong ba rab rib can lta bu la brtse bas byang chub la 'god pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin no/ /des na gnas 'jog gi bu sbrang rtsi can 'dod na rgya mtsho chen po bzhi yang sbrang rtsir 'gyur ba'i phyir dgra bcom pa sgur chung gi thal skyo lhung bzed gang po lta smos kyang ci dgos la/'on kyang dgra bcom pa sgur chung gis tha ma'i nyin la de thal skyo las gzhan du mi 'gyur bar yang snang ba ltar ji ltar yang bsgyur nus pa dang 440

las chud kyang mi 'dza' ba dbyer med pa 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin te sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul lo/ /gnas skabs su ni dge ba la bdag gir ma byas par yongs su btang ba ni dge ba mtha' yas par byed pa'i rgyu'o/ /skyon gnyis pa yang med de byang chub sems dpa' la gnod pa byas pa de bde ba'i rgyu ma yin mod kyang byang chub sems dpa' rang nyid ni pha rol gyis ci byas kyang legs par 'dzin pa'am sgyu ma lta bu las phan gnod du rtog pa med pas byang chub sems dpa' nas gzhal na gnod pa ma yin la bzang ngan gyis 'brel ba tsam de nyid gdul bya de byang chub sems dpas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ drang srong bzod par smra ba la rgyal pos gnod pa byas pa'i tshe rgyal po khyod kyis nga'i yan lag dang nying lag dras shing dras shing gtubs pa las na ngas kyang byang chub thob nas khyod kyi nyon mongs pa dras shing dras shing gtub par bya'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes te byang chub brnyes pa'i thog ra/ kho nar rgyal po de kauṇ+ḍi rgyar gyur pa la khyod kyis chos kun shes sam zhes lan gsum du rmed pas nyon mongs pa gtubs shing dgra bcom par bkod pa lta bu'i phyir ro/ /skyon gsum pa yang med de thun mong gi theg pa dang bstun pa'i lan ltar na/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i rta dang glang po che la mi rnams longs spyod par byed pa ltar byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi mthus byung ba'i dngos po nyid sems can rnams kyi rten du 'gyur ba ste bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas rnams kyis zhing dag sbyor gyis bsgrubs pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten 'di ji ltar sems can rnams kyi rten gnas su gyur pa bzhin no/ /'o 441

na brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni/ /sogs pha rol tu brgal bar 'dod pa la bdag chu bo la gru dang rgya mtsho la gzings dang chu phran la zam par gyur cig ces bdag nyid phan pa'i dngos po de dang der 'gyur bar smon lam btab pa 'di ma thebs par 'gyur ro zhe na/ rgyu smon lam gyi skabs su ni 'grub mi 'grub dang gnas gnas min sogs mi sems par snying rje chen pos ci bya gtol dang bral ba kho na'i gzhan dbang du gyur pas ma bzod de 'debs pa yin la/ 'bras bu smon pa de grub pa'i dus na bdag nyid gru gzings sogs su ma gyur kyang bdag nyid kyi smon lam gyi mthus grub pa'i gru gzings sogs kyis 'gro ba sgrol bar byed pas skyon med do/ /zhes lan gyi rnam grangs gcig go /bdag nyid kyi lus 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bza' btung du spyad pa ni nya ro hi ma'i skyes rabs dang srin bu ke ta ka brgyad khri bskyabs pa dang glang chen gyi skyes rabs sogs rgya cher bshad la/ spyir mar me'i bya ba byas pa bde byin gyis phyag la me sbar te mtshan mo tshong pa lam 'khyams pa rnams bsgral ba dang gru'i bya ba byas pa rus sbal gyis rgya mtshor lhung ba'i tshong pa lnga dang lnga brgya bsgral ba sogs gsungs so/ /shin tu nges pa'i don du na/ bem shes gang zag rnams shin tu 'gal bar rtog pa 'di ni byis pa'i mthong ba dang theg dman grub mtha' pa rnams kyi rtog pa la phyogs gcig tu zhen pa ste/ ji ltar rmi lam na snang ba dang sprul pa'i bem shes gang zag de dag la bem po'i chos dang shes pa'i chos dang gang zag gi chos kyi khyad par ci zhigades na bem por grags pas gang zag gi bya ba byed pa shing mkhan mkhas 442

pa'i 'phrul 'khor dang / 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i sman gyi bu mo sogs gsungs pa'ang yang dag par na bem shes gang zag tha dad pa'i 'dzin pa gzhig pa'i ched de chos thams cad ni ji ltar blos bzung ba de ltar gnas pa ma yin no/ /'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo ste lan gyi rnam grangs gcig go /de ltar lus longs spyod btang ba sogs bsngo ba'i 'phros don du byas pa ni bod 'grel dag gi lugs yin la/ bsdus don du/ dngos gzhi la gnyis/ smon pa'i sems mngon du bzhag pa gsum dang / de byang chub kyi bar du bar ma dor yal bar mi 'dor bar dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po la lus sogs la ltos med du byang chub chen po 'thob par dam bca' ba ni lus sogs kyis bstan pa'i tshigs bcad phyed dang lnga'o/ /gnyis pa chud mi za bar smon pa ni tshigs bcad phyed dang gsum mo/ /gsum pa longs spyod pa'i rgyur smon pa ni tshigs bcad lngas bstan no zhes dngos gzhir bsdus te bshad do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la'ang / /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni skyed bgyi zhing / /de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang / /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs te/'dir dngos su sems skyed dang sdom pa lhan cig tu bzung ba yin la so sor 'dod na yang de ltar bzung ba'i dbye bsdu shes par bya'o/ /'di ni slob dpon nam rten nam dkon mchog gi spyan sngar lan gsum du blangs pas skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa rjes la bdag nyid dbugs dbyung ba 443

dang / gzhan gzengs bstod pa gnyis kyi dang po la yang rang don grub pas dang / gzhan don grub pas dga' ba skyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de ltar blo dang ldan pa yis/ /rab dang byang chub sems bzung nas/ /mjug kyang rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ /sems ni 'di ltar gzengs bstod do/ /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsam ste/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /long bas phyags bdar phung po las/ /ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin ji zhig ltar stes nas/ /byang chub sems 'di bdag la skyes/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshigs bcad dang pos mtshams sbyar/ gnyis pas rang gi don grub par ched du brjod/ gsum pas rigs sun mi 'byin par dam bca'/ bzhi pas byang chub kyi sems shin tu rnyed dka' ba'i dpe bstan na/ de yang dbugs dbyung ba dang gzengs bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni byang chub kyi sems kyi mjug kyang rgyas par bya ba ste srung ba dang dag pa dang spel ba'i phyir ro/ /sngon thog med du 'khor yang byang chub kyi sems ma skyes la deng kho na skyes pas deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod ces bya'o/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes te byang chub kyis sems skyes pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi rigs su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas sras su/ da gyur to zhes dga' ba dang don bzhin gyi nga rgyal khyad par can yid la byed pas dman pa'i sems dod ro/ /skyon med ni thog tha bar mar dag pa'o/ /rnyog pa ste sdig 444

par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /de yang nor bu rin po che ni gces spras mang pos mdzod btsan por za ma tog tu rgya du mas btab ste 'jog pa'i phyir phyi rol lam po cher phyags bdar gyi phung por lhung bar mi 'gyur la brgya la lhung srid kyang long bas rnyed mi srid pa ltar thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems rin po che de 'dra yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas mig ldan lta bus ma rnyed par bdag cag so skye long ba lta bus rnyed pa 'di ni shin tu ngo mtshar ba ste sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs kho na'i stabs legs kyis rnyed pas te por bstes pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ sdug bsngal sel bar nus pa/ sgrib pa sel bar nus pa/ phan bde sgrub par nus pas dga' ba skyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba yi/ /mi zad gter yang 'di yin no/ /'gro ba'i nad rab zhi byed pa'i/ /sman gyi mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /srid lam 'khyams shing dub pa yi/ /'gro ba ngal gso'i ljon shing yin/ /'gro ba thams cad ngan 'gro las/ /sgrol bar byed pa'i spyi stegs yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'chi ba sel ba/ dbul ba sel ba/ nad sel ba/ dub pa sel ba/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal sel ba ste lnga po rkang pa gnyis res bstan to/ /de yang 'chi ba med pa ni sangs rgyas yin la de 'thob par byed pa'i phyir dang sems can 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde bas dbul ba rnams la 'di las dgos 'dod kyi gter 'byung ba'i phyir dang nad kyi gtso bo ni dug gsum yin la rlung mkhris bad kun yang des bskyed par zad la de sel ba'i sman gcig pu yin pa'i phyir dang 'khor ba 445

mtha' med du 'khyams pas dub pa rnams ngal gso ba'i rten yin pa'i phyir dang 'gro ba ngan 'gro las sgrol ba'i thabs 'di las gzhan med pa'i phyir te rim par sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i/ /sems kyi zla ba shar ba yin/ /'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dag /dpyis 'byin nyi ma chen po yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang rkang pa gnyis gnyis kyis nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib sel ba'i phan yon bstan pa ste nyon mongs pa ni tshad pas gdungs pa ltar rgyud sreg pa ste de sel ba la bco lnga'i zla 'od lta bu'o/ /mi shes pas shes bya la bsgribs pa ni mun pa'am nang gi rab rib yin la de sel bas na nyi ma lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las/ /mar gyi nying khu phyung ba yin/ /'gro ba'i mgron po srid pa'i lam rgyu zhing / /bde ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa la/ /'di ni bde ba'i mchog tu nyer gnas te/ /sems can mgron chen tshim par byed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang rkang pa gnyis kyis phan pa sgrub pa dang tshigs bcad gcig gis bde ba sgrub nus par ston te/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las phyung ba mar gyi nying khu lta bu ni byang chub kyi sems 'di kho na ste gzhan gnyis pa med do/ /byang chub ma thob kyi bar du yang 'di phyi'i rang gzhan gyi bde ba'i rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems kho na ste/ byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yod med na/ /'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gang tshe 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed/ /de tshe sems can las byed brtson pa de bzhin du/ /mkhas pa'i shes phyir 'jig rten byang chub sems 446

byung na/ /ye shes kyis ni sems can yon tan chos dang ldan/ /dper na ma dros gnas pa'i klu bdag med gyur na/ /dzam+bu'i gling 'dir chu klung 'bab par ga la 'gyur/ /chu klung med na me tog 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho la yang rin chen gzugs mang med par 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'dir yang byang chub sems med bde gshegs kyi/ /ye shes 'jig rten 'di dag kun tu ga la 'byung / /ye shes med na yon tan 'phel med byang chub med/ /rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas chos kyang med par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad gyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la mgon du bos zin gyis/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs te/ bdag gis ni bod pa po sbyin bdag nges bzung du byas pa'o/ /de ring ni dus te byang chub kyi sems skyed ma thag pa de nas so/ /skyob pa thams cad kyi spyan sngar zhes dpang po nges bzung du byas pa ste 'di la khyed rnams dpang po'o zhes pa'i tha tshig go /'gro ba ni mgron nges bzung du byas pa lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa sems can thams cad do/ /bde gshegs nyid dang ni bar du bde ba la mgron du bos pa ni sbyin bya nges bzung du khas blangs pa ste mthar thug bde gshegs nyid dang gnas skabs su bde ba thams cad sbyin par dam bcas pa'o/ /de ltar na khyed rnams dga' ba dang bcas pas spro srings shig pa'o/ /de ltar na char pa babs pa na sā lu skyes so zhes zer ba ltar rgyu 'bras gzhan du mi 'khrul ba'i phyir byang chub kyi sems skyes pa na rang gzhan thams cad kyi phan bde grub bo zhes brjod par bya'o/ /447

byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las byang chub kyi sems yongs su bzung ba ste le'u gsum pa rnam par phye ba'o// //le'u bzhi pa/ bag yod pa bstan pa/le'u bzhi pa la le'u'i 'brel ni/ de ltar bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa byang chub tu sems bskyed nas sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa bag yod pas sgrub dgos par 'brel te dka' 'grel chung ngur/ de ltar sems bskyed pa brjod nas da ni bslab pa nyams su blang ba 'chad do zhes so/ /de yang ngo bo ni theg chen gyi bslab pa gsum mam pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'am bsdu na sems srung ba kho na yin la pha rol tu phyin pa thabs smon lam stobs ye shes te lhag ma bzhi po sher phyin du 'du la/ bslab pa gsum yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu 'du bas 'dir sbyin pa spyi 'gror btang zhing tshul khrims la shes bzhin gyi sgras smos la pha rol tu phyin pa lhag ma rnams go rim du bstan te bag yod pa ni thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas thog mar bstan pa'o/ /des na thob pa mi nyams par srung ba'i tshul la gnyis/ rtsa ba bag yod pa la rag las par bstan pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug po re re zhing nyams su blang ba'o/ /dang po la spyi'i don gyis pha rol tu phyin pa gtan la dbab pa dang / gzhung gi don gyis bag yod bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang / so so'i don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyan dang theg bsdus las bshad pa ltar/ sdom ni/ grangs dang mchan nyid go rim dang / /nges tshig goms bya'i yon tan dang / rab dbye 4—/8

bsdu dang mi mthun phyogs/ /yon tan phan tshun rnam nges bcu/ /zhar la spel dang dag pa'ang bshad/ /ces bya ste/ dang po grangs nges la brgyad/mngon mtho nges legs don gnyis dang / /gzhan don theg chen mtha' dag sdud/ /lam kun sdud dang bslab pa gsum/ /spang bya la bltos 'grub pa bzhi/ /de ltar grangs nges rnam pa brgyad/ /ces bya ste/ de yang mngon mtho lha mi'i bde ba'i rgyu dang nges legs byang chub kyi rgyu'i dbang du byas nas phar phyin la drug tu nges te longs spyod kyi don du sbyin pa lus kyi don du tshul khrims 'khor gyi don du bzod pa ste mngon mtho'i bde legs kyi rgyu gsum yon tan 'phel ba'i don du brtson 'grus zhi gnas kyang don du bsam gtan lhag mthong gi don du shes rab ste nges legs kyi rgyu gsu/ma dang drug tu nges pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pa dang / /'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa ra/ngon mtho dang / /rtag tu nyon mongs dbang nyid mi 'gro dang / /bya ba rnams la phyin ci ma log pa'o/ /zhes so/ /yang sbyin sogs gsum gyis gzhan don dang brtson sogs gsum gyis rang don sgrub pa'i phyir yang drug ste/ sems can don la rab brtson pa/ /gtong dang mi gnod bzod pas byed/ /gnas dang grol ba gzhir bcas pas/ /rang don rnam pa thams cad sbyong / /zhes so/ /yang gzhan don kho na'i dbang du byas nas kyang longs spyod kyis mi phongs par byed pa sbyin pa nas nges don legs par brjod nga/ shes rab kyi bar du bzhag ste/ mi phongs pa dang rnam par mi 'tshe dang / /rnam 'tshe bzod dang bya bas mi skyo dang / /dga' byed legs par brjod pa de yi phyir/ /gzhan 4 /9

gyi don ni rang gi don mchog yin/ /zhes so/ /yang theg chen thams cad drug po 'dir 'du bas kyang yin te lus longs spyod la mi lta ba sbyin tshul gnyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa tha ma gnyis de dag la mi skyo zhing gus pa bzod brtson yin pa'i phyir te/ longs spyod mngon par mi dga' dang / /rab gus gnyis la mi skyo dang / /rnal 'byor rnam par mi rtog pa/ /theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do/ /zhes so/ /yang lam mtha' dag drug po 'dir 'du bas kyang ste/ sbyin tshul gyis ma chags pa'i lam bzod pas sems can mi gtong ba'i lam brtson 'grus kyis 'phel ba'i lam bsam gtan gyis rnam g.yeng sdom pa'i lam shes rab sgrib pa sbyong ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir te/ yul rnams la ni ma chags lam/ /de thob rnam g.yeng sdom pa'i gzhan/ /sems can mi gtong 'phel ba dang / /sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba'i gzhan/ /zhes so/ /yang bslab pa thams cad gsum du 'du la de'i phyir yang sbyin sogs gsum tshul khrims kyi bslab pa bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa sher phyin shes rab kyi bslab pa brtson 'grus de thams cad kyi grogs su bzhag pa ste/ bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni/ /rgyal bas pha rol phyin pa drug /yang dag bshad de dang po gsum/ /tha ma gnyis kyis rnam pa gnyis/ /gcig ni gsum char la yang gtogs zhes so/ /de ltar drug ni rgyan las bshad la theg bsdus las ni 'khor ba las mi 'phags pa'i rgyu longs spyod dang khyim thab la chags pa'i gnyen por dang po gnyis 'phags kyang ldog pa'i rgyu log sgrub dang skyo ba'i gnyen por bar ma gnyis ma log kyang chud za ba'i rgyu rnam g.yeng dang gti 450

mug gi gnyen por phyi ma gnyis te spang bya la bltos nas grangs nges dang /yang sangs rgyas kyi chos 'grub pa bzhi'i dbang du byas nas kyang drug tu bzhag ste dang po bzhis sems mi g.yeng ba'i rgyu sgrub lnga pas mi g.yeng ba thob/ drug pas de kho na nyid shes/ de las stobs sogs kyi yon tan 'thob pa'o/ /mtshan nyid ni/ rten dngos ched du bya ba dang / /thabs mkhas bsngo ba rnam dag ste/ /dam pa drug ldan dge ba yin/ /yang na khyad par bzhi ldan dge /chags med bdun ldan dge ba 'ang / /yang na 'khor gsum rnam dag pa'i/ /shes rab kyis zin dge ba ste/ /pha rol phyin pa'i mtshan nyid 'dod/ /ces bya ste/ theg bsdus ltar na rten dam pa byang chub kyi sems dang dngos po dam pa gzhi thams cad la 'jug pa dang ched du bya ba dam pa sems can thams cad kyi phan bde'i ched dang thabs mkhas dam pa 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa dang bsngo ba dam pa byang chub chen por bsngo ba dang rnam dag dam pa sgrib gnyis dag par byed pa ste dam pa drug ldan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ni skabs 'dir bstan bya pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /kha cig dam pa drug dang ldan pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid du smra ba la ni khyab ches pa'i skyon yod de 'o na sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ pha rol tu phyin pa yin par thal/ dam pa drug ldan yin pa'i phyir te chos drug po re re nas tshang ba'i phyir/ 'dod na lam dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu gang rung yin par thal/pha rol tu phyin pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na de ma yin par thal te sa dang po ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang na mi mthun pa'i phyogs 'joms 451

pa dang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa dang sems na thams cad kyi 'dod pa rdzogs par byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa dang sems can rnams theg pa gsum la smin par byed pa ste khyad par bzhi ldan gyi dge ba 'dir bstan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid de/ mdo sde rgyan du/ sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum/ /zhes so/ /phar phyin re re la de ltar bshad pa'i shugs kyis pha rol tu phyin pa spyi'i mchan nyid kyang de ltar 'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /yang na chags med bdun ldan gyi sbyin sogs kyi dge ba ste/ rgyan nyid las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa ni/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /chags pa nyid kyang ma yin la/ /ma chags mi chags chags pa med/ /ces rang gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs ser sna tshul 'chal sogs la ma chags pa dang phyi shol med pas mi chags pa dang chog par mi 'dzin pas chags pa med pa dang sbyin pa lan la re ba'am tshul khrims srid par smon pa nas shes rab thabs dang bral ba sogs ma dag pa med pas chags pa nyid kyang ma yin pa dang rnam smin la mi re bas ma chags pa dang bag la nyal la mi chags pa dang rnam g.yeng la chags pa med pa dang bdun te re re zhing de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang na 'khor gsum/ rnam par dag pa'i shes rab khyad par can gyis zin pa'i sbyin sogs kyi dge ba'ang 'di skabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid du 'gyur te/ sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab yin/ /tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /zhes dang /452

shes rab med na mig med pa rol phyin lnga 'dis/ /dmigs bu med pas byang chub reg par nus ma yin/ /gang tshe shes rab kyis ni rab tu zin gyur pa/ /de tshe mig rnyed gyur cing 'di yi ming 'thob bo/ /zhes so/ /gang dngos po 'am mtshan mar zhen pa'i sbyin sogs ni sbyin sogs yin yang pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin te shes rab kyi mig dang bral ba'i phyir te/ shes rab med na sogs dang / gang tshe shes rab kyis ni rab tu zin gyur pa/ /de tshe mig rnyed gyur cing 'di yi ming 'thob po/ /zhes so/ /yang na ni dngos mtshan gyi sbyin sogs la 'jig rten pa'i phar phyin dang shes rab khyad par can gyis zin pa la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phar phyin du 'jog ste/ 'jug pa las/ sbyin pa sbyin bya len po gtong pos stong / /'jig rten 'das pa'i pha rol phyin ces bya/ /gsum po dag la chags skyes gyur pa na/ /'jig rten pa yi pha rol phyin ces brjod/ /ces so/ /'on kyang 'jig rten pa'i phar phyin ni par phyin gyi ming tsam du zad kyi phar phyin ma yin la/ byang sems tshogs sbyor pa'i sbyin sogs ni phar phyin gyi rgyu'am rjes su/ mthun pa yin la 'phags rgyud kyi dmigs med kyi byams brtse sogs ni byams pa sbyin pa bzhi par gsungs pas der sdud pa'am phal cher ni bsam gtan dang shes rab tu 'du ba yin la de'i phyir/ theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do/ /zhes theg chen mtha' dag dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas phar phyin drug tu bsdus pa yin la nyan rang la ni pha rol tu phyin pa med cing mthar thug pa ni sangs rgyas kho na la mnga' ba yin te bshad sbyar las/ bse ru lta bu rnams la ni/ /pha rol phyin drug ming yang 453

med/ /bcom ldan nyag gcig pha rol phyin/ /drug gi spyi la bzhugs pa lags/ /zhes so/ /'o na nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o zhes sogs gsungs pa ma yin nar/ zhe na/ de ni sher phyin gyi gdul bya yin yang gnas skabs nyan rang la mos pa dag kha drang ba'i ched dang nyan rang gi rnam par grol ba yang gang zag dang gzung ba'i bdag med rtogs pa la bltos shing de sher phyin gyi cha shas su 'gyur ba tsam la dgongs nas bstan pa ste lha'i bu nyis brgya byang chub ni yun ring pos sgrub dgos so zhes skyo nas phyir ldog pa gdul ba'i don du 'khor ba las myur du thar bar 'dod pas kyang byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /des na mtshon bya re la yang mtshan nyid mtha' yas pa 'jug pa yod de/ ji srid pha rol gyis mtshan gzhi'i steng du ming don gyi 'brel ba sgro 'dogs chod par ma nges kyi bar du mtshan nyid brjod dgos la de nges nas skabs don grub zin pa'i phyir mtshan nyid brjod dgos pa 'ang ma yin no/ /de'i phyir rigs gter las/ mtshan nyid gnyis kyis 'jog na ni/ /mtshon bya de yang gnyis su 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pa'ang mkhas pa la mi 'os te mtshan nyid ni don dang mtshon bya ni ming yin la don re la yang ming mtha' yas pa 'jug pa mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos sogs las gsal ba dang / ming re yang don mang pos gtan la 'bebs pa chos kyi dbyings kho na yang khyab pa dang mi dmigs pa dang stong pa nyid dang 'gyur ba med pa sogs mtha' yas pas 'chad pa'i phyir dang bden pa gnyis zhes bya ba 'di kho na la 454

grub mtha' smra ba bzhis mtshan nyid tha dad du 'jog pa'i phyir bden gnyis bzhir thal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ni 'phros pa'i don no/ /gsum pa go rim ni/ rgyu 'bras dman mchog rags phra ste/ /rgyu mtshan gsum las drug rim bzhin/ /zhes bya ste/ lus dang longs spyod la ma chags pa'i sbyin pa dang ldan na bcas rang gi kha na ma tho ba srog la bab kyang sdom nus pas tshul khrims dang ldan par 'gyur la de yod na bzod pa dang ldan zhing bzod ldan ni brtson 'grus brtsam par gdon mi za la de las ting nge 'dzin skye zhing de yis rgyud rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba rgyu 'bras kyi go rim dang / yang na snga ma snga ma dman la phyi ma phyi ma mchog yin pas dman mchog gi go rim dang / yang na snga ma snga ma rags shing sgrub par sla la phyi ma phyi ma phra zhing sgrub par dka' bas rags phra'i go rim yang yin te/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye/ /dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang / /rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir/ /de dag rim pas bstan pa yin/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa nges tshig ni/ srid zhi'i pha rol song phyir ro/ /zhes bya ste/ 'jig rten pa dang theg dman gyi dge ba zil gyis gnon pas de dag gi pha rol tu song ba'am phyin zin pa'i phyir pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ste mya ngan las 'das pa la 'khor ba'i pha rol tu son pa zhes btags pa bzhin no/ /bye brag tu/ dā na'i sgra las dbul ba 'dor bas sbyin pa/ shī la'i sgra las bsil ba 'thob pas tshul khrims/ k+ṣarnyi'i sgra las khro ba bzod pa'i phyir bzod pa/ bīr+ya'i sgra las mchog la sbyor ba'i phyir brtson 'grus/ bh+ya nā'i sgra las yid 'dzin pa'i phyir bsam gtan/455

pradzñā'i sgra las don dam shes pa'i phyir shes rab ste/ dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang / /bsil ba 'thob dang khro bzod dang / /mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang / /don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa gom/sa tshul ni/ dngos po yid byed bsam pa dang / /thabs dang dbang 'byor lngas goms byed/ /rgyu dang rnam smin smon lam dang / /sor rtog dngos po la bsten bzhi/ /mos pa ro myang yi rang dang / /dga' ba yid byed la bsten bzhi/ /mi ngoms yangs dang dga' dang phan/ /ma gos dge ba'i bsam pa ste/ /bsam pa la bsten rnam pa drug /thabs la bsten pa gcig pu nyid/ /sku dang spyod pa ston pa ste/ /dbang 'byor la bsten rnam pa gsum/ /de ltar rnam pa bco brgyad do/ /zhes bya ste/ rgyu rigs sad pa rnam smin lus phun sum tshogs pa sngon gyi smon lam dag pas so sor brtag pa'i stobs dang ldan pa ste dngos po la bsten pa bzhi'o/ /gsung rab zab mo la dad pa mos pa dang phar phyin drug la yid ches pas sgom/ pa ro myang dang gzhan gyi phyin drug thams cad la yi rang ba dang rang ga'an la ma 'ongs pa'i tshe 'byung ba'i phyin drug la mngon par dga' ba ste yid byed la bsten pa bzhi'o/ /bskal pa gaṅgā'i bye snyed du lus de snyed kyis zhing khams de snyed rin po che sna bdun gyis bkang ba byin pa dang dus de srid du lus de snyed kyis stong gsum mes gang bar byang chub kyi ched du spyod lam bzhi spyod pa sogs phar phyin re re'i spyod pa chad med pas kyang mi ngoms pa dang de lta bu'i bsam sbyor rgyun chad med pas bsam pa yangs pa dang phan thogs pa'i dga' bas phan btags pa'i rlom sems zil 456

gyis non pa dga' ba dang / phan gdags yul gyi 'gro ba 'di rnams bdag gi byang chub kyi grogs byed pas 'di rnams kyis bdag la phan btags pa yin gyi bdag gis 'di rnams la phan btags pa ni de'i char yang mi bzod do zhes rtog pa phan pa'i bsam pa dang / lan dang rnam smin la mi re ba ma gos pa'i bsam pa dang / bsod nams de yang sems can la yongs su bsngo ba dge ba'i bsam pa ste bsam pa la bsten pa drug go /'khor gsum dag pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa ni thabs mkhas pa la bstan pa gcig go /ngo bo nyid dang longs spyod rdzogs sku thob pa sku dang / sprul sku gang 'dul du ston pa spyod pa dang / phyin drug thogs med du ston par nus pa ston pa la dbang 'byor ba ste dbang 'byor ba rnam pa gsum mo/ /de ltar yang / thams cad sgom pa dngos po dang / /de bzhin yid la byed pa dang / /bsam pa dang ni thabs dag dang / /dbang 'byor nyid la bsten par brjod/ /ces gsungs shing dbyig gi zhabs kyis 'grel par bco brgyad du bkral to/ /drug pa rab dbye ni/ rgyas par nyis stong chig brgya ste/ /dug gsum cha mnyam bcas phye bas/ /phar phyin brgyad stong bzhi brgya ste/ /bcus bsgyur brgyad khri bzhi stong nyid/ /gzungs spobs ting chos sgo de snyed/ /bsdu na phyin drug re re yang / /rnam pa drug gam gsum du dbye/ /yang na phar phyin re re yang / /ngo bo rgyu 'bras las ldan 'jug /rnam pa drug rer dbye ba'o/ /zhes bya ste/ bskal bzang gi mdor bshad pa sems ma bskyed pa'i sbyin sogs ni yongs su sbyong ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / bskyed pa'i ni snang bar byed pa'i phar phyin drug dang / sems can 457

la dmigs pa 'jig rten pa'i phyin drug dang / byang chub kyi ched min par gzhan bde ba la 'god phyir byed pa sems can la dmigs pa'i phyin drug dang / mi skye ba'i bzod pa la gnas pas byed pa gnas kyi phyin drug sogs nas/ len pa med par 'das pa sogs mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyin drug dang / gdung 'thor ba sogs cho 'phrul gyi phyin drug dang / bstan pa la rnyed pas mchod pa sogs bstan dbye'i phyin drug dang / ring bsrel la mchod pa sogs ring bsrel gyi phyin drug gi bar sum brgya lnga bcu la phar phyin drug gis bsgyur bas nyis stong chig brgya ste 'dod chags kyi rtog pa de snyed kyi gnyen po'o/ /de bzhin du zhi sdang dang gti mug dang dug gsum cha mnyam gyi rtog pa de snyed re'i gnyen po de snyed de pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong bzhi brgyar 'gyur la de dag gi rnam pa rer yang bcur 'jug pa'i phyir brgyad khri bzhi stong dang de snyed kyi chos kyi sgo dang gzungs dang ting 'dzin gyi sgo yang de snyed du 'gyur ro/ /phar phyin de rnams kyi sdom ni/yongs sbyong snang byed 'jig rten dang / /sems can la dmigs yi dam brtan pas gnas 'khor bar bde ba'i ched du bsngos pa 'khor ba/ /'dod yon gyis bsdu ba kun nyon bsdu ba bzhi lta bu phan 'dogs dmigs pa can gnas mi skye ba'i bzod bcas byang chub/1 /thabs mkhas pa ye shes gzhan don du bdag gi lus longs spyod sgrub par bsngo ba bdag la phan 'dogs 'bras bu gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis gnyis 'thob pa 'thob/ /dmigs bcas re ba dang ni 'dus byas la gnas shing 'dus ma byas 'thob pa sogs gsum rnam gsum lta/ /gzhan phan las byed 'phags lam dang ldan pa lam sbyangs brtson mi 'dor/ 2 /458

dman par bsngos pa rigs pa rang sgrub gzhan dgod bya ba 'dod pas 'dul ba bya ba min/ /nga rgyal bcas rlom pa bya dka' ba brtsams pa snying rjes zin pa'i thun mong ba dge ba 'khor gsum dag pa rno/ /mi dmigs pa zab pa rgyu 'bras sna tshogs pa sna tshogs yid kyi bkod pa'o/ 3 /sgrib med kyi sems kyis thug med sbyin pas yi dwags sbyong ba sogs sems can dmigs dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan sgrub pa chos/ /sgrib pa lnga spong ba sogs zhi 'khor gsum du mi blta ba lhag sems can thams cad kyi phyir bsngos pa thams cad dmigs bcas phyogs gcig dang / /yul mchog dman la sems mnyam pa nyams med mi dmigs shing rgyun brtan pa bcas min rang don du mi bsngo ba dbul po min/ 4 /phyir mi ldog shes rab kyis ma zin zhing 'bad pa brtan pa rnam sgrub rnam smin la mi re ba dag pa/ /bsgyur mi nus pa brtan pa srid zhir mi smon pa bstun pa 'jig rten pa dang ma 'dres pa ngoms byang chub tu mi bsngo ba'i so skye'i 'jig rten/ /srid zhi dang ma 'dres pa 'jig 'das dag sa pa'i bla med yongs sbyong gi g.yeng ba med/ 5 /mi 'khor ba mi dmigs rnam smin sems can dang thun mong du bsngo ba 'khor ba zhing dag pa'i rgyu thun mong dang / /gzungs spobs kyi rgyu thun mong min phyi ma la 'jug cing snga ma'i rnam 'bras thob pa rnam bgod ne rañdza na'i dka' spyad dang / /gaṅgā'i 'gram du rgyu skar nyis stong lnga brgya'i sprul par zhugs te mi dmigs par gnas pa dang / 'gog snyoms sogs smin med/ rlom pa med pa ngo bo ma 'ongs pa dang 'das pa'i dngos med sems can thams cad la bsngos pas rgya che phyir mi ldog pa rgyas/ 6 /shes rab dang mtshungs ldan mtha' yas rab byung gi tshol 'bras bu gzhan la stob pa brgal srid par bde 'gro'i rgyur sgrub cing nga mi rgyal ba mngon 459

par dga'/ /srid zhi la mi dga' ba dga' med chos sbyin sogs thos 'dzin mi skye ba'i bzod par bsngos pa sogs ring du 'khor/ /tshul bzhin chad med byang chub kyi phyir 'dod dang bsam gtan gyi phyir bsngos/ 7 /mngon shes su smin pa bzo gnas shes par smin pa byams pas kun nas blang ba nas brtse dga'/ /btang snyoms kyis kun nas blang ba'i bar log lta can 'dul phyir du de dang mthun par spyod pa yang dag lta/ /sangs rgyas ma byung yang phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs dang bral ba gnas pa thabs shes kyis zin pa mi gnas srid zhi las 'das/ pa gnas med bsngos/ 8 /nga rgyal spangs pa nga rgyal mi ldog pa bzod pa bstan pa gnas phyir bsngos pa phan 'dogs dang / /dmigs bcas su bsngos pa chos nub pa'i rgyu mi 'dogs/ dmigs pa can lhag bcas 'khor bar bsngo ba lhag med zhing mchog la re ba med par byin pas bskal par lus kyi mthu brtas pa sogs rigabasta na pa gnas pa'i phyir bsta na pa la gzhan gzung ba sogs rig pa'i khyad par sa ngas rgyas 'byung tshe lus 'khor phun tshogs su skye ba sgrub pa sangs rgyas 'byung gzhan gyi bsam pa rdzogs par byed pa dran ldan/ 9 /mnyam nyid can rgyal 'byung srid pa las byung ba'i nges 'byung sgrub gdams ngag can mang thos/ /rab byung rtag tu 'thob byed bsam pa bzhin chos byin pa sogs rab byung gus pas gtong ba so gas mngon shes gnas mchod rten dang por zhal sro ba'i sbyin pa dang dbang po dang ldan pa'i tshul khrims sogs mngon shes de rtas tu ldan par byed pa de rtag mi mdza' ba la gtong ba sogs lus 'dod 'jig rten pa'i phar phyin gnas sems can smin phyir rgya mtshor rus sbal sogs ldan 'jig rten la phan phyir tshangs pas chang 'thung zlog pa sogs rnam par smin/ 10 /rnam smin phyung zin pa smin med 460

zhi bar nye ba dga' med sdug bsngal las skyob pa dus dang mar me byin pa sogs 'od/ /zhing brgya 'od kyis 'gengs pa sogs 'od chen gzhan bde bar byas pa 'bras bde phyir mi ldog sems can thams cad la byin pa sogs dga' ba srid zhir mi zhen pa rnam dag 'jig rten 'das par dmigs pa/ 11 /skyes pa tsam gyis stong gsum phyin drug la 'god pa sogs skye ba 'khor sbyin pa sogs rigs gtan khrims la lo zlar 'god pa sogs 'khor bzang phra ma spangs pa sogs 'khor mi phyed/ /mgon med la byin pa sogs rnam smin dag pa rnam smin myur du mig byin pa sogs phyogs rnam lta bsngos pas gzhan la phan pa yongs shes/ /byang chub tu bsngos pa bag yod ma thogs par byin pa sogs rdzi ba med snying rjes ngan 'gro spang phyir myang 'das/ 12 /brtse ba dang mtshungs ldan dbang che len du 'dzud pa sogs bskul kha ton pa la byin pa sogs brjed med mtshan dpe/ /khyim nas mngon byung 'byung ba'i dus dang kun gnyid tshe 'byung ba sogs dus shes dang / /bsod snyoms la gshegs pa sogs rnam dbye slong mo mdzad ring 'phur bsten pa sogs srid mthun bdud btul ba sogs rtog pa'o/ 13 /ser skyar lor bsten pa sogs spong dang rdor ting sogs rdo rje 'tshang rgya tshe lhas bstod pa so gas snang dus min du me tog skyes pa sogs zil gnon/ /'tshang rgya tshe su'ang mi bkres pa sogs bdud 'joms shing drung du mi skyo ba sogs g.yo med skad cig gis 'tshang rgya ba skad cig ldan 'gro ba gzigs pa sogs mnyam par ma/ bzhag sangs rgyas pa bzhag btang snyoms mdzad nas bskul 'dzud pa sogs yongs smin/ 14 /kun mkhyen lam myur bas byung ba sogs lhag med myang 'das dang sku gdung sogs lhag ra/ bcas/ 165 /mi mthun phyogs dang len zhing kun dbyangs kyis 'gongs 461

pa rtogs thabs kyis 'dul ba rgya che yul gyis yid byung / /rang la mi lta ba gzhan dag gzhan 'dul ba dang yang spong bzhi/ 16 /rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi bsam gtan bzhi/ 17 /dran nye bzhi dang bden pa bzhi/ 18 /dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga dang / 19 /byang chub yan lag 'phags lam bcas/ /slob pa'i zhi ma thos pa'i chos shes pa sogs lhag rig pa la sbyor ba myur du zhugs pa sogs rnam pa grol/ 20 /dge slong sogs ris brgyad kyi 'khor sgrub so sor rig pa bzhi/ /chos ston pas mi skyo sbyin tshul bzod brtson dang / 21 /bsam gtan shes rab las byung ba ste go cha'i sgrub pa dang / /mig mthong na dga' ba 'thob pa sogs mig dang rna ba sna lce lus/ /sems nyon mongs pa chung ba sogs dang gzhan smin par bya ba dang bdag phan gyi phyir bsngos pa'i zang zing / 22 /chos brgyan par don longs spyod sbyong ba rtogs pa sbyin sogs gyi sbra ba dang / /stong nyid mtshan med smon pa med/ /byang chub kyi snying por skyil krung gcig gis 'da' ba sogs gzhan dang ga gon gyis zas phul ba sogs rnam smin lnga sde btul ba sogs sbyor ba dang / 23 /stobs bcu'i pha rol phyin pa bcu/ /mi 'jigs bzhi dang thugs rje dang / 24 /mi slob pa'i spyan lnga'i pha rol phyin pa lnga/ 25 /sangs rgyas nyid rang byung sangs rgyas kyi rnam rol de'i gting dpag dka'/ 26 /ma 'dres pa yi chos bco brgyad/ /thabs mkhas dang ye shes mi thogs pa ji bzhin mi dmigs pa rang bzhin mthong / /de'i las shes pa sogs khams gsum spyod dang dman sa brgyad de re re la re ba med pa sogs/ 28 /g.yo med pa'i byang sems thogs med du zad pa shes pa dang srid pa'i rtsa ba chad pa sogs mi skye shes/ 29 /bstan pa gnas pa sogs byin rlabs 462

mngon par shes pa drug /sangs rgyas kyi spyod lam zang zing len pa sogs phan 'dod nyon mongs med/ /sku tshe'i 'du byed spangs pa dang len pa med par 'das pa sogs myang 'das gdung 'gyes pa sogs cho 'phrul dang / 30 /bstan pa la mchod pa sogs bstan dbye ring bsrel rnam par dbye ba mchod pa sogs/ /re re'i pha rol phyin drug re'o/ /'di la mdo nyid las pha rol tu phyin pa brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig ces dang / de las pha rol tu phyin pa nyis stong chig brgya ni 'dod chags spyod pa rnams la chos bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin du zhe sdang gti mug dug gsum cha mnyam pa ste de dag gi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong bzhi brgya'o/ /de dag gi rnam pa la 'jug pa yang stong stong ste rnam pa brgya brgya pa re re'i yang stong stong po des na de dag gi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad khri bzhi stong ste ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyang de snyed do zhes gsungs pas rtsa ba'i phar phyin sum brgya lnga bcu dang de drug gis bsgyur bas nyis stong chig brgya ste brgya phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig go /de bzhis ni brgyad stong bzhi brgya'o/ /rnam pa brgya brgya po re re'i stong stong po zhes pa ni yi ge nyams pa zhig ste brgyas bsgyur na brgyad 'bum sogs su longs pas mang ches pa'i phyir/ des na de dag gi rnam pa la 'jug pa yang bcu bcu ste re re'i bcu bcu po des na brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo zhes par snang ste brgyad stong bzhi brgya bcus bsgyur bas brgyad khri bzhi stong du nges pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ba'i phar phyin sum brgya lnga bcu tshang dgos kyang deng sang mdo rnams las sum brgya dang bzhi tsam las mi snang ba ni bka'i bsdu ba nyams pa dang yi ge pa'i skyon brgyud mar zad pas dag pa las rnyed na 'dir bsnan par 463

bya'o/ /yang na sbyin sogs re re la nang tshan gyi sbyin sogs drug rer dbye ste gzhan sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi bar la 'god pa sbyin pa'i sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi sbyin pa'i bar ro/ /de bzhin du so so'i mi mthun phyogs kyis ma gos pa so so'i tshul khrims sbyin pa'i dka' ba nas shes rab kyi dka' ba'i bar bzod pa so so'i bzod pa de la brtson pa brtson 'grus des sems zin te gzhan du mi g.yeng ba bsam gtan 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa shes rab ste drug drug sum cu rtsa drug tu 'gyur te/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs/ /rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa yis/ /go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin de/ /drug tshan drug gis ji bzhin bshad/ /ces so/ /yang na re re la gsum gsum du dbye ste/ zang zing ster ba dang srog skyob pa sogs mi 'jigs pa dang chos ston pa ste sbyin byas phye ba sbyin pa rnam pa gsum mo/ /nyes spyod sdom pa dang dge ba chos sdud dang sems can don byed de tshul khrims rnam pa gsum mo/ /gzhan gyi gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa dang chos phyir sdug bsngal dang len dang stong nyid sogs chos zab mo la mi skrag pa ste bzod pa gsum mo/ /dge ba 'di bya'o zhes 'phen pa sngon du gtong ba go cha dang de bzhin lag tu len pa sbyor ba dang des chog par mi 'dzin pa ste brtson 'grus gsum mo/ /tshe 'di'i mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa dang mngon shes la sogs pa yon tan khyad par can sgrub pa dang mu ge dang nad sogs zhi bar nus pa sems can don sgrub kyi bsam gtan te gsum mam/ yang na lang gshegs las shes rab kyis ma zin pa byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan shes rab kyis zin pa don rab 'byed pa'i 464

bsam gtan chos nyid la 'jug pa de bzhin nyid dmigs kyi bsam gtan te bsam gtan rnam pa gsum mo/ /shes rab la rnam par mi rtog pa'i sbyor ba la 'jug pa dngos gzhi la gnas pa rjes thob shes rab kyis 'jal ba ste gsum du theg bsdus las so/ /yang na 'jig rten pa dang nyan rang dang theg chen pa'i shes rab gsum ste rgyan gyi 'grel par ro/ /yang na kun rdzob dang don dam dang gzhan don la dmigs pa ste gsum mam thos bsam sgom gsum las byung ba'i shes rab gsum mam 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dman pa'i dang 'jig rten las 'das pa chen po'i shes rab ste gsum du yang bshad do/ /yang na phar phyin re re yang dgongs don rnam pa drug ldan du dbye ste/ len pa po 'dod pa'i don gtong ba ngo bo'i don dang ma chags pa'i sems pa dang ldan pa rgyu'i don lus longs spyod phun tshogs 'grub pa 'bras bu'i don dang rang gzhan rjes su 'dzin zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa las kyi don dang ser sna med pa sogs ldan pa'i don dang chos dang zang zing dang mi 'jigs pa dang ldan par byed pa 'jug pa'i don dang drug ldan te/ don rnams gtong bar byed pa dang / /rtsa ba sems pa la brten dang / /lus dang longs spyod phun tshogs dang / /gnyis rjes 'dzin dang rdzogs byed dang / /de yang ser sna med ldan dang / /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs mthong / /sbyin pa de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces so/ /tshul khrims dang ldan pa sdom pas bsdams pa cho ga dang spyod yul phun sum tshogs pa nyes pa chung ngu la yang 'jigs par blta ba bslab gzhi gang 465

blangs pa la rdzogs par slob pa ste yan lag drug tshang ba ngo bo'i don dang zhi ba thob 'dod rgyu'i don dang phyi ma bde 'gro dang 'phral du ting nge 'dzin thob pa 'bras bu'i don dang / yon tan gyi rten dang nyon mongs zhi ba dang gzhan 'jigs pa mi skye ba ste las kyi don dang rtag par bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ldan pa ldan pa'i don dang brdar btags pa las thob pa so thar dang ting 'dzin las skyes pa bsam gtan gyi sdom pa dang chos nyid kyis thob pa zag med kyi sdom pa ste dbye ba'i 'jug pa dang de dag gang zag la ldan pa rten gyi 'jug pa ste 'jug pa'i don dang drug ldan ni tshul khrims kyi ste/ yan lag drug zhi bsam pas zin/ /bde 'gro gnas pa sbyin byed dang / /rten dang zhi dang 'jigs pa med/ /bsod nams tshogs dang yang dag ldan/ /brdar btags chos nyid thob pa ste/ /sdom pa gnas pa rnams la yod/ /tshul khrims de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces so/ /khro ba'i skabs mi 'byed sdug bsngal la cir yang mi snyam chos zab mo shes pa ste ngo bo'i don dang snying rje dang tshul khrims dang thos par ldan pas sgom pa rgyu'i don dang /'khon mi mang dang dbyen mi mang / /bde dang yid bde mang ba dang / /'gyod pa med par 'chi ba dang / /phyi ma bde 'gror 'gro ba'o/ /zhes pa'i yon tan lnga 'thob pa 'bras bu'i don dang / mdo las/ gang zhig pha rol 'khrugs shes nas/ /bdag nyid de la nyer zhi ba/ /des ni bdag dang pha rol po/ /gnyis ka dag gi don byed do/ /zhes pa ltar gnyis ma'i don byed pa las kyi don dang / bzod pa ni dka' thub rnams kyi mchog go zhes pa 466

ltar yon tan dang ldan pa'i don dang / skyes thob dang ting 'dzin dang chos nyid kyis thob pa ste dbye ba dang rten ni 'jug pa ste drug ldan ni bzod pa'i ste/ mi 'byed ji mi snyam shes dang / /snying rjes chos la bsten pa'i phyir/ /phan yon lngar ni yang dag bshad/ /de ni gnyis kyi don byed de/ /dka' thub gtso dang yang dag ldan/ /de la de ni rnam gsum 'dod/ /bzod pa de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces so/ /brtson 'grus kyi ni dge ba la spro bas 'jug pa ngo bo'i don dad 'dun drag po la brten nas 'byung ba rgyu'i don dran zhing shes rab gong du 'phel ba 'bras bu'i don nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gyur ba las kyi don dug gsum med pa'i dge ba dang ldan pa ldan pa'i don bslab gsum la brtson pa dang lus sems kyi brtson 'grus gnyis dang rtag par dang gus pa'i brtson 'grus gnyis dang rten ni 'jug pa ste don drug ldan te/ dge la yang dag spro ba dang / /dad dang 'dun la bsten pa dang / /dran sogs yon tan 'phel byed dang / /kun nas nyon mongs gnyen po dang / /ma chags la sogs yon tan ldan/ /de dag la ni de rnams 'dun/ /brtson 'grus de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces so/ /bsam gtan ni ngo bo rtse gcig pa/ rgyu dran brtson/ 'bras bu bde ba/ mngon shes drug sogs la dbang bsgyur ba byed las/ chos thams cad kyi gtso bo ni ting nge 'dzin no zhes sogs yon tan dang ldan pa/ dga' bde gnyis sim bde gnyis 'du byed btang snyoms rten dang bcas pa 'jug pa'i don dang drug ldan te/ sems ni nang du 467

gnas pa dang / /dran dang brtson 'grus la bsten dang / /bde ba skyed par byed pa dang / /mngon shes gnas la dbang bsgyur dang / /chos rnams kun gyi gtso bo ste/ /de dag la yod de rnam gsum/ /bsam gtan de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces so/ /shes rab kyang chos drug ldan te/ ngo bo chos rab tu rnam 'byed rgyu zhi gnas 'bras bu rnam grol 'tsho ba dag zhing legs bshad 'byung ba byed las shes rab ni chos thams cad kyi mchog go zhes sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dman mchog rten dang bcas pa 'jug pa dang drug ldan te/ shes bya yang dag rab rnam 'byed/ /ting nge 'dzin la bsten pa dang / /kun nas nyon mongs shin tu grol/ /shes rab 'tsho ba legs bshad dang / /chos rnams kun gyi mchog yin te/ /de dag la yod de rnam gsum/ /shes rab de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces so/ /bdun pa bsdu ba ni/ mnyam bzhag ma gzhag gnyis ka dang / /mtshan nyid rgyu dang 'bras bu'i phyir/ /dge kun phar phyin drug tu 'dus/ /de ni tshogs gnyis mtshan nyid do/ /zhes bya ste/dkar chos thams cad mnyam bzhag gis zin ma zin gnyis su 'du la mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i cha thams cad sbyin tshul du 'du zhing bzhag pa rnams bsam shes gnyis dang gnyi ga'i cha rnams bzod brtson ci rigs par 'du bas dge ba thams cad 'dir 'dus pa ste/ dkar po'i chos kun rnam g.yeng dang / /mnyam bzhag gnyi gar shes par bya/ /pha rol phyin pa gnyis dang gnyis/ /gnyis kyis yongs su bsdus pa yin/ /zhes so/ /468

theg bsdus su ni sbyin sogs drug rang rang gi mtshan nyid kyis bsdus/dad sogs rnams cha mthun nam rgyus bsdus/ stobs sogs rnams 'bras bus bsdus pa'i phyir dge ba thams cad phyin drug gis bsdus par bshad do/ /de ltar dge ba thams cad phar phyin drug tu 'dus la drug po nyid las sbyin tshul bsod nams kyi tshogs shes rab ye shes kyi tshogs gzhan gsum gnyis kur gtogs pas tshogs gnyis su 'dus pa ste/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi/ /gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ma'i ste/ /zhes so/ /brgyad pa mi mthun phyogs ni/ mi mthun phyogs ni mdor bsdu na/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis/ /phye na ser sna la sogs drug /ces bya ste/ ser sna dang 'chal tshul dang khong khro dang le lo dang g.yeng ba dang 'chal pa'i shes rab rnams nyon sgrib yin la 'khor gsum du rnam par rtog pa shes sgrib ste/ rgyud blar/ ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang / /de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod/ /'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang / /de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ces so/ /dgu pa yon tan ni/ rgya che ba dang zang zing med/ /don che ba dang mi zad pa/ /sbyin sogs re re'ang yon tan bzhi/ /thun mong rgya chen gzhan don nus/ /khyad par sbyin pas longs spyod ldan/ /tshul khrims kyis ni bde 'gro 'thob/ /bzod pa44gzugs bzang 'khor phun tshogs/ /brtson pas gzi che don myur 'grub/ /bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod les grol/ /rig dang mngon shes ting 'dzin 'grupa/ /shes rab kyis ni chos kun shes/ /srid zhi las ni yang dag 'da'/ /pha rol phyin dang mi ldan pa'i/ /nyes dmigs de 469
