mkha' mi rnyed cing mi thar bar gsungs pa ltar chos thams cad chos dbyings las gzhan ma yin pa yang de lta bu'o/ /de'i phyir sangs rgyas thob pa ni ci yang ma thob pa zhes kyang bya la go 'phang gi dam pa thob pa zhes kyang bya/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa zhes kyang bya la sangs rgyas ni ming tsam ste chos gang yang sangs ma rgyas mi rgya rgya bar mi 'gyur ba zhes kyang bya/ chos thams cad las mngon par 'das pa zhes kyang bya zhing chos gang las kyang cung zad kyang ma g.yos pa zhes kyang bya/ cir yang ma grub pa'i stong pa zhes kyang bya la rtag pa brtan pa ther zug pa g.yung drung gi sku zhes kyang bya/ chos gang yang cir yang nam du yang ma gzigs pa zhes kyang bya la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen zhing gzigs pa zhes kyang bya ste/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/ skye ba ma mchis pa dang 'gag pa ma mchis pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshig bla dwags te zhes dang / de bzhi na gshegs pa rtag tu skye med chos/ /chos rnams kun yang bde bar gshegs dang 'dra/ /byis pa'i blo can mtshan mar 'dzin pa rnams/ /'jig rten dag na med pa'i chos la spyod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zag med dge ba yi/ /chos kyi gzugs brnyan yin te 'di la ni/ /de bzhin nyid med de bzhin gshegs pa'ang med/ /'jig rten kun tu gzugs brnyan kun tu snang / /zhes dang / 'jam dpal de ltar na nam mkha' ji lta bar byang chub kyang de bzhin no/ /byang chub ji lta bar chos rnams dang sems can rnams dang zhing rnams dang mya ngan las 'das pa'ang de bzhin no de'i phyir chos thams cad ni mya ngan las 'das 998

pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya ste gnyen po med pa yin la gnyen po med pa'i phyir gzod ma na dag pa dang dri ma med pa dang gzod ma nas nyon mongs pa med pa yin no zhes dang / rgyan stug po bkod par/ sangs rgyas dngos por yod pa min/ /sangs rgyas med pa'ang ma yin te/ /rnal 'byor can rnams sangs rgyas mthong / /zhes dang / yod dang med kyi phyogs dang bral/ /sangs rgyas phyogs ni dri ma med/ /blo dang shes bya bral ba ste/ /tshad dang dbang po spangs pa yin/ /sems shes rnams kyi yul ma yin/ /de ni grol ba rnams kyi yul/ /zhes dang / lang gshegs las/ ma skyes stong pa mchog yin te/ /skyes pa'i stong pa 'jig par 'gyur/ /stong pa de bzhin nyid dang mtha'/ /mya ngan 'das dang chos kyi dbyings/ /yid kyi lus ni sna tshogs pa/ /rnam grangs dag gis ngas bshad do/ /zhes dang / ting rgyal las/ sangs rgyas su ni dag pa ste/ /bsod nams brgya skyes 'od kyang gsal/ /de ni bar snang mtshungs pa ste/ /de la tha dad bya ba med/ /ces dang / ji ltar nam mkha' de bzhin du/ /nga yi sku yang brjod med cing / /shes par dka' bar rab tu bstan/ /dpa' bo chen po chos kyi sku/ /sku ni chos las skyes pa ste/ /gzugs kyi skur ni nam du yang / /rgyal ba gdags par yong mi nus/ /zhes dang / chos 'di lus gzugs med pa ste/ /'di la lus gzugs gang yang med/ /chos gang lus gzugs med pa ni/ /de ni sangs rgyas sku lus so/ /zhes dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdor/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yang dag pa 'di ni mig thams cad kyi lam las yang dag par 'das pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs 999

pa ste de ni lus med pa ma byas pa ma skyes pa ma 'gags pa sogs nas mtshan nyid med par mtshan nyid med pa ma yin pa mya ngan las 'da' pa med pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa gnas pa med pa gnas pa med pa ma yin pa ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ni mtshan ma dang mtshan ma med pa thams cad dang bral ba'o zhes dang / lus de lus ma yin zhing lus las yongs su grol/ /sus kyang ma byas ma bshig rnyed par gyur pa'ang med/ /chos rnams gang yang kun tu ldan med mi ldan med/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sku de de ltar gdags/ /zhes dang / gzugs med sems med gnyis ma yin zhing gcig kyang min/ /dngos med dngos med ma yin ma byung med pa ste/ /yang dag nyid du rgyal ba'i sku de de 'dra'o/ /snying po de med nyam chung ma yin bcad pa'ang med/ /ma bcad ma byung kun tu ma byung zhig pa'ang med/ /thob pa med cing rdul tsam dag kyang bshig med de/ /rdul med rnams kyi sku de de 'drar shes par bya/ /zhes sogs dang / zhi med rab zhi ma yin zhi bral sbyor ba'ang med/ /chags med rig med 'di na chad pa stong pa bzhin/ /yang na ngo bo nyid kyis nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /de ltar mthong na nyin mtshan sangs rgyas mchod pa yin/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba la ni gzugs dang mtshan mar ma lta zhig /byis pa lta bus bde bar gshegs la sems ma lta/ /gang gis rab 'byor lta bur nga ni mthong gyur ba/ /des ni stong gsum kun gyi sbyin pa thams cad sbyangs/ /zhes dang / tog las/bcom ldan 'das brjod du med pa de mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar nus lags sam/ bka' bstsal ba gang brjod du med par shes pa de 1000

nyid mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'i de'i phyir rigs kyi bu khyod nyid la dri yis ji ltar bzod pa bzhin du lan thob cig gang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ming 'thob par 'gyur ba'i rdzas kyi mtshan nyid dngos po gang yang yod dam gsol ba gal te mchis zhes bgyis na ni rtag par 'gyur ma mchis zhes bgyis na ni chad par 'gyur dbu ma'i lam ni dmigs su ma mchis te de ni mchis pa yang ma lags ma mchis pa yang ma lags so zhes dang / myang 'das chen po las/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug kyang stong gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar du yang stong de bzhin gshegs pa yang stong yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa yang stong ste zhes dang / nam mkha' mdzod/ snying rje chen po nges bstan/ blo gros rgya mtsho'i mdo rnams kyi gleng gzhir/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa zhes dang / blo gros rgya mtsho'i mdor/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi chos gang yang med dam blo gros rgya mtshos smras pa/ tshangs pa chos gang yongs su ma grub pa de la yod pa'am med par khas blang du med do chos gang yod pa'am med par khas blang du med pa de la mngon sum du 'gyur ba gang yang med do/ /smras pa/ 'o na de ji ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos zhes bstan/ smras pa tshangs pa 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha' la nam mkha' zhes bstan yang na nam mkha' la yang dag par yongs su grub pa med do de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhes bstan yang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la ni yang dag par yongs su grub pa gang yang med do zhes dang / ma dros pa'i mdor/ de la yod dang 1001

med pa mnyam/ /de bzhin nyid la de bzhin shes/ /chos rnams kun ni de bzhin nyid/ /ngas ni de ltar sangs rgyas te/ /zhes dang / tshangs pa khyad par sems kyi mdor/ phung po dag dang khams rnams dang / /skye mched dag la byang chub tshol/ /byang chub de yi rang bzhin te/ /de las gud na byang chub med/ /ces dang / dri med grags pa'i mdor/ byang chub la ni su yang mi gnas mi ldog gis byams pa lha'i bu 'di dag byang chub la kun tu rtog par lta ba de 'dor du chug cig byang chub ni lus kyis mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba ma yin sems kyis kyang ma yin te mtshan ma thams cad zhi ba'o zhes dang / byang chub ni ming tsam ste ming de yang g.yo ba med pa'o zhes dang / byang chub ni lta bar gyur pa thams cad chad pa'o zhes dang / gang gi tshe bdag de bzhin gshegs pa lta 'dod pa de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mi mthong bas lta lags so zhes dang / chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa'i mdor/ sangs rgyas chos ni nam mkha' mtshungs pa ste/ /blang dang dor ba'i sgra ni de la med/ /rgyal ba nam yang byang chub sangs ma rgyas/ /des ni nam yang sems can bkrol ba med/ /ci yang ma yin chos 'di sus shes pa/ /nam yang de ni chos kun chags mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / zla mchog gi mdor/ btsun pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub ces bgyi ba de yang spros pa lags so mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o zhes bgyi ba de yang spros pa lags so zhes dang / ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod bsal gyi mdor/ rgyal po chen po chos thams cad shin tu mya ngan las 'das pa la mya ngan las 'das par rtog pa de nyid khyod kyi dmigs pa chen po yin no 100ta

zhes dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i mdor/ chos nyid ma gtogs sems gzhan nam/ /byang chub dag kyang mthong ba med/ /des ni sems dang byang chub kyang / /rnam pa gnyis su mi mthong ste/ /byang chub de yi mtshan nyid gang / /sems kyang de yi mtshan nyid yin/ /zhes dang / su yang dag par mthong ba des ni ci yang mi mthong ngo su ci yang mi mthong ba des ni mnyam par mthong ste mi mnyam par mi mthong ngo kau shī ka de ltar gzigs pa de la ni thams cad gzigs pa zhes bya'o zhes dang / sprin chen po las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa'i sku/ /rtag pa'i mtshan rnams phun sum tshogs/ /zhes dang / gnas rtag ye shes rtag pa ste/ /zhing rtag rtag pa'i rnam pa lags/ /mi rtag tshogs kyi mun sel ba/ /mi rtag tshogs ni zad par mdzad/ /ces dang / bcom ldan sangs rgyas chos kyi sku/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes dang / rgyan las/ sangs rgyas nyid ni chos kun ldan pa'am yang na chos kun bral ba ste/ zhes dang / ji ltar nam mkha' rtag tu kun song 'dod/ /de bzhin de yang rtag tu kun song 'dod/ /ji ltar nam mkha' gzugs gyur kun tu song / /de bzhin de yang sems can tshogs kun song / /zhes dang / snga ma phyi mar khyad med kyang / /sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pa/ /de bzhin nyid ni sangs rgyas 'dod/ /ces dang / de phyir sangs rgyas yod min zhing / /med par yang ni mi brjod do/ /de ltas sangs rgyas de skad 'dri/ /lung ma bstan pa'i tshul du 'dod/ /ces dang / thob par lta ba med rnams kyi/ /thob pa yang ni dam par 'dod/ /ces sogs mdo bstan bcos mtha' dag las rgya cher bshad do/ /gzhan yang byang sa 1003

las spangs pa rnam pa gnyis dang ye shes rnam pa gnyis la byang chub tu bshad pa dang / dag pa'i ye shes dang thams cad mkhyen pa dang chags pa med pa'i ye shes dang nyon mongs bcom pa dang nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i ma rigs pa spangs pa la byang chub tu bshad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brgya bzhi bcu dang nyon mongs med dang smon nas mkhyen dang so so yang dag par rig pa mnga' ba la byang chub tu bshad pa dang /sku dang sgrub pa dang phun tshogs dang ye shes dang mthu dang spangs pa dang gnas pa dam pa ste dam pa bdun ldan la byang chub tu bshad pa ste bshad lugs lnga dang / rgyan gyi 'grel par gnas gyur gsum thob pa la byang chub tu bshad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs te dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa la byang chub tu bshad pa sogs mang du yod la 'di dag ni sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang kho na la byang chub kyi sgrar brjod pa yin no/ /sgra don ni/ spangs pa phun tshogs kyi phyir sangs pa dang rtogs pa phun tshogs kyi phyir rgyas pa yin la/ bud+dha'i sgra yang na sangs pa dang yang na rgyas pa la 'jug kyang bod du thog ma'i lo paṇa rnams kyis mun pa sangs pa'am pad+ma kha rgyas pa lta bu la bud+dha'i sgra byung tshe skabs thob de nyid du sangs pa'am rgyas pa zhes so sor bsgyur la sangs rgyas la sgra 'di byung tshe de rnams su mi 'khrul ba'i phyir gnyi gar du cig char bsgyur nas sangs rgyas ces brjod dgos par brda sbyor bam gnyis ma sogs las bshad pa ste 'di lta bu'i don can ches mang ngo / /des na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bshad pa la/ /bzhi bcom drug ldan 'chad pa dang / /zhes sogs tshig skyon 1004

du 'chad pa'ang snying po mi che ste bdud bzhi bcom pa bcom pa'i don dang dbang phyug gi yon tan drug dang ldan pa ldan pa'i don du bshad mi rung na rgyud brtag gnyis las/ dbang phyug la sogs yon tan dang / /ldan phyir bcom ldan 'das zhes bya/ /yang na nyon mongs la sogs bdud/ /bcom phyir bcom ldan 'das zhes brjod/ /ces bshad pa la yang brgal dgos la/ gal te bha ga wan gyi sgra bcom pa'am ldan pa gang rung la 'jug pas gnyi gar du cig char 'bru gnyer mi rigs so snyam na 'o na bcom pa zhe'am ldan pa zhes gang rung du brjod dgos kyi gnyi gar cig char brjod pa'ang mi rigs par 'gyur bas bkas bcad byed po'i lo paṇa rnams la thog mar brgal bar byos shig dang phyis kho bo cag gis brtag par bya'o/ /des na bha ga wan gyi sgra yang so sor dgos tshe bcom pa sogs re re bar bsgyur la gnyi ga'i don can sangs rgyas la sgra 'di byung tshe bcom ldan zhes sgra gnyis tshogs dang phyi rol pa rnams kyang tshangs sogs la sgra 'di sbyor bas de'i tshe legs ldan du bsgyur cing legs ldan de las lhag par ston pa'i phyir 'das sgra'i skad dod med kyang lhag por bod skad la bsnan nas sangs rgyas la bcom ldan 'das zhes brjod pa yin la/ de bzhin du bud+dha'i sgra sangs pa'am rgyas pa re re ba yin yang bod skad la ma rig pa sangs shing ye shes rgyas pa zhes 'bru gnyer ba la skyon med de 'phags yul nyid du'ang / ma rig gnyid las sangs phyir dang / /blo rgyas gnyis phyir sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes 'bru gnyer na bod skad la sgra gnyis ldan du brjod pa'i tshe lta ci smos/ de bzhin du byang chub dang spangs rtogs sogs kyang sgra 1005

don 'di lta bu yin no/ /dbye ba ni dper na nam mkha' ni thams cad du kun tu song zhing khyad par med pas nam mkha' gcig pu zhes bya ste dbyer med pa ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang chos thams cad las 'das pa'am yang na chos thams cad las ma g.yos pa'am yang na chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid du rtag par zhugs la cir yang dmigs su med pa'i phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni gcig pu nyid de gang du yang rnam par dbyer med pa zhes kyang bya ste dbye ba ni blo la ltos la sangs rgyas ni su'i yang blo'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'di ni nges pa'i don gyi rnam grangs gcig ste/ 'jug pa las/ ji ltar snod kyi dbye bas mkha' la dbye ba med de ltar/ /dngos byas dbye ba 'ga' yang de nyid la med de yi phyir/ /ro mnyam nyid du yang dag thugs su chud par mdzad gyur nas/ /mkhyen bzang khyod kyis skad cig gis ni shes bya thugs su chud/ /ces dang / byang sa las/ gzhan yang rtog pa'i lam thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa'i phyir bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid du rig par bya'o zhes dang / rgyan las/ chos rnams thams cad sangs rgyas nyid/ /chos ni gang yang yod ma yin/ /da ni chos dkar rang bzhin yang / /de yis de ni brjod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /'on kyang nam mkha' la shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' zhes sogs rnam par rtog pas dbye zhing sgro 'dogs pa ltar sangs rgyas la dmigs nas kyang rnam par dbye bar byed te sku gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi dang lnga nas mtha' yas pa'i bar du yang dbye bar byed do/ /des na rang don don dam pa'i sku dang de la brten pa gzhan don kun rdzob pa brda'i sku gnyis te/ rgyud blar/ rang 1006

don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ /de la brten pa kun rdzob sku nyid de/ /zhes so/ /yang na rang don phun sum tshogs pa'i chos sku dang de dang rgyu mthun pa gzhan don gyi chos sku gnyis te/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /zhes so/ /yang na rang don spangs pa phun tshogs rnam par grol ba'i sku dang gzhan don rtogs pa phun tshogs chos kyi sku gnyis te/ mdor na ye shes gnyis po yi/ /las su 'di ni shes bya ste/ /grol ba'i sku ni rdzogs pa dang / /chos kyi sku ni sbyong ba'o/ /zhes dang / rnam grol chos kyi sku dag gis/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don bstan te/ /zhes so/ /yang na sku rnam pa gsum ste/gser 'od dam pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sku gsum mnga' ste chos kyi sku dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang sprul pa'i sku'o zhes dang / sku gsum gyi mdor/ sa'i snying pos gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das la sku du mnga'/ /bka' bstsal pa de bzhin gshegs pa la ni sku gsum mnga' ste chos kyi sku dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang sprul pa'i sku'o zhes so/ /yang na ngo bo nyid kyi sku'am rang bzhin gyi sku longs sprul dang bcas pas gsum ste/ rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku dbye ba/ /rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / /gzhan ni sprul pa'i sku yin te/ /dang po gnyis po'i rten yin no/ /zhes dang / sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku bsdus par ni shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /yang na chos sku dbye gzhir byas te dbye na ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang longs sprul gnyis kyis sku gsum ste mngon rtogs rgyan las mdor bstan du/ chos kyi sku dang de rnam brgyad/ /ces sku thams cad chos skur bsdus shing phyis/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /de 1007

bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni/ /zhes bstan la 'di la shān+ti pa'i dag ldan las kyang / ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /sprul pa zhes bya rnam gsum ni/ /chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /ces ga/zhung bton nas rnam pa gsum mdzad pa dang bcas pa ni chos kyi sku ste zhes sku gsum du 'grel pa ni tshul 'di la bshad pa'i rnam grangs gcig go /yang na zab pa rang bzhin gyi sku dang rgya che ba longs sku dang bdag nyid che ba sprul sku dang gsum ste/ rgyud blar/ de dbye zab dang rgya che dang / /bdag nyid chen po yon tan gyi/ /chos kyis rab phye rang bzhin la/ /sogs pa'i sku gsum dag gis 'jug /zhes so/ /yang na chos dbyings shin tu dri med rang bzhin gyi chos sku dang de'i rgyu mthun gyi chos sku gnyis te/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang / /de yi rgyu mthun zab pa dang / /sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa'o/ /zhes so/ /rgyu mthun gyi chos sku la dbye na gnyis te zab pa'i chos sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang sna tshogs pa'i tshul ston pa'i chos sku sprul pa'i sku ste mdor na rgyu mthun gyi chos sku gnyis rang bzhin gyi chos sku dang gsum mo/ /yang na sku bzhi ste ngo bo nyid sku sogs gsum gyi steng du chos kyi sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa bsnan pa ste/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /zhes sogs kyi dgongs par slob dpon seng bzang sogs bzhed la/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mdo las/ rang bzhin chos rdzogs longs spyod dang / /sprul pa tha dad 'jug pa can/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam dag 'di ni yang dag brjod/ /ces dngos su ye shes bzhi sku bzhir bstan nas de 1008

thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang dbyer med par bshad la 'di'i mdor bstan du/ sangs rgyas kyi sa ni chos lngas bsdus te chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang zhes sogs ye shes lngar bshad pas don gyi chos kyi dbyings kyi sku ste sku lngar yang shugs kyis bstan to/ /mdor na/ ting rgyal las/ sangs rgyas sku ni 'di tsam zhes/ /gal te tshad ni rnyed gyur na/ /lha dag dang ni mi rnams dang / /ston pa bye brag med par 'gyur/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku la bongs tshod la sogs pa'i tshad bzung mi nus par bshad pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi sku'i grangs kyang gdul bya'i rtog pa ji snyed par snang zhing 'on kyang nam mkha' la dbye ba ci yang rung mod kyi nam mkha'i tshad sus kyang mi rnyed pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi sku ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid kho na ste/ ting rgyal las/ ji ltar nam mkha' de bzhin du/ /nga yi sku yang brjod med cing / /shes par dka' bar rab tu bstan/ /zhes dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgyar/ yang na ngo bo nyid kyis nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /zhes gsungs shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul rgyas par slad kyis 'chad pa de'i phyir ro/ /rgyud blar/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /zhes sogs 'di'i don la bod phal cher gyis rtogs pa chos sku chos sku dngos dang /theg chen gyi chos zab pa dang theg pa sna tshogs pa'i chos rgya che ba'i chos sku ste mdor na sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos la bstan pa chos skur byed mod kyang de ni rgyud bla'i dgongs pa ma yin te/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /zhes pas chos sku dang / de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /zhes pas de bzhin nyid dang / rigs yod phyir na/ zhes pas rigs te 1009

gsum bstan la/ 'di gsum dbyer med pa ni bde gshegs snying po ste/'di yi rang bzhin chos sku dang / /de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyang ste/ /zhes so/ /de la sangs rgyas dang sbrang rtsi dang snying po ste dpe dang po gsum gyis chos kyi sku bstan pa ste/ de ni dpe gsum gcig dang ni/ /lnga rnams kyis ni shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /chos sku de la yang rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos sku nyid dang de dang rgyu mthun pa'i chos sku gnyis te/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang / /de yi rgyu mthun/ zhes so/ /rgyu mthun la longs sku zab pa'i chos sku dang sprul sku sna tshogs pa'i tshul ston pa'i chos sku gnyis te/ zab pa dang / sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de la chos dbyings shin tu dri ma med pa la ni dpe gzhan mi rnyed la sangs rgyas nyid la'ang dpe gzhan mi rnyed pas de gnyis mtshungs par sbyar ba ste/ 'jig rten 'das phyir 'jig rten na/ /de la dpe ni mi dmigs pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang khams/ /'dra ba nyid du bstan pa yin/ /zhes so/ /nges pa lnga dang ldan la byang 'phags las gzhan gyi spyod yul ma yin pas zab cing phra ba longs sku ni sbrang rtsi bzhin te sbrang rtsi thams cad mngar bar ro gcig pa ltar des bstan pa'i chos thams cad theg pa chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid du ro gcig pa'i phyir te/phra mo zab mo'i tshul bstan ni/ /sbrang rtsi ro gcig pa bzhin te/ /zhes so/ /rnam pa sna tshogs pa gang la gang 'dul gyi chos ston pa sprul pa'i sku ni snying po bzhin te sa bon sna tshogs pa'i sbubs na snying po sna tshogs pa yod pa ltar des bstan pa'i chos kyang gdul bya'i dbang gis sna tshogs par ston 1010

pa'i phyir te/ rnam pa sna tshogs tshul ston ni/ /sna tshogs sbubs snying bzhin shes bya/ /zhes so/ /rgyu rang bzhin gnas rigs dag pas chos sku dang po dang rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs dag pas chos sku phyi ma gnyis 'thob pa ste/ rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsum 'thob par 'dod pa ste/ /dang pos sku ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis/ /zhes so/ /'o na dpe dang po gsum gyis kyang sku gsum bstan la tha ma gsum gyis kyang / ngo bo nyid sku mdzes pa ni/ /rin chen sku 'drar shes bya ste/ /zhes dang / chos chen rgyal srid che ldan phyir/ /rdzogs longs 'khor los bsgyur bzhin no/ /zhes dang / gzugs brnyan gyi ni rang bzhin phyir/ /sprul pa gser gyi gzugs lta bu/ /zhes sku gsum bstan pas bzlos par thal lo zhe na/ 'o na dpe dgu gas bde gshegs snying po gcig bstan zhing dpe tha ma gsum gas sangs rgyas kho na bstan pas de dag yang bzlos par thal lo/ /de dag dgos pa tha dad pas mi zlos so zhe na 'dir yang de bzhin te/ dpe dang po gsum po rang bzhin gyi chos sku dpe dang bral ba dang zab pa'i chos skus ro gcig pa'i chos ston pa dang rgya che ba'i chos skus sna tshogs pa'i chos ston pa'i byed las shes pa'i phyir bstan la tha ma gsum sku rang gi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i phyir bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te de lta min na dpe dgu ni bde gshegs snying po 'chad byed yin pas theg chen gyi chos dang sna tshogs pa'i chos gnyis bde snying du thal ba dang / rig khams sbrang rtsi dang 'dra 'di gzigs nas/ /zhes dang / zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /zhes sbrang rtsi khams nyid dang sbrang ma zhe sdang gi bag nyal du bshad 1011

pa dang / de bzhin sems can la yod chos kyi dbang phyug nyon mongs spun las ma grol lus/ /zhes snying po sgrib bcas kyi chos sku dang shun pa gti mug gi bag nyal du bshad pa gnyi ga dang 'gal bar 'gyur zhing theg chen gyi chos dang sna tshogs pa'i chos gnyis ni dri mas bsgribs pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rong ston shes bya kun rig gis/ zab mo ston pa'i gsung rab chos can sbrang rtsi dang chos mtshungs te gzhan la dam chos zab mo'i ro sbyin pa 'i phyir/ rgya chen po ston pa'i gsung rab chos can snying po dang chos mtshungs te thogs pa'i sgrib pa'i shun pa dang bral ba'i phyir zhes gsungs pa'ang snying por mi che ste/ sbrang rtsi ro gcig pa bzhin te/ /zhes bzhed kyi gzhan la ro sbyin pa'i don yang min la gsung rab thogs pa'i sgrib pa'i shun pa dang bral ba ni ga la srid de sgrib pa na sems dang bcas pa la 'byung gi gsung rab sems bcas su khas len pa ni ngo mtshar ba'i dam bcar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na chos sku dbye gzhir byas te dbye na ngo bo nyid sku la sogs pa gsum du 'gyur ba mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bshad lugs gcig dang / chos sku dbye ngor byas pa'i sku gsum du 'jog pa sku gsum gyi mdo la sogs pa'i bzhed pa dang / chos sku dbye ngor byas pa'i sku bzhir 'jog pa sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mdo las bshad pa dang / chos sku nyid gsum du 'jog pa rgyud bla'i skabs gcig dang / gzugs sku kho na la chos skur 'jog pa rgyud bla'i/ /chos kyi sku ni spyod pa'o/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs te tha dad pa du mar yod pas deng sang gi klog pa po phar phyin smra bar rlom pa rnams kyi 'dod pas sku'i rnam gzhag 'jog pa ni rgya mtsho las chu thigs 1012

blangs te rgya mtsho ni 'di kho na'o zhes so sor sgrog pa ltar snang ngo / /da ni sku de rnams kyi rang bzhin rnam par bzhag par bya ste/ de la sku rnam par bzhag pa dang / ye shes rnam par bzhag pa dang / phrin las rnaca/ par bzhag pa ste gsum las dang po ni/ de yang spyir sangs rgyas dngos mi chos kyi sku kho na ste/ ci tsa bsags pa la'o zhes pa'i byings las bsgrubs pa dharma tā kā ya zhes chos nyid kyi lus zhes pa'i sgra las dngos po'i rkyen bod skad la nyid sgra 'am 〈spo ta la tā yig phyis pas rnyarma kā ya zhes sam chos lus zhes brjod la de la zhe sa'i sgra sbyar bas chos kyi sku ste/ dper na yan lag ma tshang ba med pa'i tshogs pa la lus su brjod pa ltar chos thams cad kyi chos nyid dngos po'i gnas lugs ji lta ba ma tshang ba med par dbyer med du yongs su rdzogs pa mngon du byas pa ni chos kyi sku ste bden gnyis kyi 'grel par slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos/ chos rnams kun gyi lus yin phyir/ /zhes sogs 'grel pa na/ ci'i phyir chos thams cad kyi lus zhes bya snyam pa la 'gro ba thams cad ces bya ba la sogs smos so/ /de bas na rnam pa 'di la ni sku zhes bya ba'i sgra ni lus su brjod par bya'o lus ni tshogs yin pa'i phyir chos kyi sku ni chos rnams kyi tshogs ces bya ste rgyu dang 'bras bus nye bar btags pa'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir rgyu nyid yin snyam pa la bshad pa/'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi rten yin pa'i phyir ro yang na 'dir 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams sgrogs shing brjod pa'i phyir chos kyi sku yin no chos kyi dbyings rtogs na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad 1013

bos pa bzhin du 'du ste/ zad pa shes la zag bcas kyang / /zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes sogs kyis chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i lus yin pa dang yon tan thams cad kyi rten yin pa dang chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid du gnas pa ste don gsum gyis chos kyi skur bshad cing / rgyan las/ chos rnams kun gyi de bzhin nyid/ /sgrib gnyis dag pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /dngos dang / zhes chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid sgrib gnyis kyis dag pa thob pa ni byang chub dngos su bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar bshad pa'i chos kyi sku 'di ni gang la sangs rgyas su brjod pa'i sangs rgyas nyid ji lta ba yin te/ brgyad stong pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni gzugs kyi skur mi lta ste de bzhin gshegs pa ni chos kyi sku'o zhes dang / ting rgyal las/ dpa' bo chen po chos kyi sku/ /sku ni chos las skyes pa ste/ /zhes dang /rgyal ba'i dbang po gzugs kyi skur mi lta/ /zhes so/ /chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni de kho nar gnas mod kyang de ltar gang gis mngon du byas pa de nyid la chos kyi skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa zhes bya ste sangs rgyas gcig pu nyid du bshad pa'i skabs so/ /chos kyi sku de ni go 'phang de las nyams mi srid pa'i phyir rang don don dam pa'i sku zhes bya la de nyid sems can gyi khams rgyud dang dbyer med du rtag par gnas pa las sems can gang gi rgyud cung zad sbyangs pa rnams kyis de'i rang bzhin rnam pa dang bral ba ji lta bar ni ma mthong yang sgrib pa'i rab rib cung zad dag pa'i rgyus rnam pa dang bcas pa gzugs sku'i rnam par snang zhing rang rgyud dang tha dad med na'ang dngos po'i bag chags kyi dbang 1014

gis rang las rgyud tha dad pa phyi rol ltar snang ba ni gzugs kyi sku ste chos sku ji lta ba mthong ba'i tshe gzugs sku'i rnam par mi snang ba'i phyir kun rdzob brda'i sku zhes rnam par 'jog ste sku gnyis kyi rnam grangs gcig go /des na gzugs sku gdul bya'i mig shes yin gyi sangs rgyas ma yin no zer ba dag kyang sangs rgyas ni chos kyi sku'o zhes pa'ang thos shing snang ba sems su bshad pas sems las don gzhan pa'i dngos po med pa'ang cung zad khong du chud pas de lta na gzugs sku ni chos sku ma yin pas sangs rgyas ma yin par snang ngo snyam pa dang snang ba sems yin na gzugs su snang ba rnams mig shes dang sgrar snang ba rnams nyan shes sogs yin par rigs pas de lta na gzugs sku ni de'i mig shes so snyam pa zhig shar ba ste bshad pa'i rnam grangs 'di cung zad go yang dpyis phyin par smra ma nus pas yon po'i gtam zhig byung bar zad la/ des na 'di skabs su gzugs sku mthong ba yang sems can gyi khams rgyud la bum pa la nam mkha' ltar dbyer med du gnas pa'i chos sku de nyid cung zad mthong ba yin pa la dgongs nas rgyud blar/ theg pa 'di la gnas pa rnams/ /nang gi dam pa chos sku ni/ /ye shes mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'di ni rang sems snang ba zhes/ /so so skye bos mi shes mod/ /ces gsung pa ste de'i phyir chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis ka rang rgyud las gcig pa dang tha dad pa gang yang ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas chos sku nyid du bshad pas gzugs sku sangs rgyas kyi sku ma yin par ston pa yang ma yin te dper na ring srel can gyi mchod rten zhig la skye bo mig ldan gyis lta ba na skya rengs dang po'i 1015

dus su ra ri tsam mthong zhing nam nangs kur de bas ches gsal ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba na ji ltar bar mthong ba ltar las kyi sgrib pa dag pa skya rengs dang po lta bu'i tshe mchod rten lta bu'i chos sku de nyid la mchog gi sprul skur snang ba dang / nyon sgrib dag pa nam nangs ka lta bu'i tshe longs skur snang ba dang / shes sgrib dag pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba lta bu'i tshe chos sku ji lta ba nyid mthong ba rād pa'i tshul du mthong ba ste sku gsum gyi mdor/ chos kyi sku ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo gang la lta bar bya'o longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni byang chub sems dpa'i ngo gang la lta bar bya'o sprul pa'i sku ni mos pas spyod pa'i so so skye bo'i ngo gang la lta bar bya'o zhes so/ /ci snang tshul gyi sku gdul bya'i mig shes su bshad pa 'di rje btsun ngal gsor yang bzhed pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni rje nyid kyi mkhan po dpal chos grub seng ge'i bkas gzhan stong gi grub pa zungs shig ces bka' bstsal pa sgrub phyir yum don jo zi'i lugs su bkral ba yin gyi nges pa'i don ma yin no zhes yang yang bka' bstsal zhing zhib mor phye na rje btsun gyi rtsa ba gzhan stong dang slob dpon gyi 'grel pa rang stong du 'grel par mdzad pas don gyis na gnyi ga la zhen bya min par bstan pa yin no/ /yang na spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa ni rang don rnam par grol ba'i sku dang rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa ni gzhan don chos kyi sku yin la de gnyis kyang yang dag par gnyis su med pa'i rnam pa gcig kho na ste rgyud blar/ rnam grol chos kyi sku dag ni/ /rnam gnyis rnam gcig shes bya ste/ /zhes so/ /'di ni nyon mongs bag chags dang bcas pas gzod nas ma 1016

gos pa nyid la ma gos pa nyid du 'gags pa'i phyir zag pa med pas brtan pa'i yon tan dang dus gsum gyi yul la chags thogs med pa'i ye shes 'jug pas khyab pa zhi ba'i yon tan dang nam yang mi 'jig pa'i rang bzhin yin pas na 'dus ma byas pa rtag pa'i yon tan dang 'jig pa med pa nyid mi 'gyur ba rtag pa'i gnas 'pho ba med pa'i yon tan te bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ nyon mongs rnams ni bag chags dang / /bcas pa 'gags phyir zag med de/ /chags med thogs pa med pa'i phyir/ /ye shes khyab pa nyid du 'dod/ /gtan du 'jig pa med pa yi/ /rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas/ /'jig med nyid ni brtan pa ste/ /brtan sogs rnams kyang de bshad do/ /zhes te sku gnyis kyi rnam grangs gcig go /'di la kun mkhyen rong ston gyis ni nyon sgrib spangs pa rnam grol gyi sku dang shes sgrib spangs pa chos kyi sku ste rnam grol gyi skus ni nyan rang dang mtshungs la chos kyi skus khyad par du byas so zhes pa'i dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi lung 'dren par mdzad mod kyang cung zad mi mtshungs te dgongs 'grel gyi chos sku ni gnas gyur thob pa la gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /sku gsum gyi rnam par bzhag pa la chos sku dbye gzhir byas pa/ dbye ngor byas pa/ chos sku gsum du 'jog pa ste gsum las dang po ltar na/ chos kyi sku ni sngar bstan pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos de nyid yin la de la dbye na ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang sprul pa'i sku'o/ /de la ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni zag pa med pa'i chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du shin tu rnam par dag pa thob pa ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid 1017

sku ni/ /zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag /thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa/ /de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /zhes gsungs la zag med kyi chos gang zhe na byang phyogs so bdun dang tshad med bzhi dang rnam thar brgyad dang mthar gnas snyoms 'jug dgu dang zad par bcu dang zil gnon brgyad dang nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang smon gnas mkhyen pa dang mngon shes drug dang so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang rnam kun yongs su dag pa bzhi dang dbang bcu dang stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang srung ba med pa gsum dang dran nye gsum dang bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid dang bag chags bcom pa dang thugs rje chen po dang ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad dang rnam mkhyen nyid dang rang bzhin rnam par dag pa chos kyi sku nyid de de rnams sgrib bral du mngon sum du byas pa ste/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang / /sogs nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang / /chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /yang na mtshan nyid lnga'am yon tan lnga ldan ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ rgyud blar/ de la sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid lnga/ /mdor na yon tan lnga dang ni/ /ldan pa nyid du rig par bya/ /zhes so/ /de yang / 'dus ma byas pa dang rnam dbyer med pa dang sgro skur gyi mtha' gnyis spangs pa dang sgrib gsum las grol ba dang 'od gsal ba ste mtshan nyid lnga'o/ /ci'i phyir 'od gsal zhe na dri ma med cing rtog pa med pa dang so so rang rig gi shes pa'i yul yin pa dang chos kyi dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i phyir 'od gsal ba ste/ 'dus ma byas shing rnam dbyer med/ /mtha' gnyis dag ni rnam 1018

par spangs/ /nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib gsum las ni nges grol te/ /dri med rnam par rtog med de/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi yul yin phyir/ /chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba/ /zhes so/ /yang na tshad med pas rgya che ba'i phyir gzhal du med pa dang /mtha' yas pas grangs med pa dang rtog ge'i yul min phyir bsam du med pa dang sangs rgyas nyid gcig pu 'ba' zhig par zad kyi su dang yang mi mtshungs pas mnyam pa med pa dang bag chags dang bcas pa'i dri ma spangs pa'i phyir mthar thug pa'i yon tan dang lngar ldan pa ste/ gzhal med grangs med bsam med pa/ /mnyam med dag pa'i mthar thug pa'i/ /yon tan rnams dang yang dag par/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ldan te/ /rgya che'i phyir dang grangs med phyir/ /rtog ge'i yul ni min phyir dang / /'ba' zhig bag chags bcas spangs phyir/ /gzhal med la sogs go rim bzhin/ /zhes so/ /yang na mtshan nyid gsum ldan te rgyan las/ rang bzhin sku ni mnyam pa dang / /phra zhing de dang 'brel ba dang / /zhes pa ste spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i mnyam pas ni gzugs sku las khyad par du byas pa phra ba'i phyir 'dus ma byas kyis ma bsdus pa dang longs sku dang 'brel bas ma dag pa dang cung zad dag pa'i de bzhin nyid las khyad par du gyur pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid sku 'di ni longs spyod rdzogs sku snang ba'i rgyu ste/ dgyes rgur longs spyod bstan pa la/ /longs spyod rdzogs 'byor rgyur 'dod do/ /zhes so/ /chos sku dbye ngor byas pa'i sku gsum gyi tshe ngo bo nyid sku 'di nyid la chos kyi skur brjod pa ste/ sku gsum gyi mdo las/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i 1019

sku gsum ni rang bzhin rnam par dag pa ni chos kyi sku'o zhes dang / rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku ni nam mkha' ltar rang bzhin med pa'i don to zhes so/ /chos sku dang ngo bo nyid sku tha dad du dbye ngor byas te sku bzhir 'jog pa'i tshe ni spangs pa phun tshogs ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang rtogs pa phun tshogs chos kyi skur 'jog la/ yang na chos kyi dbyings ji lta ba mngon du byas pa ngo bo nyid sku dang spangs pa phun tshogs chos kyi sku dang rtogs pa phun tshogs gzungs kyi skur yang bshad la/ chos sku gsum du 'jog tshul ni bshad zin to/ /sku lngar rnam par 'jog pa'i tshe ni chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag mngon du byas pa'i cha la chos dbyings kyi sku dang res 'ga' chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su'ang bshad cing spangs pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang rtogs pa chos kyi sku dang gzhan don byed tshul gyi cha nas gzugs sku gnyis te lngar 'jog go /thar rgyan las ni/ chos sku ni stong nyid rtogs pas nor ba zad de 'khrul ba log pa tsam la ming btags pa las mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhir grub pa gang yang mi mnga' la de thob pas stobs sogs yon tan thams cad 'du ba'i phyir rang don gyi sku'am sangs rgyas dngos yin la de thob pa lta zhog de la mos pa byas pa dang cung zad rtogs pa dang phyogs gcig rtogs pa dang phal cher rtogs pa rnams kyang yon tan rim pa ltar cung zad dang mang po dang dpag med dang ldan te sbyor lam pa dang nyan rang dang phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems rnams kyi yon tan rnams rim pas yin la/ ldog pa'i cha nas bcal na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos sku mtshungs pas mnyam pa dang spros pa dang bral bas 1020

zab pa dang 'dus ma byas pas rtag pa dang dbyings dang ye shes tha mi dad pas dbyer med pa dang / yang dag pas phyin ci ma log pa dang / dri ma med pas gtsang ba dang rnam par mi rtog pas 'od gsal ba dang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rten du gyur pa ste yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa ste/ rgyud bla'i/ thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med/ /sogs 'dren par mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid gdul bya la ji ltar snang ba'i tshul ni/ sangs rgyas nyid ni gzugs skur snang ba dang mi snang ba gang gi dus na'ang khyad par cung zad kyang med par chos nyid rang gi ngo bo las g.yo ba mi mnga' mod kyang nam gdul bya'i rgyud dag pa de'i tshe gzugs sku'i snang ba 'byung ba ste/ yum gyi rgyan las/ rgyu ni yongs su smin gyur nas/ /gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ /gang tshe bya ba phan 'gyur ba/ /de dang de la de snang ngo / /zhes so/ /de la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni/sisgo ga kā ya zhes theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig la rdzogs par longs spyod pa'i phyir longs spyod rdzogs sku zhes bya ste/ theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ /zhes pa nyid do/ /mtshan nyid ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan ltar na/ sku mtshan dpe dang ldan zhing theg chen 'ba' zhig gsung ba nam yang mya ngan las mi 'da' ba ste/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid 'di/ /theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ /thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed/ /ces so/ /nam yang mya ngan las mi 'da' ba ni deng sang gi rtsod ngor bsnan pa ste theg gcig ston pa'i mchog gi sprul skus ma nges pa spangs/pa'i phyir ro/ /yang na mtshan nyid lnga ldan gyi sku 1021

ste theg chen gyi chos mtha' yas pa la rdzogs par longs spyod pa dang rang bzhin gyi sku mtshan dpe dang ldan pa byang 'phags la rtag tu snang ba dang 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad pa dang 'bad med du gdul bya'i 'dod pa skong ba dang nor bu tshon dang nye ba ltar de'i ngo bo min pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa ston pa ste lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /ji skad du/ rgyud blar/ sna tshogs chos la rdzogs longs spyod/ /rang bzhin chos 'di snang phyir dang / /thugs rjes dag pa'i rgyu mthun pa/ /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad phyir dang / /rnam par rtog med lhun grub par/ /'dod pa ji bzhin yongs skong phyir/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rdzogs par longs spyod rnam par gnas/ /zhes gsungs shing de'i don bsdu ba'i phyir/ brjod don mdzad rgyun mi 'chad dang / /mngon par 'du byed med pa dang / /de yi ngo bo min ston la/ /'dir ni sna tshogs rnam lngar brjod/ /ces so/ /'dir/ sna tshogs chos la rdzogs longs spyod/ /ces sna tshogs su bsgyur mod kyang sna tshogs pa'am bi shwa don shin tu mang po la yang 'jug cing shin tu mang po ni grangs mtha' yas pa'i don yin pas theg chen gyi chos mtha' yas pa la longs spyod pa'i don can yin la brjod bya ni de kho na nyid du gcig pas sprul sku ltar chos sna tshogs ston pa la go bar mi bya la/ des na/ mtha' yas chos rdzogs longs spyod dang / /zhes bsgyur na bzang bar snang ngo / /yang na rang bzhin gyi sku dang sprul pa'i sku las rnam pa drug gis tha dad pa'i sku ste/ longs spyod rdzogs pa khams kun tu/ /'khor yongs sdud dang zhing dang mtshan/ /sku dang chos rdzogs longs spyod dang / /mdzad pa dag gis tha dad do/ /zhes 1022

pa la dbyig gi zhabs kyi 'grel par/ 'khor sdud pa tha dad de longs sku'i 'khor ma 'dres pa'o zhing tha dad de gser dang dngul dang baiḍūr+ya la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyis tha dad do mtshan tha dad de rnam snang dang 'od dpag tu med pa la sogs pa'o sku tha dad de sku'i kha dog dang tshad la sogs pa'o chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pa tha dad de kha cig mdo pad+ma dkar po dang kha cig sa bcu pa sogs gsung ba'o mdzad pa tha dad de so so'i 'khor tha dad du smin par mdzad pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don du bkral la 'dir tha dad pa drug gis chos sku mnyam pa las khyad par 'byed cing mdzad pa tha dad pas sprul sku las bye brag tu 'byed pa ste sprul sku ni mdzad pa mtshungs par 'chad pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te longs sku rnams zhing tha dad na zhing nges pa 'og min du bshad pa dang 'gal zhing sku tha dad na sku nges par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ spyir nges pa lnga ni longs sku re re'i dbang du byas nas gsungs la tha dad pa drug ni longs sku thams cad kyi dbang du byas nas gsungs shing zhing tha dad kyang de thams cad 'og min du mtshungs la 'og min de yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos kyi dbyings su mtshungs pas gnas nges pa dang yang mi 'gal lo/ /sku ni mtshan dpe can du mtshungs la 'od dang kha dog dang sku'i tshad la sogs pas tha dad pa'o/ /'o na sprul sku dang khyad med du 'gyur ro zhe na/ yab yum dang gdung dang bsod snyoms la gshegs pa dang mya ngan las 'da' ba sogs ston mi ston gyi khyad par yod do/ /des na gnas nges pa 'og min dang sku nges pa longs sku'i mtshan dpe can dang chos nges pa theg chen kho na gsung zhing dus nges pa srid pa ji 1023

srid par gnas pa yin la 'khor nges pa spyir sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' la snang zhing bye brag tu slob dpon chos bshes kyis sa bcu pa ba kho na la snang ba longs sku gtso bo dang sa dang po ba yan la snang ba phal ba ste gtso phal gyi rnam gzhag byas shing / bden gnyis nas zhing khams yongs su dag pa sa brgyad pa na yod pas de yan la snang ba dang / sku gsum la 'jug pa'i mdo 'grel las mthong lam gyi snga logs chos mchog nas snang bar yang bshad mod kyi gtso bor sa thob pa la snang ba nyid bzung ngo / /thar rgyan las ni/ 'khor zhing sku mtshan mdzad pa chos/ /lhun gyis grub dang rang bzhin med/ /de ltar mtshan nyid brgyad ldan du bzhed do/ /de la sprul sku tsam gyi mtshan nyid ni longs sku'i dngos kyi gdul byar ma gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams srid pa ji srid par gang la gang 'dul gyis 'dul ba'i sku ni sprul pa'i sku ste/ yum rgyan las/ gang gis srid pa ji srid par/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces dang / rgyan las/ sangs rgyas sprul pa dpag med pa/ /sprul pa'i skur ni 'dod pa ste/ /zhes so/ /dbye na rgyan las/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtag ston pas/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di la/ /rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen po/ /zhes pa ltar gsum las/byang chub chen po ston pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i mtshan nyid ni/ gdul bya smin pa la sprul skur 'tshang rgya ba'i mdzad pa ston zhing bslab pa bca' ba dang chos 'khor bskor bas bstan pa'i bdag po'i phrin las mdzad pa ste/thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas 1024

ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol ba dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'da' bar gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes so/ /'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba ni ston pa las gzhan sus kyang mi nus pas theg pa rnams kyi 'dul ba dang sbyar te mtshan nyid du smros so/ /'di rnams kyang gtso che ba'i dbang du byas kyi mchog gi sprul sku ma lus pa ni 'di ltar mi lta ste/ dag pa'i zhing kha cig na byang chub sems dpa' pad+ma las brdzus te skye zhing de ma thag tu byang chub kyi shing drung du 'tshang rgya bas bzo dang rol rtsed sogs mi ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dka' ba spyod pa dang bdud 'dul ba med par 'tshang rgya ba dang / sangs rgyas kha cig 'od dang byin rlabs tsam gyis 'dul bas ngag tshig gis chos mi ston pa yod cing dag pa'i zhing rnams na ni bslab pa bca' ba'ang med mod kyi 'on kyang spang blang sogs 'od dang byin rlabs las rig par 'gyur bas bslab pa bca' dang chos 'khor bskor ba'i don dang dgos pa ni grub par 'gyur ro/ /des na/ yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /zhes pa'ang longs sku'i zhing la ltos na sprul sku'i zhing ni rags pa thogs bcas su snang zhing skye 'jig byed pa sogs kyis ma 1025

dag pa yin par dgongs pa ste spyir sprul sku'i zhing nyid la ni yongs su dag pa dang yongs su ma dag pa dang yongs su dag la kun nas nyon mongs pa dang kun nas nyon mongs la yongs su dag pa dang snrel zhi dang spyi'u tshugs kyi zhing sogs du mar gsungs so/ /de la bzo sprul pa'i sku ni lha'i bu las thams cad pa sogs dang skye ba sprul pa'i sku ni gang la gang gis 'dul ba ngan song gi rnam pa'i bar dang de bzhin du gzings dang zam pa sogs bem po'i rnam pa sogs tshad med par snang bas 'gro ba'i don byed pa yin te phal chen las/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung gis kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can la phrin las sgrub bo zhes dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan gyi skye mched kyis sangs rgyas kyi phrin las gang sgrub pa de snyan gyi skye mched kyis kyang sgrub par mdzad do de bzhin du shangs ljags sku thugs rnams la sbyar nas thugs kyi skye mched kyis phrin las gang sgrub pa de 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad kyi dmigs pa dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa sna tshogs rnam par phye ba thams cad kyis sgrub par mdzad do zhes so/ /skye ba sprul pa'i sku zhes pa'ang gzhan ngor skye ba la sogs par snang bas der brjod pa ste sangs rgyas nyid der skye ba ni ma yin te yang srid pa spangs pa'i phyir ro/ /mchog gi sprul sku'i dbang du mdzad nas/ byang sa las/ rnam pa bcus de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi yon tan brjod pa dang rjes su dran pa yin te bcu po gang zhe na/'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar 1026

gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ste de la phyin ci ma log pa gsung bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes sogs gsungs te/ mchod par 'os pas na dgra bcom pa/ ji lta ba bzhin thugs su chud pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa gsum dang zhabs zhi lhag gnyis dang gnyi ga'i phyogs dang ldan pas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ mchog tu khyad zhugs pa dang mi ldog par gshegs pas bde bar gshegs pa/ sems can dang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi kun nyon dang rnam byang gi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pas 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ sems 'dul ba'i thabs dam pa mkhyen zhing 'jig rten na skyes bu gcig pur gyur pas skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med pa/ mig dang ye shes dang don dang chos su gyur pa'i phyir don gsal ba gtan la 'bebs pa dang don thams cad ston zhing mi rtogs pa rtogs par mdzad pa dang the tshom gcod cing zab mo'i gnas rnam par 'grel la yongs su byang bar mdzad pa dang chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa dang des 'dren zhing lha mi thams cad la sdug bsngal las 'byung thabs ston pas na lha dang mi thams cad kyi ston pa/ don dang ldan pa dang mi ldan pa dang gnyi ga ma yin pa'i chos kyi tshogs rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par thugs su chud pas na sangs rgyas/ bdud dpung bcas thams cad kyi g.yul chen po bcom pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das zhes bya bar bshad do/ /de la sku rnams kyi 'byung ba ni/ chos kyi sku ni 'byung ba dang mi 'byung ba'i spros pa nye bar 1027

zhi ba yin la/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni nam mkha' ji srid pa thams cad du rtag par snang ba zhes bya ste 'on kyang snang ba po'i sems dpa' de sangs rgyas pa phyin chos sku ji lta ba nyid las de'i ngor gzugs skur mi snang mod kyang chos sku de nyid la byang sems gzhan gyis longs skur snang ba rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir de skad du brjod do/ /mchog gi sprul sku ni mun pa'i bskal pa thams cad la mi 'byung zhing mun bskal mang po song ba'i mtshams kyi sgron me'i bskal pa rnams la 'byung ste bskal pa gcig la sangs rgyas gcig kho na 'byung ba de'i sku tshe dang bstan pas bskal pa de 'khyongs pa nas bskal pa gcig la sangs rgyas gaṅgā klung gi bye ma snyed mang po 'byung ba'i bar yang yod la/ rten gyi gtso bo yin la blo gsal ba'i phyir mi rnams kyi nang dang skyes pa'i rten gyis 'tshang rgya bar mdzad kyi 'gro ba gzhan dang bud med kyi rten gyis kyang ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' mang du sangs rgyas pa rnams sangs rgyas pa'i tshe gcig gam tha dad ce na gang yang min te/ rgyan las/ chos kyi dbyings na sangs rgyas rnams/ /gcig min mang po yang ma yin/ /sngon gyi lus rjes 'brang phyir dang / /mkha' ltar lus ni med phyir ro/ /zhes dang / rigs tha dad phyir don yod phyir/ /rdzogs phyir thog ma med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gcig min dri med gnas/ /tha dad med phyir mang po'ang min/ /zhes so/ /zhing gcig tu sangs rgyas gcig kho na 'byung ste bdag 'jig rten 'dren pa med pa'i nang du bdag 'jig rten gyi 'dren par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa grub pa'i phyir dang sangs rgyas gcig gis stong gsum gyi zhing du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las 1028

thams cad mdzad par spyod pas gnyis pa 'byung ba don med pa dang sangs rgyas gcig pu nyid mthong na dkon pa'i 'du shes kyis chos mnyan par 'dun pa skye la mang po mthong na de tsam du brtson par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir dang zla med pa'i tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i phyir ro/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing mtha' yas pa rnams su ni dus mnyam par dga' ldan nas 'pho ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba bstan pa gnas pa sogs dus mtshungs shing mtshan gcig pa kho na'ang gzhal du med pa 'byung ste sngon byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa rnams dus mnyam par cig char sems bskyed cing smon lam mtshungs pa rnams zhing tha dad par dus gcig tu 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du dus mi mtshungs par ston pa ni de bas kyang ches gzhal du med la sangs rgyas thams cad ni gnas bzhis tha dad de kha cig ni sku tshe nyin gcig pa sogs kyang ston la kha cig ni sku tshe bskal pa gaṅgā klung gi bye snyed las kyang ches lhag par bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas 'od srung dang sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa mtshan tha dad do/ /kha cig ni rgyal rigs dang kha cig ni bram ze'i rigs su 'byung zhing rigs de gnyis las gzhan la ni mi 'byung ste rje rigs sogs 'jig rten na bkur ba'i rigs ma yin la/ sangs rgyas rigs gnyis po de las res bram ze'i rigs mchog tu 'dzin res rgyal rigs mchog tu 'dzin pas gang mchog tu bkur ba'i tshe rigs de nyid 'dzin pa ste sa bcu pa ba des/ rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang / /'khor dang skye ba dag dang ni/ /nges 'byung byang chub shing rnams kyi/ /yon tan phun sum 1029

tshogs pa yin/ /zhes pa'i yongs sbyong bsgrubs pa'i phyir dang / 'jig rten gyi brnyas pa spang ba'i phyir rigs rus la sogs pa'i mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyal rigs la yang nyi ma'i rigs dang zla ba'i rigs sogs tha dad dang bram ze la 'od srung dang ba ra dh+wa dza dang ka t+yā na sogs te gdung tha dad do/ /kha cig ni sku bongs mthe bong gi tshad la sogs par ston la kha cig ni ri rab gaṅgā klung gi bye ma las lhag pa'i skur yang ston pas sku bongs tha dad do/ /de bzhi las gzhan pa thams cad kyis mchog gi sprul sku thams cad mtshungs shing mnyam ste khyad par cung zad kyang med do/ /des na sgra pa sat+ta shis/ pags pa gser mdog pags pa srab pa dang / /zhes pa 'gyur nyes te/ pags pa mdog bzang zhes bsgyur dgos te sku mdog sna tshogs pa yod pa'i phyir zhes dang / jo bo rjes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang mdog dzasbu'i gser mdog tu 'dug gsung nas rigs lnga ser 'jam mdzad pa 'gog pa'i phyir du gzhan dag gis/ sangs rgyas gser mdog zhes bya ba/ /sangs rgyas phal la dgongs pa yin/ /gzhan du sman bla nam mkha'i mdog /sngon po nyid du mdo las bshad/ /ces 'chad pa'ang snying por mi che ste/ spyir gser la ser pos ma khyab ste gser dmar po dang sngon po sogs bshad cing gser dmar po dngos su mthong ba'i phyir/ 'dis ni nor nyams tsam yang chung bar bstan no/ /nam mkha'i mdog sngon por 'dod pa ni 'jig rten mi nag pa'i gtam du zad de gzhung lugs pas nam mkha' dngos med du 'dod la kha dog ni bem po'i bye brag kha dog gi gzugs yin pas dngos med bem por 'dod pa ni grub mtha' smra ba 1030

bzhi'i nang na med do/ /lho gling gi nam mkha' sngon po sogs bshad do snyam na de ni ri rab kyi lho baiḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin dwangs pa la rgya mtsho'i mdangs phog pas sngon por snang ba'i 'od kyis bar snang gang ba'i mdog tu bshad pa yin gyi nam mkha' nyid sngon por gnas par 'chad pa ma yin no/ /de lta mod kyi baiḍūr+ya sngon po'o snyam pa'ang rin po che'i brtag pa la mi mkhas par zad de baiḍūr+ya dkar po sogs du ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / spyir baiḍūr+ya ni nam mkha'i ming gi rnam grangs yin pas baiḍūr+ya mchog rnams ni kha dog gang yang ma yin pa kha dog med pa'i kha dog can zhes bshad pa chu dwangs pa'i kha dog lta bu yin la cung zad snyigs ma rnams la ni kha dog tha dad pa du mar snang ba yod do/ /sman bla sngon por bshad pa'i mdo bod na mi snang ste sman mdo gnyis la ni baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po zhes pa ni mtshan du bshad kyi sku mdog 'chad byed ma yin la de las gzhan yang mi snang ba'i phyir/ ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi ras ris la sman gyi bla sngon po g.yas mchog sbyin gyis a ru ra 'dzin pa bri bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa ni mdo sngags phye ba'i sngags yin gyi mdo ma yin no/ /des na sangs rgyas kha dog lnga dang sa gnon la sogs pa lnga'i phyag gi stabs su bsdus pa ni gsang sngags nas sangs rgyas rnams rigs lngar bsdus pa'i rigs so so'i sku mdog dang phyag rgya tha dad du sbyar ba yin gyi mdo'i lugs ma yin te mdo las rigs lnga'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa ma mthong ba'i phyir/ sngags nas gsungs pa'i sprul sku mdo'i sangs rgyas la sbyor na ni sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa sogs kyang 'chad dgos par 'gyur ro/ /des na mdo'i 1031

lugs kyis mchog gi sprul sku rnams dzasbu chu bo'i gser gyi kha dog ltar dkar ser dmar gsum ga'i mdangs dang ldan par mtshungs pa yin te/byang sa las/ de la sangs rgyas thams cad ni gnas bzhi bo sku tshe dang mtshan dang gdung dang sku ma gtogs pa thams cad mtshungs mnyam ste khyad par med do zhes gsungs la gal te sku mdog tha dad yod na tha dad rnam pa lnga 'chad rigs pa las ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /mdzod las kyang /sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs dang ni/ /chos sku 'gro ba'i don spyod pas/ /mnyam pa nyid de sku tshe dang / /rigs dang sku bongs tshod kyis min/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/ sku tshe dang rigs dang gdung dang sku bongs tshod du bcas pa la ni bye brag yod de zhes bshad kyi kha dog tha dad par ma bshad la/ sku zhes pa'ang sku tshad yin gyi des kha dog thon pa ma yin no/ /mchog gi sprul skus sprul pa'i sangs rgyas la ni kha dog tha dad sna tshogs kyang bshad cing gdul bya'i dbang gis dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbang gis rnam pa gzhan du snang ba ni yod do/ /de yang 'jig rten thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir sku'i khyad par/ stobs kyi khyad par/'od kyi khyad par/ cho 'phrul gyi khyad par/ gsung gi khyad par/ ma 'dres pa'i chos kyi khyad par te rnam pa du ma dang ldan no/ /de la sku ni mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cu dang ri mo'i rjes brgyad cur ldan pa gser btso ma spungs pa lta bu lta bas chog mi shes pa mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'o/ /de la mtshan so gnyis ni yum rgyan las/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad lnga dang / rgyud blar/1032

legs gnas 'khor los mtshan pa dang / /sogs tshigs bcad dgus gsungs te/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil yon tan yongs su sdud pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong sogs bkra ba mu khyud can gyis spras pa ste 'khor los bsgyur rgyal ni mu khyud med pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'byung ba las khyad par du byed do/ /1 zhabs mthil me long ltar mnyam par sa la 'bab pa dang /2sor mo rnams dra bas 'brel bas snod chen po ltar gnas pa dang /3 phyag zhabs pad+ma'i lo ma ltar 'jam zhing gzhon pa dang /4 phyag zhabs kyi mtheb chen gyi rtsa ba'i skyong bzhi sgrog rus kyi skyong gnyis ltag pa'i skyong ste bdun po mi mngon par shas gang bas bdun mtho ba dang /5 sor mo ring ba dang /6 ting pa yangs pas zhabs stod smad zheng mnyam pa dang /7 sku che bas 'khor gzhan las bzhi 'gyur gyis 'phags shing drang la brtan pa dang /8 zhabs kyi long bu dang pus mo'i lha nga dang phyag dar gyi rus 'bur rnams mi mngon par mnyam pa dang /9 ba spu'i khung bu thams cad rin po che 'bar ba lta bu'i bu ga gyen du phyogs pa ste bcu tshan gcig go/10 byin pa ri dwags e rtsu'i lta bur skum zhing byin gyis gzhol ba dang /11 phyag de dang 'dra bar ring zhing mdzes pa ma btud par pus mor sleb pa dang /12'doms kyi sba ba spubs su nub ste mi snang ba dang /13 pags pa dzasbu chu bo'i gser btso ma'i kha dog tu 'bar ba dri mas gos mi srid pa dang /14pags pa srab cing gzhon pa dpe med par 'jam la gnyer ma dang lhod 'khums med pa dang /15 ba spu rnams baiḍūr+ya sngon po'i mdog can phra zhing 'od 'tshor ba re re zhi nga g.yas su 'khyil ba dang /16 min mtshams 1033

su mdzod spu dpe med par dkar zhing 'od 'tsher la phra zhing 'jam pa'i spu sum cu rtsa gnyis tshang ba 'then na ring por phyin pa g.yas su 'khyil te gnas pa dang /17 sku stod seng ge'i rgyal po ltar yangs shing rgyas la kho lag che ba dang /18 phrag mgo gnyis shin tu lhun che zhing blum pa dang /19phrag pa'i thal gong gnyis mi dma' bar rgyas pa ste bcu tshan gnyis so/20'jig rten na ro mi zhim par grags pa rnams kyang 'di'i ljags la ro bro ba'i mchog tu snang ba dang /21 n+ya gro dha'i sdong po ltar zheng du ji tsam pa chur yang de tsam pas sku chu zheng gab pa dang /22 dbu'i gtsug tor rang gi sor bzhi'i tshad kyis dbus drang por gyen du 'phags shing dbu skra tshom bu tshom bur 'khyil ba'i phreng bas gtsug tor gyi ngos dung gi 'khyil ltar rim pa phyed dang bcu gsum du 'khyil ba'i rtse mo'i gtsug 'khyil ni lha mi sus kyang mthong bar mi nus pa dang /23 ljags ring zhing mdzes pa brkyang na gdong khebs pa dang /24 tshangs pa'i dbyangs mnga' ba dang /25 za 'gram seng ge ltar rgyas pa dang /26 tshems shin tu dkar ba dri ma dang zas kyis gos mi srid pa dang /27 tshems ring thung dang che chung med par shin tu mnyam pa dang /28 tshems thags bzang bas 'gul mi srid cing zas shin du sra ba'ang lan gnyis pa bldad mi dgos pa dang /29 mche ba bzhi dang bcas pa'i grangs bzhi bcur tshang ba dang bcu tshan gsum mo/ /30 spyan dkar nag 'byes shing spyan 'bras shin tu mthon mthing 'od dang ldan pa dang /31 rdzi ma ba mchog gi rdzi ma ltar gnag cing stug pa de sum bcu rtsa gnyis so/ /32 'di la yum rgyan du sku che zhing drang ba 1034

dbye ngor mdzad de 'od mi the ba'i so gnyis su gsungs pa ni sher phyin gyi mdo'i lugs dang / rgyud blar sku che zhing drang pa dbye ngor ma mdzad par/'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan dang / /zhes bgrangs pa ni bu mo rin chen gyi mdo'i dgongs pa'o/ /mtshan rnams kyi rgyu yang / bla ma skyel la sogs pa dang / /zhes sogs kyis sngon bla ma la bsu zhing skyel ba sogs kyis 'khor lo'i mtshan thob pa dang / sdom pa brtan pas zhabs mnyam pa sogs te rgyas par mdor blta'o/ /dpe byad kyang / thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad bcu gnyis kyis gsungs te/ sku bcud kyis rgyas pa'i phyir sen mo zangs mdog ltar dmar ba dang mdog snum pa dang rigs mthon por 'khrungs pas ring zhing mtho ba dang sor mo rnams zlum pa dang rgyas pa dang byin gyis phra ba dang sku la rtsa mi mngon pa dang rtsa mdud pa med pa dang zhabs long bu mi mngon pa dang zhabs mnyam pa ste bcu tshan gcig go /seng ge dang glang po che dang / ngang pa dang khyu mchog gi stabs su gshegs pa dang g.yas phyogs su ldog pa dang mdzes pa dang drang por gshegs pa dang sku 'khril bag chags pa dang byi dor byas ma thag pa lta bu dang lta na 'tsham pa ste bcu tshan gnyis so/ /sku gtsang ba dang 'jam pa dang dag pa dang mtshan rnams rdzogs pa dang kho lag yangs pa dang gom pa snyom pa dang spyan dag pa dang gzhon sha chags pa dang sku sha ma zhum pa dang rgyas pa ste bcu tshan gsum pa'o/ /sku shin tu grims pa dang yan lag rnam par 'byes pa dang rab rib med pas gzigs pa dag pa dang lta zur blum pa dang sked skabs phyed pa dang lto ba ma rnyongs pa dang phyal phyang nge ba 1035

dang lte ba'i khung bu gting zab pa dang nang g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba dang sku lta na sdug pa ste bzhi bcu'o/ /spyod pa gtsang ba dang me ba'i mtshan ma med pa dang phyag mthil 'jam pa dang phyag ris mdangs che ba dang gting zab pa dang dkyus ring ba dang zhal gdong ha cang mi ring ba dang mchu bispa ltar dmar ba dang ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang lnga bcu'o/ /ljags dmar ba dang gsung 'brug sgra lta bu dang gsung mnyen zhing 'jam pa dang mche ba bzhi blum pa dang rno ba dang dkar ba dang bzhi po mnyam pa dang byin gyis phra ba dang shangs rgyud mtho ba dang shangs sbubs gtsang ba ste drug cu pa'o/ /spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug pa dang spyan pad 'dab 'dra ba dang smin tshugs ring ba dang smin ma 'jam pa dang snum pa dang spu mnyam pa dang phyag ring zhing rgyas pa dang snyan shal ring zhing mnyam pa dang gsan pa dag pas snyan ma nyams pa ste bdun cu pa'o/ /dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang dbyes che ba dang dbu gdugs ltar rgyas pa dang dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa dang tshogs stug pa dang 'jam zhing phra ba dang ma 'dzings pa dang gyen du mi gshor ba dang dri zhim zhing yid 'phrog pa dang thugs ka dpal gyi be'u dang phyag zhabs bkra shis kyi rtags kyis brgyan pa ni brgyad cu pa'o/ /mchu ni bispa ltar dmar dang / /zhes pa la dag ldan las/ zhal gzugs gzugs brnyan 'byung ba dang / /zhes bton nas/ zhal zhes bya ba ni zhal gdong ste zhal gdong la gzugs kyi gzugs brnyan mnga' ba'o zhes zhal ras dwangs pa la phyi rol gyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba la bshad do/ /spyir long bu mi mngon pa dang zhabs mnyam pa dang rdzi ma stug pa 1036

sogs mtshan dpe gnyis kur bgrangs pa rnams mi zlos pa'i tshul mkhas pa rnams kyis bsam par rigs la rgyal ba'i gsung la ni nges par 'gal zlos mi srid do/ /spyir rang rgyal rnams la'ang mtshan dpe'i cha mthun tsam re dang gtsug tor yon por 'byung bar grags shing 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la mtshan dpe thams cad 'byung yang sangs rgyas las cung zad mi gsal zhing mi legs pa dang khyad par du mdzod spu rdzogs pa dang gtsug tor drang por 'phags shing spu 'khyil ltar mi mngon pa ni sangs rgyas kho na'i khyad chos te de'i phyir/ thub mtshan yul na gnas pa dang / /gsal la rdzogs pas 'phags pa yin/ /zhes so/ /phyag zhabs kyi ri mo'i mtshan ni 'jam dpal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs pa ste/ 'dzam gling gi mi thams cad dge ba bcu la zhugs pa'i bsod nams gcig tu bsdoms pas gling bzhi pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba gcig 'grub la gling bzhi pa'i mi thams cad 'khor bsgyur du gyur pa'i bsod nams kyis brgya byin gcigabargya byin de snyed kyi bsod nams stong 'gyur gyis bdud 'dod pa'i bdag po/ bdud de snyed kyi bsod nams brgya stong du bsgyur bas stong spyi phud kyi bdag po'i tshangs pa/ stong gi tshangs pa de snyed kyi bsod nams kyis stong gnyis bar ma'i tshangs pa/ de de snyed kyi bsod nams brgya stong du bsgyur bas stong gsum gyi tshangs pa dbang phyug chen po'i mchog gcigastong gsum gyi sems can tshangs pa der gyur pa'i bsod nams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas rang rgyal gcig phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad rang rgyal du gyur pa'i bsod nams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas 1037

srid mtha'i byang sems gcig nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i sems can yod do cog byang chub sems dpa' srid mtha' bar gyur pa'i bsod nams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig de ltar spu khung brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu/ de thams cad kyi bsod nams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas dpe byad bzang po gcigade ltar dpe byad brgyad cu/ de thams cad bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mar bsgyur bas rjes kyi ri mo'i mtshan brgyad cu por ri ste/ sdom ni/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dpal be'u/ /phreng ba kyo ba dang cod pan/ /dbyug tho bum pa glang chen rta/ 10/stag dang chu srin nya rus sbal/ /rma bya ka ping shang shang te'u/ /tsa sha ngur pa ne tso dang / 20/ngang pa thi ba nas sman mchog /'o ma ba men klu yi rgyal/ /ra dang khyu mchog ri yi dbang / 30/bil wa ljon shing kṛshī ra/ /nor bu ral gri rdo rje gzhu/ /mda' dang shaghi mdung rtse gsum/ 40/gshol stun sta re zhags pa gru/ /mu tig rgyan dang sprin chen dang / /tshangs pa dbang po yul 'khor srung / 50/chu lha 'phags skyes mig mi bzang / /nor sbyin drang srong chen po dang / /dpal dang nyi zla me dang rlung / 60/pad+ma g.yung drung gru gsum dang / /dge ba'i stan dang rnga yab dang / /durlu'i rtsa dang purga sha /o bu mo rnga bo che/ 70/dung dang mṛ ga gdub bu dang / /dpung rgyan rna cha sor gdub dang / /rna cha phyang phrul ldan pa dang / /me tog bzang po dpag bsam shing / /'khor lo dpung gi seng ge ste/ 80/ri mo'i mtshan ni brgyad cu ste/ /phyag zhabs re re'i mthil la'ang ldan/ /zhes bya ste 'di la dngos su brgyad cu rtsa gcig snang yang gtso 1038

che ba la dgongs nas brgyad cu zhes gsungs pa'am yang na rna cha gnyis gcig tu byas par snang la/ sit+ta gling na ston pa'i zhabs rjes bzhugs pa'i zhal bshus paṇ+ḍi ta chung ngu gcig gis khyer nas rje kurma pa bdun pa'i drung du phul zhing de'i don bsdus kyi bstan bcos chung ngu zhig kyang yod par snang yang bstan bcos de ma rnyed/ zhabs rjes de la 'di bas ri mo mang ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tshod dang lha gnas phal cher dang shang shang la mi 'am ci zhes dang bya mgo dkar zhig la shang shang te'u zhes yi ge btab cing grong khyer mang po dang zhabs sor gyi ne le'i tshab tu'ang dung gi rigs tha dad pa du ma re yod cing zhabs phan tshun la ri mo mi gcig pa'ang mang du snang ngo / /de'i rgyu bsdoms pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas mtshan bzang po gcig de ltar so gnyis/ rgyu de rnams grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgyur bas gsung chos kyi dung 'grub par gsungs so/ /stobs kyi khyad par ni thun mong gi mdo ltar na/ mi dang glang phal pa dang khyu mchog dang ba glang mo dang glang po che dang spos kyi glang po che dang tshan po che dang rab gnon dang sred med kyi bu rnams re re zhing snga ma bcu'i stobs phyi ma gcig la yod la de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshigs re la sred med kyi bu'i stobs re mnga' bar 'chad la/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs kyis/ mi dang glang dang glang sngon po dang glang po che phal pa dang glang po che 'jigs su rung ba dang glang po che mo 'dra ba dang dgon pa'i glang po che dang ri 'bigs byed kyi glang po che dang glang po che mtshon cha'i sder mo can dang glang po che gshol mda' 'dzin dang glang po che ting zil mdog 1039

dang glang po che gel pa dang glang po che sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang skya bo dang ku mu da mdog dang pad+ma dkar po'i mdog dang spos kyi glang po che dang spos glang chen po dang seng ge ral pa can thabs can dang tshan po che dang tshan po che chen po dang de bzhin du stobs mchog rab gnon dag gnyis gnyis dang sa bla'i lha'i bu dang de bzhin du gzhal med khang pa dang gshol mda' 'dzin dang phreng thogs dang rtag myos dang rgyal chen ris bzhi pa'i lha'i bu rnams re re zhing snga ma bcu'i stobs phyi ma re la yod do/ /ris bzhi pa'i lha'i bu thams cad kyi stobs lus ngan gcig de bcu sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i bu gcig sum cu rtsa gsum pa gzhan thams cad kyi stobs brgya byin gcig de bzhin du bsgres te 'thab bral dang rab 'thab bral/ dga' ldan dang yongs su dga' ldan/ 'phrul dga' dang rab 'phrul/ gzhan 'phrul dang dbang bsgyur/ bdud dang bdud kyi bdag po rnams snga ma bzhin dang / de nas bdud kyi lha'i bu thams cad bdud kyi bdag por gyur pa'i stobs bcur bsgyur bas sred med kyi bu phyed kyi stobs/ de phyin chad bcur bsgyur te sred med kyi bu gcig sred med kyi bu chen po gcig byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa brgya lon pa/ stong khri 'bum sa ya bye ba bye ba bcu bye ba brgya bye ba stong bye ba khri bye ba 'bum/ bye ba sa ya lon pa rnams re re zhing dang / de nas mi skye'i bzod thob sa bcu pa srid pa tha ma pa rnams rim par snga ma bcu'i stobs phyi ma re la yod cing srid pa tha ma pa de btsas ma thag sa la gom pa bdun 'bor ba de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis sa rdo rjer byin gyis ma 1040

rlabs na sa chen po dpag tshad drug khri zhom ste chu'i phung po las shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam 'phyur bar 'gyur ro/ /srid tha pa btsas ma thag pa bcu'i stobs ni byang chub sems dpa' lang tsho'i mchog la bab pa gcig ste stobs des byang chub kyi shing drung du 'gro'o/ /stobs de 'bum gyis byang chub kyi snying por 'dug go /de bas ches tshad med pa'i stobs kyis 'tshang rgya'o/ /sems can thams cad sems dpa' 'tshang rgya ma'i stobs ldan du gyur pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs gcig gi cha'i char yang mi bzod de de lta bu'i stobs bcu mnga' bar bsod nams yongs su bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las bshad la/ de bzhin du mdo gzhan las ba spu'i khung bu rer sred med kyi bu'i stobs re dang ba spu thams cad kyi stobs tshigs re dang de thams cad kyi stobs dpe byad gcig dang dpe byad thams cad kyi stobs mtshan sum cu'i re re dang de thams cad kyi stobs mdzod spu dang de brgyar bsgyur ba'i stobs gtsug tor du mnga' ba sogs rnam grangs du ma gsungs so/ /'od kyi khyad par ni spyir/ lung ston par bzhed pa'i tshe zhal 'dzum pa mdzad la chos nyid kyis nam 'dzum pa mdzad pa na zhal nas 'od shel dang gser dang dngul dang mthon ka la sogs pa'i kha dog can bye ba phrag du ma byung ste 'jig rten snang bar byed cing ngan song pa rnams des reg ma thag tshe 'phos te lha mir skye/ 'on long sogs kyi dbang po'i skyon sel 'du shes med pa pa sogs sad par byas te dge ba la 'god sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas par bya ba de rnams byas te slar 'dus nas sku la lan brgya stong du g.yas su bskor te gal te 'das 1041

pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na sku'i snam logs te rgyab dang ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na mdun dang / de bzhin du dmyal ba dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro dang lha min dang lha mi dang 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams su lung ston par bzhed na rim pas zhabs mthil dang zhabs rting dang long bu dang pus mo dang phyag mthil dang lte bar nub par 'gyur la nyan thos la zhal dang rang rgyal la smin mtshams dang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na gtsug tor du nub par 'gyur la rim gro bas de'i rgyu zhus te so sor lung ston par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang phal po cher mtshan rgya mtsho bshad pa yang 'od kyi bdag nyid du bshad la bye brag tu tshangs pa khyad par sems kyi mdor de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la lta nus pa dang chos 'dri nus pa sogs de thams cad 'od so sos reg pa'i mthu yin gyi gzhan du na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ni nyi ma ltar mig gis mi bzod cing me dpung chen po ltar sku la sus kyang bsnyen mi nus na dri bar lta ga la nus par bshad de/ de yang rab zhi rnam bkod kyi 'od kyis reg pas sku la lta nus shing mig gi dbang po mi nyams par byed do mi 'jigs pa spobs pa'i 'od kyis dri lan byed nus par byed do de bzhin du dge ba bsags pa dang dge ba rnam bkod dang bdag po thob pa dang nyon mongs med dang rtse gcig dben dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su dbang bskur thob pa rnams kyis reg pas rim pas 'khor bsgyur gyi ched dang tshangs pa'i phyir dang nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa 'dri bar nus so/ /khyad par du 'gro ba'i 'od kyis bzhud pa'i tshe zhabs 1042

mthil gyis reg pa'i srog chags rnams mtho ris su skye'o/ /rgyan tham sa cad bkod pa ni grong du gshegs pa'i tshe 'byin te thams cad bde ba'i mchog tu byed cing grong kun nas brgyan par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par 'thor ba dang bde ba ston pa dang byams pas 'phags dang rab tu tshim byed dang dri med dang rna ba'i rjes mthun dang rnam par spong ba dang ngo tsha shes pa dang med par 'gyur ba dang rab tu gtong ba dang yongs su gdung med dang phan ldan dang 'bar ba can dang rtse gcig pa dang ye shes dang rnyog med dang kun 'dzin dang spyod ldan dang skyo ba dang dga' ba dang snang ba can dang kun tu 'gro ba rnams kyis rim pa ltar 'jig rten mtha' yas pa g.yo ba dang dmyal ba dang byol song dang yi dwags zhi ba dang long ba la sogs pa mig dang rna ba sogs dag pa dang mi dge ba bcu spyod pa rnams de las ldog pa dang smyos pa rnams dran pa 'thob pa dang log lta can yang dag pa'i lta ba 'thob pa dang ser sna can sogs phar phyin drug po la rim par 'god pa dang ma dad pa rnams dad pa 'thob pa dang thos pa nyung ba rnams thos pa 'a thob pa dang bag med pa rnams ngo tsha she sa pa dang 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug la spyod pa rnams kyi dug gsum 'joms pa dang dug gsum cha mnyam pa la spyod pa'i cha mnyam pa spong ba'i bar byed la/ gzugs thams cad ston pa'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku kha dog sna tshogs dang kha dog tshad med par mthong bar byed de 'od zer las brtsams te bskal par gsungs kyang mi zad par bshad do/ /cho 'phrul gyi khyad par la spyir cho 'phrul gsum las sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul 1043

ni/ phyogs bzhi'i nam mkha' la spyod lam bzhi mdzad pa dang stod nas me 'bar smad nas chu 'brub pa sogs ya ma zung gi cho 'phrul dang nyi zla dang tshangs gnas kyi bar phyag gis nyul ba sogs ni drang srong nyan rang dang bcas pa'i thun mong gi cho 'phrul yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa ni mdzangs blun nas gsungs pa'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar gyi cho 'phrul lta bu ste gzhal du med do/ /bye brag tu dga' ldan nas 'pho ba'i lo brgya'i sngon du sku bltams pa'i gnas de lag mthil ltar mnyam pa dang rdo rje'i sa gzhir 'gyur ba dang rin po che'i shing gis khyab pa dang spos kyi sprin 'thul ba dang lha rdzas kyi mchod pas gang ba sogs ltas bcu 'byung ba nas gang gi gdugs la bltams pa'i tshe sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skye ba'i rnam 'phrul tshal der snang ba sogs 'pho ba dang bltams pa'i cho 'phrul nas bzung ste sku gdung ring srel gyi cho 'phrul gyi bar mdzad pa so so'i cho 'phrul mtha' yas pa dang / chos gsung ba na ljags kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'gebs pa dang chos kyi dbyings dgang ba sogs ljags kyi cho 'phrul dang /grong khyer du gshegs pa na ngam grog dang tsher ma sogs med la lag mthil ltar mnyam zhing rtsa 'jam pos khebs pa dang mdun rol du spos chu'i char 'bab steng du sprin gyi bla re 'bre rgyab sogs su nyi 'od gsal g.yas g.yon nas tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis rnga yab g.yob cing lha dang mis bskor te gshegs shing grong khyer gang gi them pa la zhabs bzhag ma thag grong khyer rnam pa drug tu g.yo zhing rol mo thams cad ma bkrol bar sgra 'byin btson du bcings pa dang sgrog tu bcug pa thams cad rang grol long ba rnams 1044

mig 'bye 'on pa rnams rna ba dag smyos pa rnams dran pa rnyed gnyid kyis log pa rnams sad de thams cad dge ba'i bsam pa rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang zhabs sa la sor bzhis mi reg la 'on kyang lam bar gyi srin bu phra mo rnams kyi steng du'ang zhabs 'bab la des sngon ma myong ba'i bde bas zhag bdun 'da' zhing lhar skye ba sogs grong du gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul dang /bsod snyoms bzhes pa na mang du 'bul bar 'dod pa rnams ni kun+ta pa na bye ba mang po'i 'bras chan yang lhung bzed du mi dog par shong la nyung ngu las mi 'byor ba rnams ni 'bras chan gyi zegs ma tsam phul bas kyang yongs su gang bar mthong zhing bza' ba dang btung ba dang ldag pa'i bye brag brgya stong mang po lhung bzed du blugs kyang phan tshun gcig la gcig ma reg cing ma 'dres la gos pa med pa snod tha dad na gnas pa ltar 'gyur la/de gang gi tshe'ang lhung bzed kyi tshad snga ma las mi 'gyur ba 'di ni lhung bzed kyi cho 'phrul lo/ /gzhan yang rigs chen po las rab tu byung ba rnams kyi nga rgyal spang ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i dge 'dun rnams 'tsho bas mi 'phongs pa'i ched dang 'di dag gi ston pa yang bsod snyoms spyod na 'di dag lta ci smos zhes skye bo rnams sbyin par sems pa skye ba'i ched dang sbyin pa po rnams kyi bsod nams spel ba'i ched dang rab byung rnams 'tsho ba'i ched du zang zing 'dzin pa spang ba'i ched dang grong du gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul gyis gdul ba rnams rjes su bzung ba'i ched dang pha ma dang khyo la sogs pas bsrungs pa'i rigs kyi bu dang bu mo gces pa rnams kyis mthong ba don yod pa'i ched dang lha rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 1045

'od kyi gong bu lta bu nang sbubs stong mi mnga' zhing long ka sogs med pa rdo rje ltar mkhregs pa mthong nas 'di ni bkres skom sogs med cing gsol bar mi byed mod kyang sems can la snying brtse ba kho nas bsod snyoms la rgyu'o zhes dad pa skye ba dang 'bul ba po dag ni ston pas bdag gi bsod snyoms longs spyad do snyam nas dga' ba skye la ston pa ni bzhes par mi mdzad mod kyang 'bul ba po la bsod nams tshad med pa 'thob cing kha zas de gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu zhig gis rin po che'i gzhong par khyer te sangs rgyas med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du song nas sems can rnams tshim par byed cing de zos so cog phyir mi ldog pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dang sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi tshul dang mtshungs pa ste dgos pa bcu las bsod snyoms la gshegs par ston la 'di yang khyad par gyi cho 'phrul gcig go /de bzhin du skye bo bye ba phrag mang pos re res kyang bla gos brgya stong snyed sku la gsol yang thug par yang mi mngon nang ma shos kyang sku la sor bzhis mi reg la rnam par 'thor rlung gis kyang g.yo mi nus pa na bza'i cho 'phrul te de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa rnams ni sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul te de la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis ni rdzu 'phrul dngos te des 'dul ba na rdzu 'phrul mdzad la/ gzhan de dag ni ched du sprul ba ma yin te rang bzhin gyis ston pa'i chos nyid yin yang rigs mthun bsdu ba tsam gyis cho 'phrul dad par bsdus pa tsam mo/ /brjod du med cing gang gis kyang brjod par mi nus pa'i chos rnams la chos kyi rnam grangs sna tshogs su brjod pas gdul bya rnams brjod du med 1046

pa'i don rtogs pa la 'god pa ni cho 'phrul bla na med pa ste/ tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa'i mdo las/ shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das kyis ming dang mtshan ma med pa'i chos ming dang mtshan mas bstan cing brjod du med pa'i chos brjod par mdzad pa ni ches ngo mtshar to zhes gsol bas de de bzhin no zhes slar nam mkha' la ri mo gsal ba dang ri rab zos nas zhu ba dang me 'bar ba'i khyim du rtsa khur cher thogs te ma tshig par 'byung 'jug byed pa dang rdo'i gzings sa gzhi tsam gyis rgya mtsho brgal ba dang gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten khyer nas sbrang ma'i byin skas las tshangs ris su 'dzeg pa dang rlung gis bsgul ba'i srad bu phra mos ri rab btags te nam mkha' la 'dzin pa dang stong gsum du gaṅgā tsam gyi char rgyun 'bab pa thigs pa gcig kyang sa la ma lhung bar bzed pa dang stong gsum du ri rab tsam gyi rdo char bab pa de ltar bzed pa dang mchil ma'i zer ma gcig gis sreg bskal bzhil te dbugs gcig gis 'jig rten slar dgod pa dang lag mthil gcig tu sems can thams cad bkod cing gcig shos kyis stong gsum gyen du btegs nas sems can de thams cad blo gcig tu byed pa bas kyang mngon par 'du byed pa med pa dang 'byung ba med pa dang mtshan ma med pa dang mtshan nyid med pa dang bstan du med pa la de bzhin gshegs pas chos bstan pa gang yin pa 'di ni ches ngo mtshar bar gsungs la/ dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhi dang ldan pa'i gsung mnga' ba ste/ dkon mchog brtsegs par/ rnam pa drug cu rtsa bzhi gang zhe na mnyen pa'i gsung 'byung ba dang zhes sogs gsungs pa sdom tshig tu 1047

sbyar na/ 1/mnyen 'jam yid 'ong yid 'thad ngag /dri med 'od gsal 'jebs mnyan 'os/ /mi tshugs snyan dul mi rtsub dang / /mi brlang rab dul rna bar snyan/ /lus sems tshim byed snying dga' byed/ /dga' zhing bde ba skyed par byed/2 /yongs su mi gdung kun shes bya/ /rnam par rig bya rnam par gsal/ /dga' dang mngon paradaga' bar byed/ /kun tu shes byed rnam rig byed/ /rigs pa dang 'brel zlos skyon med/ 3 /seng ge'i nga ro'i shugs dang ldan/ /glang chen sgra dang 'brug gi dbyangs/ /klu dang dri za ka ping dbyangs/ /tshangs dbyangs shang shang te'u'i dbyangs/ /lha dbang dbyangs dang rnga yi sgra/ sam khengs pa dang mi dma' dang / /sgra rnams kun gyi rjes su zhugs/ /tshig zur ma chad ldab ldib med/ /ma tshang med cing ma zhum dang / /mi zhan rab dga' khyab pa dang / /chub dang rgyun chags 'brel ba dang / /sgra rnams thams cad rdzogs par byed/ /dbang po thams cad tshim byed dang / /ma dmad mi 'gyur ma tabs dang / /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor kun tu grag /'dod chags zhi byed zhe sdang 'dul/ /gti mug sel byed bdud tshar gcod/ /rnam pa kun mchog ldan pa'i gsung / /yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /zhes bya la bu ston rin po ches drug cu kho na yin gyi rtsa bzhi ma dag go zhes gsung yang mdo nyid las re bzhir bshad pas skyon med la/ snying rje chen po nges bstan gyi mdo las ni/ 'bras bu yod pa'i chos ston pa dang zhes sogs de bas mang bar gsungs te/ sdom ni/ 'bras yod chos ston nges tshig smra/ /khyad par lung ston kun shes byed/ /rnam par shes byed mtho dman med/ /ya yo ldab ldib gya gyu med/ /mi brlang mi rtsub 1048

ma 'chol ba/ /'jam mnyen las rung ngar ngar min/ /byung rgyal ma yi rab tu brtags/ /ha cang myur min shin tu phye/ /shin tu nges tshig shin dga' bskyed/ /shin snyan shin tu gdangs ches snyan/ /shin gsal thags thogs med cing rdzogs/ /snyan 'bol bsgrags mdzes mchod par gyur/ /rdul med rdul bral thal ba med/ /dri med dri bral rmongs pa med/ /shin tu zur phyin chags pa med/ /rab grol 'od gsal drang mi dman/ /ma 'dzings bde skyed dab dib min/ /lus tshim sems kyang dga' bar byed/ /dug gsum sdig sel bdud kyang 'joms/ /rgol 'dul rnam par shes par byed/ /mkhas pa dga' byed rnga'i sgra ldan/ /ka ping brgya byin tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs sgra gnod sbyin sgra/ /sa yi sgra dbyangs khrung khrung sgra/ /rma bya khu byug shang shang te'u/ /ngang rgyal seng ge rol mo'i dbyangs/ /kun shes byed cing rab shes byed/ /yid 'ong mnyan 'os rdzun min zab/ /rna ba bde byed dge rtsa skyed/ /tshig yig ma nyams tshig yig ni/ /shin tu nges tshig ldan don ldan/ /chos ldan dus ldan dus tshigs ni/ /kun ldan dus las mi yol ba/ /mchog dang mchog min dbang po ston/ /sbyin pas brgyan zhing tshul khrims kyis/ /rnam dag bzod pas yang dag bsgrubs/ /brtson pas shin sbyangs bsam gtan gyis/ /las su rung byas shes rab kyis/ /nges par brtags shing byams pas brtsams/ /snying rjes mi skyo dga' ba yis/ /'od gsal btang snyoms kyis nges brtags/ /theg gsum rnam 'jog dkon mchog gi /rigs rgyun mi gcod phung po gsum/ /rnam 'byed rnam thar gsum gyis sbyangs/ /bden dang ye shes kyis yongs bsgos/ /mkhas pas ma 1049
