ba dang 'gro ba dang sems can dang zhing dang chos dang nam mkha' dang dus gsum dang 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas dang spyad pa'i sgra thams cad kyi rjes su song ba de bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag kyang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas skye ba thams cad du rgyas par khyab par gyur cig /ces sogs bzhi ba thams cad du rjes su song ba'i sngo ba dang / gang ji snyed du sngon gyi 'das pa'i dus 'byams klas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams shin tu bstan pa grangs las 'das pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyis thugs su chud pa rnams su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan yongs su dag pa byung ba dang zhes sogs lnga pa bsod nams mi zad pa'i sngo ba ste 'di'i tshigs bcad du/ las kyi rnam pa gang gis skye ldan zhing / /rang bzhin gang dang mtshan nyid gang yin dang / /de na ci 'dra'i chos nyid yod pa dag /de bzhin de dag dag par yongs su bsngo/ /zhes kyang bshad do/ /zas ster ba na sems can thams cad ye shes kyi kha zas dang chags pa med pa'i zas dang dga' ba'i zas dang zang zing med pa'i zas dang ye shes kyis 'tsho ba chos kyis 'tsho ba dge ba'i rtsa bas yongs su bzung ba'i chos kyi sku dang ye shes kyi sku la yang dag par spyod pas byin pa'i gnas gang dang snying brtse ba'i kha zas rab tu len par gyur cig ces sogs drug pa dge ba thams cad dang mnyam nyid kyi rjes su song ba ste 'dir yang /chos nyid kun tu 'gro ba ji 'dra ba/ /de bzhin de dag yongs su sngo bar bgyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /sems can thams cad kyi re ba rdzogs pa'i phyir sngo'o zhes sogs bdun pa 'gro ba thams cad dang mnyam nyid kyi rjes 1259

su song ba'i sngo ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang gnyis su med pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la tshul gyis rgyud gcig tu gyur pas 'di ltar sngo ste zhes brgyad pa de bzhin nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin du sngo ba dang / 'dir yang / de bzhin nyid kyi mtshan nyid ci 'dra dang / /de bzhin nyid kyi ngang tshul ji 'dra dang / /de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin ji 'dra ba/ /de 'drar las rnams kun kyang yongs su sngo/ /zhes so/ /'di ltar chags pa dang grol zhing bcings pa med pa'i sems su kun tu bzang po'i lus rab tu grub par gyur cig ces sogs dgu pa chags pa dang bcings grol med pa'i sngo ba dang / sangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyis yang dag par dgongs te 'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod par gyur cig de ji lta bar 'jig rten gyi khams chos dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa ma lus pa thams cad du yang byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod par gyur cig ces sogs bcu pa chos dbyings tshad med pa'i yongs su sngo ba yin la/ 'dir/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan rgyal bas gang gsungs pa/ /yongs sngo dam pa mchog dang phul yang yin/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gsungs par bstan to/ /des na/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan rang nyid kyis/ /byas dang byed 'gyur byed pa rnams/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje rgyal mtshan nyid kyi gzhung yin par 'bru gnyer ba'ang glegs bam de bskal don du gyur pa'i bshad pa'o/ /mdor na de lta bu'i tshul rnams kyis sngo zhing mthar bden pa'i stobs brjod pas brtan par bya'o/ /bod snga rabs pa rnams sngo ba'i tshe gtor ma gtong ba dang chu 1260

rgyun sbreng ba'i lag len byung ba la rje sa paṇa gyis nan gyis 'gog mod kyang spyir rgya gar na sbyin pa pos byin zin pa dang len pa pos blangs zin pa'i tshad shes pa'i phyir sbyin yul gyi lag mthil g.yas par til dang gser cung zad blugs te sbyin pa pos ril ba nas chu rgyun de'i steng du blug pa ni byin zin pa dang blangs zin pa'i tshad yin te za ma tog gi mdo las sprul pa'i mi'u thung gis chu rgyun gser dang til bcas blangs par bshad pa dang / rgyal byed kyi tshal 'bul ba'i tshe khyim bdag gis ril ba'i chu rgyun blugs pa na thogs nas 'byung du ma btub pas ston pas sa phyogs de khyod kyis sngon de bzhin gshegs pa drug la phul zin gyis phyogs gzhan du brims shig gsungs te der chu rgyun byung bar gsungs pa yin no/ /des na bod phyi rabs na srol 'di mi snang yang mnga' bdag khri ral gyis gsar bcad mdzad dus bre srang yan rgya gar dbus dang bstun par bshad pas srol 'di yod srid cing / de min na'ang paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis rgya gar gyi lugs byed pa byung nas yon dbul ba dang sngo ba byed pa bar gzhan gyis ma chod par 'byung bas sngon yon phul ba'i tha tshig tu grags pa de byas pa la sngo ba la dgos par phyis go ba 'byams pa yin srid mod kyang 'di ni byas kyang rgya gar gyi yul srol byas par 'gyur la ma byas kyang don ci yang chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis/ sngo ba dngos dang / bka' drin dran pa'i phyag gis bstan bcos kyi mtha' bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ gtso bor gzhan don du sngo ba/ zhar la rang don du sngo ba/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i don du sngo ba'o/ /dang po gzhan don du sngo ba la 1261

yang 'gro ba phal ba'i don du sngo ba dang / mchog gi don du sngo ba'o/ /dang po la spyir sngo ba/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal zhi bar sngo ba/ mtho ris pa'i sdug bsngal zhi bar sngo ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag gis byang chub spyod pa la/ /'jug pa rnam par brtsams pa yi/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun/ /byang chub spyod la 'jug par shog /phyogs rnams kun na lus dang sems/ /sdug bsngal nad pa ji snyed pa/ /de dag bdag gi bsod nams kyis/ /bde dga' rgya mtsho 'thob par shog /de dag sangs rgyas bde thob kyi/ /bar du bde las nyams ma gyur/ /'gro ba bla na med pa yi/ /bde ba rgyun mi 'chad par shog /ces gsungs te/ dang pos sems can thams cad byang chub kyi lam du 'jug par bsngos/ gnyis pas sems can gyi nad zhi bar bsngos/tha mas thams cad phan bde 'thob par bsngos pa'o/ /de yang slob dpon nyid kyis mdo bstan bcos thams cad kyi snying po 'di lta bu skabs de nyid du gzhung 'don pa'i tshul gyis thogs med du brtsams pa 'dis ni theg chen gyi sde snod rgya mtsho chen po lta bur 'jug par mi nus pa rnams kyis kyang 'di lta bu thos pa'i mod la yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems theg chen gyi ngo bo 'thob par 'gyur la gang zag gcig kho na byang chub kyi sems la bzhag pa'i phan yon yang mtha' med na 'gro ba mtha' yas pa lta ci smos te de'i phyir bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gzhal du med pa chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gsungs pa'i dus de kho nar yang thob pa de nyid sngo rgyu'i gtso bor byas te dge ba de yi mthus sems can theg chen du ma zhugs pa thams cad kyang byang chub kyi spyod pa 'di lta bu la 1262

'jug cing zhugs pa rnams slar mi ldog par gong nas gong du 'jug par gyur cig pa'o/ /bye brag tu lus sems sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i nad pa thams cad dge ba 'di'i mthus nad thams cad ldang ba med par zhi ste lus rnal du phebs pas bde ba dang sems rnal du phebs pas dga' ba chen po 'thob par gyur cig /de dag gi dga' bde de yang sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du mi nyams bar gong du 'phel zhing mdor na 'gro ba thams cad kyang bla na med pa srid zhi las 'das pa'i zag med kyi bde ba 'thob cing mi nyams la rtag tu des 'tsho bar gyur cig pa'o/ /'di ni de'i dus yams nad mi ngas kyi 'tshe ba zhig yod pa zhi byed du gtso bor dgongs pa 'dra la spyir sems can thams cad gtan du ma rig pa'i gcong gis zin zhing de las dug gsum gyi kun ldang skye la des rlung mkhris bad dzin skyed cing de gsum cha ma snyoms pa dang 'phel zad 'khrugs pa la nad du grags shing mi la ni nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir zad mod kyang dud 'gro nas mnar med pa'i bar la snga ma brgya stong phrag mang por bsgyur ba'i nad phyi ma phyi ma la rim pas yod pa'i phyir rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sgo nas sems can spyi'i don du sngo bar bshad kyang rung ngo / /gser gling pas gtso bo'i don so drug gi tshe sngo le'i tshigs bcad dang po gsum gyis sngo le mtha' dag bsdus la/bcu gcig tu bkral tshe tshigs bcad dang po kho nas bsdus te bshad do/ /gnyis pa la spyi'i don dang gzhung gi don to/ /dang po la dmyal ba ni na ra ka zhes sdug bsngal drug pos dmyal thag bcad pa'i phyir dmyal ba zhes bya'o/ /gnas ni 'dzam gling 'di'i 'og dpag tshad nyi khri gzhal ba na 1263

mnar med kyi dmyal ba yod la de'i steng na gzhan bdun po yod de/ mdzod las/ 'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na/ /mnar med pa'o de tsam mo/ /de yi steng na dmyal ba bdun/ /zhes so/ /de la theg dman gyi mngon par mnar med kyi rgya 'phangs gnyi gar dpag tshad nyi khri re yod la/ theg chen du ni tshad med de myang 'das chen por mtshams med brgyad byas pa'i dmyal ba pa'i lus la yang dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pa dang / phal chen las theg chen la skur ba btab pa'i dmyal ba pa'i lce la yang dpag tshad 'bum yod par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye ba ni thun mong ba ltar na tsha dmyal brgyad grang dmyal brgyad nyi tshe nye 'khor te bcu drug go /sdug bsngal gyi khyad par ni yang sos su sems can mthong tshad dgra mi sha bo lta bur mthong zhing blangs tshad mtshon du gyur pas phan tshun bsnun te 'chi la de ma thag las kyi rlung grang mo'am sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra las skad cig gis sos te yang sngar ltar kho na byed do/ /thig nag tu ni gshin rjes lus la thig nag po mtha' yas par btab ste lcags sreg gi sog le dang sta re dang ste'u sog le me 'bar bas gshag gtub gzhog la stod gshags pa na smad kyi rma 'tsho la smad gshags pa na stod sos te sdug bsngal ba'o/ /bsdus 'joms ni lcags kyi ri chen po srog chags sna tshogs pa'i gdong can cha lang ltar 'thab pa'i bar du lus phye mar byed cing ri gyes pa na lus 'tsho la yang ri 'thab pas 'joms pa'o/ /ngu 'bod pa lcags bsregs kyi khang par sreg pa dang / ngu 'bod chen po lcags khang nyis rim la sogs par sreg go /tsha ba pa lcags bsregs kyi phru bar lcags khus 'tshed pa dang / rab tu tsha ba 1264

pa lcags bsregs kyis bsad cing rtse gsum pas smad nas 'bugs shing nang thams cad mer 'bar bas ba spu thams cad nas me lce 'byung ba dang lcags leb me 'bar bas dkri ba dang keng rus tsam lus pa na lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi la bkram pas sha skye zhing yang 'tshed pa sogs dang /mnar med du lcags khang rim pa mtha' yas pa'i nang du mun pa'i rang bzhin gyi me lce nag pos sreg cing sreg bzhin pa de nyid las lcags bsregs kyi zhib mar me dang lhan cig 'bru ltar bkrab pa dang rngo ba dang lcags bsregs kyi rang 'thag la 'thag pa dang lce brgyangs nas lcags bsregs kyi rmon pa dor stong la sogs pas rmo ba sogs mtha' yas te sdug bsngal la bar mtshams skad cig kyang med pa'i phyir mnar med pa zhes bya la 'di'i sdug bsngal ji lta bar thos na lha mi su yang khrag bskyugs te 'chi bas ji bzhin du ma gsungs par bshad la/ spyir mi'i me dang khor yug gi me dang dus mtha'i me rnams snga ma las bdun 'gyur gyis phyi ma tsha la de las yang sos kyi me bdun 'gyur gyis tsha zhing de bzhin mnar med kyi bar du bdun 'gyur gyis 'og ma 'og ma tsha la/ dmyal ba 'og ma 'og ma la gong ma gong ma'i sdug bsngal thams cad tshang bar yod kyi steng du rang gnas kyi sdug bsngal de lhag por myong ngo / /nad kyang mi'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi brgyar bsgyur ba'i nad dud 'gro dang de stong du bsgyur ba yi dwags la yod cing de thams cad bye ba mang por bsgyur ba yang sos dang de mtha' yas pa rim par bsgyur ba 'og ma 'og ma la tshang bar yod do/ /nyen kor pa ni mngon pa ltar na tsha dmyal brgyad po'i phyogs bzhi po re re 1265

na me ma mur pus nub tsam gyi sa gzhi dang / ro myags mi gtsang ba'i 'dam 'bu mchu rnon gyis gang ba dang / spu gri'i so gtams pa rtswa ltar skyes shing ral gri'i lo ma can gyi nags tshal dang / khro chu khol ma'i chu bo rab med de lhag pa'i 'khor bzhi bzhi yod pas tsha dmyal re re la 'khor bcu drug ste/ brgyad po kun la lhag bcu drug /me ma mur dang ro myags 'dam/ /spu gri'i lam sogs chu bo yin/ /zhes so/ /tsha dmyal gtso bo las thar yang de dag tu me ma mur la rkang pa bzhag pa na rus par 'gro la bteg pa na sha gsar pa gzhon sha can skye ba dang / 'dam du tshud de 'bu rnams kyis rus pa thams cad 'bugs pa dang / spu gris rkang pa gcod cing bteg pa na sos pa dang shing grib la 'khod pa na las kyi rlung gis ral gri rnams lhung bas lus phye mar byed cing yang sos pa dang / 'gyur byed kyi chu bor lhung ste 'tshed cing lcags bsregs kyi nya bo che za ba dang /gshin rjes lcags bsregs kyi nya rgya dang lcags kyus bshar nas lcags bsregs kyi gzhir rngod pa rnams lo mtha' yas par myong ngo / /tshe tshad ni mi lo lnga bcu zhag dang de sum cu la zla ba de bcu gnyis lor byas pa'i lo lnga brgya ni lha rgyal chen ris bzhi pa'i tshe yin la/ de bzhin du gong ma nyis 'gyur du bsgres pas sum cu rtsa gsum pa mi lo brgya la zhag tu byas pa'i lo stong / 'thab bral ba nyis brgya la zhag tu byas pa'i lo nyis stong / dga' ldan pa mi lo bzhi brgya la zhag tu byas pa'i lo bzhi stong / 'phrul dga' ba mi lo brgyad brgya la zhag tu byas pa'i lo brgyad stong / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa mi lo stong dang drug brgya la zhag tu byas pa'i lo khri drug stong rnams 1266

so so'i tshe tshad yin la/ de las rgyal chen ris bzhi'i tshe tshad la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i lo lnga brgya yang sos pa'i tshe tshad nas/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i tshe tshad la zhag tu byas pa'i lo khri drug stong tsha ba pa'i tshe tshad yin la/ rab tu tsha bas bar bskal phyed/ mnar med kyis bar bskal gcig yin te/ mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la/ 'dod lha 'og ma'i nyin zhag gcig /de yis tshe lo lnga brgya'o/ /gong ma gnyis ka nyis 'gyur nyid/ /yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ /'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ /de yis de dag rnams kyi tshe/ /'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin/ /rab tu tsha phyed mnar med ni/ /bar gyi bskal pa'o/ /zhes so/ /'di'i zhar las tsha ba'i tshe tshad ni bar bskal gyi bzhi cha yin par yang don gyis thob pas da lta'i bskal pa 'di'i bar bskal gyi tshad kyang shes nus te de lta na/ khrag khrig che gcig khrag khrig gsum/ /ther 'bum che gnyis ther 'bum bdun/ /dung phyur gcig dang sa ya bzhi'i/ /mi lo bar bskal gcig yin no/ /zhes bya'o/ /grang dmyal ni chu bur can dang chu bur rdol ba can dang a chu dang kyi hud zer ba dang so tham tham pa dang ut+pal dang pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po ltar gas pa dang rnam pa brgyad de/ chu bur can sogs grang brgyad gzhan/ /zhes so/ /gnas ni spyir ri bo gangs can gyi 'og na yod par bshad la/sdug bsngal ni ming dang mthun pa ste tha ma ni shin tu dmar la lus bye ba la sogs par gas pa'o/ /tshe tshad ni ma ga dha'i til khal brgyad cu pa'i bang ba nas lo brgya re la til 'bru re phyung bas zad pa ni chu bur can gyi tshe yin la de nyi shu chu bur rdol ba can gyi tshe dang de bzhin du nyi shus bsgyur 1267

ba 'og ma 'og ma'i tshe ste tha ma'i tshe la ni til sbyang ther 'bum gcig dang dung phyur gnyis bye brgyad yod do/ /nyi tshe ba ni mya ngam gyi thang dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram sogs gnas ma nges par sdug bsngal ma nges pa sna tshogs myong ba tshe tshad kyang ma nges pa ste gro bzhin skyes dang dge 'dun 'tsho dang dpal skyes kyis gzigs pa lta bu'o/ /dran pa nyer bzhag las ni rtsa ba bzhi chang chos la dmad pa rgyu 'bras la log par bltas pa mtshams med rnams thams cad spyad pa mnar med kyi rgyu nas srog gcod gcig pu yang sos kyi rgyu'i bar dang / de so so la nang tshan gyi byed las kyis dmyal ba re re la 'khor bcu drug po/ mi gtsang 'dam dang lcags kyis bsgyur/ /slong 'tshed gnod pa ma zhi dang / /mun pa kun tu mi dga' ba/ /tshor ba bde dang nad thams cad/ /mtshon 'bab gnod pa drag po dang / /ne le nag 'dra gzhan gyur dang / /sdug bsngal gyis gnod pad+ma'i phreng / /'tshe'u dang gnod pa bdo ba ste/ /yang sos 'khor ni bcu drug yin/ /zhes sogs tha dad par bshad do/ /yi dwags la yang pri ta zhes bkres shing gdung bas na yi dwags zhes bya la gnas ni dpag tshad lnga brgya'i sa 'og na yi dwags kyi grong khyer chen po ser skya zhes pa na gtso bor gnas shing kha 'thor ba mya ngam gyi thang sogs sna tshogs na yod la gtso bo rnams gshin rjer gtogs pa gzhan srog gis 'tsho ba dang phal ba rnams phyi'i sgrib pa can la sogs pa ste/ tā la ya thog bskams 'dra'i yi dwags gzugs/ /bltas pa tsam gyis chu klung rgyun skem zhing / /ljon shing 'bras bu med 'gyur de dag go /zhes sogs kyi sdug bsngal myong ba/ tshe tshad mi'i zla ba la zhag tu byas pa'i lo lnga brgya ste/ 1268

zla ba nyin zhag gi lnga brgya/ /zhes so/ /dud 'gro ni tsār+ya ka zhes dud cing 'gro bas na de skad bya la gnas ni gtso bo rgya mtsho chen po yin la kha 'thor ba ngan song dang mtho ris phal cher na yod la dbye na rkang mang rkang bzhi rkang gnyis rkang med bzhir thar rgyan las gsungs so/ /sdug bsngal ni klu rnams la longs spyod lha lta bu yod kyang bye tshan gyi char zhag re la dus gsum du 'bab pas lus sreg pa dang nam mkha' lding gis za ba sogs yod la spyir dud 'gro rnams che bas chung ba za zhing chung bas che ba 'bugs pa sogs rtag tu dgra kho na'i nang na gnas la tshe tshad ring ba bskal pa'i tshe dang phra mo kha cig nyin re la lan khri la sogs par skye 'chi byed pa yod do/ /de ltar ngan song pa rnams de tsam du sdug bsngal la skyob pa su yang med pas dge ba'i mthus de rnams kyi sdug bsngal zhi ba'i ched du bsngos pa'o/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don ni/ 'jig rten khams na dmyal ba dag /gang dag ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /de dag du ni lus can rnams/ /bde chen bde bas dga' bar shog /grang bas nyam thag dro thob shog /byang chub sems dpa'i sprin chen las/ /byung ba'i chu bo mtha' yas kyis/ /tsha bas nyam thag bsil bar shog /ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal yang / /de la dga' tshal sdug gur shog /shal ma li yi sdong po dag /dpag bsam shing du 'khrungs par shog /'thing ril ngur pa dag dang ngang pa dang / /bzhad sogs skad snyan 'byin pas mdzes gyur cing / /pad+ma dri bsung che ldan mtsho dag gis/ /dmyal ba'i sa phyogs dag ni nyams dgar shog /sol phung de yang rin chen phung por gyur/ /sa sreg shel gyi sa gzhi bstar bar shog /1269

bsdus 'joms ri bo rnams kyang mchod pa'i sprin/ /gzhal med khang gyur bde gshegs gang bar shog /mdag ma rdo bsregs mtshon gyi char pa yang / /deng nas bzung ste me tog char par gyur/ /phan tshun mtshon gyis 'debs pa de yang ni/ /deng nas rtse phyir me tog 'phen par shog /chu bo rab med me dong 'dra nang bying ba dag /sha kun zhig gyur rus gong me tog kun da'i mdog /bdag gi dge ba'i stobs kyis lha yi lus thob nas/ /lha mo rnams dang dal gyis lhan cig 'bab gnas shog /ci phyir 'di na gshin rje'i ming dang khwa dang bya rgod mi bzad rnam skrag byed/ /kun nas mun bsal bde dga' bskyed pa'i mthu bzang 'di ko su yi mthu snyam ste/ /gyen du bltas pas nam mkha'i dkyil na phyag na rdo rje 'bar ba bzhugs mthong nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i shugs kyis sdig dang bral nas de dang lhan cig 'grogs par shog /me tog char pa spos chu dang 'dres bab pa yis/ /dmyal ba'i me mdag chil chil gsod pa mthong gyur nas/ /glo bur bde bas tshim pa 'di ci bsams pa dang / /sems dmyal rnams kyis phyag na pad+ma mthong bar shog /grogs dag 'jigs pa bor la rings par tshur shog yu bu'i thad du ni/ /gang gi mthu yis sdug bsngal thams cad bral zhing dga' ba'i shugs phyin la/ /'gro ba kun skyob byang chub sems dpa' de dang brtse ba skyes gyur pa/ /gzhon nu zur phud can 'bar 'jigs pa med par byed pa ci zhig byon/ /khyod kyis lha brgya'i cod pan dag gis zhabs kyi pad+ma la mchod cing / /thugs rjes brlan spyan dbu la me tog du ma'i tshogs kyi char 'bab pa/ /khang brtsegs yid 'ong lha mo stong phrag bstod dbyangs 1270

sgrog ldan 'di ltos zhes/ /'jam dbyangs de 'dra mthong nas da ni sems dmyal ca co 'don par shog /de ltar bdag gi dge rtsas kun tu bzang la sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa med sprin bde ba dang / /bsil zhing dri zhim ngad ldang char pa 'bebs mthong nas/ /sems can dmyal ba de dag mngon par dga' gyur cig /dud 'gro rnams ni gcig la gcig /za ba'i 'jigs dang bral bar shog /sgra mi snyan pa'i mi bzhin du/ /yi dwags rnams ni bde gyur cig /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ /yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas shing / /khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /zhes tshigs bcad bcu gnyis kyis dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar bsngos pa ste de'i yang tshigs bcad dang pos 'jig rten thams cad kyi dmyal ba pa yod do cog gi spyi'i sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / tshig rkang gcig gis de las grang dmyal pa'i sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / tshig rkang gsum gyis tsha dmyal pa spyi'i sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / ral gri sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis nyen kor pa'i don dang / mthing ril sogs phyed dang gnyis kyis khyad par mnar med pa'i don dang / de nas gcig gis bsdus 'joms pa'i don dang / phyed kyis yang sos pa'i don te de rnams kyi sdug bsngal rang bzhin gyis zhi bar bsngos pa yin la/ slar yang chu bo sogs kyi tshigs bcad kyis slob dpon nyid kyi dge ba'i mthus sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / gcig gis phyag na rdo rje'i mthu dang / me tog sogs gcig gis spyan ras gzigs kyi mthu dang / grogs dag sogs gnyis kyis 'jam dbyangs kyi mthu dang / de ltar sogs tha mas byang chub 1271

sems dpa' gzhan thams cad kyi mthus zhi bar bsngos pa'o/ /de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / tshigs bcad phyed dang gnyis kyis yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar bsngos pa'o/ /de dag gzhan ni rtogs par sla la byang chub sems dpa'i mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu las sprin chen po glo bur du byung ba'i char gyis dmyal me gzhil ba dang / mthing ril dang bzhad dkar ni chu bya'i rnam grangs te dmyal ba'i sa gzhi thams cad pad+ma'i mtsho bsil ba chu bya dang bcas par gyur cig pa'o/ /gzhan stobs kyis zhi bar byed pa ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis sngon/ bdag gis ngan song gnas la phyogs gyur na/ /ngan song gnas rnams zhig cing stongs gyur cig /ces sogs kyi smon lam mdzad pa grub pa dang / tir med pa skems pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu las ngan 'gro stongs par mdzad pa ste za ma tog bkod pa las/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de dmyal ba mnar med par zhugs ma thag tu lcags khang thams cad ni zhig dmyal ba'i phru chen rnams ni 'thor me ni zhi ste rdzing bu bsil bar gyur dmyal ba pa de rnams skad cig gis tshe 'phos pas dmyal srung rnams gshin rje'i mdun du dong nas sems can dmyal ba 'dir skyes bu 'dod pa'i gzugs can zhig 'ongs ma thag bdag cag gi las kyis bsab par gyur to zhes gsol zhing gshin rje'i rgyal pos bltas na spyan ras gzigs bzhugs par mthong nas bstod cing phyag btsal ba dang / de nas spyan ras gzigs yi dwags kyi yul du song ba dang yi dwags kha nas me 'ab ra ba yan lag 'jag ma ltar phra ba lus ri bo tsam 1272

pa rdul gyi grangs tsam bdag cag bkres so skom mo zhes de'i mdun na rgyug pa dang des phyag zhabs kyi sor mo bcu las chu bo chen po bcu phab ste yi dwags de rnams kyis mang du 'thungs pas bkres skom zhi ste bde ba can du byang chub sems dpa' 'dod pa sbyin pa zhes ming mthun par skad cig la skyes par gsungs pa lta bu ste spyan ras gzigs ji lta ba de ltar phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa rgyal sras de thams cad kyis re re zhing yang ngan 'gro 'don pa'i phrin las de lta bu mdzad par gyur cig pa'o/ /sgra mi snyan pa'i mi bzhin zhes pa ni/ byang sgra mi snyan na ngag 'khyal ma gtogs spong ba drug po med pa dang gos dang rgyan dang longs spyod thams cad dpag bsam gyi shing las 'byung bas bdag gir bya ba med pa dang lo stong 'tsho zhing glo bur du 'chi ba med pa dang 'chi ba'i zhag bdun ma gtogs nad med cing mi dge ba'i mtshams sbyor med pas shi nas kyang lha mi gang rung du skye ba'i phyir gling gzhan la ltos na bde ba'i phyir dper byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa gtso bor mtho ris pa'i don du sngo ba la gnyis las dang po rgud pa zhi bar sngo ba ni/ long ba rnams kyis mig mthong zhing / /'on pas rtag tu sgra thos shog /lha mo sgyu 'phrul bzhin du ni/ /sbrum ma'ang gnod med btsa' bar shog /gcer bu rnams kyis gos dag dang / /bkres pa rnams kyis zas dag dang / /skom pa rnams kyis chu dag dang / /btung ba zhim po 'thob par shog /bkren pa rnams kyis nor 'thob shog /mya ngan nyam thag dga' 'thob shog /yi chad rnams kyang yi sos shing / /brtan pa phun sum tshogs par shog /sems can nad pa ji snyed pa/ /myur du nad las thar bar 1273

gyur/ /'gro ba'i nad ni ma lus pa/ /rtag tu 'byung ba med par shog /skrag pa rnams ni 'jigs med shog /bcings pa rnams ni grol bar gyur/ /mthu med rnams ni mthu ldan zhing / /phan tshun sems ni mnyen gyur cig /mgron po dag ni thams cad la/ /phyogs rnams thams cad bde bar shog /gang gi don du 'gro byed pa/ /de 'bad mi dgos grub gyur cig /gru dang gru chen zhugs pa rnams/ /yid la bsams pa grub gyur te/ /chu yi ngogs su bder phyin nas/ /gnyen dang lhan cig dga' bar shog /mya ngam lam gol 'khyams pa rnams/ /mgron po dag dang phrad gyur nas/ /chom rkun stag sogs 'jigs med par/ /mi ngal bde blag 'dong bar shog /dgon sogs lam med nyam nga bar/ /byis pa rgan po mgon med pa/ /gnyid log myos shing rab myos rnams/ /lha dag srung bar byed par shog /ces gsungs te/ tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis long 'on sogs dbang po skyon ldan rnams kyi dbang po'i skyon rab rib sogs zhi nas dbang po yongs su dag pa mig gsal ba dang rna ba gsang ba dang smra mkhas pa dang dran pa dang ldan pa sogs 'thob par gyur cig pa'o/ /de nas tshig rkang gnyis ni sbrum ma rnams ni ma bu gnyi gar shin tu sdug bsngal zhing btsa' ba'i tshe ma'i lus kyi tshigs rnams 'byed pa'i zug rngu dang btsa' ba po ni lcags bsregs kyi 'jur mig nas drangs pa ltar sdug bsngal la gnyi ga 'tsho 'chi phyed ma'i skabs yin pas de gnyi ga btsa' ba'i zug rngu med pas btsa' zhing 'tsho bar gyur cig pa'o/ /gcer bu sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis ni gos dang mal cha dang zas skom gyis 'phongs pa rnams kyis de dag phun sum 1274

tshogs pa rnyed par gyur cig pa'o/ /de nas tshig rkang gcig gis dbul pos longs spyod rnyed pa dang / gcig gis mdza' bshes dang bral ba la sogs pa'i mya ngan zhi ba dang / tshig rkang gnyis kyis sro shi zhing yi chad pa rnams kyi sems kyi re ba rdzogs pas yi sos par gyur cig pa'o/ /de nas tshigs bcad gcig gis nad byung ba zhi zhing su la yang nad mi 'byung bar gyur cig pa'o/ /de nas tshig rkang gcig gis me dang chu dang sbrul dang thog dang gcan gzan gtum po dang sha za dang chom rkun dang chad pa sogs 'jigs pa brgyad dam bcu drug gis skrag pa rnams 'jigs pa las thar ba'i don dang / gcig gis btson du bcings pa rnams bde bar 'thar ba dang / gnyis kyis lus sems kyi mthu chung ba rnams mthu stobs dang ldan la des dregs pa med par sems mnyen zhing dge bar gyur cig pa'o/ /de nas tshigs bcad gsum ni lam du zhugs pa'i mgron po rnams kyi don du sngo ba ste/ dang pos de thams cad lam du 'jigs pa med cing bde bar bgrod la don tshegs chung ngus grub pa'i ched dang / gnyis pas gaṅgā la sogs pa brgal ba'i phyir gru'i bye brag rnams su zhugs pa dang rgya mtsho'i gru bo cher zhugs te 'dod pa rnams ni khyad par du srog la dogs pa che bas de dag gi gru nye zho med cing bsams pa grub nas rang gnas su phyin pa'i tshe dang / tha mas mya ngam gyi thang dang dgon dung tsha sgo can la sogs par lam 'khyams te ci bya gtol med pa rnams lam ston pa dang grogs dang 'phrad cing bde bar phyin par bsngos pa ste ngal zhing dub la slar 'jigs pas nyen pa 'di dag shin tu snying rje ba'i phyir ro/ /tshigs bcad phyi mas 1275

ni dbul po sogs slong ba'i ched dang kha cig gzhan gyi bran du gyur pas ba lang sogs 'tsho ba'i phyir dgon pa nyam nga bar gcig pus 'dug pa dang gnyid kyis log pa dang gang dag chang gis ra ro bas 'phyan pa de dag lha dag gis bsrungs te gnod sbyin dang sha zas 'tshe ba med par gyur cig pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'byor ba phun sum tshogs par sngo ba ni/ mi dal kun las thar ba dang / /dad dang shes rab brtser ldan zhing / /zas dang spyod pa phun tshogs nas/ /rtag tu tshe rabs dran gyur cig /thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du/ /longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med pa/ /rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /sems can gzi brjid chung ngu dag /de dag gzi brjid chen por shog /dka' thub can gang gzugs ngan pa/ /gzugs bzang phun sum tshogs gyur cig /'jig rten bud med ji snyed pa/ /de dag skyes pa nyid gyur cig /ma rabs rnams ni mtho thob cing / /nga rgyal dag kyang bcom par shog /bdag gi bsod nams 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad ma lus pa/ /sdig pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /rtag tu dge ba byed par shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing / /byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing / /bdud kyi las kyang spong bar shog /sems can de dag thams cad ni/ /tshe yang dpag med ring bar shog /rtag tu bde bar 'tsho 'gyur zhing / /'chi ba'i sgra yang grag ma gyur/ /dpag bsam shing gi skyed mos tshal/ /sangs rgyas dang ni sangs rgyas sras/ /chos nyan sgrogs pas gang ba yis/ /phyogs rnams thams cad gang bar shog /thams cad du 1276

yang sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang / /lag mthil ltar mnyam baiḍūr+ya'i/ /rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yod rgur yang / /byang chub sems dpa' mang po dag /rang gi legs pas sa steng dag /brgyan par mdzad pas bzhugs gyur cig /lus can kun gyis bya dang ni/ /shing dang 'od zer thams cad dang / /nam mkha' las kyang chos kyi sgra/ /rgyun mi 'chad par thos par shog /de dag rtag tu sangs rgyas dang / /sangs rgyas sras dang phrad gyur cig /mchod pa'i sprin ni mtha' yas pas/ /'gro ba'i bla ma mchod par shog /lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing / /lo tog phun sum tshogs par shog /rgyal po chos bzhin byed gyur cig /'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog /sman rnams mthu dang ldan pa dang / /gsang sngags bzlas brjod 'grub par shog /mkha' 'gro srin po la sogs pa/ /snying rje'i sems dang ldan gyur cig /sems can 'ga' yang sdug ma gyur/ /sdig par ma gyur na ma gyur/ /'jigs dang brnyas par mi 'gyur zhing / /'ga' yang yid mi bde ma gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ dang pos thams cad dal 'byor gnyis dang ldan zhing tshe rabs dran pa'i mngon shes dang ldan par bsngos/ gnyis pas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod ni nam mkha' las ci bsams pa 'byung zhing zad pa med pa ltar thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin dang de las byung ba nam mkha'i mdzod 'thob par bsngos/ gsum pas gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par bsngos/ de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis bud med rnams skyes pa'i dngos po 'thob pa dang gnyis kyis ma rabs kyi 1277

gnas las 'da' bar bsngos pa ste bud med ni phal cher gzhan dbang du gyur pa dang snying stobs chung ba dang nyon mongs pa mang zhing gnyen po chung la nad kyang skyes pa las so gnyis kyis mang ba dang mngal 'dzin pa'i sdug bsngal che zhing bud med kyi rten la sangs rgyas dang 'khor los bsgyur ba dang rang sangs rgyas dang brgya byin dang 'jig rten skyong ba ste mchog lnga mi 'byung la rten gyi gtso bo skyes pa kho na yin la bud med rab tu byung bas bstan pa lo lnga brgya 'gribs pas na de dag bud med kyi dngos po las 'da' ba'i phyir dang / ma rabs gdol pa la sogs pa rnams dmad pa'i las spangs te mthon por 'gyur zhing 'on kyang ma rabs la mthon po'i gnas byung ba phal cher ni nga rgyal che zhing gnas min gyi bya ba byed pas rang gzhan gnyis brlag pa wa skyes la dud 'gro'i rgyal bo'i gnas byung ba lta bu mang bas na de dag mthon po thob kyang nga rgyal med par gyur cig par bsngos pa'o/ /de nas tshigs bcad gsum gyis thams cad dge sdig gi blang dor tshul bzhin du byed pa dang / theg chen du zhugs te bdud las spong ba dang / mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun tshang zhing tshe phun sum tshogs par rim pas bsngos pa ste de rnams ni gtso bor sems can yongs su smin pa'i don du bsngos pa yang yin no/ /de nas/ dpag bsam shing gi skyed mos tshal/ /la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhis ni gnas thams cad phun sum tshogs par sngo ba ste dang pos 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dpag bsam gyi shing gos dang rgyan dang bza' btung gi 'byung gnas ci 'dod blang du yod pas gang ba skyed mos tshal ltar yid du 'ong ba sangs 1278

rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chos sgrog pas gang bar gyur cig pa dang /gnyis pas sa phal pa dang mtho dman sogs med par lag mthil ltar mnyam pa'i baiḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi gser gyis mig mang ris su bris pa reg na 'jam pa'i rtsa rma bya'i mgrin pa'i mdog can gyis khebs par gyur cig pa dang / gsum pas de thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' mtshan dpe rdzogs pas gang zhing brgyan par gyur cig pa dang / bzhi pas nam mkhas klas pa'i zhing de thams cad du 'byung ba bzhi dang nam mkha' las chos kyi sgra rtag par 'byung zhing sems can thams cad smin par gyur cig pa ste 'di rnams ni slob dpon nyid kyi zhing dag sbyor dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong ba'i smon lam yang yin no/ /'di man ni 'jig rten thams cad phun sum tshogs par sngo ba ste/ tshigs bcad dang pos sems can thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad cing mchod pa'i las la brtson par gyur cig pa dang / rkang pa gnyis kyis char dus su 'bab cing lo tog dang 'brus 'byor ba dang / rkang pa gcig gis chos bzhin gyi rgyal po sha stag 'byung ba dang / lhag mas rgyu de dag las lha mi'i 'gro ba mang du 'phel zhing dar bar gyur cig pa'o/ /sman rnams kyi rkang pa gcig gis sman dang 'bru bcud thams cad bcud che zhing nus pa dang ldan pa'i ched dang / gcig gis phan byed kyi gsang sngags sgrub pa po rnams kyang ngag nus dang ldan zhing rig pa de myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba'i ched dang / gnyis kyis sha za dang gnod sbyin dang srin po rnams gdug pa'i sems zhi zhing khyad par mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba phra men pho mo nyin par mi'i lus su 1279

gnas shing mtshan mo rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro bas gzhan la gnod pa byed pa 'di la rgya gar na 'jigs pa chen por lta ba'i phyir de rnams kyi gdug rtsub zhi zhing snying rje dang ldan par sngo ba'o/ /tshigs bcad tha mas ni mdor na su yang rung ste/ sems can 'ga' yang sdug ma gyur/ /sdig par ma gyur na ma gyur/ /'jigs dang brnyas par mi 'gyur zhing/ /'ga' yang yid mi bde bar ma gyur cig /ces don bsdus pa ste/ 'di'i tshig rkang gnyis pa 'di glegs bam phal la chad snang bas nges par gzhug go /gnyis pa mchog gi don du sngo ba ni/ gtsug lag khang rnams klog pa dang / /kha ton gyis rgyas legs gnas shog /rtag tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang / dge 'dun don yang 'grub par shog /bslab pa 'dod pa'i dge slong dag /dben pa dag kyang 'thob par shog /g.yeng ba thams cad spangs nas ni/ /sems ni las rung sgom gyur cig /dge slong ma rnams rnyed ldan zhing / /'thab dang gnod pa spong bar shog /de bzhin rab tu byung ba kun/ /tshul khrims nyams pa med gyur cig /tshul khrims 'chal bas yid byung nas/ /rtag tu sdig pa zad byed shog /bde 'gro dag kyang thob gyur nas/ /der yang brtul zhugs mi nyams shog /mkhas pa rnams ni bkur ba dang / /bsod snyoms dag kyang rnyed par shog /rgyud ni yongs su dag pa dang / /phyogs rnams kun tu grags par shog /ngan song sdug bsngal mi myong zhing / /dka' ba spyad pa med par yang / /lha las lhag pa'i lus kyis ni/ /de dag sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog /sems can kun gyis lan mang du/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod byed cing / /sangs rgyas bde ba bsam yas 1280

kyis/ /rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni/ /'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa/ /sems can rnams la bde 'byor shog /de bzhin rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /nyan thos rnams kyang bde gyur cig /ces gsungs te/de yang tshigs bcad dang pos ni dge 'dun gnas bcas kyi don du bsngos pa ste de yang gtsug lag ni gzhung lugs kyi ming gi rnam grangs yin la de 'dzin pa'i gang zag gi gnas ni gtsug lag khang pa zhes bya'o/ /bod phyi rabs 'di na 'dul ba'i lung sde bzhi'i glegs bam bzhugs na gtsug lag khang yin no zhes mkhas par rlom pa mtha' dag gis mgrin gcig tu sgrog cing blun po dag gis de'i rjes zlos byed mod kyang de dag gis ni 'dul ba mi shes par gsal te 'di ni nyer dga'i gtsug lag khang ngo 'di ni dga' bo'i 'o 'di ni kho bo'i gtsug lag khang ste zhes brang khang la gtsug lag khang du bshad pa ma thos par zad cing / phyi rol ba'i gtsug lag khang zhes bshad pa rnams dran par byos shig /mdor na chos 'di ba'i theg pa che chung gi gtsug lag khang dang gtsug lag khang chen po dang khyams dang bkad sa dang dgon pa'i bsti gnas la sogs pa de thams cad du rab tu byung ba klog pa po rnams sde snod gsum po klog pa'i kha thon byed pas gang zhing rgyas la bsam gtan pa'i gnas rnams su bsam gtan la shin tu mnyam par bzhag pa rnams kyis gang ba dang / de thams cad du dge 'dun rnams mthun pa dang mi phyed pa 'o ma dang 'o ma gcig tu 'dres pa lta bur gyur pas ston pa'i bstan pa gsal bar byed cing klog pa las rig 1281

grol gyi spobs pa thob cing bsam gtan las 'bras bu bzhi dang sa bcu sogs thob pas dge 'dun de thams cad kyi bslab pa gsum gyi don mthar phyin pa grub par gyur cig pa ste sngon ston pa nyid la sbrid pa byung ba na skye rgu'i bdag mo go ta mis bcom ldan 'das ring du 'tsho bar gyur cig ces brjod pa 'og min gyi bar du grags pa na ston pas de skad ces mi brjod par dge 'dun mthun par gyur cig ces brjod par bya ste nga ni dge 'dun mthun pa nyid bzhed do zhes gsungs pas 'di ni ston pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs par byed pa'i smon lam yang yin no/ /tshigs bcad gnyis pas dge slong gi don du spyir sngo ba ste spyir slong mos 'tsho ba la dge slong du bzhag pa slong ba'i phyir dge slong dang ming gi dge slong ming gang dge slong zhes bya ba dang khas 'che ba'i dge slong bram ze la sogs pa bdag cag dge slong dang dge sbyong dang bram ze 'o zhes khas 'che ba la dge slong du bzhag pa dang / rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing / /sogs zag pa zad pa la dge slong du byas pa ste spyir rnam grangs bzhi dang / de las chos 'di ba'i gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa gang yin pa de ni don 'dir dge slong yin par dgongs so zhes pa ltar dge slong gi sdom pa thob la ma nyams pa ni skabs 'di'i dge slong yin te dge slong ma zur du bkar nas bshad pa dang bslab pa 'dod pa zhes pa'i mthu las so/ /de ltar bslab pa gsum 'dod pa'i dge slong rnams kyi bslab pa dag pa'i rgyu ni lus ngag 'du 'dzis dben pa dang sems rnam g.yeng gis dben pa yin pas lus sems kyi dben pa thob par gyur cig 1282

pa ste dag sgra'i gnyis tshig gis lus sems kyi dben pa gnyis 'dren to/ /g.yeng ba spong ba'i tshig gis ni dben pa de gnyis gsal bar byed pa ste lus kyi g.yeng ba bya ba sna tshogs pa dang dag gi g.yeng ba bre mo dang ngag 'khyal ba dang sems kyi g.yeng ba yul la sems pa thams cad spangs nas sems dul zhing las su rung bas 'du shes nyi shu dang byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang sgyu ma lta bu dang nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin sgom par gyur cig pa'o/ /tshigs bcad gsum pas dge slong ma'i don du bsngos pa ste dge slong ma rnams ni 'khor gyi gtso bo ma yin pa'i phyir yo byad rnyed par dka' zhing rnyed pa chung ba'i phyir dge slong nyer dga' dgra bcom ma ut+pala'i mdog can las ras zung bzang po blangs pas ut+pala'i mdog can chos gos kyis 'phongs pa'i tshe 'di ltar bud med ni rnyed pa chung zhing tshegs chen pos 'tsho ba yin pas dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa las dge slong gis gos slong bar mi bya'o zhes bcas pa mdzad pa'o/ /des na dge slong ma rnams ni chos gos dang bsod snyoms la sogs pa'i rnyed pa chen po dang ldan zhing rnyed sla bar gyur cig pa'o/ /bud med ni rang bzhin gyis 'thab dkrol la dga' zhing zas la gdu ba'i phyir ston pas de gnyis las byung ba'i bslab pa sor bshags dang lhag ma mang du bcas pa ste de'i phyir dge slong ma rnams 'thab dkrol spong zhing rgyud 'jam por gyur cig pa'o/ /de nas tshigs bcad phyed dang gnyis kyis rab byung spyi'i don du bsngos pa ste mdor na rab tu byung ba ni tshul khrims kho nas phye ba yin pas de thams cad tshul khrims dang ldan zhing mi nyams pa dang / tshul 'chal gyis yid 1283

byung ste sems shin tu gtsang bas gnas pas zag pa zad pa 'thob pa dang / gal te zag pa ma zad par shi 'phos na yang tshul khrims kyi mthus bde 'gro lha mi gang rung du skye zhing der yang sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pas 'dod pa la mi 'jug par lha rnams kyi lha'i drang srong du 'gyur ba'am mi rnams su khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste shi 'phos kyang snga ma'i brtul zhugs nyams pa med par gyur cig pa'o/ /'di la skye ba snga ma ji srid 'tsho'i bar khas blangs pa'i dus kyi cha phyogs gcig btang yang spong sems kyi ngo bo ma nyams pa ste bar do dang skye ba phyi ma la yang bdag dge slong ste 'di lta bu byar mi rung ngo zhes dran pa dang shes bzhin rgyun mi chad pas snga ma'i brtul zhugs ma nyams pa zhes bya'o/ /gal te phyi mar brtul zhugs ma nyams par yod na snga ma'i sdom pa ji srid 'tsho bar gyi sdom par 'gal lo zhe na/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar khas blangs pa 'di ni 'jig rten na nga ma shi'i bar zhes yun ring ba'i mthar 'jog pa ltar ji srid 'tsho'i bar khas len na de tshun gyi gnas skabs gzhan la lta ci smos zhes nyan thos rang lugs nas yun ring ba'i phyir mthar bzhag pa ste sangs ma rgyas kyi bar len pa lta bu ni blor ma shong bas rang gi blor shong tshod kyi dus kyi ring mtha' khas blangs pa yin gyi/ bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar srung la shi nas mi srung ngo zhes rnam bcad byas pa ma yin pa 'di go bar gyis shig de nas tshigs bcad gnyis kyis mkhas pa'i don du bye brag tu bsngos pa ste/ spyir shes bya la mkhas pa'i rgyu ni skye ba snga ma rnams su mang du sbyangs pa dang chos kyi sbyin pa byas pa dang tshe 'dir skye bas thob pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa'am 1284

mi ldan yang rung ste dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten zhing dka' bas sbyangs pa rnams ni mkhas par 'gyur ba'i rgyu yin la/ rnyed pa'i rgyu ni tshe rabs gzhan du sbyin pa btang ba las 'byung zhing / bkur sti'i rgyu yang tshe rabs gzhan du pha ma dang bla ma'i gnas la bkur sti byas pa dang gzhan khyad du ma bsad cing nga rgyal spang ba las byung ba'i phyir mkhas pa 'thob dang rnyed bkur 'thob pa ni rgyu tha dad yin pas mkhas pa rnyed bkur dang mi ldan pa yod la/ de'i tshe kha cig kho bo lta bu la rnyed bkur mi 'bul bar blun po 'di dang 'di la 'bul lo zhes nga rgyal dang phrag dog dang zhum pa cig char skyed pa du ma yod pas de'i phyir rig gnas chung ba lnga tsam shes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chung ba'am/ rig gnas dang khyad par sde snod gsum dang theg pa chen po'i sde snod dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho lta bu shes pa'i mkhas pa rnams la so so la ji 'tsham pa'i bkur sti mthon po'i go 'phang la 'jog cing skye bos 'dud pa dang longs spyod kyi rnyed pa chen po dang ldan par gyur cig pa'o/ /ji ltar mu ge'i dus gzhon nu ma skyes dgras lhas byin 'khor bcas la shing rta lnga brgya kha zas bsod pas gang bas rtag tu mchod cing rdzu 'phrul ma thob pa'i dge slong rnams 'tsho bas phongs pa'i tshe ston pas lhas byin gyi rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni sba dang spyig ma'i 'bru dang dre'u mo sbrum pa lta bur blta bar bya ste skye bo ngan pa ni rnyed pa dang bkur stis phung bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa ltar yon tan shes sam mi shes kyang rung ste skye bo rang bzhin ngan pa kha cig ni rnyed bkur cung zad thob na rigs ngan mdun na 'don gyi stan la bzhag pa ltar dregs shing rang gzhan phung bar byed pa 1285

yod pas de'i phyir mkhas pa rnams rnyed bkur thob kyang nga rgyal dang phrag dog med par rgyud yongs su dag cing mkhas pa'i grags pa 'thob par gyur cig pa'o/ /de la mkhas pa yang dag pa ni chos kyi tshad 'dzin par mi byed la rgyu 'bras la mkhas pa'i phyir chos spong dang gang zag la dmod par mi byed mod kyang phyogs res khengs pa kha cig ni gzhan thams cad la ba lang ltar lta zhing rtsod pa dang rtsom pa na yang tshig rtsub rnam smin mi bzad pa 'byung ba mang du 'phen la chos spong dang gang zag spong ba'i las cher gsog cing rgyu des phyi mar ngan 'gro'i gnas mi bzad pa len pa yod pas de rnams la dgongs nas mkhas pa de dag ngan song du mi ltung zhing phyi mar yang dal ba 'thob la brtson pa med par yang byang chub myur du 'thob par gyur cig pa'o/ /de nas gcig gis sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bsngos pa ste sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par byed cing de yi 'bras bu bde ba dam pa 'thob par gyur cig pa'o/ /de nas gcig gis rgyal ba dang rgyal sras rnams kyi bzhed pa rdzogs par bsngos pa ste/ de rnams kyi bzhed pa'i gtso bo ni 'gro ba'i don kho na yin pas de ji ltar dgongs pa de bzhin du grub par gyur cig pa'o/ /de bzhin du mgon po sangs rgyas rnams kyis ji ltar dgongs pa'i phrin las de nyid sems can rnams la bde zhing gya nom pas 'byor bar gyur cig pa'o/ /tshig rkang tha ma gnyis kyis nyan rang gi don du bsngos pa ste sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa na 'jig rten na yon gnas gcig pu bar gyur pa sngon sangs rgyas med pa'i zhing khams stong par skye ba dang gdul bya la lus 1286

kyis chos ston gyi ngag gis mi ston pa dang slob dpon med par rang gis byang chub mngon du byed par gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam chen po gsum btab cing tshogs bsags pas sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa med pa'i dus su srid pa tha ma la mir skyes nas skyo bas mkhan slob med par rtags rang gis blangs nas rab tu byung zhing rten 'brel lugs 'byung ldog la brtags pas srid pa'i sred pa zad pas rang gis byang chub 'bring po mngon du byas pa ni rang sangs rgyas ste sngon bskal pa nyi shur tshogs bsags pa tshogs spyod chung ngu dang lnga bcur bsags pa chen po dang de'i bar ci rigs bsags pa 'bring ste tshogs spyod kyi rang rgyal gsum ni nags sam gtsug lag khang sogs na dge 'dun gyi sde'i tshul du bzhugs la dpon slob kyi rnam par bzhag pa ni med do/ /bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags pa ni bse ru lta bu dbang po rnon po ste nags na gcig pu kho nar gnas so/ /'di dag ni bsod snyoms spyod cing bsod snyoms phul ba rnams kyis dge ba mtha' yas pa skyed la dad pa rnams kyi dga' ba spel ba dang ma dad pa rnams 'gyod pa skyed pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul ston zhing rnag gi lus kyis skyo ba'i phyir ha cang ring du mi bzhugs par cho 'phrul dang bcas te mya ngan las 'da'o/ /nyan thos ni shra wa ka zhes thos pa sgrog pa'i phyir nyan thos zhes bya la spyir nyan thos ni slob ma'i ming gi rnam grangs kyang yin pas gcer bu pa'i nyan thos zhes sogs phyi rol pa la yang tha snyad yod do/ /nang pa'i nyan thos la ni lam la zhugs pa'i nyan thos dang grub mtha' khas len gyi nyan thos gnyis yin la lnga sde dang nye ba'i lnga sde dang 'od srung sogs ston 1287

pa'i 'khor stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge 'dun nam lnga stong gi dge 'dun ni gtso bo yin la ston pa bzhugs dus nas bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun gyi bar mtha' yas pa byung ba rnams ni dgra bcom thob pa shas che la/ gzhan yang rgyun zhugs dang lan gcig phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong ba rnams kyi zhugs gnas gang rung thob pa shas che bas 'phags pa'i nyan thos zhes bya la/ 'di dag bye mdo'i grub mtha' smra bar ma nges te 'phags pa rab 'byor sher phyin ston pa'i mchog tu bshad pa dang mdo sde chen po rnams na de rnams kyis theg chen gyi chos bstan pa ches mang zhing rnal 'byor rgyud man chad kyi dkyil 'khor du yang chud pas rgyud sde dag phal cher gyi gleng gzhir yod pa dang / bla med kyi'ang sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud nyan pa'i 'khor du bshad pa dang gsang sngags byin gyi rlob par yang byed de 'dus pa rin po che'i tog las bdud gzhon nu lnga bcu lnga bcus nyan thos chen po bzhi la dge sbyor glu longs shig gar byos shig ces kyal ka byas pa na sngon ma thos pa'i glu blang ngo zhes/ phung po dag gis shin tu chog /ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang gsang sngags smras pas bdud de dag btul bar bshad pa dang dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do zhes sogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ de yang 'bras bu bzhi ni nyan thos kyi mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug thob pa gzhir byas nas de'i steng nas sgom spang spangs tshul gyis khyad par du byas pa yin te de la 'dod khams kyi nyon mongs chen po'i che 'bring chung gsum 'bring gi che 'bring chung gsum chung ngu'i che 'bring chung gsum ste 'dod nyon dgu/ de bzhin du bsam gtan 1288

bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi re re la dgu dgu ste sgom pas spang bya'i nyon mongs brgyad bcu rtsa gcig ni spang bya'o/ /de la mthong lam kho na thob la 'di dag las gang yang ma spangs shing spong bar yang mi rtsom na nyan thos mthong lam pa kho na yin gyi 'bras bu bzhi gang la yang zhugs pa dang gnas pa gang yang ma yin no/ /'on kyang drang srong nyi ra/ gung pa 'khor bcas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i gsol ba byas pas mthong lam dang phyir mi 'ong lhan cig tu thob pa lta bu la dgongs nas/ bcu drug pa la de 'bras gnas/ /zhes 'chad pa yin no/ /'dod nyon chen po skor gsum spong ba'i phyir brtson pa dang khyad par de'i bar chad med lam la gnas pa ni 'bras bu dang po rgyun zhugs la zhugs pa'i phyir rgyun zhugs zhugs pa zhes bya la 'dod nyon gsum pa spangs pa'i rnam grol lam thob pa de'i tshe rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob pa yin la 'di la dbang brtul srid pa lan bdun pa zhes bya ba lha'i skye srid bar srid bdun re mi'i skye srid bar srid bdun re ste srid pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad na sngon lha mi gang gi rten la mthong lam thob pa de'i rten gyis dgra bcom 'thob pa dang / dbang 'bring rigs gnas rigs skye ste lha mi'i skye srid bar srid gnyis res sngar ltar dgra bcom 'thob pa dang / dbang rnon rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par can tshe de nyid la sgom spang lhag ma cig char du spangs nas dgra bcom 'thob pa'o/ /spyir rang lam gyi sgom spang mngon gyur pa ma spangs na 'bras bu de thob par mi 'jog ste mthong spang ma spangs na mthong lam par mi 'jog pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang tsa ma po ba rnams kyis sa bon ma spangs pa'i phyir/1289

'bras gnas sgom spang bya ma zad/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /'dod nyon drug pa'i spong gnyen la zhugs pa phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang de spangs pa lan gcig phyir 'ong ste 'dod khams su skye ba phyi ma gcig len pa'i phyir de skad ces bya la phyi ma de nyid la dgra bcom 'thob pa ni phyir 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa ces bya'o/ /'dod nyon dgu pa'i spong gnyen la gnas pa ni phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa dang de spangs pa'i rnam grol lam thob pa ni phyir mi 'ong ste 'dod khams su skye ba mi len pa'i phyir de skad ces bya la/ gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams kyi rten la mya ngan las 'da' ba skyes nas 'da' ba dang / gzugs med na bar do med cing gzugs kyi bar srid kyi rten la 'da' ba bar 'da' ba dang / de re re la yang 'bad rtsol yod med kyis mngon par 'du byed pa dang bcas de 'da' ba dang 'du byed pa med par 'da' ba gnyis te phyir mi 'ong 'da' ba rnams dang / tshangs ris nas tshangs chen du skye ba sogs bar du re re bzhag cing skye ba 'phar ba dang / de nas 'od chung de nas tshad med 'od sogs kyi rim pas phyed 'phar zhing phyed mi 'phar bas skye ba phyed 'phar dang / thams cad du go rim gyis skye ba gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba ste gong 'pho gsum/ mthong chos la zhi ba dang lus kyis mngon sum du byed pa gnyis te phyir mi 'ong rnams so/ /srid nyon dgu pa zhes bya ba srid rtse'i nyon mongs chung ngu'i chung ngu'i spong gnyen bar chad med lam la gnas pa ni dgra bcom zhugs pa dang de spangs pa'i rnam grol lam thob pa ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob pa ste 'di la dbang brtul shes rab 1290

rkyang pas grol ba ni mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul med pa'i phyir rgyan med ces bya la/ 'di las dbang po rnon por 'pho mi nus pa ni gnas pa las mi bskyod pa'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa yin la/ mthar gnas snyoms 'jug dgu sgrub nus pa ni rtogs pa'i 'os su gyur pa'i dgra bcom pa yin no/ /dbang rnon ni mthar gnas snyoms 'jug brgyad thob cing shes rab kyis grol ba ni bsam gtan bzhi pa na mngon shes kyi lam yod la de thob pa'i phyir dgra bcom pa rgyan can zhes bya la/ nyams pa'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa ni kha cig dgra bcom gyi spangs rtogs gnyi ga las nyams pa dang re re las nyams pa sogs 'dod kyang 'di ni mthong chos bder gnas las nyams pa tshe dang ldan pa moṅgal gyi bu mthar kun tu rgyus bkrong nges kyi las yod pa lta bu mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa la 'jog go /de lta bu'i dgra bcom pa kha ci ga de'i sngun du mya ngan las 'da' ba ni bdag gsod pa'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa dang / de lta bu kha cig dbang po bsdams te bdag nyid srung ba yod pas rjes su srung ba'i dgra bcom pa zhes 'jog pa yin no/ /'di rnams mthar thug theg gsum du 'jog pa drang don gyi mdo'i lugs kyis theg pa gsum las chung ngur zhugs pa ste dgra bcom pa slar yang srid mi len par 'chad do/ /mthar thug theg gcig tu rnam par bzhag pa nges don gyi mdo rnams su theg chen nyid kyi cha re la nyan rang gi theg par ming btags shing byang chub sems dpa' nyid la nyan thos kyi sgrar bshad pa yin gyi theg chen kho na las gzhan pa'i theg pa med par 'chad do/ /'di'i tshe rgyang chub kyi rgyun la zhugs pas rgyun 1291

zhugs zhes sogs dgongs pas bstan par phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdo dam chos pad+ma dkar po las rgyas par bshad do/ /grub mtha' khas len gyi nyan thos spyir sde pa bco brgyad dang khyad par bye brag tu smra ba dang mdo sde pa ste gong du bstan zin to/ /de lta bu'i nyan rang de dag srid pa'i 'jigs pa med pas mya ngan las 'das pa rnam par grol ba'i bde ba dang ldan pa yin mod kyang dgra bcom pa rnams kyang sdug bsngal gyi phung po'i lhag ma zhes bya ba sku tshe 'di'i phung po lnga ma spangs pa de srid phung po la gshed ma mtshon thogs pa phyi bzhin 'brang ba dang khams bzhi la sbrul gdug bzhi phrag la thogs pa ltar 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis kun tu 'jigs pas/ 'bru mar gang ba'i snod bskur te/ /zhes sogs ltar nyam nga ba yod pas de dang bral te bsam gtan dang rnam par thar ba'i bde bas tshim par gyur cig pa'i don to/ /skabs 'dir/ lha dang lha min mi rnams yid/ /gus bcas rtag tu mchod par shog /ces pa rgya dpe la yod do zhes lo tsā ba kha cig 'chad do/ /gnyis pa zhar la rang don du sngo ba ni/ bdag kyang 'jam dbyangs bka' drin gyis/ /sa rab dga' ba thob bar du/ /rtag tu tshe rabs dran pa dang / /rab tu 'byung ba 'thob par shog /bdag ni kha zas gyi nas kyang / /nyam dang ldan zhing 'tsho bar shog /tshe rabs kun tu dben gnas pa/ /phun sum ldan pa thob gyur cig /gang tshe lta bar 'dod pa'am/ /cung zad 'dri bar 'dod na yang / /mgon po 'jam dbyangs de nyid ni/ /gegs med par yang mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i/ /sems can kun don sgru ba pa'i phyir/ /ji 1292

ltar 'jam dpal spyod mdzad pa/ /bdag sogs spyod pa'ang de 'drar shog /ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa dang / /'gro ba ji srid gnas gyur pa/ /de srid bdag ni gnas gyur te/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gang ci 'ang rung / /de kun bdag la smin gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyis/ /'gro ba bde la 'god par shog /ces gsungs te/ de yang tshigs bcad dang pos khengs skyungs shing gzhan gyi nga rgyal gzhom pa ste kha cig mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan cung zad kyis khengs te bdag ni brtul zhugs grub pa'o zhes bsnyems pa dag gzhom pa'i phyir bdag kyang sa dang po rab tu dga' ba ma thob kyi bar du gar skye yang tshe rabs dran pa dang rab tu 'byung ba kho nar gyur cig ces gsungs te slob dpon gyi ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa de lta bu mthong ba de yang 'di ltar smon lam mdzad na bdag 'dra ba lta ga la zhig snyam nas 'khor de nas dregs pa can mang po zhig 'dis btul bar gdon mi za'o/ /de bzhin du kham gyi zas la ma ltos shing sgo gsum byang chub kyi mi mthun phyogs kyis dben zhing sangs rgyas kyi rgyu'i yon tan phun tshogs 'thob pa dang / dus thams cad du 'jam dpal la sogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mi 'bral zhing de'i ngag ji lta bar sgrub pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jam dpal dang spyan ras gzigs dang kun tu bzang po dang phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha' mdzod dang / sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa'i mtshan bzung ba las de dag gi mtshan bzung ba phan yon che bar gsungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi po ye shes bla ma dang 'od kyi tog dang 1293

smon lam blo gros dang dbang po zhi ba rnams dang gzhan yang bzang skyong dang phug sbas dang 'dam bus byin la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa lnga brgya dang skyes bu dam pa bcu drug dang brgyad dang mdor na byang chub sems dpa' mthu bo che de thams cad kyi spyod pa ni re re la yang kun gyis 'jug pas na bdag kyang de thams cad kyi mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin du bdag nyid rtag par spyod pa dang spyod pa de thams cad kyang nam mkha'i mtha' ji tsam pa dang sems can gyi mtha' ji tsam pa de tsam du dus dang rgyar chad pa med pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi mdun na bdag nyid gnas te sdug bsngal thams cad sel zhing bde ba thams cad sbyin par byed pa dang bdag gi bde ba dang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal brje ba mngon sum du 'grub cing mdor na bdag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dge ba'i mthu kun gcig tu bsdoms te sems can thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar —thug gi bde ba thams cad la 'god par bsngos pa ste tshigs su bcad pa re re zhing bstan to/ /gsum pa bstan pa'i don du sngo ba ni/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs te/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa sel ba'i phyir sman gyi dam pa dang gnas skabs 'khor ba'i bde 'bras dang mthar thug gi bde ba byang chub dam pa gang las 'byung ba'i gnas ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos gcig pu kho na ste de'i phyir lung gi bstan pa sde snod gsum ni klog pa dang kha ton gyis rab tu rgyas shing mi nub la/ rtogs 1294

pa'i bstan pa bslab pa gsum ni rtse gcig tu tshul bzhin sgrub pa lhur byed pas rab tu rgyas shing de dag gi rten lung gi glegs bam dang sku gzugs dang mchod rten dang dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i gang zag chos smra bar bcas pa thams cad la yang lha rnams kyis cher bsngags pa dang me tog dang spos chu dang tsan+dana'i phye ma'i char la sogs pas mchod pa dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lto 'phye la sogs pa 'gro ba thams cad kyis mchod cing bsngags pa dang gang mi rnams kyi nang na rgyal po dang rgyal phran dang btsun mo dang blon po dang bram ze dang rgan rabs dang yul mir bcas pa dang chos 'di las phyi rol pa'i dge sbyong rnams kyis kyang gtsug tu gus par bkur zhing mchod pa'i yo byad kyi khyad par mtha' yas pas rtag tu mchod pa dang bcas te dzasbu'i gling 'di dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang lha klu la sogs pa'i 'gro ba'i gnas thams cad du yang nam yang nub pa med pas gnas par gyur cig pa'o/ /gnyis pa bka' drin dran pa'i phyag gis bstan bcos kyi mtha' bsdu ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis dge blo 'byung / /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi drin gyis bdag dar ba/ /dge ba'i bshes la'ang bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs te/ yon tan thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung bar ston pa dang byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba ni dam pa'i bya bar ston pa'i phyir dang bdag gis 'di lta bu shes so zhes nga rgyal mi mnga' ba nyid kyis de thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drin du mkhyen pas bstan bcos kyi tha mar dge bar yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ched du brjod pas 1295

bsngags pa ste/ slob dpon nyid la dge ba'i blo byang chub kyi sems dang por skyes pa dang mthar de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i bar thams cad 'jam dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs pa kho na'i phyir de nyid la phyag 'tshal ba dang / rab tu byung ba dang dge slong gi bslab pa sogs ster bas thugs kyi dge ba dar bar mdzad pa mkhan po rgyal ba'i lha la sogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la yang bka' drin dran pa'i phyag mdzad pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las sngo ba bstan pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bcu pa rnam par phye ba'o// //mjug bsdu ba/gsum pa tha mar dge ba bstan bcos kyi mjug bsdu ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa slob dpon shān+ta de was mdzad pa rdzogs so zhes mdzad byang dang / rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de wa ste thams cad mkhyen pa'i lha dang zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba bar+bhe dpal brtsegs kyis kha che'i dpe dang bstun nas zhus te 'di ni spyir chos rgyal khri srong gi dus bsgyur nas phyis mnga' bdag khri ral gyi dus gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa'o/ /slar paṇ+ḍi ta dharma shrī bha dra chos dpal bzang po dang zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba badhe rin chen bzang po dang shākya blo gros kyis yul dbus kyi dpe dang 'grel pa dang bstun te bsgyur la/ phyis bal yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kirti legs pa'i blo gros grags pa dang rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis 'grel pa dang bstun nas 'gyur bcos pa ste de re re zhing yang rgya skad 1296

las bod skad du bsgyur/ skad gnyis car du phan tshun bklags te zhus chen bgyis/ de nas bshad nyan gyis gtan la phab ste dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa ste 'grel pas kyang dpyis phyin par gtan la phab pa legs par grub bo/ /theg mchog kun las dam pa'i dam pa byang chub sems kyi bgrod pa che/ /rgyal sras kun las ches rab rmad byung zhi lha'i zhabs kyis rnam bshad gzhung / /bstan bcos kun gyi bla ma'i bla ma byang chub spyod 'jug phul byung 'di/ /rgya bod 'grel bshad kun las rmad byung mchog gi mchog tu deng 'dir bkral/ /'di ni bdag gi blo gros mthu min te/ /nyin byed mthu las pad+ma rnam rgyas dang / /nor bu'i mthu las 'gro ba'i longs spyod ltar/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i byin brlabs mthur ltos shig /rmongs pa'i mun nag ldang ba med par byed/ /mkhas rlom me khyer rnams kyi dregs pa 'jil/ /log smra mtshan rgyu'i bya rnams mi smrar 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di ni nyin byed shar ba 'dra/ /rigs chad gyur kyang dad pa'i spu long g.yo/ /srid par zhen rnams skyo ba'i gdung ba spel/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi brtse chen chags rab bskul/ /de phyir 'di ni ma la ya rlung 'dra/ /sna tshogs lta ba'i mun nag 'thibs po sel/ /dman par mos pa'i blo yi pad+ma 'dzum/ /byang chub sems kyi ku muta rgyas par byed/ /de phyir 'di ni cha rdzogs zla ba 'dra/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab chu bo mtha' dag 'dus/ /sngon med legs bshad nor bu bye bas gtams/ /zab rgyas don gyi gting mtha' mi mngon pa/ /de phyir 'di ni chu gter chen po bzhin/ /gsung rab mtha' dag kun gyi bang mdzod de/ /bstan bcos kun gyi glegs bam gcig pu nyid/ /yang dag 1297

lam ston dge ba'i bshes kyi mchog /thar 'dod rnams la skyes kyi dam pa yin/ /grags ldan mkhas pa mang la snang bzhin du/ /bskal don gyur pa'i don mchog mtha' yas rnams/ /phyin ci ma log gsal bar gtan la phab/ /'di lta'i legs bshad phyin chad 'byung bar dka'/ /deng dus bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan 'di mthong na/ /dpyod ldan snying gi zug rngu ldang 'gyur mod/ /'on kyang legs par bshad pa 'di mthong na/ /rgyal bstan slar yang byung zhes yid sos 'gyur/ /dam pa'i chos ni kun gyis bkur bya yin/ /legs bshad gang na 'jug kyang blang bar 'os/ /de bas grub mtha'i phyogs lhung rab spongs la/ /kun gyis gzhung lugs 'di la 'jug par mdzod/ /'jam mgon zhi ba'i lha yi byin brlabs kyis/ /rang byung dam pa'i chos kyi sgra ru shar/ /bdag gis yi ger bgyis pa tsam du zad/ /de phyir nongs pas gos par mi sems so/ /'dir 'bad dge ba gzugs su grub na nam mkha'i khongs mi shong / /de yi pha mtha' rgyal las gzhan gyi yul min mod/ /de nyid nges par dkon mchog gsum la rab tu dad pas dbul/ /kun nas mnyes byed mtha' yas mchod pa'i sprin tshogs nyid gyur cig /dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan/ /ma lus gcig tu bsdoms byas nas/ /thog med dus nas mar gyur pa'i/ /sems can kun la sbyin par bgyi/ /rang gis rang nyid ngal byas pa/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rab bskams te/ /gzod nas dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings/ /ji bzhin mngon du byed gyur cig /de ltar ma rtogs sems can la/ /snying rje'i rba rlabs cher g.yo bas/ /kun yang bla na med pa yi/ /theg pa che 'dir 'jug gyur 1298

cig /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kun gyi/ /smon lam kun la bdag 'jug ste/ /de kun thams cad bdag gis sgrub/ /kun gyi phrin las gcig pur shog /shākya'i bstan mchog mi nub slar yang sos/ /gdul bya'i rgyud la rab tu dar zhing rgyas/ /bstan pa'i dbyen med mthun zhing mi phyed pas/ /gangs can ljongs 'di bde legs kyis rgyas shog /gang las yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dkon mchog kun gyi ngo bor dbyer med pa/ /rigs bdag dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad la/ /bka' drin dran pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gzhung don rnam par bshad pa theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rgya mtsho zab rgyas mtha' yas pa'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni gzhung bsdus don du bcings/tshig don rags par bshad/ dka' ba'i gnas bye brag tu phye/ med du mi rung ba'i spyi'i don rnams kyang gtan la phab/ rgya bod kyi 'grel pa mtha' dag gi khyad par tha dad pa brjod/ gtso bo ra rgyal ba'i gsung rab chen po rnams dang shing rta'i srol gnyis kyi bstan bcos kho na dpang du byas/ ji ltar nyams su len pa'i man ngag gi tshul rgyud la sbyor ba kho na'i ched du rig pa'i gnas dang sde snod dang rgyud sde'i phyogs tsam 'dzin pa dus kyi dbang gis chos smra ba'i re mos su son zhing gangs can gyi dbus 'gyur tshal lha ldan gyi ljongs su byung ba shākya'i dge slong du khas 'che ba mi pham chos kyi rgyal po don thams cad yongs su grub pa ming gzhan gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i phreng ba can gyis gzhan la phan pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa kho nas gangs can gyi lho'i cha grub pa'i ri bo 'phags ma'i skur lhun gyis grub pa'i 1299

bsam gtan gyi khang bur mgo brtsams te/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bka' brgyud du grags pa thams cad kyi chu rgyun gyi 'byung gnas ri bo gangs can lta bur gyur pa/ gdan sa chen po dpal gro bo lung sras mkhar sprul pa'i pho brang / rang lo nga gsum pa me 'brug gi lo la sangs rgyas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po legs par grub pa dang lhan cig par tha skar gyi zla ba'i dkar tshes bcu gnyis kyi snga dro legs par grub pa'o/ /sems can thams cad la phan bde rgya chen po 'byung la dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /swasti/ phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas zla med pa/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo thub dbang gang de dang / /de yi bstan pa lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /ji bzhin thugs la bskrun mdzad dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag bgyi'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma ri bong 'dzin pa'i steng / /gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i blo mun rnams/ /sel mdzad 'jam pa'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi ting 'dzin gcig gi rnam 'phrul gyis/ /'gro kun byams pa che la 'god mdzad cing / /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dam par 'tsho bzhes pa/ /rgyal sras ma pham pa der phyag bgyi'o/ /theg pa mchog gi shing rta'i srol bzung nas/ /bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa yi/ /rgyal bas lung bstan 'gro ba'i bshes gcig po/ /'phags mchog klu sgrub snying po la phyag 'tshal/ /thub dbang rnams kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos ji snyed mkhyen pa'i mnga' bdag 'dren mchog gang / /thar pa'i lam ston 'gro rnams sgrol mdzad pa/ /kun mkhyen chen po zhi ba'i lha la 'dud/ /chos 1300

kun ji bzhin gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa can/ /'gro ba bu ltar skyob pa'i brtse ba can/ /thar 'dod re ba skong ba'i nus pa can/ /'gro ba'i mgon po zhi ba'i lha la 'dud/ /grangs med bskal pa rgya mtsho'i sngon rol nas/ /byang chub mchog gi go 'phang brnyes gyur kyang / /slar yang snyigs ma'i 'gro la brtser dgongs te/ /rgyal sras sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin de la 'dud/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas dpung gnyen gcig pu ba/ /don gnyis yongs su grub pas shākya'i rgyal po ji lta ji bzhin du/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i tshogs la zab mo'i chos kyi char chen 'bebs mkhas pa/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i phreng ba 'dzin der 'dud/ /chos kun sgrib bral mkhyen pa'i mkhyen pa nam mkha' lta bur yangs/ /dmigs med 'gro la brtse ba'i brtse ba chu gter lta bur rgyas/ /'gro kun smin grol sar 'god sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' che/ /lha mi kun gyi bla ma'i bla ma rgyal sras thu bo khyod la 'dud/ /mkhas mchog khyod kyi bstan bcos bstan pa'i nying khu phyung ba gang / /rin chen byang chub sems kyi 'byung gnas gcig pu zla med pa/ /thub bstan nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba 'di lta byung ba dang / /bshes gnyen dam pa'i tshogs rnams mchog gi bde bas tshim par gyur/ /des na dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /rnam 'phrul dzaspu gling gi skyes chen mchog /zhi ba'i lha dang mkhas mchog bla ma yi/ /bzhed gzhung rgyas par 'grel dang bcas pa 'di/ /rgyal bstan mi nub slar yang 'phel ba dang / /rgyal sras sems dpa'i pad tshal rgyas phyir dang / /rgyas 'grel 'di yang mang du spel bya'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje 1301

byin rlabs la brten nas/ /mi zad yi ge'i gzugs su bgyis pa yin/ /gang 'di nyes pa'i dri mas rnam dben yang / /yi ge'i lam las drangs par gyur pa'i phyir/ /de yi chad lhag nor 'khrul sel ba sogs/ /rje btsun dam pa'i spyan ras kyis btsas shing / /bdag gis phyag g.yog do dam bgyis pa lags/ /smon pa rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung ste/ /'jug pa mchog gis gnas 'dir 'bad pa la/ /thog mar rje btsun dam pas byin gyis brlabs/ /yi dam chos skyong tshogs kyis bar chad bsal/ /de yi 'bras bu deng 'dir mngon du gyur/ /khyad par mtshungs med bla ma'i thugs kyi sras mchog spyan snga ba/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dang dbyer med mkhyen pa'i rgya mtsho zab pa can/ /bdag sogs rnams kyi bshes gnyen gang des dus rnams thams cad du/ /bka' drin ches cher bstsal ba'i mthu las deng 'dir tshar phyin to/ /tshogs gnyis lhun po'i dpal gyis mngon mtho zhing / /dge legs bye ba'i sprin gyis rab stug pa/ /lho rgyud bya yul dpon sa sku mched kyis/ /rig byed mkhan gyi rdzong bkod thams cad gnad/ /gang gi mkhyen pas rje btsun dam pa yi/ /thugs kyi pad+ma 'dzum par byed pa po/ /chos kyi spyan ldan byams pa don grub pa/ /sku mched gnyis kyis bzo bo'i do dam sogs/ /'di yi phyogs su mdzad bzang grangs las 'das/ /mdor na bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal mkhar nas/ /byang chub sems ma bsod nams rgyal mo ni/ /sras bcas rnams kyis thugs bsam dag pa yis/ /'di nyid par du sgrub pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad/ /yig ris zlos gar sgyur bar byed pa po/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod tshul la gnas pa/ /gangs can 1302

g.yo ru'i rgyud du byung ba yi/ /tshe dbang brtan pa zhes bya gang de'o/ /brkos kyi rig byed rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa/ /tshe bkras dar po la sogs mkhas pa che/ /bcu phrag gcig gis dbyar lo bzhi yi bar/ /thugs bsam rnam par dag pas par du bsgrubs/ /gnas 'dir lag bde pa yi tshogs rnams kyis/ /lus sems ngal bar gyur kyang bzod byas te/ /thams cad chos dang mthun par mdzad byung ba/ /gang de don can yin no shes ldan dag /'dir 'bad dge ba mkha' ltar mtha' yas des/ /mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa mchog /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can 'di nyid/ /ji srid bskal pa'i bar du gnas gyur cig /de nyid 'dzin dang skyong bar byed pa yi/ /skyes chen dam pa ji snyed thams cad dang / /khyad par rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /zhabs pad 'gro ba'i gtsug tu brtan par shog /bslab gsum rnam par dag pas legs spras shing / /rig grol gnyis dang ldan pa'i dge 'dun gyis/ /stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di ni/ /thams cad gang zhing bstan pa 'phel bar shog /bdag gi pha mas gtsos pa'i sems can rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthar phyin te/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur du 'thob pa dang / /'gro kun sgrol ba'i mthu dang ldan par shog /bdag sogs 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyang / /rmi lam tsam gyi tshe 'di'i snang ba la/ /zhen zhing chags nas nyes ltung mi gsog par/ /ci byed dam pa'i lam du 'gro bar shog /pha ma'i rang bzhin 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir/ /byang chub bla med sgrub pa ma gtogs pa/ /rang nyid zhi bde don du gnyer ba'i blo/ /rmi lam du yang 'byung bar 1303

ma gyur cig /skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /gang nas gang du skye bar gyur na yang / /dal 'byor gnyis ldan rten mchog 'thob pa dang / /rje btsun dam pa khyed kyis rjes 'dzin shog /khyod zhal mngon sum lta ba'i skal ldan zhing / /khyod gsung nyan pa'i gdul byar gyur lags mod/ /'di dus tshe 'di'i snang bas mi slu bar/ /dam chos bsha' ma snying nas nus par shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo bla ma la/ /bzod glags med pa'i dad pa brtan pa dang / /de nyid dad nas rang sems chos kyi sku/ /mngon sum rang zhal rang gis mjal bar shog /grong yul la sogs chags sdang 'byung gnas bor/ /gong ma'i bzhugs gnas dben pa'i ri khrod du/ /mi dge'i bshes gnyen de dag mi 'byung zhing / /bsam gtan ting 'dzin gong du spel bar shog /rnyed pas bsgrubs pa'i rnyed pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /log pa'i 'tsho ba thams cad yongs spangs te/ /chog shes nor bu'i dkor mdzod la brten nas/ /byang chub sgrub la bar chad med par shog /rigs drug sems can pha ma'i 'khor lo la/ /chags sdang nye ring la sogs mi byed par/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems mchog skye ba dang / /kun bzang smon lam thams cad 'grub par shog /bdag la gnod cing sdang bar byed pa rnams/ /zhe sdang drag pos bskul bas dbang med cing / /rang la bzod pa'i bshes gnyen yin pas na/ /de la lhag par brtse ba 'phel bar shog /bdag la byams shing des par byed rnams kyang / /rnam dkar las kyi 'brel ba zab pas na/ /de dag rgyu de nyid la brten nas su/ /bla med byang chub myur du 'thob par shog /mdor na bdag gzhan sems can thams 1304

cad kun/ /chos kyi rtsa ba rgyu 'bras srog bzhin srung / /de yi ngang nas sa lam rim rdzogs te/ /dal 'byor don ldan nyid du 'gyur bar shog /de lta'i dge ba ma lus gcig bsdoms pa'i/ /mthu nus byin gyis brlabs kyi byed pa'i mthus/ /sa skyong bstan 'dzin rgyal po gang de yi/ /thugs dgongs thams cad deng 'dir rdzogs gyur cig /de yi thugs rgyud dag pa'i dbyings de la/ /nyes ltung sogs kyis gos par mi 'gyur yang / /glo bur dri mas gal te bsgribs srid na/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus/ /mun pa'i klong du nyi ma shar ba ltar/ /skad cig tsam gyis byang zhing dag gyur cig /tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib pa kun byang ste/ /rgyal sras spyod pa dpag tu med pa yis/ /pha rol phyin pa thams cad rab bgrod de/ /myur du byang chub mchog la reg gyur cig /mdor na 'dir 'bad dge ba mtha' yas mod/ /de kun bdag 'dras sngo tshul mi shes pas/ /dus gsum rgyal bas ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang de ltar yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /gnas skabs phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kun tu/ /char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /nad mtshon mu ge'i tshogs rnams kun zhi nas/ /rdzogs ldan bzhin du 'jig rten dar bar shog /dkon mchog rgya mtsho kun gyi byin rlabs dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i bkra shis kun/ /deng 'dir thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /sbyin bdag rnams kyi 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen thams cad chos dang mi 'gal bar/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par 1305

shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis bkra shis shog /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i bstan bcos kyi rnam par bshad pa zab rgyas mtha' yas pa'i snying po phyung ba zhes bya ba rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas bstsal pa 'di nyid bdag shākya'i dge slong chos rgyal bstan pa rab rgyas kyis do dam ched gnyer du bgyis te bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i slad du 'phags pa'i yul na don grub ces bya ba nyi 'og pa'i rtsis lugs las sa mo lug lor grags pa de'i dbyar lo nas par gyi dbu brtsams te rnga chen zhes grags pa chu pho khyi lo'i dbyar nang du bka' brgyud kyi chu bo ji snyed pa'i 'byung gnas rje btsun mar pa nyid kyi gdan sa chen po lho gnas mchog dpal gyi gro bo lung sras mkhar sprul pa'i pho brang sangs rgyas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dpal kurma rig 'dzin grub mchog sder par du grub par bgyis pa'o/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo rnyarma ya/ namaḥ saṅgā ya/ oṃ ye dharma hetupra bhanywa he tudhe ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba datu/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bādī mahā sham ṇa ye swāhā// //saṃgalam̐bhawan+tu// //1306

mjug gi gtam/bod kyi bcu phrag rig mdzod chen mo las bka' brgyud pa'i gsung rab pod nyi shu can tshar nyis stong par skrun gyi 'gro song khyon bsdoms sgor brgyad 'bum tsam dgos 'dug thengs 'di'i sbyin bdag gtso bo 'dzam gling rogs pa(ma022 )tshogs pa'i dbu khrid a dkon sprul sku rin po ches yig sgrig glog 'phrul ma lag cha tshang dang yi ge sgrig zhus dpe rtags sogs la sgor khri bcu gcig par du skrun byed sgor khri bcu drug dang yang bskyar khri bcu bsnan te bsdoms pas sgor sum 'bum bdun khri bzhi stong gnang / sku zhabs h+phung(༈thuza༅༅ ༅)gis sgor bzhi khri/ gzhan yang skyo brag gsal dga' rin po ches sgor chig khri/ 'dam dkar dul mo chos rje rin po ches sgor chig khri/ skyo brag a bstan phun tshogs rin po ches sgor chig khri/ go che bla ma nor lhas sgor chig khri/ maḥ thog 'brug grags rin po ches sgor chig khri/ go na dpal 'byor don 'grub kyis sgor chig khri/ zur mang bya btang rin po ches sgor chig khri/ nang chen tshong pa bkra shis nas sgor chig stong / khra 'gu kurma dkon mchog dang bla ma shākya zung nas sgor cig stong bcas kyi bka' drin stsal cing / mkhan po dpa' brtan/ sprul klu sgrub rgya mtsho dang / ber tsha bstan 'dzin yongs grags sogs che chung nor gyis rgyab skyor dang / ma phyi g.yar gnang / yi ge sgrig zhus kyi rogs ram bgyid mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhu/ da lan pod nyi shu yongs rdzogs lo ngo gnyis ring par skrun legs 'grub bya rgyu yin kyang 1307

'gro song gi thad du da dung dka' ngal che bas/ spyir rgyal bstan bshad sgru ba tu mkhyen cing chos 'byor stobs gsum ldan pa'i dam pa rnams dang /sgos su bod rang gi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sha zhen che zhing dad 'byor gtong phod ldan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis rogs ram yang yang gnang bar mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes sgrig pa po skyo brag dam chos zla ba nas phul/

sbyi'i jus 'god pa/ /rdo ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ rji ṭ+wāṃ mo/ /rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ bkra rgyal/ mdun shog mjes ris pa/ skar ma 'od gsal/lha ris pa/ be ri sangs rgyas tshe ring /par sgrig 'char 'god pa/ la ha'e yung /〈 bod kyi bcu phrag rig mjod chen mo 〉 las bka' brgyud pa'i gsung rab pod brgyad pa/lam rim/dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu sogs kyis mdzad/ mkhan po dam chos zla bas bsgrigs/par spun/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe san khang /(zi ling grong khyer than rin lam sgo ang 10)'grems spel/ sbrag ang 810001 ca kha par 6143426brgyung 'tshong / mtsho sngon zhing chen zhin hwa dpe khang /par 'debs/ lan kro'u7227par khang /deb tshad/ 850lalang11681bal 1732zlosna dī hākyā/ ṭ+wāṃ16/ 8'a/bsdob shog 5par thengs/ 2001 lo'i zla 12 par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dpar thengs/ 2001 lo'i zla 12 par dpar thengs dang po dpar/dpar grangs/ 2 000ngape rtags/ 15 3ma 7—5420—0923—073 22rin gong / sgor 43 00par gzhi 'di gar dbang bas par bshus brgyab na khrims chad phog(shog ngos chad nor slog skyon gang rung yod tshe par khang la dri gtug bya)
